[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 1[/color][/b] - Could incorrectly [b]reload Chapter 1 instead of loading Chapter 2[/b] upon completion if [b]Speedrun Mode was ON[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 1[/color][/b] - Fixed a [b]Chest containing a Lore item[/b] that could appear [b]floating in mid-air[/b] if viewed [b]too early[/b] in the Chapter.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 1[/color][/b] - Fixed a bug where the [b]auto-closing Door in the Lockdown area[/b] ([i]where the two walls and pipes explode[/i]) would [b]prevent re-entry[/b] when using [b]Hyper-Speed[/b].  
   - Now, [b]this skip is possible again[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 2[/color][/b] - The [b]secondary Jetpack[/b] (for Jetpackless runs) was [b]incorrectly present[/b] at the end lift of Chapter 2, even if the player had [b]already picked up the Jetpack earlier[/b]. This is now [b]fixed[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Upgrades[/color][/b] - Fixed a [b]localization bug[/b] for [b]Scanner Level 3[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Achievements[/color][/b] - The [b]Find all Curiosities Achievement[/b] and similar new Achievements should [b]no longer be unlocked prematurely[/b] upon collecting them all in Chapter 1.- They will now [b]remain unobtainable until all required conditions are met[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE | 0.604
notes.content:
[h1][color=#FF6666]PLEASE RESET SAVE![/color][/h1]
[quote] Please [b]reset your save[/b] with the [b]Reset Save button[/b] in the [b]Main Menu[/b], as this update has [b]many significant changes[/b] that will require a [b]fresh new save[/b] for Lore tablets to be counted properly, some [b]new statistics and Achievements[/b] to work, etc.[/quote]
[h1][color=#00FFFF]DISCORD[/color][/h1]
[url=https://discord.haze-games.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/43e4833461e439cccd325efc8e8788180cb284b1.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Join us[/b] on the [b][url=https://discord.haze-games.com]official Discord server[/url][/b] to [b]talk about the game[/b] and the [b]bugs you find![/b]

[h1][color=#00FFFF]HOTFIX 0.605[/color][/h1]
[quote][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/435410/announcements/detail/546726403014394854]Hotfix 0.605[/url][/b] was released [b]shortly after[/b] this update, to [b]address a few newly introduced bugs[/b] by this update[/quote]
[h1][color=#00FFFF]NEW[/color][/h1]

[h2][color=#00FFFF]CHAPTER 1 | NEW SOUNDTRACK + DYNAMIC MUSIC[/color][/h2]
This is a [b]significant change[/b], and long-time players [b]might have a hard time adjusting to it[/b] - but [b]we hope you'll like it![/b]  
[list]
[*] The goal is to get [b]Chapter 1's music more consistent[/b] with the style of [b]Chapter 0[/b], which better matches the direction of the PC version.
[*] Depending on the area, [b]room intensity[/b], and [b]outside / inside[/b], the [b]soundtrack will now change dynamically[/b].
[*] This should offer [b]more consistency[/b] and [b]variety[/b] across Chapter 1.
[*] It's [b]not "simply" a switch between 2 music files[/b], and uses [b]dynamic layers[/b]. Since it's a [b]complex system[/b], it's [b]prone to have bugs[/b] and issues in this [b]first version[/b]. If you encounter [b]any bugs[/b], please [b]be patient and report them[/b] :)
[*] A lot of [b]optimization[/b] was done to this system already - but as this is more [b]resource-intensive[/b], it's possible that on [b]low-end CPUs[/b], you may experience [b]audio de-syncs[/b] or other bugs. Please report them too, they'll need to be fixed.
[*] Currently, the [b]"chase" music while detected by Cameras[/b] is [b]still the same old music[/b]. It [b]will be replaced[/b] too in the [b]near future[/b].
[/list]  
[b][color=#FFA500]NOTE:[/color][/b] Currently, [b]only Chapter 1[/b] has this new dynamic music system. All other Chapters [b]will have a new soundtrack later on[/b], and [b]use this new system too[/b].

[h2][color=#00FFFF]DIFFICULTY LEVELS[/color][/h2]
First [b]prototype versions[/b] of [b]Difficulty settings[/b] have been added! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/843b07ecb414b115ce2ad3bc6782600acbe2421c.jpg[/img]
[b]HARD:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Most traps [b]deal more damage[/b].
[*] [b]Ammo Packs[/b] and [b]Health Packs[/b] never [b]respawn[/b].
[*] Health Backpack [b]does not auto-consume from inventory[/b] for [b]death prevention[/b] ([i]manual request required, but still auto-consumes when requesting to use Hyper-Speed without enough Health, but Healthpack available, or when reaching “Health Too Low” point while it is active[/i]).
[/list]  
[b]EXTREME:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Same as [i]HARD[/i], but [b]all traps are instant-kill[/b], with the exception of small damage events like [i]Generator explosions[/i] ([i]newly added in 0.604[/i]) which deal the same increased x2 damage compared to [i]Normal[/i] ([i]same as in Hard[/i]).
[/list]  
[b][color=#FFA500]WARNING:[/color][/b] From [b]HARD difficulty and above[/b]: [b]Softlocks are possible if you are not careful[/b] with Health for Hyper-Speed and Taser Energy. These are [b]intended in these difficulty settings[/b], please don't report as a bug, but maybe as a suggestion if you think an area should be modified to prevent them. For that reason, [b]only [i]Normal[/i] difficulty will be available[/b] on the first New Game run upon release, and higher difficulties will be [b]unlocked when completing the game[/b].

[h2][color=#00FFFF]OTHER NEW ADDITIONS[/color][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Manual Interaction[/color][/b] - A [b]new in-game interaction cutscene system[/b] has been added, allowing some buttons to be [b]only interacted with manually[/b] while [b]disallowing Taser shots[/b]. Some buttons already behaved this way ([i]Taser shots had no effect[/i]), but it was unclear, leading to [b]potential ammo waste[/b]. This should [b]now be clearer[/b]. In Speedrun Mode, the animation is [b]played 2x faster[/b] to prevent slowdown.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Textures Quality Settings[/color][/b] - Setting Textures to LOW [b]no longer reduces static lighting and shadow quality[/b]. Previously, this caused [b]visible “dark lines” between walls[/b]. Now, LOW textures can be used without affecting static shadows. However, this change slightly [b]increases RAM & VRAM usage[/b], so if crashes occur, consider lowering the new Shadowmaps setting.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]New Option: Shadowmaps[/color][/b] - A [b]new Shadowmaps option[/b] now controls [b]static lighting and shadows[/b] separately from Textures. Lowering this setting may [b]cause black lines between walls[/b], which are [b]not bugs[/b] but expected behavior for low settings. Reduce only if experiencing [b]performance issues or crashes[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c5138c0f73adb2ce3e7809a486a989a1b1199ad8.jpg[/img]
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]New Lore System[/color][/b] - Many new [b]lore items[/b] have been added in [b]Chapter 1[/b] with a [b]new interface[/b] to read them. More will be introduced in future chapters.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Statistics[/color][/b] - A new UI page now tracks [b]various player statistics[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/070b43b20ea5da32e3be3bcd8e6916b6a4509e9a.jpg[/img]
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Fragile Walls[/color][/b] - [b]Debris[/b] from Fragile Walls will [b]no longer prevent interactions[/b]. You can now interact with Buttons, Cubes, and Power Cores directly [b]through debris[/b]. This is unrealistic but improves [b]Quality of Life[/b] and reduces frustration :)
https://youtu.be/AsReaX5KwC4
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Fragile Walls[/color][/b] - Now easier to walk through after being destroyed by a [b]Hyper-Shot[/b]. While they are now [b]less obstructive[/b], bricks will still take time to clear ([i]intended[/i]). [b]Dodging remains the fastest method for Speedrunning[/b]:
https://youtu.be/xHwD2s5vMCg
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Fragile Walls[/color][/b] - In [b]Zero-G[/b], after being [b]Hyper-Shot at least once[/b], they can now be moved through. Previously, most debris [b]would block movement entirely[/b], even when using Dodge. Now, Dodge will work without needing extra Taser shots.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Lasers[/color][/b] - New [b]Tutorials[/b] added to [b]make it clear[/b] that [b]diagonally-placed (cross-shaped) Lasers will always kill you[/b]. Similar tutorials have been added for [b]Laser Fields[/b]. These tutorials will [b]appear only once[/b], but [b]can appear at different diagonal lasers[/b] or [b]Laser Fields[/b] in [b]Chapter 1[/b], depending on [b]which one is approached first[/b]. Not [b]all of them trigger it[/b], as it depends on whether it makes sense at that moment. This is a [b]rule in the game[/b] that must be [b]clear and consistent across all Chapters[/b]. If you [b]find any instant-kill lasers that don’t have diagonal lasers[/b], please [b]report as gameplay bugs or suggestions[/b]. [b]If needed[/b], upcoming updates may add reminder tutorials in later Chapters, if players [b]still do not understand or forget about it[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Lasers Consistency[/color][/b] - Related to the Tutorials above, many instances of [b]regular lasers being instant-kill[/b] have been removed or replaced with either [b]diagonally-crossed lasers[/b] or [b]Laser Fields[/b], depending on the situation. Some lasers are also simply [b]no longer instant-kill[/b], so you might now be able to pass through lasers that previously killed instantly if they are [b]not using the crisscross pattern[/b]. Please report any inconsistencies with this new setup:
https://youtu.be/i-gIkLR_mo0
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Explosive Pipes[/color][/b] - A new [b]explosive pipes system[/b] has been added, similar to the [b]exploding walls & pipes of Chapter 1[/b] upon returning with the Taser. In this Chapter 1 room, [b]they explode automatically[/b] due to [b]design reasons[/b] and because the player has [b]no Taser ammo[/b]. However, these new explosive pipes ([i]which will be used in various areas, including the future new ending of Chapter 1[/i]) [b]require a shot from the Taser[/b] to explode. Currently, [b]only one has been added in Chapter 3[/b], but more will come later :)
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Physics Objects[/color][/b] - New [b]physics objects / debris[/b] were added in preparation for the future [b]new Chapter 1 ending[/b]. They are used in [b]one or two places in Chapter 1[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Steam[/color][/b] - Steam is now [b]required[/b] to be running before starting the game in order to [b]report bugs[/b]. However, you [b]can still play without it[/b]. This requirement ensures security and prevents certain players’ bug reports from being posted on Discord. ([i]I’ll still receive them, and they will be posted in a private channel for moderators[/i]). Additionally, some players' [b]Leaderboard Scores[/b] are now [b]blocked from being uploaded[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Steam Cloud[/color][/b] - Fixed [b]Steam Cloud sync issues[/b] that could cause [b]saved game data to not properly sync between Windows, Mac & Linux versions[/b]. All saved data should now [b]sync correctly across all platforms[/b], allowing you to [b]resume progress on any of the three platforms[/b] :)
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Achievements[/color][/b] - Clicking the [b]Achievements[/b] button will now [b]display the Steam Overlay[/b] on the [b]Achievements page[/b]! This will show [b]many Achievements that are not yet completeable[/b]. Please [b]ignore them[/b] and [b]do not report them as bugs[/b], as they are [b]not yet implemented[/b] :)
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Achievements[/color][/b] - More [b]Achievements[/b] were [b]added for the new Lore System[/b]. Some might not be unlockable yet, as there are [b]not enough lore entries available yet[/b]. This is [b]intentional and not a bug[/b]. Additionally, some Achievements were removed and replaced with [b]incremental Achievements[/b] due to the [b]maximum number of Achievements Steam allows[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Achievements[/color][/b] - The following Achievements should now be implemented: [b]Killed by Camera, Killed by Flames, First Room Control.[/b]
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Leaderboards[/color][/b] - Every newly uploaded score from 0.604 will now [b]also show the date when the score was achieved[/b]. This is [b]timezone-adjusted[/b] to [b]always be accurate[/b] for the [b]player viewing the Leaderboard[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Scanner[/color][/b] - Can now be [b]upgraded to Level 3[/b] to help find [b]not-yet-found new lore items[/b] added in this update ([i]only in Chapter 1 for now[/i]). In addition, [b]sound effects[/b] have been added when the scanner [b]detects[/b] or [b]loses something nearby[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Tablets[/color][/b] - Tablets collectibles are now [b]split into two distinct categories[/b], with [b]different progression counters[/b] on the [b]Chapters Page[/b] and [b]Pause Menu[/b] ([i]NG+ only[/i]). This change is intended to improve clarity. Additionally, [b]regular "Information" Tablets[/b] are now the [b]only ones with the "Information" title[/b] header, and they [b]do not count toward progression[/b] at all :)
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Generators[/color][/b] - Now turn [b]orange after the first shot[/b] to indicate that a second shot may be required to break them and that the [b]first shot was successful[/b]. They also [b]now have a small screen[/b] displaying the generator's status.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Safe Landing[/color][/b] - Safe Landing Level 2 Upgrade will now show a [b]preview of what is below the player’s feet[/b]. This can be useful, once you get used to it, to [b]avoid needing to look down while jetpacking or jumping[/b], as the preview helps ensure a safe landing.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 1 | Escapism Room[/color][/b] - The button to open [b]Cage 1[/b] ([i]where the button is located[/i]) can [b]no longer be shot from a distance[/b] and now requires [b]manual interaction[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 3[/color][/b] - The door button [b]after the Leaf Bridge[/b] has been modified to be [b]protected[/b], ensuring the player understands why it [b]cannot be shot from a distance[/b]. However, once the protection is removed, it [b]can now be shot by the Taser[/b]. This change should [b]not cause bugs[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 3[/color][/b] - The [b]initializeRoom.cpp button[/b] now has a [b](silent for now) dialog[/b] to help players understand that [b]it’s not a bug that this button has strange text[/b] ([i]intended[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 3 | Bonus Room 7[/color][/b] - The [b]broken pipes[/b] through which the player must [b]shoot the switch[/b] now have [b]flames as you enter[/b] and will [b]require a player action[/b] to explode. This is to provide a [b]hint on where to look[/b], as many players [b]did not notice the crack through the pipes[/b] ([i]suggested by Chris[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Cameras[/color][/b] - Cameras will now look [b]fully “turned off” while stunned[/b]. This should make it [b]more visible when a successful shot stuns the Camera[/b]. The camera will appear [b]dark while stunned[/b], but that should be acceptable.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Cameras[/color][/b] - Destroyed Cameras are [b]now in a red color state[/b]. We’ll see if this is better than keeping them in the default blue state :)
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Cameras[/color][/b] - Shooting Camera [b]projectiles[/b] will now create [b]sparks & particles[/b] when shots hit objects, surfaces, or the player.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Audio[/color][/b] - Cardboard boxes will now have an [b]associated sound effect when burning[/b] due to colliding with Lasers or Laser Fields.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Exit System[/color][/b] - Returning to the [b]Main Menu[/b] and [b]Exiting the game[/b] now requires a [b]confirmation popup[/b]. You can now [b]Exit the game from the Pause Menu[/b] using the [b]red EXIT button[/b]. [b]ALWAYS USE THE EXIT BUTTON[/b] to [b]avoid saved data corruption[/b]. Never exit the game with [b]ALT+F4[/b] or other methods, as it may [b]corrupt your saved data[/b] if you do so [b]while the game is saving[/b] ([i]like in any other game[/i]).  
[b][color=#FFA500]WARNING:[/color][/b] If not careful, [b]100% of pre-alpha players will now exit the game by mistake instead of returning to the menu![/b] 😂
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Ultrawide Support[/color][/b] - Many visual bug fixes & improvements in the user interface for [b]Ultrawide and Super-Ultrawide[/b] display aspect ratios.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Safe Area[/color][/b] - Now supports [b]Ultrawide & Super-Ultrawide monitor aspect ratios[/b], allowing the [b]main UI to be centered like on a regular 16:9 monitor[/b]. Holding the [b]keys down[/b] now modifies the [b]safe area faster[/b]. It now [b]affects more UI elements[/b], including the menu's bottom [b]navigation bar[/b], Main Menu buttons/windows placements, etc., to [b]ensure everything looks OK[/b] on Ultrawide / Super-Ultrawide displays.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Instant Restart[/color][/b] - The [b]HOME[/b] key (by default) will now [b]instantly restart the current Chapter[/b] from the beginning when [b]Speedrun Mode is ENABLED[/b], [b]without any confirmation required[/b]. This shortcut can be [b]customized[/b]:
https://youtu.be/wqIbC9FQ6OA
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Tablets[/color][/b] - Information Tablets that [b]change from a New Game to New Game+[/b] will now allow you to [b]toggle between the original New Game text and the New Game+ version[/b] by pressing [b]TAB[/b] ([i]or D-Pad Down[/i]) while [b]zooming in[/b] with [b]Right Click[/b] ([i]or Right Stick Button[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Tablets[/color][/b] - Tablet and Encryption Key screens [b]now jitter and appear buggy while underwater[/b]. They also [b]react to Taser shots[/b] with a temporary [b]buggy screen effect[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Achievement[/color][/b] - A new [b]Achievement[/b] has been added for getting [b]past the very first blinking Hyper-Speed Lasers in Chapter 3 without using Hyper-Speed[/b] ([i]only possible after acquiring Hyper-Speed, though - intended[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Bug Reporting[/color][/b] - Reworked the [b]Bug Reporting system[/b] to be [b]much faster[/b] when displaying reports on Discord. Now, after [b]everything is uploaded[/b], the [b]bug report will appear on Discord nearly instantly[/b] instead of having a [b]5-10 minute delay[/b]. Additionally, if no errors are shown, the system should now have a [b]100% success rate[/b] when publishing to Discord ([i]previously, some rare reports could be lost in the void, though they would still reach me[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Bug Reporting[/color][/b] - Please [b]have the Discord app running in the background[/b] and [b]signed in with your main Discord account before launching the game[/b]. This ensures that [b]bug reports are linked to your Discord account[/b]. If you do not wish to have the Discord app installed or running in the background, please [b]contact me on fractal-space-chat or via DM[/b]. A new method is now available to [b]link your Discord account manually[/b] [b]without requiring the Discord app[/b] to be running.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Background Loading[/color][/b] - By default, the [b]Chapter 0 to Chapter 1 transition[/b] lasts only [b]2-5 seconds[/b] on most PCs, thanks to a [b]background loading system[/b] ([i]only used for the CH0 to CH1 transition[/i]). However, in rare cases on older PCs, this may cause a [b]crash or infinite loading after drowning[/b]. If you experience this crash, please [b]disable Background Loading[/b] in [b]Options | Accessibility[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/6f609e05f77220e0e1471636f90a1dec82dfddaa.jpg[/img]
[b][color=#FFA500]NOTE:[/color][/b] If you are [b]not experiencing these issues[/b], it is [b]not recommended[/b] to disable background loading, as it will [b]only increase the loading time[/b] for the CH0 to CH1 transition.
[/list]
[h1][color=#00FFFF]CHANGES[/color][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Reset Save[/color][/b] - Now has a [b]confirmation popup[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Hover[/color][/b] - Now [b]requires Taser Ammo to be engaged[/b]. If [b]Ammo is depleted[/b] while using [i]Hover[/i], it will [b]automatically disengage[/b]. [i]Hover[/i] will [b]not engage[/b] when aiming if [b]Ammo is at zero[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Framerate Counter[/color][/b] - Changed from [b]SHIFT+F[/b] to [b]ALT+SHIFT+F[/b] to prevent accidental activation ([i]can cause a temporary mini-freeze when toggled[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Save System[/color][/b] - Whenever an important level change happens during a [b]Checkpoint Save or Quick Save[/b], the game now performs a [b]re-save as a safety measure[/b]. Previously, this re-save process [b]could not be interrupted[/b], making saving [b]take much longer when triggered frequently[/b]. Now, if a re-save is required, it will [b]interrupt the current ongoing save[/b], making most Checkpoint saves [b]faster than before[/b] with [b]less risk of requiring an extra re-save[/b].  
  - Generally, [b]auto-save should now be safer[/b], with [b]less risk of incorrect saved states[/b].  
  - Checkpoint saving is now [b]slightly faster overall[/b].  
  - Please report if you experience a [b]strong hiccup or freeze[/b] while checkpoint saving ([i]this could affect older CPUs[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]New Game[/color][/b] - Selecting [i]New Game[/i] will now [b]reset all picked-up Recordings and Color Packs[/b] as well.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Screenshot Mode[/color][/b] - Pressing [b]F11[/b] to [b]Enable Screenshot Mode[/b] will now display a [b]Notification for 3 seconds[/b], showing the [b]shortcut to disable it[/b] before engaging. This should help players who [b]mistakenly thought it was a bug[/b] when their [b]UI disappeared[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 1[/color][/b] - The final room’s [b]first Camera patrol angles[/b] have been adjusted slightly to be [b]more forgiving[/b] when standing next to the [b]Door from which the player enters the room[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Bonus Rooms[/color][/b] - Completion state of [b]Bonus Room screen panels[/b] ([i]incomplete vs. complete[/i]) has been [b]migrated to a completion percentage system[/b]. When a Bonus Room [b]only has an Upgrade Terminal[/b], it will be [b]100% completed[/b] after acquiring the Upgrade. If there are [b]Tablets, Recordings, or Color Packs[/b] to find, the [b]completion percentage will adjust until reaching 100%[/b]. This change needs testing, as many things can go wrong :)
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Doors[/color][/b] - Many [b]regular Doors[/b] in the game were [b]not being slowed down by Hyper-Speed[/b]. [b]Only Hyper-Doors[/b] should be [b]immune to Hyper-Speed’s time dilation[/b], except for some [b]specific cases[/b] where regular Doors must [b]close faster[/b] ([i]but not open faster[/i]) with Hyper-Speed ON to [b]prevent softlocks[/b] or for [b]practicality[/b]. This is now [b]more consistent[/b] across all Chapters. However, this change [b]may have introduced new softlocks[/b] that [b]will need to be fixed[/b]—testing required.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Flames[/color][/b] - Damage over time from [b]Flames[/b] and other objects [b]did not show red screen edges[/b] while taking damage. Now, the [b]red screen effect will be displayed while being burned[/b], and [b]hurting sounds will now play every 1.5s while burning[/b] ([i]intended[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Flames[/color][/b] - An additional [b]flesh-burning sound[/b] has been added while being [b]burned by flames[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 1[/color][/b] - The dialog [i]“clumsy running around with Cubes”[/i] now [b]only triggers if you actually have a Cube in your hands[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 1 | Speedrunner[/color][/b] - Threshold reduced to [b]1:28[/b]! 🎉
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 1 | Whoopsie Area[/color][/b] - Falling into the void now displays an [b]“Imminent Death” warning[/b]. If you attempt to skip past the walls, you will now experience the intended [b]Relocation[/b] instead, depending on how far down you fell.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 2[/color][/b] - In the [b]first Zero-G scene with 2 Cubes[/b] and the [b]second Zero-G scene with a Power Core[/b], rare cases could cause [b]both Cubes and/or the Power Core to “go back downwards” after enabling Zero-G[/b]. Adjustments ensure these important objects are now [b]stabilized and remain motionless after Zero-G activation[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Taser[/color][/b] - When reloading, [b]ejected batteries are now thrown at a slower speed[/b], making them more noticeable, especially in Zero-G.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Low Fuel[/color][/b] - Now [b]only shows the LOW FUEL notification once per session[/b] within a Chapter to prevent spam. The [b]“low fuel” sound still plays every time[/b]—this is [b]intended and not a bug[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Depth of Field[/color][/b] - Depth of field is now [b]disabled when aiming at transparent Windows and Fragile Windows[/b]. This ensures that you [b]can always see the window properly[/b], as well as the [b]contents behind the window[/b]. Previously, this sometimes caused [b]blurry windows[/b] or [b]blurry content behind them[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 3 | Entrance to Vertical Room[/color][/b] - Lasers are [b]no longer force-enabled behind you[/b] as you approach the entrance of the [b]Vertical Room[/b] ([i]where you reach the large vertical moving platform[/i]).  
   - You can still [b]go back outside by dropping between the lasers below[/b].  
   - Now, [b]only the “entrance lasers” controlled by the Timer are instant-kill diagonal lasers[/b].  
   - [b]More freedom:[/b] Upon approaching the large [b]vertical moving platform inside the Vertical Room[/b], it [b]no longer locks the door behind you[/b]. This allows you to [b]backtrack more easily if you haven’t explored the Bonus Room[/b] at the top yet (outside) and are [b]curious to explore outside more[/b]. No bugs should be present.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 3[/color][/b] - The [b]first two lore tablets[/b], located right after exiting the first room and entering the secret area, now have [b]small traps in the room[/b]. Difficulty may be increased in the future.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Cameras[/color][/b] - [b]Live preview screens for Cameras[/b] in Chapter 1 are now [b]higher quality[/b], and the [i]“censored”[/i] effect on the player is now [b]more visible[/b]. Feel free to suggest other Camera feeds that should have improved preview quality ([i]only where relevant[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Imminent Termination[/color][/b] - No longer triggers any dialogs—[b]only Relocations do[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 4[/color][/b] - Fixed [b]various softlocks[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Fragile Walls[/color][/b] - Fragile wall rubble pieces will now be [b]more easily movable by shooting at them[/b]. Previously, rubble on the ground would often [b]refuse to move when shot[/b]. While this may still happen occasionally, it has been [b]significantly minimized[/b]—most shots should now [b]push rubble objects out of the way[/b]:
   - The most effective method is firing a [b]Hyper-Shot[/b], as it will [b]move more pieces away in a single shot[/b] and [b]push them farther[/b]
   - The [b]same change was applied to broken glass[/b]
https://youtu.be/zHqHj1Xd9fc
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Tablets[/color][/b] - Can now be [b]pushed by walking toward them[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Audio[/color][/b] - The [b]slow heartbeat sound[/b] ([i]low health[/i]) and [b]fast heartbeat sound[/b] ([i]low health while Hyper-Speed is ON[/i]) are now [b]significantly louder[/b]. Previously, they were barely audible. Let us know if they are now [b]too loud[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Mines[/color][/b] - The [b]center part of mines[/b], which looks like a Laser, will now [b]rotate with the mine casing[/b] ([i]intended[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Screens[/color][/b] - The [b]“buggy screen” animation when shot at[/b] has been [b]slightly improved[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 2[/color][/b] - You can now [b]take the Cube from the Roof[/b] of the [b]Big Room[/b] toward the [b]dual-moving-platforms-with-pressure-plates area[/b] :). If lost or dropped, it will [b]respawn correctly[/b] in the dual pressure plate room.  
   - Players should [b]no longer be able to softlock themselves below in the Roof area using Hyper-Speed[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 2 | New Achievement[/color][/b] - Added a new [b]Achievement[/b] for completing [b]Chapter 2 without using the Jetpack[/b] :)
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 2 | Jetpackless Run[/color][/b] - Major reworks were made to allow a [b]Jetpackless Chapter 2[/b] in an [b]officially supported way[/b]!  
   - This is [b]only possible in New Game+[/b], requiring at least [b]Dodge / Hover[/b].  
   - Most areas now feature [b]new small platforms[/b] or [b]objects to stand on[/b] to make it [b]more achievable[/b].  
   - Two [b]new optional Skips[/b] were added in Chapter 2 to [b]allow faster completion[/b] and to [b]make the Jetpackless Achievement slightly easier[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 2 | New Skip Path 1[/color][/b] - Players can now [b]skip directly inside the dual-pressure-plates section[/b] in the vertical-moving-platforms area, [b]bypassing the Big Room[/b].  
   - [b]Only available in New Game+[/b].  
   - This Skip is designed to [b]help with Jetpackless runs[/b], as it allows players to [b]climb to the top area above the Big Room using new pipes[/b].  
   - When reaching this room through the Skip, both Cubes...
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 2 | New Skip Path 2[/color][/b] - After passing the [b]first Shooting Cameras[/b], players can now [b]skip directly outside of the very first electrical water area[/b].  
   - This is [b]recommended for Jetpackless Chapter 2 runs[/b] and [b]Speedrunners[/b]!  
   - The outside vent is now a [b]locked vent[/b], based on the [b]locked status of the vent that is partially underwater[/b].  
   - It will [b]remain locked[/b] unless opened via the [b]Room Control terminal[/b].  
   - This is intended to [b]prevent softlocks[/b] when attempting a [b]Jetpackless Chapter 2 run[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 2[/color][/b] - You will be [b]forced to pick up a secondary Jetpack[/b] at the [b]end of Chapter 2[/b] if you [b]complete Jetpackless Chapter 2[/b], as it will be [b]mandatory to continue[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 3[/color][/b] - The first Hyper-Speed lasers: The objective [i]“Use Hyper-Speed to get past lasers”[/i] will now only be marked as complete if the player [b]actually used Hyper-Speed[/b]. Otherwise, the objective will be [b]red and canceled instead[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 4[/color][/b] - The very first [b]pillar towards Solar Station[/b] now has a [b]short cutscene to show it appearing[/b], as some players didn’t notice it.
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 4[/color][/b] - The [b]Sequence Room with colors[/b]: [b]Poppy[/b] has been changed to [b]Tomato[/b], as too many players were [b]unaware of what a poppy is[/b] 😢. Additionally, these hints are now [b]correctly localized[/b].
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Chapter 4[/color][/b] - Added a [b]new Checkpoint[/b] just [b]after starting the Train Ride[/b]. This should [b]reduce the chances of a respawn making you fall into the void[/b] if the Train Ride had already started while the previous Checkpoint was [b]still saving[/b] ([i]edge case due to save system limitations[/i]).
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Options[/color][/b] - Resolution now displays a [b]suffix of the aspect ratio[/b].
[/list]
[h1][color=#00FFFF]BUG FIXES[/color][/h1]
[b][color=#FFA500]NOTE:[/color][/b] Only a [b]few fixed bugs are mentioned here[/b], as I can't write a description for [i]every single reported bug[/i] that was fixed. The bot summary will contain more details about fixed bugs. 😉
[list]
[*] [b][color=#00FFFF]Relocation[/color][/b] - Player Relocation could be [b]interrupted by pausing the game[/b], causing major bugs… 😆
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c359da6380bdf27c998bba087ce418d48072c65a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/0204d4b828c75e8abbea14d75815917bb53b8881.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/306484ffd17c8041f30d3f7f80f6f2a6c982304b.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.603 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]DISCORD[/b][/h1]

[url=https://discord.haze-games.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/43e4833461e439cccd325efc8e8788180cb284b1.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Join us[/b] on the [b][url=https://discord.haze-games.com]official Discord server[/url][/b] to [b]talk about the game[/b] and the [b]bugs you find![/b]

[h1][b]UPDATE[/b][/h1]

Hello, dear [b]Fractal Space[/b] players!
New [b]PC Pre-Alpha[/b] update [b]0.603[/b] is available on [b]Windows[/b], [b]Mac[/b] & [b]Linux![/b]

[quote][h5][b]IMPORTANT: RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER[/b][/h5]
If you were [b]playing before this update[/b] and do not wish to [b]start a new game / reset your save[/b], please [b]restart current Chapter[/b] from the beginning to [b]avoid bugs[/b], [b]prevent invalid softlocks[/b], and ensure the [b]new bugfixes are correctly applied[/b].[/quote]
If you encounter a [b]major blocking bug[/b] that prevents you from finishing the game, please [b]report in-game as [i]MAJOR Bug[/i][/b] with [b]ALT+B[/b].

[b]Thank you[/b] for testing and reporting bugs!

[h1][b]CHAPTER | FIXES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Chapter 0:[/b] Objectives accomplished / new objectives were silent in CH0 intentionally, to not be too disturbing to the atmosphere. An additional change is now to only have 1 objective: “Investigate the Red Platform”, instead of first “Reach” then “Investigate”. This is to avoid disturbance too. Please let me know if you think it should be reverted or if it’s better like this ;)

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] When coming [b]from Chapter 0 to Chapter 1[/b], some objects, like [b]moving platforms[/b], some doors, vents, and other objects, could be [b]significantly darker than expected[/b]. A restart of Chapter 1 was required to fix it. It should now be fixed and be correct, even when coming from Chapter 0 to Chapter 1.

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Cannot use cables to skip the dual laser cages with 2 cubes anymore

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Added “Reinitialize Cube” button in the dual laser cages/cubes area, in order to prevent a potential softlock. This may be making this part too easy, so maybe it will be removed, if enough players suggest its removal. But maybe it will remain if we see it does indeed prevent the softlock, and doesn’t add any confusion. I prefer this rather than an auto-respawn in this case, as the auto-respawn might respawn the cube by mistake / when not necessarily desired.

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] First room: Vertical moving platform above the space gap [b]will now crush you if you stand in between the void and the ground[/b]. It will still [b]not crush you[/b] if you have [b]no ground below your feet[/b] (intended), but will do if you get [b]squashed between the platform edge and the ground[/b]. There is still [b]some tolerance[/b], if you are far away enough from the gap’s edge, you will still be [b]pushed back instead of crushed[/b] (intended)

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed visual rendering bug with windows that caused a window to be rendered on top of another window.

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused Power Core to indefinitely respawn in a loop showing Power Core Respawned, after reaching the first Zero-Gravity room.

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause [b]infinite relocation[/b] just after the first Hyper-Speed blinking lasers.

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Fixed a visual bug at the very end, that could cause some “white lines” due to the blinking lights in the corridor, when looked at from outside / above.

[*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed a rare bug that could cause the Secret Passage to be in an inverted state, blocking the player.

[*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed Hyper-Speed Suppressor sometimes not showing the “red cross” above Healthbar, meant to show that Hyper-Speed is currently unavailable.
[/list]
[h1][b]BUG | FIXES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Taser:[/b] Fixed an exploit that allowed you to control the direction of a pushed Cube by rotating the camera very fast just after a Hyper-Shot.

[*][b]Cameras:[/b] Destroying them right as they detect you, will ensure the shield is disabled (to avoid camera football)

[*][b]Moving Saws:[/b] Fixed a rare case in which Saws would [b]rotate incorrectly sideways when not needed[/b].

[*][b]Moving Saws:[/b] Moving saws, which need to [b]rotate sideways[/b], could sometimes [b]not be perfectly aligned with their moving direction[/b]. They should [b]now always be aligned in a straight line[/b] with their [b]moving direction[/b].

[*][b]Moving Lasers:[/b] Fixed remaining edge cases with Moving Lasers, which could [b]become de-synced from their intended pattern[/b]. There should not be any remaining cases of Laser movement de-syncs anymore. To be tested, though, as [b]this fix might have broken other specific cases[/b] of Moving Lasers.

[*][b]Flashlight:[/b] When triggering a cutscene with Flashlight currently ON, the flashlight will no longer move along with the cutscene camera during the transition (it will remain where it is, as intended). In addition, some cutscenes will now force Flashlight state OFF during the cutscene, and restore it after the cutscene (intended). Please [b]report as a visual bug[/b], if you see cutscenes in which [b]the flashlight should be forced-off[/b] to avoid [b]various visual bugs[/b] or [b]strange-looking situations[/b].

[*][b]Bug Reporting:[/b] Should no longer be possible to interact with objects or other actions while the Bug Reporting page is displayed.

[*][b]Bug Reporting:[/b] Video URL field could sometimes be resized to be taller than intended. Shouldn’t happen anymore.

[*][b]Jetpack Notifications:[/b] Low Fuel [b]sound and text notification[/b] system have changed. It now is as follows:
[*]  - [b]Low Fuel Sound:[/b] Played when going from "normal fuel" to "low fuel" state, with a minimum allowed interval of [b]3s[/b]. This prevents it being spammed when you are letting it recharge slightly, then using Jetpack again (avoids spamming the low fuel beep sound)
[*]  - [b]Low Fuel Text Notification:[/b] "Low Fuel" text notification when going from "normal fuel" to "low fuel" state, is now shown only [b]once per game session[/b]. This allows new players to [b]see it the first time they use the Jetpack[/b] and reach Low Fuel. Then, [b]only the sound plays[/b]. Every time you restart the game, [b]you'll see it once[/b], just as a [b]reminder[/b] of associating the notification to the sound. Then, [b]only the sound is played[/b]. This change is to [b]avoid having "Low Fuel" notification appearing too often on the screen[/b].

[*][b]Encryption Keys:[/b] Approaching a Formatting Terminal, with a [b]Power Core or Cube[/b], would play the dialog and show [b]Incompatible Device[/b] Notification, whereas this was meant to [b]only happen when approaching them with an information Tablet[/b]. Also, it used to only appear once. It will now always appear if the player approaches a Formatting Terminal with an information Tablet instead of an Encryption Key.

[*][b]Custom Resolution:[/b] The -allowCustomResolution argument to allow custom resolution, to use with -screen-width and -screen-height was [b]working correctly for most PC configurations[/b]. However, it should now also work for more specific setups and Windows versions. If you [b]still experience resolution resets[/b], please try also by adding the new -noForcedRefreshRate (but only as last resort, as it should not be needed, in theory)

[*][b]Leaderboards:[/b] Potential fix for Cycle leaderboard, which would always [b]incorrectly round legitimate scores milliseconds to 0[/b]. It should now send the [b]correct entire game duration value[/b], with correct milliseconds. [b]To be tested[/b] if properly fixed, though. To test this, make sure you [b]never enable Debug Mode in your run[/b].
[/list]

[h2]ADDITIONAL HOTFIX 0.603[/h2]
[list]
[*]Game install size on disk increased, because of a test using a different type of compression
[*]The change should significantly speed up loading times on older PCs
[*]The change should not change anything for modern/powerful PCs - it should feel the same
[*]Performance in general should be better on older PCs, same on modern PCs
[*]Chances of crashes during loading times should be reduced on older PCs
[*]This is a test, if too many players are affected negatively regarding level loading times / performance, let us know, it might be reverted
[*]Screenshot Mode: Default shortcut changed from F3 to F11 to reduce chances of mistakenly activating it
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.601 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]DISCORD[/b][/h1]

[url=https://discord.haze-games.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/43e4833461e439cccd325efc8e8788180cb284b1.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Join us[/b] on the [b][url=https://discord.haze-games.com]official Discord server[/url][/b] to [b]talk about the game[/b] and the [b]bugs you find![/b]

[h1][b]UPDATE[/b][/h1]

Hello, dear [b]Fractal Space[/b] players!
New [b]PC Pre-Alpha[/b] update [b]0.601[/b] is available on [b]Windows[/b], [b]Mac[/b] & [b]Linux![/b]

[quote][h5][b]IMPORTANT: RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER[/b][/h5]
If you were [b]playing before this update[/b] and do not wish to [b]start a new game / reset your save[/b], please [b]restart current Chapter[/b] from the beginning to [b]avoid bugs[/b], [b]prevent invalid softlocks[/b], and ensure the [b]new bugfixes are correctly applied[/b].[/quote]
If you encounter a [b]major blocking bug[/b] that prevents you from finishing the game, please [b]report in-game as [i]MAJOR Bug[/i][/b] with [b]ALT+B[/b].

[b]Thank you[/b] for testing and reporting bugs!

[h1][b]BUG | FIXES[/b][/h1]

[list][*][b]Audio:[/b] Hopefully, sometimes hearing electricity sounds in the background, should be solved. Maybe not yet fixed for 100% of cases and 100% of hardware combinations? To be tested.

[*][b]Audio:[/b] Hopefully, sometimes hearing electricity sounds for 0.1-0.5s upon respawning, should be solved. Maybe not yet fixed for 100% of cases and 100% of hardware combinations? To be tested.

[*][b]Taser:[/b] Could fire Hyper-Shot through walls, if a piece of broken glass or breakable window was the first object to be hit by the Hyper-Shot.

[*][b]Taser Ammo:[/b] Fixed a bug which could cause you to have the [b]wrong amount of maximum Taser Clip ammo after Upgrading Capacity[/b]. Starting from Chapters page should always start the Chapter with a full clip (at current max ammo value). Transitioning from a Chapter to another should continue to keep the amount of ammo of the previous Chapter.

[*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Fixed a hard crash, if you were to quick load shortly after it entered “Unauthorized Object” state, and various other textures-related bugs along with it for this situation.

[*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause Power Core to be invisible / inexistant, after a Quick Load performed just after it was “Unauthorized Object”.

[*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Could remove Power Cores from Slots, from a [i]specific angle[/i] that was [i]undesired[/i].

[*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Should now be possible to [i]insert through broken pieces of glass[/i] (could prevent it previously).

[*][b]Cube / Tablet Surfing:[/b] Recent fixes to [i]prevent Cube Surfing / Tablet Surfing was not working as intended for Tablets[/i]. Should now be [i]harder to exploit Cube Surfing / Tablet Surfing[/i], [i]even with Hyper-Speed enabled[/i]. It’s still somewhat feasible, the idea is just to make it harder to break the game by making it [i]not easy and less efficient[/i].

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] If you skip the door that closes in front of you using Hyper-Speed (red saws area just after the first lift), then enter with a Dodge from below to return back inside this room, the button to open the door will now be unavailable (intended). This makes it hard to come back out, but it’s also not intended that you re-do this from inside, once you have been past it already.

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] First Cube ever area: Could somehow skip the door closure, get back outside, and climb the wall and skip many parts. Shouldn’t be possible anymore.

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed illegal skip from roof of very first room using Hover.

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed some visual bugs when backtracking just before meant to enter the Zero-G Room.

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed being able to remain in-air during the trapped lift with saws.

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed various gaps and visual bugs.

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] It should be possible to use previous Power Cores to open the Crypto-Locator door - it used to Destroy them as you approached the Power Core Slot.

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Mysterious “saws rotated the wrong way”: Unsure if fixed, as I cannot reproduce it, but maybe it is fixed? To be tested.

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Fixed case where backtracking inside the newly re-designed room, after Crows cutscene, would cause it to re-save the checkpoint inside.

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Fixed incorrect default insertion position of Power Core protected by Camera (for the first Electrified Water area)

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Bonus Room accessible around the Sequencer Room area, could sometimes have the Cube misplaced, not on the desired button to keep the vent open, resulting in a closed vent. Should now be fixed.

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Various visual bug fixes, including some disappearing objects, etc.

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Fixed seeing noticeable missing switches when going through the Bonus Rooms and looking through the window towards the platform/cube puzzle before the electrified water.

[*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Train Ride: After passing the final saws, you **cannot backtrack anymore** *(Imminent Termination)*.

[*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Train Ride: Prevented softlock if player goes on left, then right side of the laser fields

[*][b]Mines:[/b] Mines explosion should be louder and heard better (they used to be mostly silent)

[*][b]TAA:[/b] Enabled could cause some blurriness like “motion blur through walls”	

[*][b]Custom Resolution:[/b] More small changes were made, hopefully should help avoiding reset resolutions. However, having multiple monitors connected, might be the source of the issues experienced. I think it should work fine with a single monitor, maybe having a second one and rendering on a different monitor will cause issues? To be tested.

[*][b]Error:[/b] Fixed a possible game error when very quickly requesting to restart the current Chapter, just as the game is currently auto-saving. To be tested.

[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.600 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[quote][h2]0.600 Hotfix[/h2]
This post was [b]originally written for 0.599 update[/b]. We have since then [b]released a 0.600 hotfix, which adds the following important fixes over original 0.599[/b] post below:
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Integration Fixed:[/b] Leaderboards, Achievements [b]should be working as intended again[/b]
[*] [b]Chapter 2:[/b] A level bug was causing a [b]wall to remain present[/b], blocking the player
[/list][/quote]
Hello [b]dear Fractal Space players![/b]

It's been a while - we've been [b]focusing quite a bit on Pocket Edition updates recently[/b], and there [b]were many bugs reported in latest 0.598[/b], so it was a lot of work to [b]get this 0.599 update ready![/b]

The goal of this update is mainly to [b]reach a stable point for Chapter 1 in order to update Steam Demo and Demo on other platforms[/b], about [b]a week after this update is live[/b] for the Pre-Alpha PC players.

Let's talk about the [b]major new changes[/b] in this post!

If you encounter a major blocking bug that prevents you from finishing the game, please [b]report in-game with ALT+B[/b] ;)

[b]Thank you[/b] for testing and reporting bugs!

[quote][b]IMPORTANT: RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER:[/b] If you were playing before this update and do not wish to start a new game / reset your save, please [b]restart current Chapter[/b] from the [b]beginning to avoid bugs[/b], [b]prevent softlocks[/b], and ensure the [b]new bugfixes are correctly applied[/b].[/quote]
[h1]NEW[/h1]
The [b]major new changes[/b] are discussed here.
[h2]CHAPTER 3 | Re-Design[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/624a394fd70c31b47223fa22a1af011d325e829d.jpg[/img]

The [b]first room of Chapter 3[/b] has been [b]completely re-designed and re-worked[/b] with [b]new rooms[/b]:
[list][*]You should [b]no longer be able to skip past the first Crows cutscene[/b].[/*][/list][list][*]There is now also [b]new optional/secret area here[/b], but we will let you find it for yourself :)[/*][/list][list][*]You [b]can no longer simply Jetpack to the first platform when getting out of the first room[/b], in [b]NG with Jetpack Level 1[/b] - you’ll need to deploy additional platforms.[list][*]These platforms are [b]optional from Jetpack Level 2[/b], or from [b]Jetpack Level 1 + Sprint[/b] [i](intended)[/i].[/*][/list][/list]
[h2]CHAPTER 2 | Even More Freedom[/h2]
Update [b]0.598 introduced more freedom[/b] for the player to [b]explore the outside of the station[/b], after going out from the[b] first electrified water vent[/b]. It has now [b]been improved even more[/b], by [b]giving that same freedom, from the moment the player acquires the Jetpack![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/d5d5b322be2cbddb6e5507ea7807ec345b196ac1.jpg[/img]
[quote][i]"With [/i][b]more freedom[/b][i], comes a great chance of [/i][b]introducing game-breaking bugs[/b][i]. To be tested!"[/i][/quote]
[h2]SAW | Sparks[/h2]
[b]Saws[/b] now have [b]new particle effects[/b] to show [b]sparks![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a830071fcd866b9695b355bbae4b336593028de9.jpg[/img]

They also have [b]physics collisions.[/b]

[h2]INTERACTION | Fixes[/h2]
After the [b]major interaction rework[/b], that was then added to [i]Pocket Edition[/i] as well, interactions were [b]more precise and most bugs related to them were fixed[/b]. In addition, interaction with [b]a specific object when multiple ones were present[/b], was made [b]much easier and more intuitive[/b].

However, a consequence was that [b]interacting required the player to look more precisely at objects[/b], even when there was [b]only 1 interactive object available[/b]. Some precision is [b]still required when there are multiple interactions available[/b], but most cases will now be [b]much more tolerant of where the player is looking at[/b], than the previous update [i](more radial interaction)[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/3c56cc9477f926bd9b396b1bbd47cef8c7d7dbcb.jpg[/img]

In addition, the [b]new interaction changes had[/b] [b]broken a previous system:[/b] preventing [b]picking up / dropping Cubes or Power Cores[/b] [b]through Laser Fields and vent grids[/b], etc.

This made some [b]previously-impossible softlocks possible again in 0.598[/b].

It should now be [b]working as intended again[/b], with [b]some Laser Fields / Vent grids / small bars[/b] in vents, now [b]preventing you from dropping/picking up “through them” again[/b] [i](as it was, prior to 0.598)[/i].

[h2]LEADERBOARDS | Improved[/h2]
This update required a [b]FULL RESET of all Leaderboards[/b]. This is because [b]new features to leaderboards were added[/b], which made them [b]not retro-compatible[/b]. Further changes should [b]not require Leaderboards reset anymore[/b].

Not only does leaderboards now [b]fully support MILLISECONDS[/b] [i](even though they are not displayed in-game to avoid distraction of fast ms change)[/i], but you [b]can now hover any Leaderboard entry[/b] to get [b]more statistics about the player’s run![/b]

Stats are [b]per-Chapter[/b] for this run, except for [b][i]Cycle[/i][/b], in which it’s the [b]accumulated for the entire [i]Cycle[/i][/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/b39ae77890310b9eed176461ad84fc4596989f9b.jpg[/img]

Obviously, this is a new feature, and [b]requires some testing to validate all stats are correct[/b] [i](we have tested, they seem OK :) )[/i]

[b]Navigation has also been improved[/b] on [b][i]Leaderboards [/i]page[/b]. In addition to being able to [b]navigate the Leaderboards Page with keyboard / gamepad[/b], you can now [b]also browse through entries / scroll[/b] using [b]keyboard arrows[/b] to see [b]more info about other player’s scores[/b]. Mouse [b]scroll wheel[/b] also works.

If you are using a [b]keyboard or gamepad[/b], when changing Chapters, while looking at [b]Top 50 / Top 100[/b], it will automatically select ranks [b]10 and 50 respectively[/b] after loading the scores. This is to [b]avoid scrolling down[/b] the first 10/50 scores when looking at Top 50 / Top 100, because these first 10/50 can already be seen in Top 10 / Top 50 respectively.

[h2]BUG REPORTING | Improvements[/h2]
Various [b]improvements were made to the bug reporting system.[/b] It's possible that the first bug reports you send will [b]not appear on the Discord server just yet[/b], because [b]there were changes to the syntax and how they are sent[/b], that will [b]require some changes from the Discord server's side[/b].

However, [b]we should be receiving all bug reports correctly even if they do not appear on Discord just yet[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/b3623c22a1cb853bd641fce24c4f5c239fcfe378.jpg[/img]

We also made these changes in order to [b]ensure that we would still receive all bug reports even if the Unity side of the system would fail[/b], like it did [b]during approximately 2 months[/b] [b]when 0.598 was released[/b].

Here's an overview of the new changes to the bug reporting system:
[list][*][b]Categories:[/b] Many new categories were added. This will make it much easier for us to filter / prioritize bugs and ensure Nitpicks don't slow down the development's process by requiring to be fixed now as they were same priority as "Gameplay Bugs". Please [b]make sure you select the appropriate category[/b] for each reported bug. Thank you![/*][/list][list][*][b]Video Link:[/b] A [b]new field for Video link was added![/b] Bug reports [b]are always much better with video[/b] links if possible :) Whenever you have a [b]video available[/b], please [b]copy/paste the link in the video field[/b], it will make it [b]much easier for us to access it[/b] instead of having it directly in the description. Thank you![/*][/list][list][*][b]More details:[/b] The bug reporting system will now [b]provide more details to the Discord server.[/b] Once the Discord server code has been updated to receive the new bug report information, it will be [b]possible to show a few more stats on the bug report entries[/b] on the server.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Longer storage:[/b] We used to only have 2 months to fix a reported bug. This was really impractical, because many minor bugs or nitpicks could wait for a future update instead - but if we did wait, we would lose all the data from this bug. We will now be able to keep them for much longer in order to push back minor bugs to future updates.[/*][/list][list][*][b]More stable:[/b] Various edge cases that caused bug reports to fail to upload were fixed. You will still have failures in some cases but the retry should be OK. If after 3 or 4 retries you still can't upload a bug, please [b]temporarily disable your firewall and antivirus and try again[/b].[/*][/list][quote]Reporting a bug [b]will still take time[/b], and the [b]Discord upload will look like it froze on 0% for a while.[/b] This is [b]normal[/b]. We are planning to [b]change the Discord screenshot upload server in a future update[/b], to [b]greatly increase the speed of this step[/b] in the near future.[/quote]
[h2]SAVE BACKUPS[/h2]
The game now makes backups of the [b]save game regularly[/b], mostly [b]every time the game is paused[/b]. If later on, the saved data file gets [b]corrupted or deleted[/b], the player [b]will now be informed when starting the game[/b].

A popup will now allow to either [b]start a fresh new save[/b], or [b]use the latest backup[/b] [i](if available)[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/d6dbac5f4eff05ba3dd3e12c7a066faabc5374a2.png[/img]

This is different from save game compatibility after a major game update. There will be a [b]separate system to warn players about their potential saved games incompatibility in the future[/b], encouraging them to restart the current Chapter, if it was affected.
[quote] This is [b]only for data corruption of the main save file[/b]. If a level checkpoint auto-save or quick-save is corrupted, it should result in [b]automatically restart the Chapter from start[/b]. But in case of [b]main save file corruption[/b], this backup popup window system should [b]at least allow players to resume their last checkpoint[/b] [i](if last checkpoint file itself is not corrupted)[/i], or [b]resume from the beginning of the Chapter[/b] they had reached [i](which is still better than starting from Chapter 0)[/i][/quote]
[h2]CUSTOM | RESOLUTION[/h2]

[quote]This is only for [b]very specific edge-cases[/b] in which players need to use a [b]specific, non-standard resolution[/b], that is [b]not listed[/b] in the resolution options list.[/quote]
If you wish to use a different resolution than the one [b]officially supported by your monitor[/b], you now can make sure it works by using [b]-allowCustomResolution[/b] launch parameter on [i]Steam[/i].

If you use this, please make sure you add new add this new [b]-allowCustomResolution[/b] as well, when using [b]-screen-height[/b] and [b]-screen-width[/b] to [b]force a specific resolution[/b].

This new parameter will [b]disable all resolution fallbacks and resetting of the game[/b], to [b]avoid overriding your custom resolution[/b], even [b]when requesting to change graphics options[/b].

[quote]This means [b]the Resolution popup list[/b] will be [b]completely ignored[/b] when using this argument![/quote]
[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
Below are described the [b]important changes[/b] from this version:
[list][*][b]Dodge:[/b] Upgrades were a bit overpowered. Slightly modified the Dodge upgrades. Level 3 is no longer 0.5 seconds, but now 0.8s recharge time.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Respawn Spam Protection:[/b] Increased the respawn spam protection delay to 0.8s. This means that, if you die, with a Quick Save available, the game will ignore SPACE / LMB for 0.8s to prevent reloading the last checkpoint, in case you in fact wish to use F9 to load your Quick Save instead.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chests:[/b] The newly added chests in 0.598, will now [b]unlock faster after shooting the associated generators[/b]. The bug in which they remained in locked state after destroying their generators, could [b]not be reproduced[/b], though. Please keep an eye on it, and [b]report with a video for more specific steps on how to reproduce this bug[/b]. Thank you![/*][/list][list][*][b]Interaction:[/b] New interaction rework made it sometimes hard to pick up / interact with objects if a piece of broken glass was in the way. Broken glass pieces should no longer be a problem for interaction with objects, nor with picking up objects ;) This may have introduced new bugs, to be tested.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3 Double Cubes / Timed Boxes:[/b] At the beginning of Chapter 3, once you had placed both Cubes on the Pressure Plates to open the horizontally-placed door by taking Cubes from the Timer Boxes, it [b]used to lock the Pressure Plates to Red state[/b], and the [b]door you come down from would close[/b]:[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/f4004cde7effb96ebea242a377ce859816cf8de4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]This was [b]originally designed to avoid various bugs[/b] in earlier versions of the game. It has now been changed to [b]not do any of these things[/b]. You can then [b]continue having fun opening the door / timed boxes as much as you want[/b], before activating the platform with the far-away large button, and no bugs should occur. There will later on be an achievement planned here for some fun action to do, but it’s [b]not implemented yet[/b]. [b]This change should be tested for bugs[/b] :)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3 Large Button / Fast Platform:[/b] The big button to shoot for the fast Transport platform, just after the area mentioned above, has now been [b]changed for you to be able to return to it after reaching the other side[/b] of the Transport. It will [b]no longer relocate you[/b]. There is no purpose in backtracking here at this time, but this change was simply made to allow curious players to return there [b]safely without encountering weird bugs[/b] ;) In addition, there is [b]no longer a relocation if you fall from the transport platform[/b] - death is upon you in this case (intended). If you jetpack out of the level bounds, you will [b]no longer relocate at the end of the Transport[/b] platform path [i](it was a skip)[/i]. If you miss the Transport platform path [i](by jumping off it)[/i], you will need to reach the other side using the Jetpack (it’s possible by landing on the pipes on the wall in front). You cannot backtrack to that area again, once you have approached the Tower area [i](intended, like before)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3 Musical Hack - Hard of Hearing:[/b] In case some players might have missed that in an earlier changelog, or if I forgot to mention it: This puzzle [b]was too hard for most players, and couldn’t find the combination once it was changed to not fail on every mistake[/b] [i](it was only doing so with Hard of Hearing enabled)[/i]. So, it was changed back to [b]always fail on the first mistake[/b]. This was changed because of [b]too many reports of players not finding the solution[/b]. It will maybe be re-introduced later, but only [b]if the player selects a harder difficulty setting[/b]. Then, the [i]Hard of Hearing[/i] option, will [b]override this specific puzzle to keep current behavior even on Hard difficulty[/b] [i](and other potential / future audio puzzles will be adjusted too)[/i]. So, it means that currently, [b][i]Hard of Hearing[/i] option no longer has any effect[/b] [i](intended)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Jetpack Balancing:[/b] Jetpack regular [b]cooldown[/b] before recharging fuel has increased from [b]0.3s to 0.5s[/b]. If Jetpack fuel becomes empty, [b]penalty Jetpack cooldown[/b] before recharging has increased from [b]1s to 1.2s[/b]. This is to compensate for the fact that from recent updates, Jetpack is now much faster to provide the [b]first 3s rise[/b] - so it became much easier to exploit it and remain for a very long time in-air, without having to worry about Fuel. [b]Zero-G boost[/b] remains [b]unaffected by these changes[/b] and is [b]faster to recharge[/b], and has [b]no empty penalty cooldown[/b] [i](intended)[/i]. If this change breaks too many speedrun strats, please report a suggestion with a video of the strat, we’ll see if we can fine tune it to still keep it.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Relocation:[/b] It is fully intended that you cannot drop your current object, or pickup any other item, while the Relocation is active. This is to make the game safer, and avoid the player dropping important objects inside a non-reachable area. It also prevents the player from picking up items that should not be obtainable at this moment in the game. However, trying to pickup an object during relocation would display “Cannot Drop Here”. It now shows the appropriate message.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Dropping Objects:[/b] Changed to have [b]higher velocity from the player[/b], when [b]dropping objects while moving[/b]. This [b]reduces the chances to “bump” into the Tablet / Power Core dropped while moving forward[/b]. However, when you are [b]moving slowly[/b], or [b]stopped actively requesting movement[/b], velocity transferred is now reduced, to [b]avoid “throwing the dropped object forward”[/b] while you are currently stopping [i](could be irritating)[/i]. You can still do so if you request to drop while still requesting movement, and stop requesting movement just after the drop request. But this is acceptable, as you are, in fact, moving, so it is natural that the object is “thrown forward”. It simply happens less frequently by mistake.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Now held [b]a bit further away from the player[/b]. This is to [b]avoid bumping too much into it when dropping it while moving[/b]. You may still bump it while [b]high-velocity sprint[/b]s, but that’s acceptable.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Core Slots:[/b] Power Cores are now [b]inserted “further away inside” Power Core Slots[/b]. This is intended to ensure they don’t “stick out” too much from the front. They are now less problematic to the player, as [b]they will no longer “push the player backwards” when inserting them while being very close to the Power Core[/b] Slot. Or when it still happens, it’s only “slightly” [i](while in Zero-G)[/i] and [b]acceptable[/b]. In addition, this now makes it[b] harder to “climb on them” while inserted[/b] [i](intended)[/i]:[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a538079d6da694989553023c24577e829464c3de.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Thresholds:[/b] Chapter 2 leaderboard threshold is now 3:00[/*][/list][list][*][b]Destructible Walls:[/b] Broken pieces of Destructible Walls had[b] very fully-black edges & border[/b]s. They should now [b]look more normal and react more normally[/b] [b]to lighting[/b] changes.[/*][/list]
[h1]LEVEL FIXES[/h1]
Below are mentioned the [b]important level bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed “pure black” borders on obstacle crates in the Camera room at the end of the Chapter.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed OOB when being pushed towards the wall using the moving platform in the room with the very first Camera ever. It should now be harder to get pushed through the wall, and if it happens, the player will die (intended, appropriately squashed).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed some “purely black” moving platforms, and some platforms that were being rendered incorrectly and too dark.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed a few pipe collisions with the new “Cozy Den” area of the first electrified water room.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed various bugs related to the “more freedom” approach of Chapter 2, which included missing objects and not-yet active traps.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed a possible trigger skip in the first Shooting Cameras room, when entering, that could cause multiple other bugs. Should not be skippable anymore by “hugging the wall”.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] “Roof” slow inoffensive smasher will now close down much faster, to prevent you from squeezing through while it’s closing. It will also now only close behind you a bit later, as you get past the second laser field.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed OOB by backtracking and seeing the door still open if you skipped a trigger, where you press the initializeRoom.cpp button (thanks Latte).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed some cases in which the “Set all Solar Panels in Sunlight” would not accomplish correctly even if the puzzle was completed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed some misplaced buttons in some vents[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed some missing mines towards the end, that seemed to have been triggered by a ghost :)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed a bug when you were standing on a retractable, you could get pushed through the ceiling of the vent. Player character should now be killed, as intended.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Some optimizations were made to texts in all Chapters in 0.598. This broke some Timers screens in Chapter 4 that were now displayed too big.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Train area: fixed a bug that caused a Power Core to be respawned when removed or re-inserted in the Power Core Slot.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed various visual glitches [i](blinking walls, blinking vent entrances, etc.)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed various softlocks in the very last room. Laser Fields in the last room now respawns Power Cores to prevent softlocks.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] The Processing Center could have strange, deadly respawn points for some checkpoints in specific cases. Should now be fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Processing Center giant crushers should now kill the player more often, when squashed against vents, like the one towards generators / maintenance, etc. In addition, lower FPS now has much less chances to push the player to clip into the Bonus area / outside (will die more often instead)[/*][/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
Below are described the[b] important general bug fixes[/b] [i](many more in the full changelog below)[/i]:
[list][*][b]Buttons:[/b] Fixed a rare bug that could cause button states to become invalid and break some areas, thanks to Latte’s discovery[/*][/list][list][*][b]Pressure Plates:[/b] Fixed a Game Error when dropping Power Cores / Tablets on Pressure Plates[/*][/list][list][*][b]Pressure Plates (Player Activated):[/b] Will now correctly push up / down the objects dropped on them, as they move up and down [i](objects used to clip through them)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Cameras:[/b] A new bug allowed Cameras to revive after being destroyed. This was fun, honestly, should probably have remained - but should be fixed :D[/*][/list][list][*][b]Vibration:[/b] Many fixes were done to gamepad vibration: sudden vibrations stop while using jetpack should now be fixed, and Sprint vibration should now resume correctly after jetpacking. In addition, sprint vibration should be paused while jumping and resume when on the ground again (intended)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Heal / Damage Effects:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused them not to be displayed correctly during Chapter 1, after coming from Chapter 0.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Hover:[/b] Fixed a new bug with latest changes, that caused to [b]fall down rapidly for 1s[/b], if you were to [b]engage Hover instantly after requesting a vertically-upwards Dodge[/b] [i](without prior Jump / Jetpack in the sequence)[/i]. Hover engagement should [b]feel smooth and working as expected in all combinations[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Sprint:[/b] Fixed bugs that allowed Sprinting in mid-air, if the key was [b]sprint was pending[/b] before falling [b]while in crouched stance[/b], or if [b]key was held[/b] while [b]jumping in place[/b] from a [b]crouched stance[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Bug Reporting:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused the bug reporting window to not react to user input, when reporting a bug in Chapter 1, after coming from Chapter 0.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Propellers:[/b] Fans could be bugged after quick load / quick save and could be incorrectly stopped / turned on when they shouldn’t be after loading. Audio could sometimes continue when they were off.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Encryption Keys:[/b] Changing language should now properly update the Encryption Key’s language instantly.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Dodge:[/b] Fixed exploit which allowed to have infinite Dodge when trigger cutscenes after Dodging (while still in-air). To be tested for potential new bugs related to this fix.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Mines:[/b] A new bug from 0.598 was causing Mines to react [b]as if you had detonated them by direct contact[/b], when you [b]pushed a Power Core to the Mine Beam[/b]. This bug could cause you to [b]be damaged from very far away[/b] when pushing Power Cores into the beam from a distance. Should now work as intended again.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Cores / Cubes:[/b] A new bug allowed the player to drop and pick up Cubes / Power Cores behind areas that shouldn’t allow it [i](through Laser Fields, vent grids, small gaps, etc)[/i]. It should now work as intended.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Core Slots:[/b] New interaction rework changes introduced a new bug that allowed the [b]insertion of Power Cores / Tablets through walls[/b]** and windows. Should now be fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Inserting in Zero-G could provoke Power Cores to flip 180 degrees visually before inserting. This should now be fixed in 99% of cases. It could still happen, but if you manage to, please report the repro steps as visual bug, as it should now be rare and considered minor or nitpick, and would need precise reproduction steps to be fixed. Thanks![/*][/list][list][*][b]Saws:[/b] Most of the time, Cubes and Power Cores are pushed away correctly by Saws. Only very fast moving saws, while Hyper-Speed is disabled, can cause strange bugs when pushing them. From now on, some very-fast moving saws will selectively respawn Cubes and Power Cores, when Hyper-Speed is disabled.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Damage:[/b] Lasers and Saws will now have the same delay between hits, when Hyper-Speed is ON or OFF. It used to allow longer invincibility time between hits in Hyper-Speed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Terminals:[/b] Will now react and glitch when shot at with the Taser :)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Timers:[/b] Fixed an exploit that could reset speedrun timers to 0 when quick loading during the final end of chapter fade-out.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Cores:[/b] They should no longer go through windows when thrown fast vertically from above (using Hyper-Speed + Dodge downwards, kinda Latte’s trick :) )[/*][/list][list][*][b]Screenshot Mode:[/b] Enabling Screenshot Mode with either the Options menu or F4 Shortcut, will now hide the FPS counter, and display it again it was meant to be ON originally[/*][/list][list][*][b]Screenshot Mode:[/b] Its state is now saved when using the Shortcut, to be kept in sync with the checkbox in the Options[/*][/list][list][*][b]Audio:[/b] A new bug could cause undesired sound effects to be played upon respawning [i](electrified water sound, for example)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Audio:[/b] Colored Pressure Plate won’t make the “pressed down” sound if you walk on it multiple times while it’s already being pressed down with Hyper-Speed enabled [i](thanks Latte & ChrisLP!)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Audio:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause music to play, when music volume was set to 0. This might still occur in some remaining rare cases. Please report as Audio bug, if it occurs again, with as much info as possible on what happened previously, as these are generally very specific.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Screens:[/b] Fixed various bugs with signs / screens, which could cause some screens to not show their associated texts after quickload sometimes, or vice-versa, showing them when they should be OFF. Keep an eye out for new bugs with them, though ;)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser:[/b] Fixed a bug that showed “Switch” on the Taser screen, while in fact, aiming at a regular non-interactive Laser.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser:[/b] Shooting at buttons would make the shot’s shadows show some incorrect shadowing (lighting was “going through the button”). It is now more accurate. It can still happen in some angles, but it’s now much more rare.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Menu:[/b] Fixed a “tiny crack” in the Main Menu area[/*][/list][list][*][b]Cables:[/b] Collision bugs with the new hanging cables prevented you from shooting through them. Now fixed and working as intended ;)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Return to Menu:[/b] Quick loading while the game is returning to the main menu (after completing Chapter 4) is no longer possible.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Performance Guide:[/b] Button now correctly localized[/*][/list][list][*][b]Reported Bugs:[/b] Many more [b]in-game reported bugs[/b] and suggestions implemented.[/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update over the next few weeks for the next bugs[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.598 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, [b]dear players![/b]

The new [b]update 0.598 is now LIVE on Steam for Pre-Alpha testers![/b] It includes [b]over 100 reported bug fixes[/b], [b]many gameplay and Quality of Life improvements[/b], and a [b]full Lighting & Static Reflections rework![/b]

Once it has been tested for major issues in [b]Chapter 1 New Game[/b], we will [b]update the Steam Demo[/b].

If there are [b]only minor bugs, or major bugs exclusive to New Game+[/b], [b]or later Chapters than [i]Chapter 1[/i][/b], [b]a hotfix update will be made in 1 or 2 weeks[/b], but the [b]Demo will still be updated before that[/b] [i](if these issues do not impact Chapter 1 New Game)[/i].

In this post, we'll talk about the major changes that were done for this [b]0.598[/b] update!

[quote]The reason why [b]players awaiting for Steam keys have still not yet received them[/b], is because [b]we have run out of Steam keys and have reached the authorized limit[/b].

We will be [b]migrating the game to the [i]Steam Playtest[/i] system to override this limit[/b]. This will likely [b]change the way you access the Pre-Alpha[/b], [b]even for existing Pre-Alpha testers[/b].

We will keep you updated on [b]when and how this migration[/b] will take place.[/quote]
[quote]Once this update is [b]stabilized for the first major bugs in Chapter 1 New Game[/b], and the [b]Demo is safely updated on Steam to 0.598[/b], we will take some time to [b]work on a maintenance update for the Pocket Edition[/b]. It will include [b]many bug fixes [/b]and some [b]first visual improvements[/b].

We'll keep you posted on that, but[b] you can expect a BETA very soon![/b][/quote]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
First, we'll [b]highlight below the most important new elements[/b] from this update.

[h1]LIGHTING | Rework[/h1]
One of the [b]major changes[/b] for this update, that took a long time to implement, is a [b]full rework of the lighting system[/b].

The impact [b]may not be noticeable to all players[/b], but the decision to rework this [b]came from the following reasons:[/b]
[list][*][b]G.Round Playtest[/b] was [b]very positive[/b], but the [b]most frequent complaint[/b] was that the [b][i]"Flashlight was too bright and hurt the eyes"[/i][/b][/*][*]Some areas had [b]lights with too strong intensities[/b], which could be [b]a strain on the eyes as well[/b][/*][/list]
As a result, in general, [b]the following changes can be noticed:[/b]
[list][*]All [b]shaders and textures[/b] of the game [b]have been modified[/b], in order to [b]less exaggerate the [i]"lighting highlights"[/i] from objects[/b], and have a [b]more neutral rendering[/b]. This was the [b]main source of the issue[/b], as having a [b]light source next to an object or flashlight[/b] would result in [b]very strong metallic highlights, that could be a strain on the eyes[/b][/*][*][b]Every single light [/b]in the game has been [b]manually re-balanced[/b] to [b]avoid being too bright[/b][/*][*]All [b]textures and shaders[/b] are [b]now slightly darker[/b], which means that [b]in general, the game feels darker in many areas[/b] [i](lighting highlights are no longer / much less exaggerated)[/i]. Many [b]more lights were added to counter-act this[/b] in some areas.[/*][*][b]Extremely bright/white metallic highlights[/b] are [b]greatly reduced to avoid strain on the eyes[/b] [i](door frames, cube frames, vent walls, etc.)[/i]. They [b]still remain, to give a metallic feel[/b], [b]but are less exaggerated[/b].[/*][*][b]Grounds and ceiling [/b]tiles are now [b]slightly darker[/b], which [b]adds contrast[/b], and [b]reduces the over-bright lighting in many areas[/b].[/*][*][b]White pipes [/b][i](ones attached to various fans)[/i] are now [b]much less reflecting white/bright colors[/b], meaning they will have [b]less situations in which their lighting is [i]"too bright”[/i][/b] because of a nearby light. They also now [b]feel more metallic[/b] with a [b]real-time light source nearby[/b].[/*][/list][quote]Below are [b]a few screenshots to illustrate these differences mentioned above[/b][/quote]
[b]Door / Vent Frames | OLD:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/8b0a3c178f4014d3f30988c6516fa61d4c0014bd.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.597:[/b] Door and Vent frames were[b] often very white when lit by any lights, especially the flashlight[/b][/i]

[b]Door / Vent Frames | NEW:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a65330c33c054be7832d97419507493ae21ecde7.jpg[/img]
