[i][b]0.598:[/b] Door frame is now still metallic, but is [b]no longer purely white[/b] [b]even with flashlight[/b]. [b]Bloom [/b]is less intense.[/i]

[b]Cube Borders | OLD:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/52c2f0a695f40f30dfe7f488ed239c0e302065cc.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.597:[/b] Cube [b]borders / edges[/b] were reflecting[b] extremely bright white light[/b][/i]

[b]Cube Borders | NEW:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/b5c5f3981fc5cbce22543f2503f0edc963941bd8.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598: [/b]Cube borders [b]are still highlighted[/b], but [b]more realistically[/b], [b]less exaggeratedly white [/b]even with [b]flashlight active[/b][/i]

[b]Inside Vents | OLD:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/afe7f6db883644ccbd674d24a1829088ea1f516e.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.597:[/b] Vent [b]walls[/b] were [b]reflecting a lot of white lighting [/b]- could be [b]blinding[/b][/i]

[b]Inside Vents | NEW:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/ebfe63d1b984a98744db4c7568c1e18215d5cd7c.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598:[/b] Vent walls are [b]reacting more realistically to reflected light[/b], and [b]less blinding[/b]. You can actually see the light source.[/i]

In addition to the [b]lighting system rework[/b], here are [b]a few new changes worth noting related to it[/b]:
[list][*]Shooting a [b]dynamic light[/b] [i](not static lights)[/i] with [b]Hyper-Shot[/b] will now [b]completely turn it off forever[/b]. Later on, [b]a light destruction effect will be added[/b] [i](not yet implemented)[/i]. In addition, [b]regular shots and Hyper-Shot will now also reduce the associated reflections[/b] to make the area significantly darker [i](as it should, because less light present means less visible reflections)[/i].[/*][*][b]Bloom [/b]has been [b]reworked to be less intense[/b] than before, to[b] avoid overbright areas with some lights[/b]. In addition, [b]many lights in all Chapters [/b]were changed to be [b]less intense[/b], in order to [b]avoid overbright areas[/b] next to them.[/*][/list][quote]Now that the game is [b]less blinding[/b], and [b]more realistic[/b], we will [b]likely add a few more highlights in the future[/b], but they will remain [b]less intense[/b] and [b]not on large surfaces[/b].[/quote]
[h1]WHITE REFLECTION CIRCLES[/h1]
Another [b]major improvement which the Lighting Rework allowed to achieve[/b], is to [b]significantly reduce the presence of the [i]white reflection circles[/i][/b], that you may have noticed on the grounds and ceilings.

In reality, these [b]need to be somewhat present[/b], to be [b]accurate and provide a metallic feel to surfaces[/b].

However, [b]before this update[/b], they were [b]extremely strong[/b], [b]very large[/b], and [b]present in every single area of the game, and on every object[/b]. This could be [b]too disturbing and a strain on the eyes as well.[/b]

From this update, the [i][b]white reflection circles[/b][/i] [b]are now:[/b]
[list][*][b]No longer present on all surfaces:[/b][*]Some grounds/ceilings [b]do not have them[/b], when they are [b]too distractin[/b]g[/*][*]When present, they are [b]significantly smaller than before and less distracting[/b][/*][*]They are [b]less intense[/b], which [b]avoids the strain on the eyes[/b][/*][*]They have [b]a grain/stained effect[/b], instead of a [b]perfectly white circle[/b][/*][*]They are [b]no longer present on many other object types[/b][/*][*]The flashlight’s [b]light reflection[/b] [i](or any other light source)[/i], will [b]no longer result in a big white circle[/b] when [b]reflected in the windows[/b] and other objects. It is now a more diffused, larger reflection highlight from the light source across the window, avoiding to be a [i][b]“too bright white reflection circle”[/b][/i].[/*][/list][quote]Below are a few [b]example comparisons from 0.597 / 0.598[/b] to see the differences [b]with these light circles[/b][/quote]
[b]OLD:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/30e0c8e213832624723ba7ccd7b5706fd3acab61.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.597:[/b] Large [b]white reflection circle[/b] on the ground[/i]

[b]NEW:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/b2795f22383562cf7ea32968cb5aea291c4c2b81.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598: [/b]White reflection circle not visible in this area (fully disabled)[/i]

[b]OLD:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/431e64cf6fcb085c1e8a4f71f54dd9f611282bec.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.597: [/b]Windows reflected light as a[b] concentrated white circle[/b], very[b] strongly[/b][/i]

[b]NEW:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/b3d62c9d97f131186c2ca7980be11a617cc424a1.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598: [/b]Window reflects light in a [b]more subtle, diffuse manner[/b], and the [b]ground circle is no longer distracting[/b][/i]

[b]OLD:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/079fd00902f6e0123513ebcda8fea7181e33727e.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.597: [/b]White reflection circles for [b]2 lights on the ground in this room[/b], [b]ceiling light reflection[/b] is very strong[/i]

[b]NEW:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/8d26c0909d9cb994f0a19d1a60841b9e771431e4.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598:[/b] White reflection circles are [b]not visible anymore[/b], and the [b]ceiling light reflection is less intense[/b][/i]

[b]OLD:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/2f5c765dddf4ad4b6e78a5bff5132178849c908f.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.597:[/b] There were [b]2 strong white reflection circles[/b] on the grounds[/i]

[b]NEW:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/16d8772f78ff005838acf2ec2c37868834e07971.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598:[/b] Here, the [b]2 reflection circles are intentionally kept[/b], but you can notice [b]they are much less distracting[/b], and have a [b]dirtiness effect instead of a perfect circle[/b], which looks [b]more realistic[/b][/i]

[h1]STATIC REFLECTIONS | Rework[/h1]
You may have noticed that in various Chapters, quite often, [b]Static Reflections could be greatly distorted:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/f658896ec2c1ff8ff52e7195291f950c17f5caae.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.597:[/b] Example of some [b]inaccurate reflections[/b][/i]

This was the result of [b]many optimizations.[/b] For this update, [b]all static reflections of all Chapters have been significantly improved[/b], in order to [b]reduce the noticeable inaccuracies[/b], and [b]reduce distortion[/b].

They will now, [b]most of the time[/b], [b]have less visible inaccuracies:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/30b1a0f2f204917d274d07aea6b07aa27a4909f2.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598:[/b] More subtle, and [b]significantly more accurate reflections[/b] [b]on the ground[/b]. [b]White reflection circles[/b] are also [b]much less distracting [/b](but intentionally still present)[b].[/b][/i]

Here's [b]another example [/b]of an area with [b]distorted / inaccurate reflections:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c8a3222f1440f721e6f08058c9a2a7796e9b8746.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.597:[/b] The [b]ground has distorted, inaccurate reflections[/b], and the [b]walls as well[/b][/i]

[b]NEW: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a0ee68e37d034ee0901ef473c1da0a44461ad704.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598:[/b] [b]More accurate [/b]reflections on the [b]ground[/b], [b]no distortion [/b]on the [b]walls[/b][/i]

It's important to note that [b]some distortion and inaccuracies are still present[/b], [b]as is the limitation of those static reflections[/b], which are [b]very optimized[/b] and [b]can run smoothly even on integrated GPUs[/b].

If you [b]search and analyze[/b], you'll [b]always find inaccuracies / distortions[/b] - and that's okay, because they are now [b]considered [i]"good enough"[/i] for most areas[/b].

Some areas [b]cannot have good Static Reflections[/b], and [b]cannot be solved[/b] - these areas now [b]have less visible Static Reflections[/b], or [b]no static reflections at all.[/b]

The only way to have better reflections from this point in these problematic areas, is to [b]use [i]Dynamic Reflections[/i] mode[/b].

Please[b] report areas in which even these new Static Reflections are way too distracting[/b], and they will [b]either be improved or made less visible.[/b]

[h1]LENS FLARES | Rework[/h1]
Another [b]major visual improvement in 0.598[/b] is the [b]lights' lens flares rework[/b]. Many of the existing lights were using a [b]simple [i]"star shape"[/i] lens flare effect[/b], [b]which didn't always look good[/b].

[b]All light lens flares [/b]have been [b]reworked, then adjusted individually[/b].

These [b]new lens flares[/b] now [b]add a visual effect on most lights[/b], of [i][b]"horizontal line lens flare"[/b][/i]. The [b]further you are from the light[/b], the [b]more visible the effect is[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/21476e681d1d2402603b4ea2142450e94dd2810d.jpg[/img]

They all have been [b]adjusted to avoid being too strong / blinding[/b], but you [b]might still find some that are too intense[/b]. Up close, they might still look like [b][i]“small stars”[/i][/b], which isn’t great, but they [b]still look significantly better than the previous light flares[/b], which were [b]simple circular spherical points[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/550c1a221911a1d6143a4b9543378802b5265d4d.jpg[/img]

In addition, it’s now [b]more consistent[/b], as [b]all lights have the same effect[/b] [i](previously, many lights were missing them)[/i] - even though it's now [b]more or less visible based on light intensity[/b] and light [b][i]“importance”[/i][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/d92664fee37a0818fc92ebbad88fa10aa621b3b1.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW OPTION | Lens Flares[/h1]
Since the [b]addition and rework of the new Lens Flares[/b] - which [b]are now present on all lights[/b] - you can now [b]also select adjust how many[/b] of them you want:
[list][*][b]None: [/b]Will [b]disable all lens flare effects[/b] [i](select this if you don't like them!)[/i][/*][*][b]Partial: [/b]Only [b]Dynamic Lights[/b] and [b]important objects[/b] will have them [i](Color Packs, Ammo Packs, Lasers, blinking lights, lights which change colors, and some other important lights)[/i][/*][*][b]Full:[/b] Every light has the [b]new reworked Lens Flare effect[/b][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/6b6cb37ad67c271b24012d1e8835875016c9179e.png[/img]

[h1]NEW OPTION | Monitor[/h1]
You can now click on the [b]new Monitor option[/b] to change on [b]which monitor the game should be rendered[/b].

Doing so will [b]apply any pending graphics options changes[/b], and [b]instantly change display and update the available resolutions accordingly[/b].

It will always [b]default to maximum resolution[/b] after switching. This [b]option is unavailable if you have a single monitor attached:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/9dd3ea024add9305667662764bfad4005a06a00c.png[/img]
[i][b]0.598:[/b] New Monitor option[/i]

[quote][i]The game will now [/i][b]show less options in resolutions[/b][i]. This is normal, as previously it [/i][b]could list resolutions that your monitor[/b][i] [/i][b]couldn’t handle at the regular refresh rate[/b][i].[/i]

[i]This helps reduce the chances of selecting a resolution that would result in lower framerate. Now, [/i][b]only the resolutions that your screen supports at maximum refresh rate[/b][i] are displayed.[/i]
[/quote]
[h1]INTERACTION | Rework[/h1]
This update includes [b]major changes to the object pickup / interaction system[/b]. This will very [b]likely provoke new bugs with certain objects[/b], [b]so it is to be tested![/b]

This rework was done to [b]finally solve some old problems that were considered minor[/b], but are [b]welcome additions[/b].

Most importantly, it [b]solves the following issues:[/b]
[list][*][b]Pickup transition[/b] of objects is now [b]smoother than before[/b][/*][*]Picking up a [b]Cube or Power Core[/b] would [b]make the object rotate a lot during pickup[/b], and often [b]rotate the wrong direction[/b] [i](not taking shortest path for rotation)[/i]. If you drop a cube, then pick it up [b]from the opposite side[/b], it would [b]rotate 180-360° during the pickup transition[/b]. This [b]won’t happen anymore[/b]. Well, to be precise, it can [i]still happen[/i] in some specific cases of Power Cores, but it's [b]much more rare[/b], and [b]will be finalized later[/b].[/*][*]Cubes [b]can now be picked up from any of the 4 sides![/b] This helps a lot with the issue above. It will now [b]only significantly rotate if it’s placed on its sides or is upside down[/b], as it should still always [b]require to be standing upright[/b] while in your hands [i](intended)[/i][/*][*][b]Power Cores[/b] can now [b]be picked up from any of the 2 sides[/b] - they [b]won’t rotate 180° to be picked[/b] up anymore![/*][*][b]Cube Stacking[/b]: Does [b]not take longer anymore [/b]to [b]decide to stack while [i]Hyper-Speed[/i] is enabled[/b][/*][*][b]Cube Stacking[/b]: Requesting to [b]crouch while holding a Cube above another one [/b][i](stacking)[/i], [b]no longer creates a Cube vertical jitter[/b] [b]glitch[/b][/*][*][b]Crouched Drop[/b]: The Cube is now [b]held a bit higher than before while crouched[/b], to allow to [b]still drop the Cubes on Pressure Plates[/b] [b]while crouched[/b] [i](would previously clip through the Pressure Plate and would not allow to drop)[/i]. Maybe [b]some Pressure Plates will need to be adjusted[/b] for this to work everywhere as expected - [b]to be tested[/b].[/*][*][b]Crouch[/b]: Tablets are now also[b] held slightly lower when crouched and in Zero-G[/b][/*][/list]You can see [b]examples of this new interaction rework in this video:[/b]

[previewyoutube=kxpbGzVluRM;full][/previewyoutube][i][b]0.598:[/b] New Interaction System Rework Examples[/i]

[h1]DODGE | Improvements[/h1]
A few [b]important improvements were made to [i]Dodge[/i][/b] and [b]some bug fixes as well[/b].

Requesting to [b][i]Dodge [/i]downwards vertically[/b] while [b]standing on a breakable window[/b], or [b]while in mid-air[/b], was functional. However, doing the same when [b]trying to get down a horizontally-placed vent[/b], or [b][i]Dodging[/i] down from a Ledge[/b], would [b]always result in a horizontal [i]Dodge[/i] [/b]if you were [b]on the gound[/b].

This has now changed, in order to [b]allow you to more easily [i]Dodge [/i]down vents or from ledges[/b], [b]without the need to jump beforehand[/b].

[b]Dodging[/b] while [b]looking downwards[/b], while [b]standing close to a ledge[/b] or next to a [b]horizontally-placed vent[/b], will now [b]Dodge vertically downwards[/b] - This should make [b]Dodging down through vents below you[/b] much easier during Speedruns.
[quote]Please note that you must request [b]either no movement[/b], or [b]forward-only movement[/b], otherwise you will [b]Dodge horizontally in the requested lateral directions[/b] as usual [i](intended)[/i].

Please also note that this new behavior [b]only works when close to a ledge/gap[/b], and [b]while looking downwards[/b] [i](intended)[/i], to avoid unintended downwards dodges in all other situations.[/quote]
You can see [b]an illustration of these new Dodge changes in this video:[/b]

[previewyoutube=effZRGD26K8;full][/previewyoutube][b][i]0.598: [/i][/b][i]Dodge improvements examples[/i]

This new change [b]now also works with [i]Destructible Windows[/i] and [i]Destructible Walls[/i][/b] ;)

[b]In addition:[/b]
[list][*]Initiating a [b]horizontal-only Dodge[/b] while [b]standing on a horizontally-placed [i]Fragile Window[/i][/b] will [b]no longer break it[/b] - you [b]need to [i]Dodge [/i]downwards towards it[/b] [i](intended)[/i][/*][*]Dodging [b]over a horizontally-placed Fragile Window[/b] will [b]no longer break it[/b] - you [b]need to Dodge downwards towards it[/b] [i](intended)[/i][/*][*]Dodge can now be upgraded up to Level 3![/*][/list]
[h1]CHAPTER 2 | More Freedom[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/fd7df6127b6e402f7a60c805f2a7f8ca752f5a95.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Chapter 2:[/b] From this moment, the player has [b]more freedom[/b] and [b]less relocations[/b][/i]

[b]Significant changes[/b] were made to [b][i]Chapter 2[/i][/b], in order to [b]add much more freedom once the [i]Jetpack [/i]is acquired:[/b]
[list][*]As you get out of the [b]vertical vent just after the very first electrified water room[/b], you will [b]now be allowed to drop down to get the [/b][i][b]Upgrade Terminal[/b] [/i]if you missed it and noticed it from here.[/*][*]You will now [b]also be able to go further back to grab other Health / Ammo Packs[/b]. Before this update, [b]Relocations would prevent you [/b]from doing so [i](it was intended)[/i]. These changes [b]should not create new bugs[/b] if you go there [i](to be tested!)[/i].[/*][*]The first [b]Electrified Water Room has a few small changes:[/b] electricity pylons coming down from the pipes, [b]and cables are powering up the water electricity[/b].[/*][*]In addition, [b]a new Tablet has been added in Chapter 2[/b]. We’ll let you find it :)[/*][/list][quote][b]NEW:[/b] Some tablets are now "[i]enclosed[/i]". You’ll see ;) There will be various ways to unlock them in the future.[/quote]
[h1]CUBE SURFING | Reduced[/h1]
The previous update [b]already introduced a first version of the Cube-Surfing / Tablet-Surfing prevention system[/b] - but it [b]was not working as intended[/b]. It [b]now should[/b].

This system should make it [b]much harder to perform Tablet / Cube jumps while the object is in freefall[/b].

It should now [b]push the objects downwards[/b] instead of allowing you to jump from them [i](this push is only done if the Cube is not too close to the ground already)[/i].

In addition, it should be [b]harder to pick them up while in the air[/b] to [b]chain drop-walk on top[/b] of them. You should be [b]able to do this once[/b], then, you probably [b]won’t have the object anymore[/b].

This change might [b]create various new bugs[/b], so it is to be tested.
[quote][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Cube-Surfing prevention system is [b]automatically disabled[/b] when [b]Hyper-Speed is enabled[/b]. This is considered [b]acceptable[/b], as [b]no Cube-Surfing tricks should allow you to reach/skip anything that you[/b] [b]wouldn’t be able to do with Dodge/Hover/Jetpack in NG+ anyways[/b].

Please report any cube-surfing which seems illegal, i.e. areas that [b]couldn’t be reached with Dodge/Hover/Jetpack in NG+[/b], and that is reachable [b]thanks to Cube-Surfing only[/b].

If that situation creates a major issue, then Cube-Surfing might be prevented at all times. But the idea is that Cube-Surfing is [b]only an issue in NG in early Chapters[/b] [i](before Jetpack)[/i], so I would like to still allow you to [b]have fun with Cube / Tablet-Surfing in NG+[/b] [b]using Hyper-Speed[/b], [b]if it does not break the game[/b] ;)[/quote]
[h1]FLASHLIGHT | Improvements[/h1]
Flashlight [b]intensity has been reduced[/b]. Its radius is [b]now smaller[/b] [i](less spread out across the screen)[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/21d042bd1e9bc469b1dffdb9ccf9dd147942f429.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598: Smaller radius[/b] of Flashlight, and [b]more realistic intensity[/b][/i]

This is primarily because[b] if it was turned on in not-so-dark areas[/b], it would [b]overly brighten up the scene[/b] to a point[b] where reflections of lighting would be painful to the eyes[/b].

This is based on [b]various [i]G.Round[/i] players reporting flashlight is way too bright[/b]. It is meant to be [b]used in dark areas[/b], in which case [b]it lights up enough[/b] - but obviously, it’s now [b]much harder to notice in bright areas[/b] [i](now intended)[/i].

[b]In addition to that, t[/b]he [b]Flashlight system was reworked[/b] [b]to:[/b]
[list][*]Have [b]small sideways movements as you walk[/b], instead of always [b]being perfectly centered[/b][/*][*]Now [b]animated for a small, slow flashlight movement[/b] when [b]standing still[/b][/*][*]Slightly [b]more noticeable latency[/b] as player [b]looks around / moves arounds / crouches[/b] for a [i]“less robotic”[/i] feel of the flashlight movements[/*][/list]
[h1]TOOLTIPS | Added[/h1]
A first version of [b]Tooltips for all the options that are not self-explanatory[/b] have been added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/19a9cf34a14d3e63eb0d10635e8decef328dc521.jpg[/img]
[quote]They [b]should also work with a keyboard or gamepad[/b], with a slightly longer delay. [b]Translators might want to take a look at the sheet[/b] to localize them - Thank you! ;)[/quote]
[h1]FRAMERATE OPTION | Removed[/h1]
After a lot of additional work that was made on [b]supporting more refresh rates and framerates[/b], it was decided to [b]remove the Framerate option[/b].

The reason behind this, is that now that the [b]screen has a proper support for changing the active display[/b], there are [b]various combinations which could result in problematic settings[/b], and many of them [b]could cause screen tearing[/b] or other [b]unwanted bugs[/b].

Some other edge cases could cause [b]inaccurate physics / framerate calculations if you were to define specific frame rates[/b].

The best way to handle this, is to [b]allow the game to select the appropriate framerate[/b] [i](always the maximum possible framerate based on your system’s connected monitors)[/i].

With these changes, you should now be able to [b]safely play on any monitor[/b], with [b]any resolution[/b], in [b]borderless/fullscreen/window[/b] - [b]without any screen tearing[/b], even if you are duplicating your screen or playing on screen set to be a secondary monitor.

[h1]CHAPTERS | Cycle Button[/h1]

You can now [b]start a New Game+ Cycle directly from the Chapters Page[/b]. This also allows to [b]quickly view the Cycle Leaderboard directly from the Chapters Page[/b], and [b]stats for the Entire Game:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/7f7eecaa01d7c62201c36bcf1b775a9a78e53f47.jpg[/img]
[i][b]0.598:[/b] New [b]Cycle[/b] Button in the [b]Chapters[/b] page[/i]

[h1]OTHER | NEW FEATURES[/h1]
A [b]few additional new features worth noting here:[/b]
[list][*][b]Screens:[/b] Screens will now [b]react to Taser shot and jitter a few moments[/b]. Maybe later [b][i]Hyper-Shot[/i] will fully destroy them[/b], just like lights? We’ll see![/*][*][b]Generators:[/b] They will [b]now damage the player[/b] if they [b]explode while the player is close[/b] to them.[/*][*][b]Cables:[/b] Some parts of Chapter 1 have new [b]small hanging cables here and there[/b].[/*][*][b]Screenshot Mode:[/b] The [b]F4[/b] key [i](only while Debug Mode is DISABLED)[/i] is now a new default hotkey to [b]toggle Interface ON/OFF[/b] to allow easy [b]screenshots without any user interface[/b]. This hotkey and Interface option will only be available if the game was [b]completed at least once[/b], in the final release. [/*][/list][quote]Currently, the [b]F4[/b] [b] hotkey for Screenshot Mode[/b] is [b]always available in the Pre-Alpha[/b] [i](but not in the public Demo)[/i].

Just like [i]Performance Mode[/i], it’s customizable ;) Changing via [b]F4 hotkey should not be saved when the game is closed[/b] [i](in contrast to going to enable / disable Interface in the Options)[/i]. It’s possible later on the Screenshot Mode will pause the game and allow custom camera placement [i](but this is for later)[/i].[/quote]

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
Below are listed the [b]major changes in the game[/b], which are [b]worth noting:[/b]
[list][*][b]Switches:[/b] Slightly improved required precision to shoot Switches. You could previously shoot slightly next to them, and it would be registered as a successful shot. Collision detection for Switches is now more precise. Please report a Suggestion if you now think it’s too hard to shoot at them, or if this change is annoying / problematic.[/*][*][b]Cubes Pushing Player:[/b] It was intended [i](not a bug)[/i] that moving Cubes in mid-air push the character when they collide with him. This was to prevent various bugs, and add a feel of weight to the Cubes. This has now changed, and the player will no longer be pushed around by Cubes that are in mid-air. The player will either block the Cube’s movement, or push them slightly depending on current player velocity. This may create new bugs, but should remove the strange feeling of being “bullied by Cubes” :)[/*][*][b]Cubes Forced Physics Clipping:[/b] Pushing Cubes through walls should now be near impossible / very hard to achieve.[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Restarting Chapter 1, only skipped the “Shortest Distance” text and wake-up cutscene [b]if Speedrun Mode was enabled[/b], or [b]if Cutscenes were disabled[/b]. It will now [b]always skip it when Restarting the Chapter[/b]. This might be reverted later on, to be still played when restarting Chapter 1, but only when this cutscene is made skippable. The issue with it is that it’s not skippable currently, so that why it may be annoying for testers.[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] The rooms just after the 6984 Code are [b]now taller[/b], which allows for [b]jumping without touching the ceiling[/b], to make it more comfortable while playing. Various changes were made on the way to the [b]Taser Room vent / Bridge[/b] button path with big saws [i](removed the first slope next to the window, new edge that requires a jump on the roof, etc.)[/i][/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] The [i]Lasers Cage Room for Cubes[/i] after 6984 Code, has changed to make the laser cages [b]look more dangerous[/b] [i](more lasers, crossed lasers, and lasers pillar added)[/i], to [b]discourage trying to squeeze through individual lasers[/b] without activating the switch. You will [b]no longer survive trying to do so[/b]. Added screens, and [b]wires as hints[/b] to find the vent, as [b]quite a few new G.Round players were unable to find the vent below[/b] to invert the laser's state. The lower-part of the left-side cage [i](when entering)[/i] [b]allows to go through[/b] if you [b]block the lasers[/b] with a Cube [i](like previously)[/i], but the [b]upper part doesn’t allow to go through[/b] [i](intended)[/i].[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] The Orange Structure, that appears only on your way back after acquiring the Taser, will disappear as you will go outside after the “Cracker Room”. This is intended, for both performance and consistency with the fact that this structure strangely appeared out of nowhere and disappeared as well (intended).[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] “Chapter 1” 3D text title is now placed next to the first door in front of the player, when Speedrun Mode is enabled or Cutscenes are disabled. In normal situations, it’s still on the right-side wall. This is to ensure it’s visible in all configurations.[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] The optional area for Recording pickup, behind the breakable window next to 3600 code, is no longer requiring you to complete the deployable platforms puzzle to get back up in New Game+, in case you dodge up trying to skip it (authorized in NG+). In New Game, however, solving this puzzle manually to get back up remains mandatory.[/*][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] First Room with platforms / lasers / crushers: A gap was added between the vertical moving platform [i](activated by Pressure Plate surrounded by 2 saws)[/i] and the top ground towards the Bridge. This gap [b]does not require you to jump[/b] [i](you can simply walk over it)[/i]. However, if you do so, you will be damaged because of the new laser. In addition, the [b]entire room was made slightly taller[/b], to allow jumping without being stopped by the ceiling, to make it more comfortable [i](this room was designed a long time ago, when jump was not as high as it is today)[/i]. There is now a glass window to allow picking up the Taser Ammo from only one direction [i](intended)[/i].[/*][/list]
[quote][b]This post is too long and exceeds [i]Steam[/i]'s character limit. Please [url=https://haze-games.com/update-0-598]check the full list of Changes and Bugfixes on the update changelog on our Official Website[/url].[/b][/quote]

notes.title: Update 0.597 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear [i][b]Fractal Space[/b][/i] players!

The latest [b]update 0.597 is now ready for testing[/b], and [b]fixes many of the in-game reported bugs[/b]. 

However, [b]there were many reported bugs[/b], so only around [b]40% of them are fixed[/b]. We will [b]gradually work through them all and fix over the next few updates[/b].

We focused mostly on the [b]important major bugs [/b]for this update.

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

Here are a couple of [b]changes in this update:[/b]
[list][*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Interaction ranges to remove / insert Power Cores has been slightly reduced, as you could remove them from very far away.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Cutscenes:[/b] Black top/bottom cutscene bands now remain visible when the game is paused [i](but behind the menu)[/i][/*][/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

Here's a [b]short list of most important fixes in this update[i] [/i][/b][i](many more in-game reported bug are will be mentioned on the Discord server)[/i]:
[list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed “Tablet Destroyed” in Chapter 1 after the “I’m not your shrink” lasers room.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Infinite Jump:[/b] Fixed a bug that could sometimes cause the Player to be able to indefinitely continue jumping from the air, after repeatedly jumping from Moving Platforms / Lift buttons surface. Thanks Latte, Chris & Aidan for the videos ;) The infinite flying / jetpack bug is separate than this though, so fixing this bug doesn’t mean the other cases are solved as well yet.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Latest update that improved Power Core physics collisions, also made it much harder to insert them into Power Core Slots while in Zero-Gravity. This has now been fixed, and it’s easier, as it was before 0.596[/*][/list][list][*][b]Object Respawns:[/b] Latest 0.596 update made many/all respawn systems areas for Power Cores / Cubes to be non-functional. This has been fixed, so respawn areas should be functional correctly again.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Pressure Plates:[/b] When multiple Cubes are placed on a pressed down Pressure Plate, removing 1 of them would deactivate and reactivate the Pressure Plate within 1s. Should now no longer react this way and remain pressed down, when another Cube is already actively pressing the Pressure Plate down, and the other second one is removed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Pressure Plates:[/b] Fixed a new bug with Pressure Plates, introduced in 0.596, that could cause Cubes to be ejected / catapulted fast from Pressure Plates upon deactivation (return to unpressed red state). Should now behave normally, pushing them gently upwards instead of sending them off flying in the air.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Zero-G Boost:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause being able to Zero-G boost indefinitely, after a Last Checkpoint load with Speedrun Mode disabled.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Crouching:[/b] Fixed a rare bug that could cause crouch/standing up transition to provoke the Player to die on some moving platforms / lifts.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Saving:[/b] Dying while reloading Taser, and while a save is happening, wouldn’t always save the Taser as full upon loading the save later on. Should now work as expected.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Reported Bugs:[/b] Hundreds more [b]in-game reported bugs[/b] and suggestions implemented.[/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update over the next few weeks for the next bugs[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.596 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear [b][i]Fractal Space[/i] players![/b]

We have worked on a [b]new 0.596 update for [i]Fractal Space[/i] on Steam[/b], in order to [b]fix most of the remaining bugs[/b] reported by players in [b]0.595![/b]

Now that this update is live, the [b][i]Demos[/i] will be updated on both [i]Steam[/i] & [i]Xbox[/i] within the next 7 days[/b], except if players find [b]new major bugs in[i] Chapter 0[/i] or [i]Chapter 1[/i] in [i]New Game[/i][/b]. We'll also [b]finally be sending more keys to players that were still waiting for them![/b]

Various [b]balancing changes [/b]and [b]dangerous changes were made[/b], so it's a [b]good idea to re-test a few core mechanics[/b] that we'll discuss here.

If you encounter [b]a major blocking bug that prevents you from finishing the game[/b], please [b]report in-game with ALT+B[/b] ;)

[b]Thank you[/b] for testing and [b]reporting bugs![/b]

[quote]Since the Demos will be updated soon to 0.596, if you don't have much time to test, you may focus on New Game only, in Chapter 0 & Chapter 1, as the Demo content is limited to this.[/quote]
[h1]NEW[/h1]
Let's talk about a [b]few new additions in this update.[/b]

[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]
This update now adds a few new [b][i]Achievement[/i]s for:[/b]
[list][*]Death by electrified water[/*][*]Destroy first Camera[/*][*]Destroy 10 different Cameras[/*][*]Stun first Camera[/*][*]Stun 10 different Cameras[/*][*]Enable Zero-Gravity the first time[/*][/list]
Some of these new achievements are currently missing icons, but that’s OK for now ;)

[h2]CHAPTER 0[/h2]
First, [b]t[/b]he [b]Red Platform[/b] now uses an [b]animated red volumetric light beam[/b], and is now [b]taller[/b] than before. It also now [b]gradually disappears[/b] [i](intended)[/i] when the box is placed.

[spoiler]Here's an image of the [b]new red volumetric light beam in Chapter 0:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/618b25d2eaf8c1a7d0b98b225df349205f695c78.jpg[/img]
[/spoiler]

Then, a [b]few additional improvements:[/b]
[list][*]The word [i]"presents"[/i] is now [b]more readable [/b]in the introduction sequence[/*][/list][list][*]Fixed some [b]potential softlocks in which the player could get stuck[/b] in corners. Some might still remain.[/*][/list]
[h2]PRESSURE | Plates[/h2]
[b][i]Pressure Plates[/i] [/b]have been [b]reworked[/b] in order to make them [b]more accurate[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/77555d350dd212dc4f30dfb2575de14b26eea99f.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The slightly [b]higher edges[/b] are now [b]taken into account[/b] in the [b]Cube’s collisions[/b], and they now [b]need to be placed more to the center[/b] to be [b]considered valid[/b]:[/*][/list][list][*]They [b]remain tolerant[/b], as to [b]not be frustrating[/b], but a small part on the corner, or too much on the outside, will [b]no longer activate it:[/b][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/7735b30dab0e7eb2672749ea2b56d76104767534.jpg[/img]

This change, behind the scenes, [b]is a big change[/b]:  as a precaution, [b]all pressure plates should be tested[/b] after this change.

[h1]JUMP | Improvements[/h1]
The game already has many systems to ensure jumps are reactive and never ignored [i](height tolerances, jumps from ledges have tolerance, higher jumps when moving upwards on slopes, etc)[/i].

However, a [b]new security system[/b] has been added that could be the root cause of [b]some ignored jumps:[/b] When the player requests a jump up to [b]0.15s too early[/b] [i](while in air, just before touching the ground)[/i], the game will now [b]still jump as soon as the character touches the ground[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a2d0fbcc775e51c33a69142e0fbcb66a6e3496d7.jpg[/img]

This should fix all the remaining [i]“why didn’t I jump when I asked for it?”[/i] situations - except, obviously, if you [b]miscalculate your timing[/b] and request to jump too early [i](0.15s timing precision required from the player, instead of previously frame-perfect)[/i].

[h1]CUBE SURFING | Props Flying[/h1]
[b]Prop Flying & Cube Surfing:[/b] Still possible, but [b]made much harder to achieve with Power Cores and Cubes[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/4065d11852a3b4b1d66268f491357d989d1aaeba.jpg[/img]

You’ll be allowed to jump from an airborne Cube / Power Core [b]only once in most cases[/b], as it will be [b]pushed downwards properly[/b] [i](this was added 0.594 but wasn’t always working as expected)[/i].

They can act as a [b]single-use temporary platform[/b] instead of a chain-cube-surfing exploit. In addition, simply walking on Cubes in-air by repeatedly dropping and grabbing it should be much harder to exploit, as it should now try to prevent you from doing so.

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
This [b]update includes quite a few notable changes [/b]that [b]should be tested too:[/b]
[list][*][b]Chapter 0:[/b] Show HUD [b]no longer plays any sound[/b] [i](whether the first Objective will be shown or not)[/i]. This is now [b]intended[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 0:[/b] Current [b]upgrades display[/b] on Pause Menu is [b]now fully hidden in Chapter 0[/b], even if you have started from Chapters page - they should remain hidden in that sequence. They will be [b]restored when you reach Chapter 1[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Added a [b]new Checkpoint[/b], when the [b]first Taser Battery is retrieved[/b] in the [i]Lockdown[/i] room. If you [b]die before retrieving it[/b], it is [b]intended and normal[/b] that you see the [i]“wall explosion”[/i] moment again. This new Checkpoint is [b]to be tested![/b][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/79ed82729d77d14b3eb71e99ba06670f1e36d977.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Musical hacking minigame is now too hard for some players, as new players are unable to get past it and report “bugs”. This puzzle is now [b]reverted back to the previous logic[/b], that [b]fails upon any mistakes in the code[/b].
Later on, when the [b]difficulty system will be implemented[/b], the [b]0.595[/b] logic for this puzzle [i](fail only on first mistake)[/i], will be used when [b]Puzzles Difficulty[/b] is set to [b]Hard[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Flames corridor before Processing Center: Now damages significantly more, as it [b]should not be survived in most cases of NG[/b]. You’ll now need at least [b]1 Healthpack[/b] in your [b]Backpack[/b] + [b]Sprint[/b] + [b]Dodge[/b] + [b]Speed[/b] Level 3 + [b]Health[/b] Level 3 to [b]survive it consistently[/b]. Missing any of the last 2 mentioned upgrades is still [b]theoretically possible[/b] [i](especially at low framerate)[/i], but harder to do consistently [i](not recommended)[/i], and will [b]still require you to Sprint + Dodge[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Fixed [b]inaccurate collisions between Power Cores and pillars in the game[/b]. They should now be [b]greatly improved[/b], and [b]collide properly with walls and pillars[/b]. This is a [b]dangerous change[/b], though - [b][i]Power Cores[/i] functionality should be tested[/b]:[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/2d2c6903ceffa8bea9ca8e85a1d1c3196813b83c.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Switches:[/b] [b]Reduced manual interaction[/b] range slightly, for [b]all switches in the game[/b]. To be tested if any issues occur in specific cases.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/515922130370eda064bb4594e0fe2f9bcd46f933.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Mines:[/b] It was possible to stand on [i]Mines[/i]. It’s no longer possible - they will now [b]explode[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Recordings:[/b] Listening to a [b]Recording from the Recordings page[/b] will now [b]pause the Menu or Chapter music[/b], and [b]resume it correctly when finished[/b].[/*][/list][h1]LEVEL FIXES[/h1][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed [b]visual black shadow bug[/b] on an [i][b]Exit [/b][/i]vent.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed [b]Solar Panels distorted texture[/b]. These Solar Panels [b]will be reworked in the future[/b] to look better. This is just a [b]temporary fix.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed various [b]Power Core related softlocks[/b] and issues with being able to [b]pick them up from too far away[/b][/*][/list][h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
Most of the [b]in-game reported bugs have been fixed[/b], and [b]some suggestions have been implemented:[/b]
[list][*][b]Taser:[/b] Fixed a case that would result in [b]reloading an invisible Taser[/b], if you were to [b]reload after / while using [i]Scope[/i][/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser:[/b] Pausing the game while holding the Aim button, would remove the Taser, and quickly show it again upon resume.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser:[/b] Pausing the game while Hyper-Shot is currently charging, would continue the charging animation while paused.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser:[/b] Pausing the game while charging Hyper-Shot would reset the Hyper-Shot charging to zero.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser:[/b] Fixed a case that would [b]cause [i]Module Management[/i] to not work properly[/b] after [b]using [i]Scope[/i][/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Laser-Equipped Cameras:[/b] Depending on your framerate, [b]many hits from the shooting cameras[/b] would [b]not properly register[/b]. This has been significantly improved, and you should now be [b]more accurately damaged when hit by the Camera’s shots[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Breakable Walls:[/b] Aiming exactly [b]between small bricks of the wall[/b], would not register the shot to destroy it. In addition, the screen will no longer show it’s a breakable wall, once it has been damaged at least once. In addition, remaining flying wall pieces should now happen much less frequently than before.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Zero-Gravity:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause indefinitely keeping “upwards gravity”, if a Quick Load occurred to load a Zero-G state save, while the game was already transitioning from Normal Gravity to Zero-Gravity. To be tested if this doesn’t provoke new bugs with checkpoints in Zero-G, etc.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Quick Load:[/b] Fixed an exploit that could allow to [b]spam Jump during Quick Load[/b], and resulting in an additional [i](illegal)[/i] jump even [b]while in the air[/b]. To be tested, and to verify if this doesn’t introduce new bugs with Quick Load in normal conditions.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Game Saves:[/b] Switching from a Chapter to another would sometimes keep previous run’s quick save and checkpoint autosaves. All these cases should be fixed, and saved data should be cleared properly, thus preventing various exploits.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser Batteries:[/b] Saving the game after picking up a Taser Battery, then exiting to main menu, and resuming again, would result in the Taser Battery being respawned and present instantly. It will now correctly not be present, and will only respawn after the intended delay.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Reported Bugs:[/b] Hundreds more [b]in-game reported bugs[/b] and suggestions implemented.[/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update over the next few weeks for the next bugs[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.595 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello dear [b][i]Fractal Space[/i] players![/b] The new [b]0.595 update is now ready[/b] to be tested, and focuses on [b]stabilizing the new changes introduced by 0.594[/b].

In the [b]next few days[/b], we will be [b]sending Steam keys to the players waiting to access the [i]Pre-Alpha[/i][/b] up to Chapter 4.

We are still [b]not showing / detailing much the newly added [i]Chapter 0[/i] introduction scene[/b], as it was [b]only limited to [i]Pre-Alpha[/i] testers[/b].

This [b]0.595 update[/b] will [b]also be set live for the [i]Steam Demo[/i][/b] and [b][i]Xbox One Demo[/i][/b], [b]provided we do not receive major bug reports in fresh New Game runs in Chapter 1[/b] [i](bugs in next Chapters, or in New Game+ only, do not impact the Demos)[/i].

[b]All players[/b] will be able to see the [b]new introduction[/b] in the [i][b]Demo [/b][/i][b]by the end of next week[/b].

Let's take a look at the [b]new changes & improvements of this update![/b]
[h1]NEW[/h1]
What's new in this latest update?

[h2]CHAPTER 0 [b]| Improvements[/b][/h2]
A few [b]improvements were made to [i]Chapter 0[/i][/b]. If you [b]haven't seen it yet in 0.584[/b], [b]do not read this yet[/b].

[list][*][spoiler]First of all, some players were [b]confused about the child’s voice in the introduction[/b], and thought it was only IG speaking. It is [b]not only IG[/b]. It’s a conversation [b]between IG and a different voice[/b] [i](a child)[/i]. It is [b]now a bit clearer [/b]in both audio and subtitles.[/spoiler][/list][list][*][spoiler][b]Animated volumetric fog[/b] has now been added to [b]Chapter 0[/b]! Having fog was [b]always planned [/b]in [i]Chapter 0[/i], but considering [b]both performance and complexity[/b], it wasn't ready yet. It should be [b]well optimized[/b] [b]already[/b], but is still a [b]heavy addition for some older machines with integrated GPUs[/b].[/spoiler][/list][list][*][spoiler][b][i]Performance Mode[/i] keeps the fog enabled[/b], but since [b][i]Performance Mode[/i] is now more effective [/b]in [i]Chapter 0 [/i]from this update, it should [b]allow older machines to run smoother in this scene[/b]. Later on, an [b]option for [i]Fog Quality[/i] will be added[/b] to reduce its performance impact.[/spoiler][/list][list][*][spoiler]The [b]volume of the waves is now increased[/b]. You should now [b]hear them more on other shores[/b].[/spoiler][/list]
[h2]CHAPTER 1[b] | Dialogs[/b][/h2]
The [b]update 0.594[/b] introduced [b]all-new re-written and re-recorded dialogs for Chapter 1[/b]. One major change is that we wanted to [b]try a more feminine voice for IG[/b], and make it [b]feel like her voice was coming through speakers[/b].

However, we understand IG's voice may have been a bit too [b]high-pitched[/b] and [b]could feel irritating[/b]. We have [b]adjusted them all in order to try and reduce this effect[/b], but [b]still keep a mild [i]"coming from speaker"[/i][/b][i] [/i]sensation.

Hopefully, the [b]irritating aspect of her voice should be now reduced[/b]. We'll continue working on that to improve it.

In addition, some of the new dialogs are [b]planned to be re-recorded[/b], because even though, we feel [b]most of them are better than their older versions[/b], some still aren't good enough - so you can expect them to be [b]improved across the next few updates[/b] [i](In this update, already [b]a few of them were re-recorded[/b], but not as much as we hoped)[/i].

[h2]SHOOTING | [b]Lights[/b][/h2]
The previous update [b]added the ability to shoot at blinking lights to temporarily disable them[/b] [i](small visual enhancement).[/i]

From this update, shooting at [b]dynamic lights[/b] that [b]do not blink[/b] [i](most of the time, the ones that can change color, for example lights for buttons, Power Core Slots, etc.)[/i], would not react. [b]They now will[/b], just like other [b]blinking lights[/b]. Static lights do not [i](and never will)[/i] react, as those need to [b]remain on at all times[/b], for [b]optimization purposes[/b].

[h2]SPEED |[b] Upgrade[/b][/h2]
Speed upgrade was [b]already affecting crouched movement speed[/b]. However, this update now allows the player to [b]crawl faster than it used to[/b], [b]after upgrading [i]Speed[/i].[/b]

[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]
Achievements were [b]added[/b] for [b]acquiring [i]Hyper-Speed[/i][/b], and [b]breaking walls with [i]Hyper-Shot[/i][/b].
[quote]You’ll need to [b]reset your save[/b] for [b]Breakable Walls related achievements[/b] to work![/quote]
[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
What was [b]changed in this update?[/b]

[h2][b]CHAPTER 0 | [/b]Changes[/h2]
A few [b]changes were made to [i]Chapter 0[/i][/b]. If you [b]haven't seen it yet in 0.584[/b], [b]do not read this yet[/b].
[list][*][spoiler]White [b]light next to the [i]Red Platform[/i][/b] has been [b]removed[/b] to make it darker and [b]more mysterious[/b]. If it’s [b]too dark and hard to get there[/b], it will be restored. Let us know if you want it back ;)[/spoiler][/list][list][*][spoiler]Water [b]visual edges[/b] are now [b]less noticeable[/b] than before - they [b]can still be noticed[/b], but should be significantly better.[/spoiler][/list][list][*][spoiler][b][i]Interface[/i] [/b]option, is now [b]ignored during [i]Chapter 0[/i][/b], and will be [b]applied when reaching [i]Chapter 1[/i][/b] [i](intended)[/i][/spoiler][/list][list][*][spoiler]Changes to [b]reduce CPU usage[/b] after [b]dropping the box on the red platform[/b]. This could [b]help older machines with low-end CPUs during this cutscene[/b], but might also result in [b]longer transition time to [i]Chapter 1[/i][/b]. Most players won’t feel any difference.[/spoiler][/list][list][*][spoiler][b][i]Performance Mode[/i][/b] should now [b]much further increase performance in [i]Chapter 0[/i][/b], as the [b]lighthouse light will now be disabled as well[/b].[/spoiler][/list]
[h2][b]OTHER |[/b] Changes[/h2][list][*][b]Health Packs:[/b] Standing on a [b]Health Pack[/b], will now [b]pick it up properly[/b] even if you [b]don't “move out from it”[/b], if you [b]get injured while still standing on it[/b] - or if you [b]now have available space in your Health Backpack[/b] [i](use one from Backpack while currently standing still on it)[/i].[/*][/list][quote]If you are [b]full health[/b], standing on a [b]Health Pack[/b], and then [b]enable Hyper-Speed[/b], it will [b]NOT pick it up instantly[/b] [i](intended, to avoid wasting it to heal just 1 HP)[/i]. It will instead [b]wait for you to disable Hyper-Speed[/b], or be [b]injured externally[/b], to pick it up. These improvements are [b]not applied to Taser Batteries[/b]. It will be done for them in the future [i](less urgent)[/i].
[/quote][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Shorter relocation to [b]make less visible a visual bug when trying to go around / above the [i]“bigger on the inside door”[/i][/b], just after the [b]Leaf sequence[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] [b]Optimizations [/b]for the area with the [b]musical [i]Hacking [/i]minigame [/b]have been done [i](still an expensive area to render, optimizations not finished)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] The [b]first jetpack path with retractable pillars[/b], will [b]no longer kill the player[/b] if he falls slightly lower than the building. It will now [b]relocate instead[/b]. In addition, if you try to [b]enter from below[/b], when the laser field isn’t present yet [i](if you didn’t go through the vent to the bonus area below)[/i], it will [b]activate to prevent you from reaching it from outside[/b] [i](as you are meant to use the ground vent from inside)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Core Slots:[/b] Slightly improved the [b]self-shadows[/b] for those.[/*][/list][list][*][b]All Chapters:[/b] Various [b]optimizations for first-time use of most shaders[/b] - should [b]prevent some mini-freezes[/b] while playing on older GPUs. If you still have mini-freezes on first usage of game features, it is most likely linked to [b]first audio loading[/b]s, on [b]older CPUs[/b].[/*][/list][h1]LEVEL FIXES[/h1]
[list][*][spoiler][b]Chapter 0:[/b] A bug was causing [b]water to be very bright and white[/b], when[i] [b]Chapter 0[/b][/i][b] was started with [i]Water [/i]quality set to [i]Low[/i][/b]. Should now be [b]fixed with proper [i]Low[/i] quality water[/b].[/spoiler][/list][list][*][spoiler][b]Chapter 0:[/b] The Beach music would [b]not properly loop[/b] and have small “skips” in some cases. Should now be [b]solved and play perfectly[/b].[/spoiler][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] If the box from [i]Chapter 0[/i] was placed [b]too far away from the center of the red platform[/b], it will now [b]fallback closer to the center to avoid having it too close to the player[/b] as he wakes up in [i]Chapter 1[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Power Core was [b]not always respawned properly[/b] when dropped in the [b][i]Laser Field[/i][/b] in front of the [b]time-related keypad [/b]for the vent.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Recent changes to the [b][i]Bridge [/i]area[/b] introduced a new [b][i]Last Checkpoint[/i] softlock[/b] when [b]dying on the Bridge[/b] [i](locked in between the double doors)[/i]. Now fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Various [b]static reflections improvements / bugfixes[/b] after the [i]“Heads Up”[/i] lift, and [i]Bridge[/i] areas.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Added [b]security system[/b] for [b]ending the Sun Control sequence:[/b] it should make sure you [b]cannot move the sun at the very last frame when it’s in the correct angle[/b]. You could potentially end up with the [b]Power Beam enabled[/b] and [b]not all [i]Solar Panels[/i] in the sun[/b] without this security. To be tested.[/*][/list][h1]BUG FIXES[/h1][list][*][b]Mouse / Gamepad Rotation:[/b] Looking around with mouse or gamepad had a bug that [b]caused it to be framerate dependent[/b]. The speed of looking around with gamepad and mouse, should now be [b]fully independent from framerate[/b]. Having a mini-freeze can still cause some jittering, but this is hard to fully solve [i](should be reduced now)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Camera Smoothing:[/b] The [b]smoothing of looking around[/b] [i](enabled by default)[/i] is now [b]slightly smoother[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Mouse / Gamepad Rotation:[/b] In addition, when [i]Camera Smoothing[/i] is [b]disabled[/b], the camera [b]rotation movement[/b] should now feel [b]more reactive and more instantaneous[/b] [i](less input lag)[/i], especially at [b]144+ FPS[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Moving Platforms:[/b] There was still a case in which [b]jump reception on a moving platform[/b] could [b]push you a bit too far for 1 frame[/b], [b]offsetting you from the platform[/b] at every jump landing on said platform. Should now be [b]fully solved[/b] [i](to be tested with different machines and framerates, though)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Aim Stabilizer:[/b] The automatic movement to [b]aim at the stabilized object[/b], was also framerate dependent, due to a bug. Now fully framerate independent.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Leaderboards:[/b] Exiting Leaderboards page while the active tab was [i]Cycle[/i], and coming back, would result in an [b]in-game critical error[/b]. Now fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Tablets:[/b] Current tablet held in hand would become invisible when a cutscene started, but the text would remain in the air, flying. They are meant to be fully hidden during cutscenes, and should now be fully invisible as intended.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Tablets:[/b] A bug would allow [b]picking up the same tablets in NG+[/b] in order to [b]incorrectly increase[/b] the completion of the Chapter [i](Tablets found)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Crosshair:[/b] After or during a cutscene, the [b]crosshair could sometimes be visible again[/b], even if the player [b]currently had an object in his hands[/b] [i](should be hidden in this case)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Graphics:[/b] Changing [b]Graphics Options[/b] during a cutscene would provoke unintended flying lights above the player’s hands, and for other various lights in the game during that specific cutscene.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed [b]various small lighting and reflections bugs[/b] that were reported.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Catwalk Achievement:[/b] Could sometimes be unlocked even if the player walked in water in the first room. Now fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Reset Save:[/b] Improved this system to clearly explain in case the game is not allowed to delete its own save files (antiviruses usually do this). In addition, ensuring that requesting this while the game was already saving, would still successfully reset the save.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Forced Pause:[/b] Fixed a case in which out-of-focus forced PAUSE overlay would [b]remain visible when returning to the Main Menu[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Film Grain:[/b] Could sometimes remain enabled even if it was requested to be disabled. Should now be fixed, but to be tested as there may be edge cases.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Reported Bugs & Suggestions:[/b] Many additional in-game reported bugs have been fixed, and various suggestions have been implemented or planned for future update.[/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update over the next few weeks for the next bugs[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.594 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear Fractal Space players!

After a [b]large amount of work and time[/b], the latest [b]major update 0.594[/b] for [b]Fractal Space[/b] is now [b]live on Steam![/b]

This update brings [b]a crazy amount of bugfixes[/b], [b]improvements [/b]and [b]new changes[/b], and a completely [b]new introduction sequence to the game![/b]

Currently, this update is [b]only for [i]Pre-Alpha[/i] players[/b]. The [b]Public Demo on [i]Steam [/i]and [/b][i][b]Xbox[/b] [/i]will only be updated [b]in a couple of weeks[/b] - after the major issues have been fixed in the new changes and the new intro.

[b]Players awaiting for a Steam Key:[/b] You will receive [b]within 1 or 2 weeks[/b], most likely [b]after the next update is[/b] live, once major issues with this update are fixed.

[quote]Please click the [b]!Reset Save![/b] button in the Main Menu to reset your save and avoid various bugs with the new changes - At least, [b]starting a New Game[/b] is strongly recommended.[/quote]
[h1]CHAPTER 0[b] | Introduction[/b][/h1]
The [b]new introduction[/b] for [b]Fractal Space[/b] on PC is now [b]finally ready![/b]

Even though it [b]feels like a short introduction[/b], it was a [b]significant amount of work[/b] to have this first functional version.

[h2]IMPORTANT [b]| Notes[/b][/h2][list][*]Please [b]start a fresh [i]New Game[/i] without [i]Speedrun Mode[/i] [/b]and [b][i]Cutscenes[/i] enabled[/b], to see the new intro![/*][*][b]None of your [i]Abilities[/i][/b] are available during the introduction [i](intended)[/i][/*][*][b]Debug Mode[/b] is [b]not allowed[/b] in Introduction [i](intended)[/i][/*][*][b]Custom FoV[/b] is [b]ignored[/b] and [b]NOT applied[/b] throughout the introduction sequence. This is [b]intended[/b], and will not change. It is only then correctly applied to desired value [b]after[/b] the intro is finished.[/*][*]There are [b]no checkpoints[/b] in the introduction scene [i](intended, it’s very short)[/i][/*][*]There is a point in the introduction sequence, from which the [b]“Restart” chapter button is temporarily unavailable[/b] [i](greyed out)[/i]. This is intended, and it is restored again [b]after[/b] the intro is finished.[/*][*]It is intended that it’s [b]not played[/b] when starting a [b]New Game+[/b], and start directly in Chapter 1.[/*][*]Chapter 0 is [b]entirely skipped[/b] in [b]Speedrun Mode[/b] [i](because it does not impact Leaderboards, and contains 1 unskippable cutscene)[/i][/*][/list]
[h1]CHAPTER 1[b] | New Dialogs[/b][/h1]
This update contains [b]many changes to Chapter 1's dialogs:[/b]
[list][*]Most of the [b]dialogs of Chapter 1[/b] have been [b]re-recorded from scratch[/b], many were [b]entirely re-written too[/b]. They are now of [b]much higher audio quality, with better audio equipment[/b].[/*][*]IG’s voice now feels more like it is [b]coming out of a speaker in the room[/b], or a communication device [i](intended)[/i].[/*][*]In general, the [b]acting is also improved for most lines[/b] - some are still not good though, and [b]we’ll improve them over time[/b].[/*][*]Many [b]more dialogs are now different in [i]New Game+[/i][/b]. Since most of them are [b]not played in [i]Speedrun Mode[/i][/b], it’s recommended to [b]play at least once NG and NG+[/b] with [b]Speedrun Mode disabled in CH1[/b] [i](no changes in later Chapters yet)[/i] to hear them / check for bugs / subtitles issues.[/*][*][b]Note of a story change:[/b] the character (you) is meant to [i]“remember more”[/i] in NG+ compared to previous versions and [i]Pocket Edition[/i], this is also intended.[/*][*]The [b]last rooms of Chapter 1 [i](after the second lift)[/i] still have older dialogs, and some that are silent[/b], please ignore those, because we didn’t have time to work on them yet - and there are planned changes at the end, that aren’t done yet.[/*][/list]
Next Chapters’ dialogs will come later, as [b]they will all also be re-written and re-recorded.[/b]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
Let's talk about the [b]new features and options that were added[/b] in this update.

[h2]LEADERBOARDS [b]| In-Game Page[/b][/h2]
Finally! The game now has [b]full support for in-game [i]Leaderboards[/i] page![/b] You can now [b]check your Rank[/b], [b]Top 10[/b], [b]Top 50 [/b]and [b]Top 100 [/b]of each [b]Chapter[/b], and the [b]entire Cycle![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/47e7bf6fc8dfa2ae86e5831800256257bbb8bf52.jpg[/img]

In addition, [b]gamepad navigation is fully supported [/b]on this new page.

When this new page has been [b]tested and all potential bugs on this new system are fixed[/b], there will be a [b]Leaderboard reset for all Chapters[/b], and [b]anti-cheat systems [/b]to avoid uploading scores from older versions of the game, and more - but this isn't the priority for this update.

[h2]CHAPTER 1 [b]| Recordings & Tablets[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/9e5d90624391776f3670f4c21221d7bb01d4379c.jpg[/img]

Picked-up [b]Recordings [/b]for the first Chapter have been [b]re-recorded[/b] for [b]better quality and acting[/b] as well. There are now also [b]3 new Recordings to pick up in Chapter 1![/b]

[b]New Tablets [/b]were added in the [b]first Chapter [/b]as well. We'll let you find them :)
[quote]Some Tablets now have a different text in New Game+, so it might be worth to revisit them![/quote]
[h2]CHAPTER 1[b] | Accessible Rooftop[/b][/h2]
The [b]rooftop above the Taser Room[/b] is now meant to be [b]fully accessible[/b] [i](only in New Game+)[/i], when going to pick up the Taser, and when returning back from it. No buggy / forced skips should be possible:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/ace4dcd49cbf680c075644baf34e8a4af933494a.jpg[/img]

Future updates will [b]add more challenge[/b] to reach the item up there.

[h2]CHAPTER 1 [b]| Lockdown Area[/b][/h2]
After getting the Taser, the room where you [b]get the first Taser Ammo Pack[/b] ever has changed [i]slightly[/i], when you return to it on your way back [i](the lockdown moment)[/i]. You’ll see ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/f52371d26f832a6d9a324345358c75954dfc6457.jpg[/img]

[quote]In addition, [b]IG will now react to activating the button manually[/b] instead of shooting at it [i](it's intended to be possible, but not the main path)[/i][/quote]
[h2]WATER | Option & Optimization[/h2]
A new [b]Water Quality[/b] option has been added. Default is [i][b]Maximum[/b][/i], which [b]enables dynamic reflections on Water[/b]. Setting it to [i][b]Low[/b][/i] [b]disables the water reflections[/b] and other effects:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c5b91edaf258547135fe81d0f80c32f90963e2f8.jpg[/img]

This allows you to [b]disable environment dynamic reflections[/b] by setting [i][b]Reflections[/b][/i] to [b][i]Medium[/i][/b] [i](Static reflections only)[/i] or [b][i]“Disabled”[/i][/b], but [b]keeping dynamic reflections on Water[/b] by keeping [b][i]Water[/i][/b] option to [b][i]Maximum[/i][/b] separately. [b][i]Maximum[/i][/b] setting is quite expensive, but [b]much less expensive than general [i]Dynamic[/i] [/b]environment [b][i]Reflections[/i][/b] settings [i](as there are less water areas regular reflective areas)[/i].

In addition, [b]dynamic water reflections[/b] [i](Water setting at Maximum)[/i] have been [b]significantly optimized[/b] compared to previous versions of the game. Various rendering artifacts causing objects to [b]blink / disappear[/b] in water reflections were fixed as well.

[h2]240 FPS SUPPORT | Framerate Options[/h2]
This update adds [b]official support[/b] for [b]60+ Hz monitors[/b], and a [b][i]Framerate [/i]Option[/b], which can allow to [b]disable V-Sync[/b].

[h3]240 Hz Screens[/h3]
The game [b]now supports all monitor refresh rates![/b] If you have a [b]75, 144, 240 Hz monitor[/b], and a gaming GPU that can [b]run the game above 60 FPS[/b], you should feel the difference:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c7b62ccad24db5b5cc06a9d3c0d92d0ecb5e9188.jpg[/img]

Monitor maximum refresh rate is [b]automatically detected and the monitor’s refresh rate is used when starting the game.[/b]
[quote][b]Note:[/b] It is recommended to keep [b]Reflections[/b] to [i][b]Medium[/b][/i], [b]Decals [/b]at [b][i]Low / Medium[/i][/b] to reach higher framerates [i](Dynamic reflections is the most expensive setting)[/i][/quote]
[h3]Framerate Option & V-Sync[/h3]
You can now [b]cap your framerate to a lower value[/b] than your monitor refresh rate:

In which case would you do that? If you have an older PC, and rarely hit 60 FPS on a 60 Hz monitor, it might be a good idea to [b]limit it to 50 FPS[/b], for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/55ca80b865c71e6b67b907253b7145f162f79b7a.jpg[/img]

This will [b]avoid substantial changes in framerate[/b], and will [b]automatically disable Vsync[/b], which will slightly increase performance - so it might help to try and keep this framerate. Since the framerate is capped to that selected value, you will [b]not experience screen tearing even without Vsync[/b].

Vsync is[b] always enabled if you select your monitor’s refresh rate[/b] as a framerate cap [i](max value)[/i]. Otherwise, you are bound to experience [b]screen tearing if you ever reach 61 FPS[/b], which is [b]bad for everyone's experience[/b].

Unlimited framerate is not an option, as it will [b]not have any advantages to go higher than your monitor’s refresh rate for this game[/b], and will only introduce screen tearing and various other issues, and could result in potential exploits.
[quote]If you wish to [b]simply disable V-Sync [/b] [b] while still targeting max framerate[/b], simply [b]select the second-to-last maximum framerate option[/b] - it will[b] disable V-Sync and sure no screen tearing will happen [/b] [i] (best of both worlds)[/i], as the game will remain 1 FPS below than your monitor's refresh rate.[/quote]
[h2]DYNAMIC REFLECTIONS[b] | Rework[/b][/h2]
The [b][i]Dynamic[/i] [/b]option for [b]environment [/b][i][b]Reflections [/b][/i]has been [b]completely reworked[/b] in order to [b]improve their overall visual quality[/b], [b]reduce the blur and associated jittering[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/38f7bc676da507fbde5d5cb58a581fca426a46f8.jpg[/img]

They also are now [b]greatly optimized[/b] compared to the previous versions. Even with these optimizations, it’s still [b]the most expensive option[/b] in the game, and is [b]built for dedicated gaming GPUs[/b], so [b]do not expect to play smoothly on an old PC, or non-gaming laptop[/b] with [b]integrated graphics[/b].

They still cannot be perfect in all situations and have some artifacts in some angles; but it’s [b]much better than previous implementations[/b] ;)
[quote][b]Note:[/b] They are now [b]meant not to be present on all surfaces[/b]. It is normal that you’ll find [b]various areas where you cannot see any Dynamic Reflections [/b] [i] (intended for either performance reasons, or because they have not been implemented in this room yet, and sometimes because they would simply be too distracting)[/i].[/quote]
[h2]VENT FANS & DYNAMIC LIGHTS[/h2][list][*]Shooting a [b]dynamic[/b] light [i](blinking / color changing ones)[/i] will provoke it to [b]flicker a bit temporarily[/b] [i](not the fully static ones, and this is intended. It’s acceptable as this is only a small cosmetic detail)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Vent Fans:[/b] Shooting vent fans will provoke them to [b]stop spinning / jitter temporarily[/b][/*][/list]
[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]
A [b]few new Achievements [/b]were added in this update:
[list][*]New [i]Achievement[/i] added for the [b]very first room[/b], only possible in [b]New Game+[/b]. Won’t be detailed here to avoid spoilers, but you can see it after playing the new introduction, on the game’s page on Steam / Achievements.[/*][/list][list][*]New [i]Achievement[/i] added for [b]completing Chapter 1 while shooting only 1 Switch[/b] [i](the mandatory one during the Tutorial)[/i]. Only possible in [b]NG+ with upgrades [/b][i](to my knowledge!)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*]New [i]Achievements[/i] added for [b]finding Tablets[/b]. They [b]cannot be all completed yet[/b], because [b]not all Tablets are in the game yet [i](intended)[/i][/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Stats:[/b] Current Chapter stats in New Game+, and Chapters page, now [b]display Tablets found[/b], and are [b]taken into account for Chapter Completion %[/b].[/*][/list]

[h2]LIGHTING [b]| Improvements[/b][/h2]
Most [i]“light band highlights”[/i] on walls and grounds [i](blue, red, etc)[/i], now [b]emit a faint [i](non-dynamic)[/i] light to surrounding objects[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/35b922931ecc276f6bc4cae34711d104bfff61b5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/81ef17d4570fb5ffdd609e1137567fac988c64a0.jpg[/img]

It remains mostly visible in dark areas and corners, and adds a bit to the atmosphere and [b]feels more realistic:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/6e13aec148ff59ed4a82e230452fc29f4c2081f9.jpg[/img]

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
This update contains [b]various changes [/b]- we'll list the [b]most important [/b]ones here.

[h2]LOCALIZATION[b] | Update Shortcut[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Localization:[/b] Dynamic update of Localization has now been changed to [b][i]Left Shift + L[/i][/b] key combination[/*][/list][h2]LEVEL[b] | Changes[/b][/h2]
A [b]non-exhaustive of various Chapters changes: [/b]
[list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] [i]‘Don’t look down’[/i] laser fall: Last blinking lasers are no longer instant-kill, meaning you can now survive them if you have enough health. This might be reverted in the future, but if so, it will have many more lasers to make it understandable that you cannot survive them.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Terminal Override (musical hacking): Since the latest change [i](that made it harder by only failing when all 5 notes have been pressed)[/i], too [b]many first-time players are stuck here[/b]. [b]Piano notes sound quality and accuracy has been greatly improved[/b] to help with this. In addition, the [b]first note now always fails instantly if it is wrong[/b], to at least [b]give away the first base note[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Train Ride: Many of the challenges [b]no longer allow you to simply fall below to skip them[/b] - it made it too easy, especially while speedrunning:[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/b9bd495ff66a86c39743da1eb88cb697c472ad6a.jpg[/img][list][*]The ones in which you still can simply fly below, are still allowed, but most [b]now require you to play then normally even while speedrunning[/b] - which makes it harder [i](intended)[/i]. In addition, [b]a few new changes were made to the Train Ride rooms[/b]. If you resume your saved game from the previous update without restarting Chapter 4 entirely, you will have various invalid bugs - [b]please restart Chapter 4 from the start[/b] if you are not starting a New Game or not resetting your save.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] The [b]Secret Passage[/b] area is now a [b]fully enclosed[/b], darker area [i](as intended)[/i].[/*][/list][h2]JETPACK |[b] Balancing[/b][/h2]
The latest update introduced [b]smoother jetpack movement[/b].

However, it was a known issue that the [b]first few seconds of jetpack rise were too powerful[/b].

It has [b]now been reduced[/b], in order to both [b]feel smoother[/b] and [b]prevent exploiting to jetpack almost indefinitely[/b] [i](as the jetpack rise of the first few seconds was too powerful, you could chain the jetpack and fly for much longer than intended)[/i].

[h2]PROP FLYING[/h2]
[b]Tablet Surfing / Cube Surfing / Prop Flying[/b] exploit [i](not really a bug per-say)[/i] has been [b]present for a while[/b], as it’s a complex one to solve. Finally, it has now been [b]drastically reduced[/b].

The idea behind this change is that Cube Surfing / Prop Flying should [b]no longer be easy to perform to skip mandatory puzzles / challenges in New Game[/b] for a [b]new player[/b].

A [b][i]Cube [/i][/b]below your feet will still slow down your fall [i](intended)[/i], but [b]won’t allow you to jump higher from it anymore[/b].

In addition, whenever you try to perform it [i](or successfully manage to)[/i], the [b][i]Cube [/i][/b]will now [b]be properly pushed downwards[/b] [i](as it should, because you are in fact, “kicking it down”)[/i], thus preventing you from chaining it easily.

This change should [b]prevent many illegitimate skips in New Game[/b].
[quote][b]Note:[/b] You can still perform it ‘easily’ if the cube currently has an upwards vertical velocity [i](intended)[/i].[/quote]
[h2]TUTORIALS[/h2][list][*]All [b]tutorial visual skins have changed[/b] for better [b]readability[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b][i]Movement[/i] [/b]and [b][i]Look Around[/i] [/b]tutorials are now [b]present only in the intro[/b], and [b]only displayed if the player has not looked around or moved[/b] after a few seconds upon taking control in the intro. It is [i][b]not a bug that they are no longer displayed in Chapter 1[/b][/i], and intended that they are [b]never seen if the player knows how to move / look around[/b] on his own [i](the case of most players)[/i].[/*][/list][h2][b]OTHER |[/b] Changes[/h2][list][*][b]Flames:[/b] Flames now [b]push Cubes that are in the way[/b] [i](intended)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Crosshair:[/b] Center [b]crosshair is now hidden[/b] when the player is [b]carrying any object[/b] [i](intended)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Respawn:[/b] [i]Cycle[/i] and [i]Iteration[/i] now displayed [b]at every death[/b], even if [b]cutscenes are disabled[/b] / [b]Speedrun Mode is enabled[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Speedrun Mode:[/b] Speed is now correctly updated while in Zero-Gravity[/*][/list][list][*][b]Skip Cutscenes:[/b] The “Skip” button has been [b]moved to the top-right corner[/b] of the screen, to [b]avoid interfering with subtitles readability[/b]. It is now also [b]automatically hidden after 5 seconds[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Terminals:[/b] Upgrade Terminals and Room Control Terminals now show [i]Sign in[/i] instead of [i]Activate[/i] when looking at them.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Heal / Reload:[/b] Request to reload Taser / Heal while nothing left in the Backpack and Health / Ammo already full,, will now show “No healthpack” / “No Batteries” instead of “Health Full / Ammo full” [i](intended)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Health / Taser Backpacks:[/b] Moving naturally from a Chapter to another, will keep the current items from the previous Chapter (Health/Taser backpack count), but will properly be emptied if starting any Chapter from Chapters Page, or starting New Game / New Game+ [i](intended)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Performance Mode:[/b] Enabling Performance Mode now also reduces the quality of Dynamic Lighting on Recordings.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Code Changes:[/b] There has been many code changes to ensure many time-based events / User Interface animations / tutorial, etc are [b]now fully independent from the time slowdown provoked by Hyper-Speed[/b]. For example, before this update, enabling Hyper-Speed while a Tutorial was displayed, could cause it to [b]remain displayed for 30 seconds instead of 3 seconds[/b]. This was considered minor, but could cause other bugs that could end up being major. Most, if not all, important code is [b]now independent from Hyper-Speed time slowdown[/b] [i](as intended)[/i].[/*][/list][h1]BUG | Fixes[/h1]
A [b]large amount of bugs[/b] were fixed in this update - [b]more than what will be listed here[/b], but here's the list of the most important ones. Note that most [b]in-game reported bugs [/b]should [b]now be fixed as well[/b].

[h2]LEVEL | Fixes[/h2]
Here are the [b]major bugs fixed in specific Chapters:[/b]
[list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Various [b]relocation fixes [/b]have been made. The relocations for [b][i]Taser Room [/i]have been modified [/b]to avoid certain [b]skip/exploit situations [/b][i](could sometimes relocate next to “first 2 cubes & laser cages room” instead of inside Taser Room, etc[/i]). Should now be [b]fixed for all Taser Room relocations[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Bridge Puzzle: If you were to instantly [b]request Last Checkpoint within 1s after solving it[/b], you would remain stuck in the [i]Bridge Puzzle [/i]interface. Good find! It used to be a bug that could happen “often” and was fixed, to only be possible in that [b]small timing window[/b]. Now it should be fully fixed![/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Various [b]vents now open faster & earlier[/b], to avoid getting slowed down by them while speedrunning.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Train Ride: Various visual bugs [i](missing objects when backtracking)[/i] have been fixed. Maybe some still remain, to be tested. Various [b]collision bugs were also fixed[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Progress Room: If you were to go through the window of Progress Room [i](as intended)[/i], then went back up outside to the roof, you could then [b]drop down into the Cameras room too early[/b] [i](not intended)[/i], and be stuck without the [i]Hyper-Speed Suppressor Generator[/i] present. Should now be solved:[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/450551283d9c17e328dd1c6c412a719cae81ed56.jpg[/img][h2]GAMEPLAY | Fixes[/h2]
And now, here is the [b]list of most important gameplay bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*][b]Terminals:[/b] Fixed a bug that provoked Terminals to [b]only be usable once[/b], if the player had [b]acquired every single upgrade in the game[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Keypads:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause a softlock on Keypad interfaces, in case you spammed keys while it is hiding / showing.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Gamepad:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause [b]gamepad right stick to not work to look around[/b] in some rare combinations of ALT+Tab and playing on keyboard/mouse while a gamepad is attached (not used).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Mouse Look:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause [b]mouse movement to not rotate the camera properly[/b] (only vertical or horizontal look movement was working). This happened with a complex combination of ALT+Tab and playing on keyboard/mouse while a gamepad is attached (not used).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Gamepad:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause [b]wrong control icons[/b] when often switching between keyboard/mouse and gamepad.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Performance Mode:[/b] Fixed a bug when Enabling, then Disabling Performance Mode during a cutscene, could cause it to be re-enabled when the cutscene was finished, but with the game considering Performance Mode to currently be OFF.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Room Control:[/b] Map labels for objects “Camera 1”, “Door 2”, etc. were not properly localized. Now fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Room Control:[/b] Visual gauge to represent [b]current Available Power[/b] has been reworked to [b]ensure the “0” state is represented correctly with the bar placed fully at the left[/b]. Now [b]becomes red when at 0[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Bridges:[/b] If the player is on a Bridge’s deployment animation path, he will now be pushed correctly by the deploying Bridge (bug also known as ‘Bugge’ for Bug + Bridge). You might be teleported above or below the Bridge (intended).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Tutorials:[/b] Changing resolution or Safe Area position while a Tutorial was displayed, could cause the tutorial to not be fully visible. It may now take 1s to update, but should ensure to adjust tutorial position to be fully visible, after changing resolution. This could mostly be noticed on 4:3 screens, rather than 16:9 / 16:10 screens.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Crouching:[/b] Crouch / Standing Up transition could be faster when running at higher FPS, and slower when running at lower FPS. This has now been fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Flames:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause flames to sometimes be ON or OFF incorrectly, while sometimes doing damage or not - they should now always be in sync properly with the desired state.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Cutscenes:[/b] Disabling Cutscenes option while a cutscene was playing, but was just already requested to be skipped right before pausing, could cause various strange bugs. Should now be fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Moving Platforms:[/b] The rare, mysterious bug in which the player could “slide” while standing on a moving platform, should now be fixed. It was rare, because it could only happen if you were to play on a PC with a 144hz monitor and was actively running the game at 144 FPS.
