Official support for 144 FPS should now fix this issue.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Moving Platforms:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused a slight “player push” upon reception on an actively moving platform. Repeating jumps on moving platforms would gradually move you towards the edges of the moving platform, if the reception happened while it was still moving. Should now be perfect.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Headbob:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause sudden camera mini-bump shortly after reception on a moving platform. Recentering (headbob stop) upon stopping requesting movement, is now smoother as well.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Aim Stabilizer:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause it to aim next to the object instead of directly aiming at it. It should now be solved, but could create new ones - to be tested![/*][/list][list][*][b]Physics:[/b] Some players could feel like the physics movement of objects, especially in Zero-G, could “feel laggy”. This was mostly noticeable when running the game above 60 FPS. It should now be greatly improved, as physics system is now update more often to result in smoother movement, based on the actively selected framerate in Options.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Pause Menu:[/b] Fixed visual bug that could cause the current Chapter Stats and Upgrades Stats text to sometimes overflow their box container visuals in some languages.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Pause:[/b] Pausing the game or ALT+Tabbing while on a moving platform could cause the player to be moved slightly forward/back in the moving platform’s movement direction. Should now be fully solved.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Lighting:[/b] Fixed unintended self-shadowing on some grounds (floors), that would show “black shadow bands” for no apparent reason.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Save System:[/b] Rare cases of saving during cutscenes that modified the environment (disabled Flames, lasers, opened doors, etc), could result in corrupted level state (lasers remaining ON when they should be OFF after a last checkpoint load, for example).[/*][/list]
[h2]KNOWN [b]| Issues[/b][/h2]
A short list of the [b]known bugs[/b] or issues that [b]aren't 100% sure to be fully fixed:[/b]
[list][*][b]Bug 7482773931343[/b] about somehow having a non-unlimited ammo during the Taser tutorial of Chapter 1 could not be reproduced, thus might still be active. If you find steps on how to reproduce, please report again with more information. Thank you![/*][/list][list][*][b]Bug 231132669394050[/b] about a probably incorrect relocation in Chapter 4 could not be reproduced, thus might still be active. If you find steps on how to reproduce, please report again with more information. Thank you![/*][/list][list][*][b]Bug 4212816279831[/b] involving an incorrect moving platform / switch state synchronization in Chapter 1 could not be reproduced, thus might still be active. If you find steps on how to reproduce, please report again with more information. Thank you![/*][/list][list][*][b]The new “Chapter X” 3D[/b] display will [b]not adjust localized language correctly [/b]if the language is changed while already displayed. This will be solved later. It is currently only used in CH0 / CH1.[/*][/list][list][*]Even though most cases of players [b]unable to rotate the camera horizontally or vertically using the mouse[/b], [b]have now been fixed[/b] [i](happens after ALT+Tab out and back)[/i], there [b]could still be rare cases of this happening[/b]. If it happens, please report with [b]details of steps to reproduce[/b]. When it happens, simply [b]moving your mouse significantly or Alt+Tab again should fix it[/b].[/*][/list]
[h1][b]THANKS[/b] | For Playing[/h1]
[b]Thank you again to all dear players [/b]for testing!

We'll [b]continue working to fix the new reported major bugs from this update, in order to update the [i]Steam [/i]and [i]Xbox One Demo[/i], over the next week or two [/b];)

When the [b]Demos are updated within the next 1-2 weeks[/b], we will [b]send out new [i]Steam Keys[/i] [/b]to players currently waiting.

Have a [b]great day[/b], and [b]happy gaming![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.593 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear [b]Fractal Space[/b] players! The [b]PC Pre-Alpha[/b] Version [b]0.593[/b] is now [b]available on [i]Steam[/i][/b]!

After recent [b]update 0.592[/b], we have been working on [b]various bugfixes & improvements for 0.593[/b], which are [b]now ready to test![/b]

We're [b]hoping most major bugs are now fixed[/b], but we'll see about that once [b]our testers get their hands on it[/b] :)

Alright, let's take a look at the [b]new changes and fixes![/b]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
Here's a list of a few [b]new features [/b]that are worth mentioning first.

[h2]SWITCH PRO CONTROLLER[/h2]
This update [b]adds official support [/b]for [i][b]Nintendo Switch Pro[/b] [b]Controller[/b][/i][b][i]![/i][/b] It will now [b]show the correct gamepad icons [/b][i](was previously showing the Xbox One button icons)[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/e552c1b543d45b8fb91d0d1d97c7103234e656e4.jpg[/img]

[quote]Please note it will [b]only work perfectly while connected wirelessly via Bluetooth[/b]. If you are playing with [b][i]Nintendo Switch Controller [/i][/b]via [b]USB cable[/b], please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2590063463][b]follow this guide[/b][/url].[/quote]
[h2]USER INTERFACE | Improvements[/h2]
This update includes a few [b]user interface improvements[/b]:
[list][*][b]Many UI elements [/b]are now [b]sharper[/b][i] [/i][i](less blurry)[/i].[list][*][b]Note:[/b] This may not be noticeable at low resolutions[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Jetpack/Hover Gauges:[/b] Some [b]unintended lines [/b]could be visible next to them. Should now be [b]fixed[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Mouse: Button Icons:[/b] Mouse side [b][i]Next/Previous[/i] buttons [/b]on a [b]gaming mouse [/b]should now show [b]side click buttons correctly [/b]instead of [i]“ButtonX”[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Health Bar:[/b] Improved [b]visual indicator [/b]for [b][i]Hyper Speed / Health Backpack [/i][/b]counter above health bar. Health backpack and Taser backpack battery counters are now [b]greyed out if empty[/b]:[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/676b9876813859ff448e15debbadc7ae82d80224.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Room Control Interface:[/b] Buttons are now [b]less blurry:[/b][/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/459e176d67e017dded484a43162cb36e28c2a96e.jpg[/img]

[h2]CHAPTER 2[/h2]
First of all, in the[b] first room of Chapter 2[/b], you will [b]now be required to shoot a button for the Bridge 1 to deploy[/b] [i](similar to the [url=http://fspe.haze.games][b]Pocket Edition[/b][/url]):[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/99a899cd66c2b7c4a6fb13d9947f464874f147de.jpg[/img]

In addition, a [b]button is now also required [/b]to [b]deploy Bridge 2 [/b]to [b]exit this room[/b]. This was added for the [b]following reasons:[/b]
[list][*]It is a [b]preparation to later allow the player to drop down[/b] to access [b]a Bonus Room[/b][i] (roof of the Room you are getting out of)[/i]. This change makes this [b]future secret area easier to see and access.[/b][/*][*]Currently, there is [b]no way to actually reach the roof anymore;[/b] but this is [b]intended[/b], as there is [b]not yet any content here[/b][/*][/list]Moreover, [b][b][b][b]m[/b]ore optimizations for triggers [/b][/b][/b]were done in [b][b][b]Chapter 2,[/b][/b][/b] similarly to Chapter 1 [i](still work in progress[/i]).

[h2]LAST CHECKPOINT[/h2]
The [b][i]Checkpoint[/i][/b] button now displays [b]how much gameplay time has elapsed[/b] since it [b]was saved:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/d90d26392a3b79d39d92ab374cf703e9fd8928ba.jpg[/img]

The goal of this is to allow a player to [b]estimate roughly how much gameplay time would be lost [/b]if he uses the [b][i]Checkpoint [/i][/b]button to restart from the last Checkpoint, or if he wants to [b]exit the game.[/b]

Please note that:
[list][*]It [b]intentionally does not change the elapsed time if the game is paused[/b] or [b]out of focus[/b][list][*]This is to avoid [b]wrongly thinking the last checkpoint was “10 minutes ago”[/b] whereas the game was in fact [b]paused for 10 minutes[/b].[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]It is [b]reset to 0 [/b]when [b]loading the last checkpoint [/b]or [b]after death[/b], to [b]avoid thinking the last checkpoint was “a long time ago”[/b] after multiple deaths, whereas it is, in fact, a [b]very recent save[/b], and no [i](or very little)[/i] progress would be [b]lost[/b]. [/*][/list]In future updates, the [b]Last Checkpoint [/b]and [b]Exit [/b]confirmation [b]popups[/b] will state this [b]duration[/b].

[h2]LOCALIZATION[/h2]
Good news for [b]translators! [/b]

From this update, when you are done [b]making a pass of changes to the [/b][i]Localization Kit [/i]online sheet, and would like to [b]test them[/b], simply [b]let us know at charles@haze-games.com [/b]and we will [b]update the game's database[/b] [i](it's in a different dedicated sheet, for security reasons)[/i]

Then, you can [b]automatically update the localization[/b] of your [b]local version[/b] [b]of the game[/b], [b]without needing to wait for a next Steam update![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/6f6325594dcd10ba04e4b0513b5b67e9e95ee9a3.jpg[/img]

This [b]runtime localization update [/b]can be [b]performed by:[/b]
[list][*][b]Pause [/b]the game [i](or if already on the Main Menu)[/i][/*][*]Press [b]Left Shift + R[/b][list][*][b]Note: [/b]This will be changed to [b][i]Left Shift + L[/i][/b] in next [b]0.594 [/b]update, to [b]avoid potential conflicts[/b][/*][/list][/*][*]Wait [b]5 to 15 seconds [/b]for the [b]notification to appear[/b][/*][*]And [b]that's it [/b]- The [b]game's localization [/b]will be [b]updated to the latest version![/b][/*][/list][quote]If [b]after 15s[/b], [b]no notification appears[/b], it means [b]you already have the latest localization version[/b]. The next update will [b]notify you that you are already up-to-date[/b].[/quote]
[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
Below is the list of [b]main changes in this update.[/b]

[h2]CHAPTER 1 [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a8292bc37162431bd7ef9e88e087c4b9ba85583b.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Last Room Camera: You can [b]no longer avoid the Camera by standing/jumping [/b]on the crates with a Healthpack on them. It is intended, though, that the Camera [b]cannot see you on the 3-stacked Crates [/b]if you go there with Dodge [i](NG+ only)[/i].[/*][/list][h2]CHAPTER 2 [/h2][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] [b]Bridges 1 and 2[/b] in the [b]first Room[/b] now require a [b]button interaction to be deployed[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Corridor before [i]“Don’t Look Down” [/i]screen: You [b]can’t stand above the Lasers [/b]anymore[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Double-Saw [b]horizontal door [/b]replaced by [b][i]Hyper-Door[/i][/b]. The saw can be [b]seen and climbed on from the outside[/b], but that’s acceptable.[/*][/list][h2]CHAPTER 3[/h2][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] First bridge and first room now uses “Imminent Death” instead of instant-death[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Crows and Leaf cutscenes will now teleport the Player to the correct end of cutscene position[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Added a checkpoint if you enter the Bonus vent to reach the Recording, after the first possible Breakable Wall.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Entering the Sequence Room will now make the ground below the Laser Field disappear[/*][/list][h2]CHAPTER 4 [/h2][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] You can now shoot through the pipes of Chapter 4 to destroy the Hyper-Speed Suppressor below you. You can still either open the door or shoot through (now a player choice).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] You can now shoot through pipes in the Vent 3, returning to the Door 1 after opening it (the Vent with a Generator to Destroy, and small retractable walls)[/*][/list][h1]LEVEL FIXES[/h1]
 Here's a list of the various [b]level-related bug fixes[/b]:
[list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Light next to the moving platforms after the dual Laser Cages was too bright.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] When speedrunning, the London Bridge area where you pickup the jetpack would require you to stand still or move backwards for relocation & lasers in front to be properly disabled / activated if you were to skip the Bridge puzzle. Should now be fixed an allow fast playthrough to skip the London Bridge.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed exploit that could allow you to go through the Roof large smasher and skip a big part of the level. You will now be crushed appropriately.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Fixed a bug if you entered then exited rapidly the “bigger on the inside” door, after the leaf scene. All bugs of this door should now be fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Various collision bugfixes in electrified water area, below the Initialization Room[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Opening the Secret Passage protection of the Beam Receiver, with the Beam already directed correctly, would cause a magic “free camera” bug. Should now be fixed![/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Fixed keyboard going through the ceiling of the last Room Control area (hopefully)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Last Room checkpoint could incorrectly save the state of lasers that protect the Power Core, and the Generator. Should now be fixed[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] The first Mines intro cutscene could sometimes not be played. Should now be fixed (to be tested).[/*][/list][list][*][b]All Chapters:[/b] Removed player collisions on various lights to avoid interference with gameplay[/*][/list][h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
Finally, here's a list of the [b]most important bug fixes for this update:[/b]
[list][*][b]Black Screen:[/b] When restarting a Chapter or loading the next Chapter, it could happen that the game would remain a black screen. If this happens, please use ALT+Tab to fix it. At least 1 occurrence of this bug has been fixed - so it should happen much less often. Though there may still be some cases, please report if it happens again with as much details as you can about what preceded the occurrence of the bug (ALT+Tab, bug report uploaded recently, etc.). Thank you![/*][/list][list][*][b]Terminals:[/b] Pressing ESC or back button on the gamepad will now properly remove the Upgrades or End Game tutorials.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Objective Markers:[/b] Enabling Objective Markers in the middle of a level, while having played without them, would cause older objective marker arrows to remain.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Pressure Plates:[/b] When disabling Zero-G, the Pressure Plate would sometimes become green, but not activate the corresponding objects. This could likely happen for the last door of Chapter 2. Should now be fully fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Sequencer:[/b] Fixed bug that could cause the Sequencer light LEDs to be all off after resuming the game from the Main Menu, even though it should show the currently required color to press.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Encryption Keys:[/b] When inserted into Key Readers, the Encryption Key could sometimes change to an incorrect color[/*][/list][list][*][b]Objective Markers:[/b] Changing language while playing will now correctly update language of objective markers.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Tutorials:[/b] Would sometimes still play appear/disappear sound even though these tutorials would not be visible to the player (already seen, for example)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser:[/b] A bug could cause the Taser to hide even with Aiming button held down, when a Cube/Tablet/Power Core was respawned[/*][/list][list][*][b]Doors:[/b] Sometimes, doors could finish their close animation abruptly, skipping the “small bump upon closing” part of the animation and instantly close. Should now be fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Generators:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause Generators to be saved as Exploded, when the associated objects would still be ON. This could happen if the game was saved during a Generator Explosion. It could result in an impossible situation if Quick Load / Restart from Last Checkpoint. Should now be fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Start Screen:[/b] If a gamepad is connected, it will now display correctly both gamepad button AND Tab icons instead of “Action4”[/*][/list][list][*][b]Restart:[/b] Upon restarting or loading to the next chapter, “Last Checkpoint” respawn hint, crosshair and other interface elements could be visible. Should now be fixed (at least improved)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Cube:[/b] Unauthorized Object cube disappearing animation could keep the Cube’s visual effects while the cube was no longer visible, for quite a while if it happened with Hyper-Speed active.[/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b].

notes.title: Update 0.592 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear [b][i]Fractal Space[/i][/b] players! A [b]new update is now live on Steam! [/b]Version [b]0.592[/b] is[b] available![/b]

This version [b]includes hundreds more bug fixes[/b], reported by our [b]dearest fans[/b], which we [b]would like to thank [/b]before we continue :)

We will be [b]sending hundreds of keys to the many players who requested them [/b]since previous [b]0.591 [/b]was live. Get ready!

Alright then, [b]what's new?[/b]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
We have a [b]few new elements [/b]or [b]major changes [/b]to [b]discuss in this update[/b].

[h2]JETPACK | Customization[/h2]
You can now [b]customize your Jetpack Color[/b] in [b][i]Taser Customization[/i] page![/b] The [b]Jetpack fuel bar[/b] will now [b]adjust its color[/b] [b]based on this custom color as well:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/46efe5d7137a69fd18e0df115245eabe8711ab06.jpg[/img]

[h2]JETPACK | Physics Improvements[/h2]
Jetpack [b]physics have been improved[/b] to [b]feel smoother[/b]. It might take you some time to get used to it. [b]New bugs expected[/b] with this change as well.

The[b] goals of this change are to:[/b]
[list][*]Make the [b]vertical compensation of initiating the Jetpack during a fall,[/b] feel much [b]smoother[/b][/*][*][b]Eliminate all "abrupt stops"[/b] while using the Jetpack[/*][*]Create a[b] smoother Jetpack momentum feel[/b][/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/eead24fcb618c7a5292c0f13d31eb602962bfefe.jpg[/img]

[h2]HYPER-SHOT | Improvements[/h2]
Many[b] improvements were made[/b] to the [b]newly introduced Hyper-Shot system:[/b]
[list][*]Hyper-Shot [b]sounds[/b] have been [b]added[/b][/*][*][b]Sound fixes[/b] when starting to [b]charge Hyper-Shot[/b][/*][*]Hyper-Shot [b]Level 2[/b] now [b]charges significantly faster[/b] than Level 1[/*][*][b]Various bugfixes [/b]linked to [b]Hyper-Shot[/b] mechanic[/*][/list]
[h2]FRAGILE | Windows[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/2b0178bd0bfb437b38c6af27ddb93976190304fb.jpg[/img]

In most situations, [i]Dodging [/i][b]while on the ground will never dodge downwards[/b] [i](but Dodging downwards works if you are [b]in the air[/b])[/i].

From this update, you can now [b]directly Dodge vertically down[/b] [i](towards your feet)[/i] when [b]standing on a breakable window[/b] to [b]break through it![/b]

[h2]VISUAL | Improvements[/h2]
This update [b]includes some visual improvements[/b] - let's take a look at a few of them!

[h3]Crates[/h3]
Simple [b]static crates that block the player[/b] [i](not interactable)[/i] have been [b]visually improved[/b]. The [b]older version is still used[/b] in [b]some areas[/b] to vary:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a8292bc37162431bd7ef9e88e087c4b9ba85583b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Lights[/h3]
Improved [b]lights source visuals[/b] and [b]texture[/b].

Lights now [b]have the center neon[/b] of the [b]correct color[/b] instead of simply white. In addition, when the [b]light color changes[/b] (green to red, for example), [b]neon center and surrounding “light beam” around it also changes[/b] to the appropriate color. It’s good to check them out, because there [b]might be some incorrect color selected[/b] by the system in some edge cases:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/08af1e6b8c60ac238d0d8ba1ce0ea8869910d6be.jpg[/img]


[h2]OTHER | New Additions[/h2]
A short list of the [b]most important[/b] new additions:
[list][*][b]Smashers:[/b] Death by being [b]crushed[/b] by [b]moving platforms [/b]or [b]Smashers[/b] will now [b]instantly fade-to-blac[/b]k[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser-Gun:[/b] The character will [b]now still squeeze his finger[/b] even if there is [b]no more ammo remaining[/b], as he [b]tries to shoot[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Terminals:[/b] Textures of Terminals and locks [b]have been slightly improved[/b]. White [b]lighting [/b]is present on them (especially sides/back), as it was always intended.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Cores[/b] Now have [b]gradual appear visual effect[/b] when [b]respawned[/b], like [b]Cubes[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] [b]Triggers / Spawning / Despawning optimizations[/b] have been applied to [b]Chapter 1 only[/b]. As these optimizations may [b]create new bugs[/b], it was [b]only applied to this Chapter[/b] [i](and a bit in Chapter 3)[/i]. Let us know [b]if new bugs appear[/b]. This optimization should result in slightly [b]less mini-freezes[/b] as you make [b]progress through the level[/b], but will potentially [b]take longer to save Checkpoints[/b] in some areas on [b]low-end PCs[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Added a [b]new button to open / close Door 1 and Door 2[/b] in the [b]first Camera Room[/b], in case you [b]lock yourself in with the vertical moving platform[/b]. If you are detected, they remain [b]unusable until Camera is Cleared[/b] [i](intended)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] First Camera Room: There is now a Laser Field that will kill you below the vertical moving platform, as you should not be able to exit through here. There is now a visible gap between vertical moving platform and walls, so you can clearly guess that there is a trap below (light goes through the edges)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Picking up the [b]Taser with a Cube in hands[/b], will now [b]automatically drop the Cube to ensure you see the Taser[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] You can now [b]skip the corridor that leads to the Big Room[/b] in [b]New Game+[/b], by using [b]Hyper-Speed + Dodge[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Door to the final lift of the Chapter, now uses a [b]Pressure Plate[/b] instead of a switch - requires you to [b]disable Zero-G[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] [i]Initialization Room[/i] now has [b]more lasers protecting the first Generator to destroy[/b] - this is to make it more [b]clear you won’t survive[/b] trying to go through. In addition, there are now [b]static lasers[/b], requiring you to [b]either crouch[/b] or [b]jetpack above[/b] them to reach the [b]Generator[/b]. New static lasers when entering this area as well, to force you to be more careful after moving the [i]Platform 1[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Processing Center Atomizer [b]destructible floors now look “cracked”[/b] to have a more [b]fragile appearance[/b]. The [b][i]Protection Grid[/i][/b] also now [b]looks stronger[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Quick Save:[/b] Requesting a [b]Quick Save[/b] while the game is [b]already saving a Checkpoint[/b], will now [b]force the Checkpoint save to finish instantly[/b], to [b]avoid you having to wait[/b] a few seconds for it to finish, before the Quick Save can [b]finally be performed[/b]. This may result in a [b]mini-freeze when requesting a Quick Save[/b] while the game is [b]already busy saving your checkpoint[/b] - but should [b]avoid you having to wait[/b]. If this mini-freeze is too much on low-end machines, let me know and this will be reverted.[/*][/list]
[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
In addition, we have [b]some changes that are worth noting [/b]here.
[list][*][b]Optimization:[/b] Various [b]Triggers[/b] and other events in [b]Chapter 1[/b] and [b]Chapter 3[/b] have been [b]optimized[/b]. These optimizations will [b]over the next few updates[/b] be [b]applied to other Chapters[/b], and be improved. The goal for them is to reduce mini-freezes while making progress.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Jetpack Color:[/b] Default [b]Jetpack flames color[/b] is now [b]changed from Yellow to Cyan[/b] [i](Arctic)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Headbob:[/b] Headbob movement while walking has been changed slightly to feel smoother and more natural. It may feel weird at first - or maybe you won’t even notice :)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Dodge:[/b] Requesting to [b]Jump while already Dodging[/b] used to [b]continue the Dodge[/b], and [b]perform a Jump[/b] at the [b]end of the Dodge[/b]. This could be a [b]few seconds later[/b].
This has now been [b]changed to start jumping instantly[/b] - [b]interrupting the Dodge[/b] but still providing you with [b]higher momentum for the Jump[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] First Cameras room (last room of the Chapter): You can now [b]see better the Camera 3D Models[/b], as there is [b]better lighting next to them[/b]. First Camera is now [b]behind a window that clearly shows the rest of the station outside[/b] (intended):[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c278a9d265c666f9c717d0632a5e02e8ca8927dd.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Saws:[/b] Now have a [b]more precise damage collision system[/b]. Should improve cases where [b]player’s head is “inside the saw without being damaged”[/b]. Good idea to check if [b]some saws no longer work correctly[/b] after this change.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Changed the first Cube room: the [b]Respawn button has been removed[/b]. The Cube will now automatically be respawned in front of the exit door, if it’s placed where you would be softlocked, once the player touches the ground. This makes it more discrete, and still handles the potential softlock. This auto respawn system is disabled in NG+ if you have Dodge, as it’s not required.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] First Power Core will only respawn in front of the fist Power Core Slot if you had reached that area [b]with the Power Core in your hands[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Vertical Room large moving platforms are now [b]made of 4 [i](now red)[/i] moving platforms instead of one large one.[/b] When opening the Exit, the light of the moving platform that stops becomes white, in order to make it clear that it is not an active danger of falling anymore:[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/d544a8e95a02d33ea4f961adaa65257d53e4018f.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] First shooting cameras room: If you use the [b]Override Door[/b] button, the saved Checkpoint [b]will now respawn you force-crouched behind the boxes[/b] (intended), to ensure you will not be softlocked in an “imminent death” checkpoint save, if a projectile was [b]currently heading towards you at the time you interacted[/b] with the [b]Door Override[/b] button.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Very last room, the [b]breakable window[/b] to get out of the [b]optional Upgrade Termina[/b]l, now has [b]many more lasers to make it clear you cannot survive[/b] entering it [b]without first disabling the lasers[/b], or [b]going through the vent instead[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Various [b]lighting improvements[/b], including the [b][i]Sequence Room[/i][/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] [i]From Cold to Warm[/i] hint text in the Tunnel, is now [b]white instead of cyan[/b] to [b]avoid confusion in the order / hints[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] The [b]Sun Control Room[/b] is [b]now accessed from below[/b], instead of on the right [i](when looking at it)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] The [b]Train Ride:[/b] [i]Imminent Death[/i] system now displayed correctly. Has been changed to make it [b]harder to be skipped[/b] in [b]New Game[/b] [i](only 2s before death)[/i]. If you are in [b]Speedrun Mode[/b] or in [b]New Game+[/b], “Imminent Death” limit is now moved to be lower than normal, allowing you to continue performing your previous speedrun skips.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Various [b]lighting improvements[/b][/*][/list]
[h1]CHAPTER | Fixes[/h1]
Here's a list of the most [b]important bugfixes [/b]which are [b]directly related to Chapters:[/b]
[list][*][b]Chapter 3 and Chapter 4:[/b] All lights [b]re-adjusted[/b] to avoid the “too bright” intensities of lights when Bloom is enabled. Some are still [b]intentionally brighter than others[/b] - but If you still find some that are [b]way too bright[/b] (blinding) or [b]way too dark[/b], please report them as visual bug.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Pandora’s Box at the beginning of the level, was using the old visuals. Now updated.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Various collision bug fixes in the [b]very first lift[/b] when using Dodge [i](could stand where you shouldn’t)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Various collisions bug fixes with Cubes on the ledge to exit the “Prison of Lasers for Cubes” room[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed door appearing as you stepped in for the Lift just after the dual smashers area.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed [b]2 infinite Relocations[/b] when trying to go through [b]unintended paths[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] A bug could cause [b]Relocation from beginning to Jetpack area (!)[/b] is now [b]fixed[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed exploit in which you could skip from the roof of the dual Cameras Room, directly to the Bridge [i](not intended)[/i].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Fixed exploit in which Dodging through a laser field that would kill you, would save at the next checkpoint, allowing you to skip a room (and creating bugs along the way)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Entering The Cube (after using the first mandatory Encryption Key) could sometimes cause missing objects before the Tunnel entrance. Lasers by the entrance vent will no longer be disable as you move forward.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Many various visual bugs have been fixed[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] In rare cases, very fast smashers in the Red area could be out of sync. Should not happen anymore.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] The musical Hacking in Chapter 3 to access Room Control, could sometimes not play the sounds correctly for some players. Should now be fully fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] It was [b]possible to complete the Sun Orientation puzzle with only B[/b] as a deployed wall. [b]Should not be possible[/b], and [b]should now be fixed[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Various screens were displaying multiple times “Door 1” when incorrect (upgrade before fast-shooting Camera)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Now impossible to enter the UV-color-Sequence room by entering from below, just after breaking the Breakable Window of the Sequence Room (laser field will now be active if you try)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] In the room just before the fast shooting Camera, the bottom laser field of the moving dual-laser-field could sometimes be missing.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] When entering the flames area (just before Processing Center), you could drop down rapidly through the closing vent and be locked out, and you could see the world being de-spawned. Now fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Processing Center large crushers now change color (blue/red) appropriately when moving.[/*][/list][list][*][b]All Chapters:[/b] Various collision bug fixes with some pillars throughout levels.[/*][/list]
[h1]BUG | Fixes[/h1]
[b]Destructible Walls:[/b] Borders of destructible wall pieces [b]no longer have the strange buggy colors[/b] before they are broken
[list][*][b]Save System:[/b] Rare bug with [b]Save System[/b] could cause the [b]rooms to be in an incorrect state[/b] [i](missing objects, lasers OFF instead of ON, etc.)[/i].
I [b]could not reproduce those[/b], as it seems to be [b]machine-specific depending on how fast the save process is[/b], based on [b]hard drive speed[/b], etc.
Many [b]changes were made to the save system to make this more robust[/b], hopefully [b]solving all these rare cases of incorrect saved data[/b].
This is a [b]dangerous change;[/b] to be tested if there are any [b]new bugs linked to saving / dying rapidly while the game is saving a Checkpoint[/b], etc.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Relocation:[/b] “Imminent Death” message for “relocation” that kills the player character, were not being shown correctly and would display “Relocation” instead. Should now be properly fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Ceiling Clipping:[/b] In some cases, when [b]very close to the ceiling[/b] - an object below you forcing you to touch the ceiling, for example - you would [b]see through the ceiling[/b] [i](clipping bug)[/i]. [b]Should now be fixed[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Jump Exploit:[/b] At low FPS, your character [b]could jump slightly higher[/b]. That was enough to reach unintended areas. This should now be drastically improved, and it will be much harder to manage to reach unintended places at low FPS.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Cube Exploit[/b]: It should [b]no longer be possible[/b] [i](or much harder)[/i] to get [b]Cubes stuck in between vertical pillars[/b], preventing [b]various exploits[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Smasher Exploit:[/b] Fixed an [b]exploit that would allow players to sometimes go through smashers[/b], especially easier at [b]lower FPS[/b]. If this happens, the player character will now be [b]killed appropriately[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Dodge Exploit:[/b] Fixed a bug that could allow to jump at the same time as starting Dodge, resulting in being able to [b]Dodge twice without touching the ground[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Fan Exploit:[/b] Mitigated (or fully fixed), an [b]exploit[/b] in which the player [b]could go through a full-speed fan even without Hyper-Speed[/b] in Chapter 3. Maybe [b]other fans have the same bug[/b], to be checked.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Speedrun Mode:[/b] A bug was causing Laser collisions to not be correctly enabled/disabled when Speedrun Mode state was changed while in a level. This only applies for the lasers which should have collisions in Speedrun Mode.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Hyper-Speed:[/b] Pausing the game with Hyper-Speed active, would then [b]continue to be active (intended) when game is resumed[/b], but [b]without the Hyper-Speed visual effects[/b] (unintended). Hyper-Speed visual effects are now [b]properly re-applied when the game is resumed[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Quick Load:[/b] Fixed various gameplay bugs that could happen if requested to Quick Load exactly while shooting a button - could cause the player to not be able to jump for a few seconds.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Jump:[/b] Fixed a bug that could [b]prevent the player from Jumping[/b] after a [b]Quick Load[/b] in which the [b]Quick Saved player position was on a slope[/b] instead of flat ground[/*][/list][list][*][b]Disable Cutscenes:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause skipped cutscenes to not react to the next activation (from a button, or any other type of trigger for the cutscene), if a quick load was performed just after interacting with it[/*][/list][list][*][b]Upgrades:[/b] Hyper-Shot upgrade icon was not showing[/*][/list][list][*][b]Terminals:[/b] Now easier to interact with terminals when crouched, or in Zero-G and slightly lower height than the Terminal screen[/*][/list][list][*][b]Footsteps:[/b] Sometimes, the first footstep sound when starting to move would not be played. Now fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Tablets & Power Cores:[/b] Fixed blinking blue/red tablets and power cores at low FPS.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Retractable Walls:[/b] Made potential improvement for retractable walls/platforms which can sometimes be visually deployed when they should not (and usually, not fully deployed when this bug happens). It’s a [b]blind fix[/b], meaning [b]I couldn’t reproduce the actual bug[/b] on my machine, so [b]I’m not sure if this is fixed[/b]. But here's [b]hoping[/b] it’s improved ;)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Screens:[/b] Fixed some [b]screens which were not displaying their text correctly[/b] after recent optimizations of 3D texts (Chapter 4 Generator screens, Chapter 2 Special Thanks title, and more). Please [b]report any other screen that seems to not display its text correctly[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Overlapping Cutscenes:[/b] A very rare bug could cause 2 cutscenes to play at the same time. This should no longer happen. In the event that you manage to make 2 cutscenes play at the same time (very rare), it should now correctly play them one after the other in a sequence.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Tablets:[/b] Removing a Cube that is below another Cube (stacked) was no longer provoking flying cubes anymore from the latest update. However, this could still occur with Tablets. Should now be solved.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Cubes:[/b] Quick-Saving while a [b]Cube was falling in the void[/b], would then result in the Cube [b]never being respawned[/b] if you were to [b]Quick-Load[/b] to that save with the Cube falling in the air. Could also happen if you were to simply push the cube off the ledge, instead of picking up then dropping the Cube.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Red Pillars[/b]: Could have a “hole”, missing face on the red pillars. Fixed in most cases (some remain).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Dodge:[/b] Various bugs were fixed if the [b]player requested to Jump just after a Dodge was initiated[/b], including various exploits[/*][/list][list][*][b]Vents:[/b] If you placed [b]Power Cores / Cubes in the middle of an open Vent Door[/b], Quick Saved, then [b]closed the vent[/b], and then [b]Quick Load to the save with the Vent Door open[/b], it would [b]provoke the Cubes/Power Cores to fly a bit[/b]. Now it should be fully solved and keep the object’s [b]precise positions[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Objectives:[/b] Playing with [b]Objectives disabled[/b] would [b]still play Objective sounds[/b] when an objective was [b]accomplished[/b]. Now fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Module Management:[/b] Fixed a bug in which [b]Module Management could be displayed over Pause menu[/b], if it was being shown while the Taser was [b]Toggled ON[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser Ammo Indicator:[/b] Reduced [b]unintended flickering of the Ammo display[/b] on the Taser-Gun, [b]after the Train Ride in Chapter 4[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Death:[/b] Requesting [b]Quick Load or Last Checkpoint after Death[/b], will [b]no longer cancel the fade-to-black[/b] [i](which allowed you to see for a short amount of time after death)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Death:[/b] [b]Pausing the game[/b] while dead will [b]keep a black background[/b], to [b]prevent you from seeing the world while being dead[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser:[/b] Fixed a bug that prevented aiming laser from turning on correctly, if insta-reload was meant to be done instead of reloading animation (ex: picking up healthpack at the same time as reloading)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser:[/b] Fixed [b]many bugs[/b] related to [b]playing both reload & heal animation[/b] at the same time [i](not intended, the first one requested should play, the second one should be instant)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Keypads:[/b] Using keyboard to interact with keypad buttons should now play the sound, just like using the mouse cursor[/*][/list][list][*][b]Cubes:[/b] Fixed a rare bug that could cause Cubes to be non-interactable, after a quick sequence of Quick-Save/Quick Loads while the Cube is being respawned[/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update over the next few weeks for next bugs[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.591 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, [b]dear [i]Fractal Space[/i] players![/b]

A [b]new update is ready to be tested![/b] As usual, [b]many bugfixes & improvements were added[/b], in addition to a a couple of [b]new features & changes![/b]

[h1]COLLISION BUG | FIXED[/h1]
We mentioned in our [b]previous update news[/b], that a [b]major collision bug was under investigation for months with the [i]Unity [/i]team[/b]. It was [b]investigated and solved[/b], but we had to [b]wait for it to be included [/b]in order to [b]update [i]Fractal Space [/i]with the fix[/b].

We are[b] glad to say the fix is now live[/b], and [b]included in this latest update![/b] You should [b]no longer randomly fall through any ground [/b]for [b]no reason [/b]:)

[h1]TASER | HYPER-SHOT[/h1]
The [b]Taser-Gun shooting and input system[/b] has a [b]significant change [/b]in [b]this update:[/b]
[list][*]Normal shots [i](Shoot button pressed)[/i] will [b]no longer break fragile walls[/b], nor [b]destroy [i]Cameras[/i][/b][/*][*]When [b]upgrading [i]Taser Power to Level 2[/i][/b], you now [b]unlock [i]Hyper-Shot [/i]ability[/b][/*][*][b]HOLD [/b][i][b]Shoot[/b] [/i][b]button [/b]to [b]charge [i]Hyper-Shot[/i][/b], release when [b]charged [/b]to [b]fire [/b][i](releasing [b]before [/b]fully charged will [b]cancel [/b]shot)[/i][/*][*][b]Only [/b][i][b]Hyper-Shot[/b] [/i]will perform first [b]breaking impact on a [/b][i][b]Breakable Wall[/b][/i][/*][*][b]Only [/b][i][b]Hyper-Shot[/b] [/i]will [b]destroy[/b] an unprotected [b][i]Camera[/i][/b][/*][*][i][b]Hyper-Shot[/b] [/i]can [b]destroy a [/b][i][b]Generator[/b] [/i]in [b]1 single shot[/b][/*][*][i][b]Hyper-Shot[/b] [/i]can [b]break through multiple fragile windows[/b], and [b]directly Activate the switch behind[/b] the broken window and break any next windows behind in 1 single shot![/*][*][b]Normal shots [/b][i](even with Taser Power level 2 or 3)[/i] will continue to [b]only stun Cameras[/b][/*][*][b]Shoot animation[/b] now [b]blends better[/b] with [b]walk/jump/jetpack/reception animations[/b][/*][*][b]Holding the Shoot button[/b] down [b]without [i]Hyper-Shot [/i]unlocked[/b] will now [b]continue to shoot as soon as possible[/b] when you have [b]not yet unlocked [i]Hyper-Shot[/i][/b] [i](in which case it will then start [b]charging[/b] Hyper-Shot instead)[/i].[/*][*]Pressing the [b]Shoot button[/b] while the Taser is [b]already shooting[/b] will now [b]chain another shot as soon as possible[/b] [i](intended)[/i].[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/6122e378460eb11d86acef86d60fb39a851a2385.jpg[/img]

This [b][i]Hyper-Shot[/i][/b] system was [b]always intended[/b], but required some [b]rework of the Taser-Gun that we didn’t have time for[/b]. It was done for the following reasons:
[list][*]We want you to[b] time your Hyper-Shot charge correctly[/b] before being able to [b]Destroy objects[/b] [i](especially during speedruns)[/i][/*][*]Greater [b]feel of power[/b] as you [b]upgrade the Taser-Gun[/b][/*][*]Allows you to [b]still stun Cameras instead if you don’t have time to Charge[/b][i] (now a player choice)[/i][/*][*]There will be an [b]Achievement for completing the game without ever destroying Cameras[/b] [i](impossible without this new system if you upgraded Taser Power).[/i][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/cd51a32993585dc7920f3f02e68149cd5daa9e75.jpg[/img]

Currently, a [b][i]Hyper-Shot[/i][/b] still [b]only consumes 1 Ammo.[/b] It is possible in the future that it will consume [b]2 Ammo instead[/b] - but this is still [b]under investigation[/b]. It might be like this soon as a test, and we’ll see how that goes ;)

[quote][b]Note:[/b] Later on, there will be a [b]specific visual effect[/b] and [b]sound effects[/b] that are different for [b]Hyper-Shot[/b] [i](not yet implemented)[/i][/quote]
[h2]WATER | Dynamic Reflections[/h2]
From this update, when [b]Reflections[/b] are set to [b]Dynamic[/b], [b]water areas now have much more precise realtime reflections[/b]. This is [b]very expensive[/b], and should [b]only be enabled with dedicated mid/high-end graphics cards[/b]. If you are playing on [b]Mac/Laptop/integrated graphics[/b], it will most certainly [b]result in lower FPS[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/d8f5b4e55de4c9443e65c7bbd779a48665271108.jpg[/img]

In the future, there will be a separate setting for [b][i]Water Reflections[/i][/b] quality VS [b][i]Reflections[/i][/b], in case you have decent playable performance with [b][i]Reflections [/i][/b]set to [b][i]Dynamic[/i], [/b]but dynamic water reflections impact your FPS too much. [b]Currently, they are both tied to the same [i]Reflections [/i][/b]option.

[h1]PERFORMANCE | MODE[/h1]
[i][b]Fractal Space [/b][/i]is now [b]well-optimized [/b]and [b]should run smoothly on any modern computer [/b]with a [b]dedicated GPU[/b].

If you are playing with a [b]low-end machine [/b]or [b]laptop [/b]with an [b]integrated graphics card [/b][i](no dedicated GPU)[/i], you'll always [b]need to reduce resolution [/b]to reach [b]playable FPS [/b]in a game like[i] Fractal Space[/i], which has [b]dynamic lighting [/b]and [b]realtime shadows[/b], along with [b]post-processing effects[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/4b0b9c72d905182e1494d69d8c0c122ca56df2fe.jpg[/img]

In general, it is [b]not recommended [/b]to enable [b]any other post-processing effect than Bloom [/b]and [b]remain around 1280x720[/b] when you only have an [b]integrated graphics card[/b].

The game had [b]an old Debug Tool [/b]was used by some players to improve performance: [b]ALT + Backspace[/b]. This shortcut [b]disabled all post-processing effects[/b]. However:
[list][*]It was [b]unstable[/b], and would be [b]automatically disabled [/b]in the [b]next cutscene[/b][/*][*]It could [b]cause various rendering bugs: [/b][i]windows, screens would have visual bugs when using it and aiming with the Taser or using Scope[/i][/*][*]It was [b]not a recommended feature [/b]to use, only to [b]debug crashes[/b][/*][/list]
We have now [b]completely reworked this system[/b], to make a [b]proper[/b], [b]officially supported [i]Performance Mode[/i]![/b]

The [b]goals [/b]of the [b]Performance Mode [/b]are to:
[list][*]Choose your [b]regular settings [/b]to [b]play most of the game with good-looking visuals [/b]on your machine. You might be able to play with [b]acceptable FPS [/b]with Bloom, Chromatic Aberration, etc in [b]most areas[/b], so you will want to keep these settings for most parts of the game.[/*][*][b]Easily engage [i]Performance Mode [/i][/b]when you [b]reach a low-FPS area [/b]in which your GPU/CPU has more difficulty[/*][*][b]Easily disengage [i]Performance Mode [/i][/b]to [b]return to your desired higher-quality graphics [/b]when you are [b]past the low-FPS area[/b][/*][*]It is now [b]activated with the [i]F2 [/i]key [/b][i](will not react while Debug Mode is enabled)[/i][list][*]You can now [b]re-assign this shortcut [/b]in the [b]key remapping window [/b]to suit your needs [i](Keyboard/Mouse only)[/i][/*][/list][/*][*]It is [b]more efficient:[/b] it now [b]disables and adjusts much more [/b]than [b]only removing [i]Post-Processing[/i][/b][/*][/list]
In general, the [b]FPS boost provided by [i]Performance Mode [/i]should be significantly higher [/b]than the previous [b][i]ALT + Backspace[/i][/b] [b]debug shortcut[/b], and should [b]no longer create any visual bugs[/b]!
[quote]Please note that[b] changing any of the Graphics Options will automatically disengage [i]Performance Mode [/i][/b]when [b]applying settings [/b]- this is [b]intended[/b], you [b]will have to re-enable it [/b]when you are[b] back in active gameplay.[/b][/quote]

[h2]CHAPTER 3 | NEW SKIP[/h2]
[b]Chapter 3[/b] now has a new [b]skip path![/b]

It is meant to skip a part, [b]only for New Game+[/b]. It’s next to the large [b]vertical Tower area[/b], around where you can find the [b]very first [i](optional)[/i] Encryption Key[/b] of the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/584080300b65742d90d9e89bc79039567986bfcf.jpg[/img]

This path means that you can [b]backtrack a bit more in this area[/b] [i](to return and get the Upgrade next to the Crusher if you missed it)[/i]

The level has been [b]changed accordingly to avoid most bugs.[/b]

If you get[b] Hyper-Shot Level 1 with the Upgrade Terminal just before it[/b] (inside), it means you [b]can get out in New Game[/b] - which is intended, so you can [b]go to the optional area on the roof in case you missed it[/b], but [b]can’t skip this area the first time.[/b] To be tested!

[h2]OBJECTIVES | Options[/h2]
From this update, there are now [b]2 new Gameplay options:[/b]
[olist][*][b]Objective Markers:[/b] New option to [b]disable the Objective Markers[/b] [i](and keep only objective entries)[/i][/*][*][b]Objectives:[/b] New option to [b]disable the Objective entries[/b] [i](and keep only objective markers)[/i][/*][/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/956933a60ecc727aa53ccd4d7a017ecddcffec72.jpg[/img]

[h2]NEW | IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list][*]The [b]FPS counter [/b][i](displayed at the top-right corner of the screen)[/i] on [b]SHIFT + F [/b]was [b]now restored[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Now have higher-quality and improved textures.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Core Slots:[/b] Now have higher-quality and improved textures. They also now have improved lighting effect with shadows. If performance impact is too high, later on shadows on these objects will be only enabled on Maximum [i]Dynamic Lighting[/i] option.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Film Grain:[/b] Film grain used in [b]Cutscenes[/b] can now be [b]disabled in Graphics options[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Loading Optimization:[/b] In addition to the new Performance Mode, loading time should now be improved. It’s not really the “Loading…” progress bar time that has been reduced, but more the “black screen transition” time from load completed to level initialization, that should now be shorter. Same goes for black screen load for Quick Loads.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] The area just [b]before the Leaf[/b] has [b]slightly changed[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Pandora’s Box:[/b] Improved it visually for PC - still work in progress.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Bloom:[/b] Latest update [b]increased Bloom intensity[/b]. This causes various lights in the game to be more intense (blinding effect). Lights in Chapter 1 have all been re-examined and changed to decrease this effect, while keeping the more intense Bloom. This should solve most cases of too intense lights in Chapter 1. Other Chapters have been changed as well, but some of them aren’t done yet (will be in future update).[/*][/list]
[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
[list][*][b]Lighting:[/b] The previous update increased general Bloom intensity (as a test). As a result,[b] many lights were much brighter than they should be[/b]. All lights in [b]Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 have been re-adjusted to compensate[/b], and should now look better (please report if you still find some, as I might have missed some). Chapter 3 and 4, though have not been reworked, so you will still see[b] very intense lights in Chapter 3 & 4.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]FPS Counter:[/b] Restored [b]FPS counter[/b] feature, top-right of the screen with [b]Shift + F[/b] shortcut[/*][/list][list][*][b]Performance Mode:[/b] Now [b]toggled with F2 instead of ALT+Backspace[/b]. You can now [b]change this key binding![/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser Shots:[/b] Will now still show [b]taser shots impacts[/b] when [b]particles are disabled[/b] [i](but no particles will be present)[/i], because this [b]impact display[/b] is now driven by [b]Decals[/b] Graphics Option.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Changed the optional Color Pack in the first Power Core area (accessible in New Game) to have different relocation and save Checkpoint (with the ground below the Color Pack now always present) in order to prevent exploits of just picking up the Color Pack, then throwing yourself intentionally into the void or load last checkpoint to get back to the lift exit.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] The very first Cube room of the game now has a [i]Reinitialize Cube[/i] button for the Cube, in case you left it up next to the Vent, and can’t get it anymore after dropping down.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Aim Stabilizer:[/b] Improvements were made for it to be smarted when selecting which object to Stabilize to, when multiple possibilities are available. It might still fail in some cases, but most of the time, it should prioritize the closest object you are aiming at.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Power Core Slots:[/b] You can no longer stand on Power Cores once they are inserted in a Power Core Slot (intended)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Musical Hacking now reduces sounds of the game and music, and ensures buttons/listen to sample are now played at regular volume regardless of sfx/music volume in case you reduced it[/*][/list]
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list][*][b]Performance Mode:[/b] Bugs linked to enable Performance Mode should now all be fixed.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Options:[/b] Fixed a bug in which Subtitles/Speedrun Mode/Cutscenes checkboxes could be shown unchecked, while these options were actually enabled (checkboxes were out-of-sync).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Reported Bugs[/b]: Fixed [b]many other in-game reported bugs[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Hover:[/b] Fixed a bug that would cause Hover to engage, even if it was toggled OFF using Module Management or Shortcut.[/*][*][b]Hover:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused Hover to engage when Dodging in Vents[/*][*][b]Hover:[/b] Ensured Hovering would stop crouching - if not enough space to stand up, Hover won’t engage[/*][/list][list][*][b]Skip Cutscenes:[/b] Fixed bugs that could occur when disabling cutscenes in Options, while the game was already playing a cutscene, or transitioning to a cutscene. It will now automatically skip it correctly if cutscenes are disabled while a cutscene is already playing, without causing major bugs. A small jitter can be felt, but nothing major should go wrong anymore ;)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Interaction Pause:[/b] Fixed various bugs that could happen when pausing the game instantly after interacting with a button while Hyper-Speed was enabled. Pausing the game while transitioning to a cutscene will also pause the transition as expected.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Save System:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause a Quick Save to not be saved correctly, if you were to instantly pause the game after requesting to Quick Save.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Pandora’s Box:[/b] Aiming at it will now show correctly “Unknown” and no image (intended).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Aim Stabilizer:[/b] Fixed a bug where the Aim Stabilizer would try to aim the incorrect object (Mostly happening in Chapter 4)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Flying Cubes:[/b] Stacked Cubes could sometimes end up flying in the air when one of them was removed. This should be fully solved.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Taser Customization:[/b] Various visual bugs have been fixed in Taser Customization (older button design, screen not visible from the back).[/*][/list][list][*][b]Cameras:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause Camera shields to be re-activated even if the Power Core was removed and it shouldn’t activated (after returning to menu and coming back, not simply Quick Loading)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Bug Reporting:[/b] Fixed the bug with scrolling Colors list if you reported a bug while on Taser Customization. Ensured pressing ESC to exit bug reporting will not exit the current Keypad interface.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Keypad Interface:[/b] Ensured clicking the Back button will correctly exit the Keypad Interface[/*][/list][list][*][b]Tutorials:[/b] Will now dynamically adjust in realtime when you switch from/to Gamepad/Keyboard, and when language is changed - even when already visible on screen[/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update over the next few days for next bugs[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.590 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear Fractal Space players! We’ve been working hard on this update, which includes many new improvements & changes; especially on the code / behind the scenes, and of course, hundreds of reported bugs are now fixed!

Some of the improvements, you might not even notice, but they were necessary to prepare the game for the next Chapters. We’ll present here an overview of the main changes that were made in this latest update!

[quote]Considering the major changes in the Save System of the game, we did our best to keep older saves compatible, but there is a chance you will need to RESTART the Current CHAPTER from Start after resuming from the new version, to avoid any level or save-related bugs![/quote]
[h2]HOTFIX | 0.588 -> 0.590[/h2]
[b]Additional changes[/b] made in this latest additional [b]update 0.590 that improves over original 0.588[/b].

[h3]CHANGES | In 0.590[/h3][list][*][b]Module Management[/b]: Shouldn't display anymore in New Game+ if you don't have the Taser-Gun yet[*][b]Taser Screen[/b]: Now displays the[b] new button design[/b] when aiming at a button[/*][*][b]Taser Screen[/b]: Now displays the[b] appropriate color of the aimed at button[/b][/*][*][b]Flames[/b]: Now have sound, and damage sound is better (will be improved later)[/*][*][b]Blades[/b]: Will [b]now have player collisions when disabled[/b], and [b]when Hyper-Speed in ON[/b][/*][*][b]Bugs[/b]: Most major reported bugs are now fixed[/*][/list][list][*][b]Relocation/Save Bug/Exploit[/b]: Even though the game does not allow Quick Saving while in Relocation, some players were able to sneakily save just while Dodging towards relocation and then Quickload past the relocation. From this update, it should be impossible (or much harder). If the save is successful, it should always load right before you exited the authorized area. To be tested, though, as this is a complex timing problem, please report if you still manage to do so ;) This issue was much more likely to happen at low FPS. Thank you![/*][/list][list][*][b]Dodge Save/Load Exploit[/b]: You could potentially Dodge more often than intended by repeatedly quick saving / quick loading. Dodge cooldown should now be saved / loaded more precisely to avoid this[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Removed the Moving Platforms appearing just above the “Escapism tablet Quote” Room, with the “Impressive!” optional recording. Now that the “button cage” from the previous room remains (in earlier versions, it disappeared), you can use the ledges and that part to do this room and reach the Bonus Recording. The grounds will now disappear as you approach instead of having already disappeared. The second button to shoot has been moved to be harder to shoot until you reach the ledges.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Should no longer be possible to reach the roof of the first Power Core area in New Game (meant only possible in New Game+). You might be able to still find a way; if so, please report ;)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Changed checkpoints in the first Power Core Area (3600 code) to save inside this room, in case you enter through the breakable window without opening the door in NG+. There were various bugs if you skipped this way: lights were off, etc.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4[/b]: During the Great Fall, the blades won’t kill you if HS is enabled. You will also collide with them with HS enabled.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Blades:[/b] Blades in general should no longer kill the player when HS is active. However, if it still rotates very fast with HS, then it’s intended to still be able to kill you in HS - but this is rare: The Train ride in Chapter 4, the second one is like this intentionally; it requires to remove the Power Core OR use perfect Dodge timing)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Saving[/b]: Requesting to return to main menu will now force finish saving all data before returning to menu to avoid save data corruption and errors[/*][*][b]Saving[/b]: Requesting a Quick Load while the game is saving a Checkpoint/Quicksave will force current save to finish much faster to avoid to have to wait - This may cause small hiccups but it’s acceptable since you explicitly requested to load, so it’s best to have it performed ASAP.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Speed Counter[/b]: Will now show same speed with HS on or OFF[/*][/list][h3]BUG | Fixes in 0.590[/h3][list][*][b]Bug Reporting[/b]: Screenshots should be working again for Discord.[/*][*][b]Bug Reporting[/b]: Upload Progress was not being displayed (bug) should now be displayed correctly. The ‘Pause’ overlay shouldn’t remain after a failed bug report retry[/*][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Fixed a bug when entering the Camera Room, which could cause to respawn at wrong position with some key level objects disabled[/*][*][b]Chapter 2[/b]: Activating Hyper-Speed on the first frame of Chapter 2 could cause the first bridges platforms to be misaligned, and you would see them move[/*][*][b]Vertical Saws Lift[/b]: If you were to “climb without the lift” using Hover/Dodge etc without even activating it, some objects would disappear[/*][*][b]Moving Lasers[/b]: A remaining bug could cause (rarely) some lasers to be out-of-sync. Not due to saving/loading (previously, save/load could provoke this), but due to how they were being turned on[/*][*][b]Locking Devices[/b]: Locking devices next to vents could have floating texts[/*][*][b]Reported Bugs[/b]: Fixed [b]many other in-game reported bugs[/b][/*][/list]
[quote]Below is the original post for [b]major update 0.588[/b].[/quote]
[h1]FRACTAL SPACE | 64-BIT[/h1]
Fractal Space has [b]now officially switched to 64-bit support for Windows[/b], allowing better performance in general. Along with the big save system optimization explained later below, this should greatly help with various stutters and mini-freezes.

Since this is a first 64-bit implementation of the game, [b]there is a chance new bugs/crashes may occur.[/b] We’ll see how it goes!

Still on a 32-bit Windows machine? Don’t worry, all updates will also ship the 32-bit version, and only the appropriate version for your machine will be downloaded.

[h1]NEW | Buttons[/h1]
This will [b]feel like a big change[/b] at first for our dearest fans, as you are [b]accustomed to how the in-game 3D interactable buttons look like[/b], since the [b]Pocket Edition of Fractal Space[/b].

However, it was[b] important to improve them for various reasons:[/b]
[list]
[*] We want them to [b]look better and have a bit more detail[/b]
[*] We need it to be [b]more clear which state they were in, even from a distance[/b]
[*] They need to have a [b]more visible state change[/b]
[*] [b]Red VS (Green/Blue) state[/b] needs to have a [b]slightly different shape[/b] to ensure [b]colorblind players notice more[/b] the difference
[*] We want to [b]make it more clear that a button is currently unusable:[/b]
[*] When [b]unusable[/b], the [b]difference VS usable is more noticeable[/b]
[*] Even while being [b]not completely off[/b]
[/list]
For example, [b]Elevators: [/b]They [b]can’t be used while the elevator is active[/b], but the [b]button remains in a colored state (blue)[/b] instead of [b]completely off[/b] (intended), but it is now [b]more understandable “why” you cannot activate it[/b].

It may [b]take a while for you to get used to the new buttons[/b] [i](just like it was for some with the new Taser-Gun for PC)[/i] but in the long run, [b]we feel they are better compared to the old ones[/b] 🙂

We’re intentionally not including screenshots for this, [b]see it for yourself in the game![/b]

We [b]hope you’ll enjoy them![/b]

[h1]TASER-GUN | Weapon Sway[/h1]
One of the additions we wanted to work on for a while, was adding a dynamic weapon sway system for the Taser-Gun in Fractal Space. We took the time to add this, and even though this is a first version, it now:
[list]
[*] Adds a feeling of weight to the Taser-Gun
[*] Feels more natural as the player looks around while aiming
[*] Feels more natural as the player moves/uses the Jetpack/hovers while aiming
[*] Adds this rotation/movement momentum over regular Taser Animations, smoothly blending with them, making a more natural movement feel
[*] Small change in Taser-Gun position when crouched VS standing up
[/list]

[h1]TASER-GUN | Animations[/h1]
We made a few improvements to Taser Animations in this update:
[list]
[*] All Taser Animations have been improved to feel smoother
[*] Many cases of “instant interruption” of some animations (upon jump/reception/jetpack events) have now been fixed and general Taser Animation transitions feel much smoother than before.
[*] NEW: Taser Animation for Hover, with sound and vibration. Additional visual effects will be added in later updates
[*] Zero-G Boost: Slight Taser-Gun shake while using Zero-G Boost
[/list]

[h1]VISUAL | Improvements[/h1]
There are countless of small visual improvements in this update, we’ll mention the most important ones here:
[list]
[*] Bloom: Now more intense in general (slightly). Might be too much now in some areas. We’ll see if this will be reverted, or if in general lights will need to be lowered to compensate.
[*] Hyper-Speed: Visual effects (Distortion + Chromatic Aberration) are now reworked for progressive transition instead of instant when enabling / disabling Hyper-Speed.
[*] Smashers now become RED while moving:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/b3e63ab4e1189b003b9f1363cd61992d125d1d7f.jpg[/img]

[*] Power Cores and Cubes now look better (RED lines highlights) when held in an invalid position (Cannot drop here). The rest of the Cube / Power Core does not become red anymore:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c88aa4a8ed98dfd6e30052c7165c77521a637b28.jpg[/img]

[*] Generators: Textures have been improved and better “metallic” feel. In addition, generators are now red when destroyed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/8930783ef00f3b078584a43b7f2de7c456fbb45e.jpg[/img]

[*] Generator Explosions: Now look better, and more realistic. Looks also better when Hyper-Speed is active. Uses Particles, so will look better with Particles enabled (just like the Taser-Gun shooting)
[*] Camera Explosions: Now look better, and more realistic. Looks also better when Hyper-Speed is active. Broken Camera has a small blue fire for a few seconds after being destroyed. Uses Particles, so will look better with Particles enabled.
[*] Lasers ON/OFF states (color/lighting) is now better, and visual difference is more noticeable (there were texture bugs with them). Side grid of Lasers now also become RED when ON.

[*] Lasers: Some laser sets now have a STATIC rail support (different from moving laser rails). More will be added over time. Not all static lasers should/will have them (intended):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a5439347b93b3876a45581c4be34950e17d8b7b6.jpg[/img]

[*] Bridges: Improved Bridge textures:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/5b92f522b44a0a727b68b77fdcc8d40f79472084.jpg[/img]

[*] Water: Objects falling in Water, and Taser Shots, will now create various water splashes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/1a809bf4c1d6def08097ade939a8a2c807e497c9.jpg[/img]

[*] Chapter 4‘s Solar Station now has proper cables for all Solar Panels
[*] Many optimizations of some some specific Areas in all Chapters
[*] Various animations improvements to the Taser-Gun
[*] New Buttons visuals
[/list]

[h1]AUDIO | Improvements[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/3c5c70ed566a16eff30011f69d0e2ede271356db.jpg[/img]

We’ve reworked a lot of the audio as well to fix a few issues:
[list]
[*] Some players could have “cracking” sounds at higher volume, especially if volume sliders were all at maximum.
[*] The default sound setting for the game have changed, to have most sliders to maximum value, and sound is more “normalized” to your current system sound volume.
[*] All bugs related to “cracking” sounds at higher volume should now be fixed. Please report if you still find some.
[/list]
In addition, as general Audio changes:
[list]
[*] Water now has specific sounds when walking in it, and creates water splashes with sound, reacting to objects and player
[*] Footsteps: Better in sync with camera headbob. Reworked system to sound “smoother” from one step to the next, and for more variety in sounds. Lowered their general volume as they were too loud.
[*] Added many new sound effects and made sure some existing ones can be heard better: saw hit, pickup Healthpack / Battery Pack, objective accomplished, Taser Reload, Hover and more…
[*] All sounds have been re-mixed and volume-adjusted in order to create a more harmonious sound experience, so it should be more comfortable to play.
[/list]

[h1]BRIDGE | Puzzle[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/9056f8f167eea1a49e40a87e3514d69a34ee3ffa.jpg[/img]

The Bridge Puzzle has changed in this update:
[list]
[*] It no longer activates automatically as you approach the Bridge
[*] It now requires interacting with a Terminal
[*] It is now fully skippable in New Game+ with Dodge and/or Hover. Should NOT be skippable in New Game.
[*] The game no longer saves checkpoints if you try to continue without picking up the Jetpack. It’s authorized to try, though, but to avoid encouraging you to do so (impossible to continue later), the game only saves next checkpoints after picking it up.
[/list]

[h1]CUTSCENES | Improvements[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/3222677fc883c5a5366ae6220ba85c4863d1af64.jpg[/img]

We’ve made a push on cutscenes issues for this update, finally solving some older bugs and adding missing functionalities:
[list]
[*] Chapter 3: InitializeRoom.cpp room cutscene can now be skipped like any other cutscene! To be tested, should not break anything (but could, as it’s a complicated one to make skippable)
[*] Auto-skipped cutscenes (Cutscenes disabled) should no longer create any gameplay/camera jitters!
[/list]

[h1]SAVE SYSTEM | Optimization[/h1]
A while back, we introduced the new save system, which allowed to add many more checkpoints, and allow instant Quick Save / Quick Load.

In this update, there was a [b]tremendous change of how the Save System works[/b]: it is now more optimized and now takes advantage of Multithreading.

Even though it was functional, there was still a lot that could be done in order to make it safer, and optimize it to be more efficient.

Hopefully, this update addresses both of these concerns. However, as this is a first test version of the newly-optimized save system, you might encounter various new bugs about saving / loading, that will need to be fixed ASAP.

You might be wondering: “What changed exactly in the save system?” Here’s an overview if you’re interested (skip this if you’re not interested in technical):
[olist]
[*] Objects Gathering: In order to save, the first step is for the game to check every single object in the level (there are tens of thousands!), and gather each of their individual “states to save”. All this must be done as fast as possible to avoid mini-freezes. This is much now more optimized, and will use much less CPU.
[*] Conversion: This step is also expensive. It now needs to convert all the data into “saveable” data before writing the save file. This is also much faster, and is now multithreaded in the background. It should not stall the game, and reduce/remove mini-freezes in this step as well.
[*] Writing: The game will now write the save data using multithreading in the background. Should also greatly help with mini-freezes and slowdowns.
[/olist]

[h3]WHAT’S THE BENEFIT?[/h3]
The game should now:
[olist]
[*] [b]Save Faster:[/b] Saving is generally faster and uses much less CPU
[*] [b]Optimized:[/b] When saving at a checkpoint, you should feel much less slowdown and mini-freezes. If you were having them before, they should be greatly reduced, or completely fixed from this update!
[*] [b]Safer Save/Load:[/b] There should no longer be “moving lasers out of sync” bugs after Quick Save / Quick Load, or some objects not being saved properly – they should all be fixed.
[/olist]

[h1]OPTIONS | Improvements[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/3c5c70ed566a16eff30011f69d0e2ede271356db.jpg[/img]

There were various improvements to the Options menu in Fractal Space:
[list]
[*] Many Graphics options have switched to a Checkbox system
[*] NEW: “Decals” setting, default to Medium. This controls how complex the shooting impacts are with Taser shots and others. Integrated graphics and low-end PCs might have severe performance issues when shooting at the same position multiple times. This setting on lower than “Maximum” should help with this.
[*] NEW: “Chromatic Aberration” option in Graphics options. Used for Damage effect, Hyper-Speed, Scope. Remains subtle to avoid it to be disturbing (especially visible on edges of the screen). Now fully disabled if this new option is disabled.
[*] Hard of Hearing: New Accessibility option. Doesn’t affect anything yet, except the musical hacking sequence in Chapter 3; it will fail at first mistakes with this option ON. However, it will now require you to complete the sequence before knowing if it’s correct or not, if you don’t have this enabled.
[*] Particles: More particle effects will now be disabled from visual effects, when Particles are disabled (Taser/Ammo Pack pickup points smoke, vent door smoke, Taser Shoot effect, Camera/Generator explosions,etc.). This will help improve performance if you disable Particles.
[/list]

[h1]GAMEPLAY | Changes[/h1]
Here’s a list of various other changes & improvements that are worth noting here:
[list]
[*] Chapter 4: Achievement added for using only 2 portable mirrors!
[*] Flashlight: Will now adjust its size based on the selected Field of View (larger spot with higher FoV).
[*] Chapter 1: The Ramp and recording on top of the first Bridge room (orange ceiling) should ONLY be accessible with New Game+ using Dodge. Changed it to be so – please report if you can still get up there in New Game.
[*] Chapter 1: You can now keep cubes from the room just after the Math door, and use them to skip directly to the roof of the next area (Platforms button). This is intended. They will only be destroyed later on. You may test around with this, as you’ll have more cubes and might lead to unintended skips / exploits.
[*] Chapter 1: Double saws after interacting with the Bridge button (dancing platforms before Taser) will no longer disappear. They will turn off and move slightly away from each other to let enough space for you to walk in between them. If you Dodge to skip from below, the area will be initialized correctly.
[*] Chapter 1: After “Escapism” room, less objects are destroyed, to avoid too visible inconsistent shadows. This means in the optional area above, you can now jump onto Cage 1, which is now intended 😉
[*] Cubes: Collisions are still present with collectable objects (intended), but can no longer remain “standing” on Taser or Ammo Packs or Color Packs.
[*] Saving: If character dies while saving the first very checkpoint of the current level, the game will now wait a few seconds until the new save game is written, instead of instantly restarting the Chapter from start. Ex: rush fast into first lasers of Chapter 4. The game won’t restart the entire level anymore.
[*] Zero-G: Dangerous changes: It was necessary for technical reasons to disable Zero-G instantly upon death. It has now been changed to not do this anymore. This is a dangerous change, please test zero-g ON / OFF saves and last checkpoint saves, as this may have broken this!
[*] Taser Shots: Light effect when shooting (impact) now only produces shadows if Dynamic Lighting is set to Maximum
[*] Chapter 2: Bridge Puzzle will now have black buttons before performing it. Once solved, the buttons will be unavailable, but reflect colors of their respective states instead of remaining black.
[*] Chapter 2: Bridge Puzzle doesn’t start automatically anymore; you’ll need to activate the newly added Computer. This also means you can entirely skip it in New Game+, using Dodge (from standing on buttons to reach upper platforms), or Hover + Dodge.
[*] Chapter 2: Some Laser Fields could be walked on or prevent you from standing up. This was intentional. Changed them intentionally now to not allow this – we will see how things go!
[*] Chapter 3: Musical hacking Terminal will now only fail when finishing a whole sequence. Added Reset button. If you enable Hard of Hearing in Options, it will be as it was before (to ensure you can find it by memory + trial and error, at least, and without Reset button as it is not useful in this case).
[*] Chapter 4: Small changes to the Structure Control room (added pillars, fixed various visual bugs and such).
[*] Chapter 4: First mines area (with the Light Beam Receptor for Secret Passage): Reworked mines to ensure you cannot get through without shooting at least 1 mine. The ceiling for the upper mines now remains when retracting the wall, which allows the mines to remain present.
[*] Chapter 4: Flames corridor in the room before Processing Center: it is not mandatory to disable the flames; only if you want to not be damaged at all. However, added more flames to provoke more damage in most cases and keep it more discouraging (even though possible).
[*] Chapter 4: When the suns is turned OFF (approaching secret stairs), there are now much less reflections, and it’s now much darker outside. This is intended and desired.
[/list]

[h1]BUG REPORTS | Retry[/h1]
We’ve made quite a few changes as to how bug reports are uploaded. Most importantly:
[list]
[*] Progress of bug report upload is now displayed. You cannot report another bug until the previous bug is fully uploaded. This avoids various errors that could cause some bug reports to fail.
[*] If a bug fails to upload to Haze Games servers, it will show the bug reporting window again, and keep the title/description/category/screenshots in order for your to try again. If you cancel it instead of retry, it will discard your bug report and not bother you again.
[*] If the bug only fails to send to Discord server (separate system), it will not try again. However, this is not a problem; if you don’t see an error, it means we have received the bug report – no need to report again if you do not see it on Discord 😉
[/list]
These changes should help with reporting bugs, but might add new bugs to the bug reporting system. To be tested!

[h1]COMING SOON | Random Collision Bug Fix[/h1]
You might have encountered this bug before:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/3e53e59cf22bb8f41c2c642dbaec21a84de4db0d.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Some grounds becoming non-solid for the Player, making you fall through the floor
[*] The concerned ground is random; it can be any of them in the entire game
[*] It’s rare, so you may encounter it only once in a game, or never
[*] The bug persists until you exit the game and resume your save (or use SHIFT + F9 or SHIFT + F10)
[*] We’ve been investigating this a lot the past couple of months, and we can confirm this is NOT a Fractal Space bug. It’s a Unity Engine bug. It’s been present in the engine games for a few years now.
[/list]
It was very hard to point out the issue precisely, and understand how to fix it. We’ve been working with Unity the past few months to help reproducing the issue in a separate reproduction project:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/8b5b4d8c5b62178010746cbee52ec87d777778eb.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] They were then able to focus on it.
[*] Great news! They have indeed fixed the bug!
[*] Bad news: the fix is not ready yet.
[/list]
This means this bug is still active in this latest update. However, we think they will have published the fix in about 2-4 weeks, so we’ll have it soon finally fixed in Fractal Space as soon as they are ready 🙂

[h1]BUG | Fixes[/h1]
There were many bugfixes in this update. Here are just a few of the most important ones:
[list]
[*] Coming Soon: The black-magic-random weird bug when you could sometimes “fall through” some grounds, and this would persist for the entire session for these concerned grounds until you restarted the game, was a long-time-running Unity Engine mystic bug.
