We have worked with them to finally reproduce and isolate the bug; they were able to fix it! Thanks to all your reports, as it also helped with identifying it and escalating the issue on their side. However, the fix is not ready yet, so it is still active in this update – but it will finally land in the near future 😉
[*] Chapter 1: Invisible wall on ceiling of the first Bridge room, next to the ramp (bug introduced by recent changes of this area).
[*] Crouch: Crouch jump could sometimes result in crouching upon respawn instead of standing up. Should be fixed.
[*] Crouch: Saved Crouch state could sometimes fail to be applied correctly upon last checkpoint or quicksave loading – resulting in sometimes being spawned too high, and other issues. Tested many combinations, but this is quite a dangerous change – to be tested in combination with Zero-G checkpoints / Quicksave if something got broken by this.
[*] Dodge: Dodge would sometimes be not allowed when starting a level from the beginning (no Checkpoint saved data). Dodge cooldown gauge could be displayed on Computer Interfaces
[*] Cutscenes Off: Finally, the camera jitter and other visual bugs upon auto-skip of cutscenes with Cutscenes disabled, is now fixed! Should no longer happen. Please let me know if you still encounter it on some specific cutscenes. Now, this is a dangerous change; maybe auto-skip of cutscenes or the normal “cutscenes enabled” system now have new bugs with this change. To be tested!
[*] Interaction: Since recent changes, it was possible to mistakenly activate a button multiple times just before a cutscene, if you were to spam the interaction button. This was a new bug with the changes with the hand interaction system. Should not happen anymore.
[*] Pause: Clicking “Resume” button would fire the Taser-Gun if it was toggled ON
[*] Fragile Windows: Floating pieces of glass not being broken should now happen much less often / completely fixed. Please report if you still encounter it (should be more rare).
[*] Saws: Remaining “inside” a saw would allow you to not be damaged again after the short saw damage cooldown.
[*] Taser Toggle: Fixed a case in which Taser would be forced Toggled Off when it was set to Toggled On (after a skipped cutscene with cutscenes OFF). Fixed states in which center dot Crosshair would be visible while aiming Taser because toggled ON (should not)
[*] Taser FoV: Laser offset while Dodging with Taser aiming is now fixed, and a “jitter” of the Taser Gun when starting to Dodge is now also fixed (smoother for Taser)
[*] Depth of Field: Ensured first Depth of Field setting is set correctly when you start aiming the Taser. Avoids waiting 0.2s to focus on desired, already-aimed at object. Depth of field change speed is now more consistent and more reactive.
[*] Main Menu: Fixed a bug that could cause Main Menu buttons to not react to mouse input at all. This was only if you pressed ESC to show Pause, just after leaving a Computer Interface (within 0.2s)
[*] Laser-Equipped Cameras: Shots would sometimes ignore the player. Should happen much less often, thus you will be damaged more often (especially fast-shooting camera in Chapter 4)
[*] Hover: Fixed various exploits with Hover toggle ON/OFF and Quick Save / Quick Load. Last Checkpoint load should always restore Hover/Jetpack to full energy (intended), but Quick Save / Quick Load will now restore the same gauge state at time of Quick Save.
[*] Chapter 3: Fixed issue where cubes outside the Tunnel could sometimes be much higher than they should be
[*] Chapter 3: Crows could be seen for a very short duration if Cutscenes were disabled.
[*] Chapters Mode: Could start Chapters with 0 Taser Ammo, whereas Chapters Mode should always start with at least 6 Taser Ammo.
[*] Safe Lander: Fixed various display bugs some cases where it should not be displayed (cutscenes, interfaces, etc).
[*] Power Cores: Could have (undesired) collisions with the object currently held in your hands. This should never happen. Should now be solved and back to normal (currently held object does not collider/push other objects).
[*] Power Core Slots: If you performed a Quick Load while a Power Core was at insertion position (but NOT inserted) of a Power Core Slot, the Power Core Slot would be activated without any Power Core inserted, and would be in a “broken” state.
[*] Interface: Various interface elements should no longer be visible between Chapter loads (Scope, Jetpack gauge, etc.)
[*] Hyper-Speed: Restarting the Chapter from start with HS enabled could result in reducing the game’s speed.
[*] Chinese: Some in-game characters were not displaying correctly. Now fixed
[*] Reported Bugs: Fixed many in-game reported bugs
[/list]
Thank you for testing! We’ll continue working on the various remaining bugs, and re-update over the next few days for any major bugs 😉

Have an awesome week, and happy gaming!

Charles & Amélie from Haze Games

notes.title: Update 0.587 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, [b]dear players of Fractal Space![/b]

We [b]thank you again[/b] for the [b]many bug reports[/b], [b]suggestions [/b]and more that we have received lately.

We've been [b]delaying the hundreds of Steam key requests [/b]to access the [b][i]Pre-Alpha[/i][/b], in order to [b]solve these first before having new players report new bugs[/b] :)

The [b]latest update 0.587 [/b]is now [b]live[/b] on [b][i]Steam![/i][/b] It [b]solves many more bugs[/b], and adds [b]new improvements[/b], various [b]levels changes and more[/b]. We'll discuss the [b]important ones [/b]here.

[quote][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] [b]RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER:[/b] If you were playing before this update, please [b]restart current Chapter from the beginning to avoid bugs[/b], prevent softlocks, and ensure the new bugfixes are correctly applied.[/quote]
[h2][b]DIALOGUES |[/b] REPETITION[/h2]
Some players were [b]complaining about hearing the same dialogues again after dying and respawning[/b]. We have [b]changed the system to:[/b]
[list][*][b]Do not play already played level dialogues[/b] again within the [b]same session[/b][/*][*]There might be[b] exceptions for some dialogues[/b] because [b]some should be repeated in the same session[/b][/*][*]If you[b] exit the game and resume[/b], these dialogues [b]will be played again [/b][i](intended)[/i][/*][/list]
We hope this change will [b]make dying feel less repetitive[/b], and [b]avoid hearing the same level dialogues over and over.[/b]

[b]Respawn dialogues have not changed[/b], and will [b]still be different at each death[/b], until there are [b]no more available[/b], in which case it will then be [i]"sighs"[/i] instead of sentences.

[h2][b]CUTSCENES | [/b]HANDS[/h2]
In this update, you [b]can now see the player character's hands during the very first introduction of the game[/b], and [b]during Respawn cutscenes![/b]

They[b] should work correctly with any FoV setting[/b] - even though [b]high FoV will always result in slight distortion[/b] of objects, which is [b]normal[/b]. Ensuring animations work well with all FoV values [i][b]isn't as easy as it sounds[/b], so it has to be tested[/i] ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/886a58a30f7338faf114b2d3b9aa47ba5ccb6562.jpg[/img]

On [b]some specific respawn points[/b], you might [b]see the hands go through objects or the ground;[/b] please [b]report in-game when this happens[/b], so it can be fixed in the next updates.

[h2][b]FRAGILE |[/b] WINDOWS[/h2]
[b]Fragile Windows [/b]have been [b]reworked [/b]in order to [b]solve multiple issues:[/b]
[list][*]They had [b]holes[/b], which [b]required you to aim more precisely [/b]to avoid [b]shooting through he holes instead[/b]. This [b][i]was [/i]intended[/b], but it seems like more players are [b]annoyed by this than anything[/b] - so they [b]no longer have holes[/b], but they do have [b]visible cracks.[/b][/*][*]Holes were partly also present to [b]make the fragile windows stand out more from regular windows [/b]and make them [b]more visible.[/b] This new version [b]now has a much more visible crack [/b]to help making them [b]more noticeable[/b], as some players [b]had a hard time differentiating them[/b].[/*][*][b]After shooting a first time on a fragile window[/b], [b]shards will then break with player weight [/b]and / or dropped cube on them. It [b]now makes more sense[/b] that [b]they do not do so until a first shot [/b]has been fired.[/*][/list]
You can see the [b]crack [/b]is [b]much more noticeable than previously, and holes have been removed:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/6b0aaac5811de1730f7c3e1248d8af98c0916c13.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]CHAPTER 1 |[/b] NEW AREA[/h2]
Just after [b]the first 2 pressure plates[/b], in front of the [b]Math door[/b], you can [b]now freely access the “white light hole” to your right[/b].

There will be a [b]recording here in the future[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/911effd04d75a4e33cb5d9f5ed818acb89565813.jpg[/img]

It is meant to be [b]accessible and completable in New Game[/b]. You can do this [b]before or after getting the Taser[/b]. The [b]roof above the math door [/b]will still [b]relocate you for now[/b], but [b]in the future [/b]there will be a [b]recording accessible only in New Game+[/b] up there as well.

[h2][b]CHAPTER 1 |[/b] OPTIONAL RECORDING[/h2]
The [b]optional Recording [/b]to get around the [b]first Smashers area [/b][i](requiring Cube/Dodge to reach the Roof)[/i] is [b]now protected to be inaccessible[/b] or by simply [b]Dodging [/b]from below, or by using various other techniques to reach the ceiling:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/083c9c8748df6dceecbd6c3ad3d1ade719734a73.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]CHAPTER 2 |[/b] LAST ROOM[/h2]
The [b]Power Core Storage[/b] button will [b]no longer disable the lasers[/b] above the [b][i]Power Core[/i][/b], and will [b]only open the door[/b]. You will need to [b]open the door[/b], then [b]enable Zero-G [/b]to get the [b]Power Core[/b] that will be [b]pushed out[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c9be86f8b2e633583743d4c1dc5d266033b5f8b0.jpg[/img]

In addition, the [b]optional Upgrade [/b]in this room [b]will now require Zero-G to be accessed:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/8c3fed18f8cea9ea97b6813e121fdf2ca80f0c7d.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]OTHER[/b][/h2]
[b]Other new additions [/b]worth noting here:
[list][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: [b]New checkpoint added[/b] above the [b][i]“Go Left, Go Right”[/i][/b] area to save outside as well. In addition, [b]checkpoints here will save multiple times[/b] after[b] various key interactions are done.[/b][/*][*][b]Cameras[/b]: Disabled Cameras [b]can now be destroyed[/b][/*][*][b]Physics Debris[/b]: You can now [b]shoot [i]“through the cylinder”[/i] of floating pipes debris[/b] in Chapter 3[i] (The Cube area)[/i][/*][*][b]Tablets / Power Cores / Encryption Keys[/b]: Will now [b]react to Taser shots[/b] [i](be pushed)[/i] in [b]Zero-G[/b].[/*][/list]

[h2][b]CHANGES[/b][/h2]
Below is a [b]list of various important changes [/b]in this update:
[list][*][b]Lasers[/b]: Various insta-kill lasers now have more tightly-packed lasers to make it more clear you won’t survive if you try to get through. Many of these areas will have similar additions over the next updates to make it more predictable.[/*][*][b]Saws[/b]: Some saws (especially moving saws, or static that should be jumped over) are always more tolerant than others (intentionally) to avoid you getting damaged when a “fairly acceptable jump” was performed instead of a “perfect jump”. This will remain for the upper part to avoid frustration. Though the sides shouldn’t behave like this for this saw. They will now damage the player more accurately from the sides. Please report any unintended damage by saws that may now occur with this change (in some specific areas, this change might be an issue)[/*][*][b]Saws[/b]: Now have additional red lines coming from the center when activated[/*][*][b]Bloom[/b]: Bloom is now a bit more intense[/*][*][b]Taser Shot:[/b] Impact light now more intense and more visible[/*][*][b]Doors / Vent Doors[/b]: Closing a vent door with a Cube in the middle would now push it better “out of the way” since the previous update already. With Power Cores, it’s more complicated due to their shape. Now, if a Power Core gets “caught” inside a closing door or vent door, it will be automatically forced out of the way. This solves the issue. To be tested in case it creates new bugs![/*][*][b]Dodge Cooldown[/b]: The Dodge cooldown gauge could sometimes remain indefinitely visible when used with the Taser Toggle system. In addition, it could sometimes not be visible with Taser Toggled on, preventing you from knowing when it has finished recharging.[/*][*][b]Dodge Cooldown[/b]: Will now always be displayed, and move downwards while aiming in order to avoid being disturbed when trying to aim with the Taser.[/*][*][b]Speedrun Mode[/b]: Some lasers have player collisions in speedrun mode only. Previously, changing Speedrun Mode during a level would not update laser collisions (restart of Chapter required). It will now change appropriately instantly.[/*][*][b]Chapters Replay[/b]: Selecting Chapter 1 from the “Chapters” page would not play the first introduction (it was only played on New Game without Speedrun Mode).[/*][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Pipes to reach the skip (Fragile Wall) next to the Smasher button are kept, but not the “lowest” one, as it creates more confusion than anything (was intended to be here to help and provide a hint that roof is accessible).[/*][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Small vent in Taser Room cannot be closed after being opened to prevent potential softlock[/*][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Saw in “This is bad” room has a new path, which doesn’t clip through the Door pillars. Other various small changes and improvements were made in this room.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3[/b]: Vertical row of Lasers next to the Camera (for which you must disable Shield to get through, that is looking at the vent), could let you go through with somedamaged - they are meant to kill if you go though. Now changed to reflect this.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3[/b]: Horizontal lasers in the area after the 2 breakable glass to access the Power Core to disable the camera shield mentioned above, will now instantly kill you if you go through it to prevent you from skipping this room.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3[/b]: Solved potential softlock with locking the cube on the wrong side in the Initialization Room[/*][*][b]Chapter 4[/b]: When reaching the last room, the retractable walls will now deploy to prevent you from backtracking to a potential softlock (room with flames)[/*][*][b]Upgrades[/b]: Tutorial about upgrades (and associated dialogues) will not play when interacting with a mandatory Upgrade Terminal if it’s your very first terminal ever (ex: first terminal ever interacted with is Hyper-Speed terminal in Chapter 3). This is because the player has no choice for this terminal.[/*][/list][h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
Below is a [b]list of the most important bugfixes [/b]included this update:
[list][*][b]Taser Toggle[/b]: When toggled always on, the Taser could be shown after a Cutscene, even with an object currently in hands.[/*][*][b]Saws[/b]: “Cannot Stand Here” could happen when crouched really close to a Saw[/*][*][b]Room Control[/b]: Sometimes, a button would require clicking it twice to perform the turn ON/OFF of a specific action. Should be fully solved. To be tested - as this change may have caused unwanted new bugs in various other Room Control interfaces.[/*][*][b]Moving Platforms[/b]: Vertical Dodge from a moving platform could sometimes result in “bouncy reception” upon the next moving platform landing. This should now be fixed (to be tested).[/*][*][b]Power Cores[/b]: You could potentially encounter bugs if you inserted a Power Core inside a Power Core Slot at the same time as Relocation would be happening. You can no longer drop / insert a Power Core Core while a relocation is in progress (to prevent this bug, and to prevent unintended situations / softlocks due to leaving a Power Core in an unreachable area).[/*][*][b]Lasers[/b]: Laser beams could go through the edges of vent doors (leak). Now fixed.[/*][*][b]Taser[/b]: In some specific cases / angles, you could sometimes shoot through walls. Shouldn’t be possible anymore.[/*][*][b]Sprint[/b]: When a sprint is pending, and getting out of a vent could result in sprinting while remaining crouched.[/*][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Ensured the Ext door of the very first Camera room will not sometimes re-open once you went past the door (could happen in some cases).[/*][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Relocation could sometimes briefly be displayed upon entry of the very first Cube room.[/*][*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: Math Door: Entering slightly then returning back, could result in relocation bug that allowed to skip the “Laser Cage” room if you were to go outside on attempted to reach the roof.[/*][*][b]Chapter 2[/b]: Solved possible unintended backtracking after disabling lasers in the first “Electrified Room” if you returned outside using the vent below, after going past these (now disabled) lasers.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3[/b]: You could skip the 2 “cages” with cubes by flying further on the sides[/*][*][b]Chapter 3[/b] You could activate “The Cube” button remotely with the Taser, earlier than you should be able to. Now fixed (not usable until going actually through)[/*][*][b]Chapter 3[/b]: Generator to break for glass-cubes area (just after the Tunnel): There were multiple bugs with the vents / lasers in this room, could cause laser issues, and softlocks. All should be fixed. Added an Ammo Pack in this room as well to prevent soflocks.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3[/b]: “The Cube” Area Encryption Key Formatter: The game should now only save in front of the formatter Terminal, after leaving it, but only if the Lasers have already been disabled by breaking the generator. This avoids potential softlock if went through using cover, then removed it, or passed through and survived during Dodge.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3[/b]: In the last hallway, sometimes laser fields would not be properly activated for the Bridge power puzzles (where you must deploy only necessary Bridges). Should now always be the correct way (all laser fields enabled correctly)[/*][*][b]Chapter 4[/b]: The Map of the Room Control Terminal in the Hyper-Speed suppressor area would not be displayed correctly upon very first interaction[/*][*][b]Chapter 4[/b]: Portable mirrors were “falling like leaves” when Zero-G was disabled. Should now behave correctly.[/*][*][b]Saving[/b]: A change was made on saving data, hopefully will help reduce chances of having an in-game error about “a value being negative”. However, if your game crashes while saving, or you exit the game with ALT+F4 while saving, data will still be corrupted (like with any other game). Later on, there will be a backup system in case this happens, but this is not here yet.[/*][*][b]Texts[/b]: Texts that appear “gradually” (tutorials, etc.) could display the full text for a very short period of time, before starting the smooth apparition. Should now be fixed.[/*][*][b]Reported Bugs[/b]: Fixed [b]many in-game reported bugs[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update over the next few days for next bugs[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.586 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi all, dear [b]Fractal Space players![/b] We wish you all a [b]Happy New Year 2021![/b] A new [b]update 0.586 is now live[/b] for [b]Windows, Mac & Linux![/b]

[quote=""]Please [b]restart Steam[/b] to ensure you [b]get this update now[/b][/quote]
This update [b]focuses on fixing the various major issues in levels, that could prevent you from completing the Pre-Alpha.[/b]

Some of these issues [b]were added with 0.584 and 0.585 changes[/b], and [b]should now be solved[/b].

In addition, there are [b]various level changes to solve some gameplay issues[/b], most [b]important ones [/b]are [b]listed below[/b]. There is [b]a chance these new changes provoked[/b] new bugs - [b]to be tested![/b]

If you [b]encounter a major blocking bug that prevents you from finishing the game[/b], please [b]report as usual[/b], and [b]also send an email to [url=mailto:bug@haze.games]bug@haze.games[/url][/b] ;)

[quote=""][b]IMPORTANT: RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER:[/b][i] If you were playing before this update, please [/i][b]restart current Chapter[/b][i] from the [/i][b]beginning to avoid bugs[/b][i], [/i][b]prevent softlocks[/b][i], and ensure the [/i][b]new bugfixes are correctly applied[/b][i].[/i]
[/quote]
[h2]NEW[/h2]
List of [b]additions / new elements [/b]in this update:
[list]
[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Optional Area with [b]“Impressive” Recording:[/b] Checkpoint to [b]save progress[/b] if you reach this area. To be tested.[/*]
[*][b]Ammo Packs:[/b] Now [b]slightly smaller visual[/b] - same pickup range. Now it has [b]more polygons to look better on “circular” parts[/b]. Texture will be improved later on:[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/6494ece3df858ffddd7c9639ad334ca6eb81f8a0.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Screens:[/b] They [b]no longer have player collisions[/b]. Only a few will keep them (the very large ones that should have some). Please report if you find [b]large ones that should be walkable and that currently aren’t[/b] (should be very rare).[/*]
[*][b]Controls Remapping:[/b] Skip [b]cutscenes control will now use the Show Objectives input [/b]to skip cutscenes if [b]remapped[/b]. [b]Only with the Keyboard[/b], as with a [b]Gamepad it should always remain on the Y [/b]button (intended).[/*]
[*][b]Taser Power Upgrade[/b] Previous updates added [b]more powerful wall breaking[/b] with [b]Taser Power Level 3[/b]. Now, from [b]Taser Power Level 2[/b] upgrade, f[b]ragile windows will also break much more in 1 single hit[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Lasers:[/b] Some [b]individual lasers (selectively) [/b]will now [b]destroy broken glass shards upon contact[/b] (intended), to [b]avoid blocking the beam[/b]. Please report any areas where specific lasers should use this new system to destroy glass shards in order to [b]avoid game-breaking situations[/b] (like going through lasers you shouldn’t be able to, etc.). These situations will usually be [b]isolated to vertical lasers, placed low on the ground, next to fragile windows[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
List of [b]changes to be aware of from this update:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Taser Toggle ON/OFF:[/b] As some players pressed “T” by mistake, and thought it was a bug that the Taser Gun would remain toggled ON, releasing the AIM (HOLD) key will now cancel the Aim (Toggle) in order to hide the Taser to “unblock aiming”.[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/fdb3a765aeaf87b8dac35a15db2df0680c698514.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Room with first 2 pressure plates: reworked to prevent being able to get up onto the pipes and upper vent (upon return) without a Cube in New Game. You can either get past the lasers (with the 2 lower ones now disabled) and use the Cube to get up unharmed, or go through lasers without a cube (on the side of pipes), but you will be damaged (intended to allow it, but not optimal choice). From the “start of the pipes” (higher than the rest), you may stack 2 cubes to directly reach the upper vent from here (intended). You can step on the pipes directly on the right as you enter but won’t be able to get onto the vent:[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/9c6f06a04b8fdf9f443bacd394c1973a7d0729d0.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] New Game + shortcut with Dodge through fragile window, upon returning with Taser to get Ammo Pack: Has been changed to ensure that: You cannot go outside through that window without Dodge anymore; recently added Cube Respawn here has now been removed (you can stack cubes and won’t be able to go out in New Game). It’s now higher, to discourage new players from trying to get there. With Dodge, you can still go outside or inside through that fragile window:[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/bd064be82e109843e52c6e532860d10f0d3c0048.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] “New Orange thingy” dialogue actually refers to the structure on your right as you return to this room (which wasn’t here first time you crossed the Bridge). Moved the Color Pack to be less visible upon return here to avoid confusion with the Color Pack, until this dialogue is changed.[/*]
[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] You cannot simply jump over the laser field in the “This is bad” room after the fall in New Game anymore. You’ll need Dodge as intended:[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/2e229868ff6e6b8dfba8520dcd736fff1dc5b6a5.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Alternate route: You cannot use only 1 cube anymore on New Game and will require 2 cubes (except if there is still an issue with jump height in some cases or another collision bug here)[/*]
[*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Second propeller (super-fast one) in the Train area (which requires to remove Power Core) was too easy to get through without removing it, because it was pushing you instead of killing you (this “pushing” is kept and appropriate for other areas). It is now still possible without removing the Power Core, but much harder, using a perfect Dodge, or quick jetpack below before relocation. There will be an achievement here in the future. You could also just crouch below them - no longer possible.[/*]
[*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Sun & Solar Panels: The only possible combination should be A-B-E green. Solved multiple cases of other combinations that could work (not intended, and objectives would not accomplish). If you find other combinations that work, please report them ;)[/*]
[*][b]Speedrun Timers[/b]: Will now correctly be hidden on all Computer Interfaces / Upgrade Terminals, but remain on Keypad and other interfaces (intended).[/*]
[*][b]Screens:[/b] Small screens (rectangular ones - most of them) will now have borders that don’t look as “stretched” as they used to.[/*]
[/list]
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
List of [b]major bug fixes [/b]in this update:
[list]
[*][b]Chapter 3[/b]: Hyper-Speed could not be acquired
[*][b]Dodge[/b]: Dodging upwards from Crouched stance could allow you to enter “small height” areas that you are not meant to.[/*]
[*][b]Jump Save Spam[/b]: Spamming Quick Save / Quick Load with Jumps could allow multiple jumps. Now solved.[/*]
[*][b]Save System[/b]: 0.584 introduced a “safer save system” to ensure there were no level bugfixes after saving when many changes are being done simultaneously in the level. Fixed some additional cases of these issues (with buttons triggering Timers and such).[/*]
[*][b]Interaction[/b]: Could interact with some objects through some types of walls. Should be fixed. In order to solve this, a few changes had to be done to interaction in general - please check interaction for all object types to see if this change didn’t break interaction with some object types. In addition, it was possible to pick up cubes through “vent grids”.[/*]
[*][b]Show Objectives[/b]: Various bugfixes with the system which sometimes would not show objectives when requested. Fixed cases where health / fuel bar could remain displayed on interfaces if quickly interacted with it after unpausing the game.[/*]
[*][b]Objectives[/b]: Objective entries could sometimes remain displayed as a line for a few seconds before being shown. Should now be fixed.[/*]
[*][b]Objectives[/b]: Objective cancelled red square could be displayed at a wrong position in the notification system, overlapping text, etc. Should be fixed.[/*]
[*][b]Music[/b]: More cases of “Detected” music remaining indefinitely now fixed. Shouldn’t happen anymore, or at least, much less often. If it happens, please report again with steps to reproduce (if you know them).[/*]
[*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: “This is bad” room Relocation will now be performed before dying from falling into the void[/*]
[*][b]Dodge[/b]: Fixed exploit that allowed you to Dodge through lasers or others if Dodge was performed immediately after a Quick Load. Dodge is no longer available until the Quick Load is fully completed (around 0.5s).[/*]
[*][b]Upgrades[/b]: Could sometimes fail to provide non-acquired upgrades when reaching last terminals in the game (and End Game not yet reached)[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a0cebafd59dc3146fb33bc067d056bcf06f82670.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Controls Remapping[/b]: Fixed a bug with Aim Toggle being displayed and empty on Gamepad input, which was creating a conflict - should not be here with Gamepad (at least for now, intended not to be).[/*]
[*][b]Controls Remapping[/b]: A bug caused deleted secondary mappings to cause conflicts on “empty” keys.[/*]
[*][b]Localization[/b]: Various localization fixes[/*]
[*][b]Taser Ammo[/b]: The “Energy” text on the Taser screen was not using the correct color and would keep orange / red even when fully charged.[/*]
[*][b]Reported Bugs[/b]: Fixed [b]many in-game reported bugs[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update over the next few weeks for the next found major bugs[/b] ;)

[b]We wish you all have a great year 2021![/b]

[i]Charles & Amy from Haze Games[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.584 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear [b][i]Fractal Space[/i][/b] PC Pre-Alpha players! [b]Latest update 0.584[/b] of the PC Pre-Alpha is now [b]live on Steam![/b]

The update is also coming within [b]a few hours for the Xbox One Demo.[/b]

There has been a [b]massive amount of bugfixes[/b] from the recently reported bugs, and [b]many changes [/b]and some [b]new features![/b]

[quote][b]IMPORTANT: RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER:[/b] If you were playing before this update, please [b]restart current Chapter[/b] from the [b]beginning to avoid bugs[/b], [b]prevent softlocks[/b], and ensure the [b]new bugfixes are correctly applied[/b].
[/quote]

After updating, if at any time you are [b]encounter a missing object in the level[/b] [i](Power Core Slot or other)[/i], please [b]restart the current chapter from the beginning[/b] [i](not last checkpoint, full Chapter restart)[/i] and [b]check if the issue is still happening[/b]. If it [b]still missing[/b], please [b]report with ALT+B[/b].

[quote][b]IMPORTANT: DEBUG MODE AND TERMINALS:[/b] Acquiring upgrades via [b]Debug Mode will always likely result in bugs with Terminals upgrade list[/b], Terminal usable states and such; if you are testing the [b]Upgrades distribution and End Game[/b], you should [b]play the game normally and never acquire upgrades via Debug Mode.[/b] Any bug about [b]Upgrades / Upgrades PC / End Game mode[/b] (all Terminals found once) are [b]invalid if any upgrades are acquired with Debug Mode[/b] as it results in [b]impossible situations[/b].
[/quote]

If you [b]encounter a major blocking bug that prevents you from finishing the game[/b], please [b]report as usual[/b], and[b] also send an email to bug@haze.games[/b] ;)

[b]Thank you[/b] for testing and [b]reporting bugs![/b]

[h2][b]TASER |[/b] TOGGLE AIM[/h2]
[b][i]Fractal Space[/i][/b] is [b]meant to be played [/b]with the [b][i]Taser-Gun[/i] hidden[/b], and [b]shown only when the player requests to aim[/b]. This [b]will not change[/b] for regular and new players as a [b]first experience with the game[/b].

However, if you are an [b]expert at the game and/or a speedrunner[/b], you will [b]enjoy having the ability to toggle the[i] Taser-Gun[/i] to be always displayed[/b] - and [b]we want this to work[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/7df79134adb8e935bac3974fdaf9920350c62a8b.jpg[/img]

This will [b]require you to change the default keys for [i]Dodge[/i][/b], and [b]use the new [i]Modules Management[/i] system [/b]to [b]enable / disable[/b] the [b][i]Aim Stabilizer [/i][/b]and [b][i]Hover [/i][/b]modules at your convenience.

The [b][i]Toggle Taser[/i] is set by default on the T key[/b]. It has now been [b]greatly improved to:[/b]
[list][*][b]Save [/b]the [b]desired Taser Toggled on / off state [/b]to [b]avoid you [/b]from having to [b]request it again [/b]at [b]every game load / checkpoint[/b][/*][*][b]Keep the desired Taser Toggled on / off state [/b]after [b]cutscenes[/b], [b]interfaces[/b], and [b]dropping objects[/b]. It used to sometimes be [b]forced off[/b].[/*][/list]
If you find cases where the [b][i]Taser-Gun[/i][/b] gets [b]hidden[/b] and [b]doesn't come back automatically[/b] when you [b]indeed had toggled it ON[/b], please [b]report a bug[/b].

The [b]end goal [/b]is that if you [b]Toggle the Taser-Gun ON [/b]in the [b]first room [/b]of the game, you can [b]complete the game without ever having to request it again[/b]. Except, of course, if you [b]intentionally toggle it off yourself[/b] ;)

[h2][b]TASER |[/b] RELOADING[/h2]
Added a [b]first version[/b] of a new [b]Taser[/b] [b][i]Reload[/i] animation![/b] No longer instant reloading. Still, it’s [b]very fast to make sure you don’t wait too long[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c84b63dcc4dac8ab4807119abcf6b627e5ab1e82.jpg[/img]

It is intentional that reloading now takes [b]around 1s[/b] - and is [b]not meant to be instant in [i]Speedrun Mode[/i] either[/b]. You’ll need to [b]take that time into account during speedruns[/b] and reload at the right moment (intended).

The following cases [b]INTENTIONALLY result in an instant-reload[/b] to avoid waiting / frustration:
[list][*]Reload animation will [b]not be played if you are currently healing[/b] (intended)[/*][*]Reload will [b]interrupt Scope[/b] and [b]return to previous Scope zoom[/b] after reload is completed, if [b]aiming is still requested[/b] [i](intended)[/i].[/*][*]Reload will [b]NOT interrupt Hover[/b] if you [b]keep requesting to aim the Taser[/b] [i](intended)[/i]. If you [b]stop requesting to aim the Taser[/b] during the reloading process, [b]Hover will stop[/b] as intended.[/*][*]Requesting to [b]shoot while reloading[/b] will shoot [b]as soon as the Taser is ready[/b] (intended).[/*][/list]

[h2][b]IMPACTS |[/b] IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
Many [b]improvements to impacts[/b] were made:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/737210ce70d069ea966fed1afeccddbb896b463e.jpg[/img]

[list][*]Less chances of [b]floating on sides of objects[/b] [i](Power Cores, etc.)[/i][/*][*][b]Impacts[/b] are now [b]visible on glass![/b][/*][*][i]“Lasting impact”[/i] [b]doesn’t last as long as before[/b], but [b]looks better than the circle that was here in previous versions[/b] [i](and PE)[/i], and now [b]disappears smoothly over time[/b][/*][*]The impact will still [b]look strange on edges / corners, but much less than before[/b][/*][*][b]Cardboard Boxes:[/b] Added [b]visual effect[/b] when destroyed by [b]lasers[/b].[/*][/list]
[h2][b]MODULE |[/b] MANAGEMENT[/h2]
[previewyoutube=WnZDKSzj1QY;full][/previewyoutube]
We've [b]added a new [i]Module Management[/i] system to allow you to:[/b]
[list][*][b]Toggle Hover ON / OFF[/b] anytime using [b]"1"[/b] key[list][*]When [b]disabled/enabled[/b], [b]Hover gauge [/b]will be [b]hidden / shown accordingly[/b][/*][/list][/*][*][b]Toggle Aim Stabilizer ON / OFF [/b]anytime using [b]"2"[/b] key[/*][/list]

However, [b]in addition to this[/b], you can [b]now see which modules are currently active[/b] by [b]holding the [i]Show Stats[/i][/b] [b]key [/b][i]([b]TAB[/b] by default)[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/1c5ab1205190b4eb498e4e7e61c219336f3ce2eb.jpg[/img]

While [b]playing on PC with keyboard[/b] [b]/ mouse[/b], this [i][b]Module Management[/b][/i] will [b]mostly be cosmetic [/b]and to [b]help you to learn the shortcuts[/b] by heart.

After a while, you [b]won't need to use it[/b], as you can [b]use those shortcuts anytime[/b] [b]without showing [i]Module Management[/i][/b].

If you [b]toggle any module ON / OFF [/b]while aiming, the [b][i]Module Management [/i][/b]will display for [b]3 seconds[/b] as [b]feedback[/b], [b]without disturbing you current aiming state:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/ccfc652201d1e8556c21941bb5ca3444eb560be9.jpg[/img]

While [b]playing with gamepad[/b], the [b]shortcuts [/b]to toggle Modules are set to [b][i]A[/i] and [i]B[/i] [/b]buttons, and are [b]only active [/b]while [b][i]Module Management[/i][/b] [b]is displayed[/b]. This way, [b]you can still jump and crouch[/b] using the [b]alternative [i]LB[/i] and [i]RB[/i][/b] buttons [b]while this interface is displayed[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/93b6c4ff20e66acb63155b736818e5ebcbba9277.jpg[/img]

[i]Please note that since [b]gamepads have less input buttons[/b], you [b]will need to hold Show Stats button[/b] ([b]Dpad Down[/b] by default) in order to [b]toggle Modules ON/OFF [/b]if you are playing with a gamepad[b].[/b] This is to [b]prevent disabling modules by mistake[/b].[/i]

[h2][b]OPTIONS[/b][/h2]
[b]Many improvements[/b] and [b]bugfixes [/b]were made to the [b]Options[/b] menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/eba847c846ff97ecf063688f0ef9121d79426e20.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b]Reworked [/b]the [b][i]Fullscreen / Windowed / Borderless[/i][/b] system to [b]work more consistently[/b], and [b]more stable[/b]:[list][*]Now [b]starts by default in [i]Borderless[/i] mode[/b], switching to [b]other modes[/b] should now [b]work better[/b][/*][*][b][i]ALT+ENTER[/i][/b] now disabled to prevent [b]engine bugs[/b][/*][/list][/*]

[*][b][i]Language[/i][/b] now uses a [b]Drop-Down list[/b]:[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/0aad124ff4a76f4eb80e456382b1364172f118fb.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b][i]Resolution [/i][/b]now uses a [b]Drop-Down list[/b]:[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/d4a14b322a933c4982e00c0b89b415fb2f9a388f.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b]Some sliders[/b] now have [b]values text displayed[/b][/*][*][b]Changed some options [/b]to use [b]Checkboxes[/b] [i](Speedrun Mode, Cutscenes, etc)[/i][/*][*]New [b][i]Aim Sensitivity Multiplier [/i][/b]slider [i](set it to [b]1[/b] for [b]same sensitivity as when not aiming[/b])[/i]:[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/682fb394a5a675367bfe50957a00fbc6c53d3c54.jpg[/img]

[list][*]New [b]customization shortcuts [/b]for [b][i]Aim Stabilizer[/i][/b] and [b][i]Hover [/i][/b][i]Modules[/i] Toggle [b]ON/OFF[/b][/*][/list]

[h2][b]CHANGES[/b][/h2]
Summary of the major changes of this update.

[h3][b]AIM |[/b] STABILIZER[/h3]
[b]Improvements [/b]were made to the [b][i]Aim Stabilizer[/i]:[/b]
[olist][*]Can now be[b] disabled anytime with 2 key [/b][i](default)[/i][/*][*][b]Toggle Aim Stabilizer key[/b] can now be [b]changed in Remapping[/b][/*][*][b]Disable [i]Aim Stabilizer[/i] now has an animation[/b] and can be [b]seen inactive on the [i]Taser-Gun[/i][/b][/*][/olist]
[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Button Interaction:[/b] Improved interaction hand animation - smoother[/*][*][b]Power Cores:[/b] Now have reworked, [b]more precise collisions[/b].[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Added [b]relocation for the first area outside[/b], to prevent climbing around for huge skip[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Smasher Room will [b]no longer close behind you as you approach the “lift protected by lasers” section[/b]. This allows you to [b]return to the Bonus Room behind you[/b], in case you missed it. It also allows you to [b]come back from here in case you backtracked [/b]after opening the retractable wall to [i]“Find an Alternate Route”[/i][/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] [b]First Cube Room:[/b] The [b]Healthpack[/b] in front of the [b]first vent door[/b] (Vent 1), [b]has now been moved[/b] on the [b]pipes[/b] as an [b]optional Healthpack[/b][/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Changed Vent 1 in the room with very first Cube to now be [b]locked at start[/b], requiring to be [b]unlocked with a small button[/b]. It will now be locked when opening the Door as before. This keeps the [b]upper vent mandatory for return to the main room[/b], but still [b]allows going back inside to get the recording[/b] using the new [b]Vent 1 button to reopen it[/b], after [b]dropping out of the upper vent[/b].[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] [b]“Use Protection”[/b] room row of lasers now changed to [b]not have collisions when ON[/b] [i](like most others in the game)[/i], as on PC you can simply [b]Dodge over them for speedruns[/b]. They have [b]collisions when turned OFF[/b] [i](intended)[/i].[/*][*][b]Windows:[/b] Windows variant [b]with holes to let pipes / cables through will now allow you to shoot through them[/b] [i](collision bug fixed on them)[/i]. Good idea to check if this [b]doesn’t break the game by allowing to shoot some gameplay objects in advance[/b] through them.[/*][*][b]Hyper-Speed:[/b] Will now [b]auto-consume Healthpack from your Backpack[/b] [i](if available) [/i]when requesting to [b]activate Hyper-Speed while you currently not have enough Health[/b] to do so.[/*][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Reworked the [b]vent in the optional area above the first room control room with Cameras[/b] - it was using an [b]old layout.[/b] Changed slightly [b]how to the get the NG+ only Color Pack here[/b].[/*][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] [b]Big Room:[/b] Healthpack can now [b]only be obtained through the crusher[/b]. We will see if it has [b]become too hard to get healed[/b] in this area - in which case [b]I will change it back to how it was before.[/b][/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] [b]Bonus Room:[/b] You could [b]glitch / crouch on the glass vent, probably to protect yourself with a cube placed on top of it[/b], instead of [b]destroying the generator to access the second Cube[/b]. Now [b]blocked[/b] to avoid this possibility. Might revert it back if you suggest it, to [b]conserve both possible solutions,[/b] but as this would require a higher ceiling in this area [i](not enough time to do this yet)[/i], it wasn’t done yet.[/*][/list][h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
This update [b]includes hundreds of bugfixes;[/b] only [b]important ones are mentioned here:[/b]
[list][*][b]Corrupted Save[/b]: Might still happen - [b]will be investigated more in a future update[/b]. Not sure what causes it yet. However, when save corruption happens [b]while reading the save file[/b] [i](resume or last checkpoint)[/i], the game will [b]now restart the Chapter from start to unblock the game[/b] (no other solution yet).[/*][*][b]Reported Bugs[/b]: Fixed [b]many in-game reported bugs[/b][/*][*][b]Upgrade Terminals[/b]: If you had [b]all upgrades acquired for a Terminal[/b], or in End Game mode, [b]Hyper-Speed could show up as an upgrade[/b]. It shouldn’t.[/*][*][b]Color Packs[/b]: After requesting a [b]New Game[/b] (not NG+), picking up Color Packs would [b]not correctly update the count of found Color Packs[/b] in the Pause menu. This fix [b]requires you to request a New Game[/b] to test if it’s [b]now correctly solved[/b].[/*][*][b]Lifts & Moving Platforms[/b]: After a [b]Quick Save / Quick Load[/b], in some cases, some [b]Lifts or Moving Platforms would refuse to move after being activated[/b].[/*][*][b]Chapter 4[/b]: Many [b]gameplay and visual bugfixes in Processing Center[/b].[/*][*][b]Save System[/b]: More cases of saving are [b]now safer[/b] [i](lasers positioning and more)[/i][/*][*][b]Interaction:[/b] When [b]not in Speedrun Mode[/b] (rarely if enabled), [b]interaction with buttons could fail [/b]if you [b]looked rapidly the other way[/b] while [b]interaction animation was playing[/b].[/*][*][b]Lasers[/b]: After a [b]Quick Load,[/b] [b]moving lasers could be out of sync / moving towards incorrect direction[/b]. There might still be cases of this, but [b]most should now be fixed[/b].[/*][*][b]Screens[/b]: A bug was [b]provoking second run texts to not be used in New Game+[/b]. Should be fixed.[/*][*][b]Moving Platforms[/b]: Many [b]bugfixes coming from PE with platform pushing/crushing player fixes[/b]. Quick loading while standing on a moving platform could cause [b]wrong moving platform movement[/b] after quick load.[/*][*][b]Show Stats[/b]: Tab key would not always work to request to hide/show stats & objectives. Should now be more reactive.[/*][*][b]Hover[/b]: Hovering [b]just after a fully-vertical-upwards Dodge[/b] could result in [b]sliding vertically up[/b] for a few seconds.[/*][*][b]Sparks[/b]: [b]Particles [/b]for lasers could sometimes [b]go through objects.[/b][/*][*][b]Crouched Jump:[/b] If you [b]chained jump just after a crouch request[/b], you’d have a [b]jump height boost[/b]. Fixed.[/*][*][b]Moving Platforms:[/b] Spamming [b]Jump when Quick Loading with a Quick Save on a moving platform [/b]could result in your [b]being able to fly[/b][/*][*][b]Recordings[/b]: If [b]Steam failed to initialize correctly[/b], errors could happen when p[b]icking up Recordings.[/b] Should not happen anymore.[/*][*][b]Other[/b]: Countless [b]other bugs [/b]in all Chapters :)[/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update over the next few weeks for the next found major bugs[/b] ;)

[b]Enjoy your wonderful holidays[/b], and we wish you a [b][i]Happy New Year[/i] in advance![/b]

[i]Charles & Amy from Haze Games[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.583 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear [b]Fractal Space[/b] players! Update [b]0.583 is now LIVE[/b] on Steam for Windows, Mac & Linux!

This update focuses on fixing many reported bugs in 0.582. The game should now be more stable 🙂

[quote="Haze Games"][b]IMPORTANT: RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER[/b] after updating to avoid bugs, softlocks and ensure new bugfixes are correctly applied![/quote]
After updating, if at any time you are encounter a missing object in the level (Power Core Slot or other), please restart the current chapter from the beginning (not last checkpoint, full Chapter restart) and check if the issue is still happening. If it still missing, [b]please report with ALT+B[/b].

As there were a [b]huge amount of bug fixes and important changes[/b], please [b]expect new bugs to occur[/b]. If major blocking bugs occur, please report and there will be a quick patch within a few days to fix those first. Other bugs will wait for the next update.

If you have specific bug reports that require videos, please send them to bug@haze.games 😉

Thank you for testing and reporting bugs!


[h1]| NEW IN 0.583 |[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Interaction:[/b] A bug made all interactions possible from further away than intended. Fixed, which might create new bugs or unsolvable situations. Picking cubes that are on platforms below you may now require you to crouch (intended and acceptable). Please report if you find blocking issues with performing interactions after this change. I’m aware speedrunners might dislike this change; I’m expecting complaints 🙂 You’ll need to get used to the smaller interaction range. If after a few runs you still can’t adapt to it and it is too annoying, I’ll increase it slightly again (but will remain smaller than it was before), and maybe only for Speedrun Mode. Please report as Suggestions what you think about the smaller interaction range (please not the first time you try – only after doing a few runs and being used to it).
[*][b]Button Interaction:[/b] First version of button interaction animation; will be using the left-hand glove with an electrified short-range visual effect towards the button activated in the future. It’s meant to be very short and quick to avoid adding delays for interaction. Current delay is only 0.1s. Speedrun Mode completely removes this delay and keeps instant-interaction (the animation will be slightly out of sync, but it’s intended for Speedrun Mode). You can safely request interaction and move / look away and it will work (intended to avoid annoyance, and remain cosmetic). If you press it multiple times, it will correctly perform the interaction multiple times (might sometimes be out of sync visually with the animation, but that will be fixed later). Won’t be played if currently healing, but instant interaction will be performed (intended)
[*][b]Achievements: [/b]Many existing Achievements now have new icons, 2 small ones were added. Many more to come, when I have time to add Achievements 🙂
[*][b]Hyper-Speed:[/b] Auto-heal if the player has a health kit in his backpack when reaching the low health threshold for Hyper-Speed.
[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Added softlock release in the first vertical corridor if no more Taser Ammo. You need to aim really badly to have it 🙂 It’s a silent dialogue for now. [/list]

[h1]| CHANGES |[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Damage:[/b] Invincibility period after being hit by Lasers / Saws has been reduced
[*][b]Dodge:[/b] Crosshair disabled will now still show Dodge cooldown gauge (washidden as well with the crosshair)
[*][b]Chapter 1: [/b]Taser pickup dialogues and objects are now better tied to picking up the Taser, avoiding them to be triggered if you don’t pick it up directly.
[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] First button to shoot in the game, can no longer be accessed manually
[*][b]Chapter 1: [/b]Skip through the breakable window in the room with the first Cube will no longer destroy the first cube – you can continue to Taser Room door with it. Previous vents won’t be automatically locked.
[*][b]Chapter 1: [/b]Cannot go back into the lift “Maintenance” hatch of “Alternate Route” anymore after using the lift to go up to the first Power Core
[*][b]Chapter 1: [/b]After dropping in the room below the vertical corridor with a button to shoot, the blinking laser will turn off after interacting with the first switch.
[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Upon entering the last room in the Zero-Gravity part, the ground will be blocked to prevent you from returning down.[/list]

[h1]| BUG FIXES |[/h1]
There were many more bugfixes than the list below; only noting here the most important ones:
[list]
[*][b]Reported Bugs: [/b]Fixed many in-game reported bugs
[*][b]Saving:[/b] In some cases, resuming the game from Main Menu could provoke some triggers to re-activate and checkpoints to re-save. This has been fixed.
[*][b]Cutscenes:[/b] Disabling Cutscenes while a cutscenes was already playing could result in a black screen.
[*][b]Cutscenes: [/b]Auto-Skipping a Cutscene with Hyper-Speed activated could freeze the player for around 1s if the player was static – or impede controls if already moving
[*][b]Music: [/b]Could play “detected” soundtrack at the same time as level soundtrack, especially when there were multiple cameras involved in the room. Most cases should be fixed, please report steps to reproduce if you find additional cases of this happening. Thank you!
[*][b]Music: [/b]Entering loading transition will now stop playing current chapter music until next chapter is loaded (intended).
[*][b]Cameras: [/b]Will now switch to normal level music and show “Cleared” when no more cameras are searching for the player. The game would sometimes do this when there was still another different camera detecting / searching for the player.
[*][b]Sequence Switches: [/b]Bugs were fixed with them sometimes remaining pressed down without actually moving to the next sequence step. Other bugs related to saving at specific moments of sequences have been fixed too – they should be more stable.
[*][b]Room Control: [/b]Improved buttons to avoid them not always being activated when clicking outside of the center
[*][b]Sound Volume / Music Volume:[/b] Various bugfixes were made to music / sound volumes: a bug was provoking music to return during level loading (should be silent for now between levels), and music volume could be changed to higher than desired. Should now be better, might provoke new sound-related issues.
[*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Power Beam switch was not playing its “Activation” animation.
[*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Secret stairs to secret passage could sometimes open / close instantly instead of playing the intended animation. This is quite a dangerous change, please test and report any bugs regarding stairs animation or other animations like this.[/list]
Thank you for testing! We’ll continue working on the various remaining bugs, and re-update over the next few days for next bugs 😉

Charles & Amélie, Haze Games

notes.title: Update 0.58 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello dear [b]Fractal Space[/b] players! Latest [b]update 0.58 [/b]is now available on [b]Windows, Mac and Linux![/b] Please [b]restart Steam [/b]to be sure you get the [b]latest update as soon as possible[/b].

This update [b]focuses on a massive amount of bugfixes[/b], that were introduced by [b]previous update 0.57;[/b] as the previous version had [b]many code / structural changes[/b], it also [b]brought in many new bugs[/b].

Theoretically, [b]most of them should now be fixed![/b] We hope this [b]0.58[/b] [b]update [/b]version is [b]more stable than 0.57![/b]

[quote=Haze Games][b]RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER:[/b] If you were playing before this update, please [b]restart current Chapter [/b]from the [b]beginning [/b]to [b]avoid bugs.[/b][/quote]
After updating, if [b]at any time you are encounter a missing object [/b]in the level [i](Power Core Slot or other)[/i], please [b]restart the current chapter [/b]from the beginning [i](not last checkpoint, full Chapter restart)[/i] and check if the issue is [b]still happening[/b]. If it still missing, [b]please report with ALT+B[/b].

If you have specific bug reports that require videos or cannot be sent via [b]ALT+B[/b], please send them to [b]bug@haze.games [/b];)

[b]Thank you [/b]for testing and [b]reporting bugs![/b]

In case you had [b]missed our behind-the-scenes video[/b] about adding pipes in the past few updates, you can [b]check it out now:[/b]

[previewyoutube=K8_2cIC18bM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]NOTES | KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[b]Ghost Mode: [/b]Using [b]Ghost Mode [/b]will result in [b]bugs that you do not need to report[/b].
If you use [b]Ghost Mode[/b], please [b]play the "normal way"[/b] and [b]activate all the buttons / objects correctly in the right order[/b], and [b]"fly" through the normal path[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/b798992773153e1e9b4419969a3d8723a106fb1b.png[/img]

Otherwise, the level won't respond correctly and [b]won't be initialized how it should[/b]. This is [b]intended[/b], as the game is [b]highly optimized with all rooms being initialized as the player progresses[/b].

If you [b]skip them completely with Ghost Mode[/b], they [b]won't be initialized[/b]. This is [b]not a bug [/b]and [b]does not require to be fixed[/b], because it's simply an [b]impossible situation in normal play[/b].

There will be an in-game warning about this in the future ;)

[b]Random Clipping:[/b] It can sometimes happen that you [b]may randomly clip through a wall or ground[/b]. This is a [b]Unity engine bug with physics.[/b]

Unfortunately, [b]we cannot do anything about it[/b] at this stage. The bug was reported years ago, and[b] Unity is finally working on a fix.[/b] I will let you know when this issue is presumably fixed, from which point this issue shouldn't happen anymore.

Until then, you [b]might still experience it once in a while[/b]. You may still [b]report bugs about them for information purposes[/b] but it requires Unity to fix their physics bug :(

[h2]NEW | IN 0.58[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Propellers with Blades: [/b]Being [b]improved and reworked visually[/b]; you currently will have a [b]mix between the old and new version[/b] [i](it's intended as work not finished)[/i]. Will be improved in the [b]next updates [/b];)[/*]
[*][b]Safe Area:[/b] Added [b]"Reset"[/b] when [b]editing Display Safe Area [/b]to reset to default values in Options - Accessibility:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/32c33129ae0fd699b6f6c0d63113ccaba651e88f.png[/img][/*]
[*][b]Upgrades:[/b] Reworked [b]Upgrade interface [/b]with [b]more readable layout [/b]and [b]new icons [/b]for [b]each upgrade.[/b] If you want to [b]discover the updated Upgrades page yourself[/b], please [b]don’t hover the SPOILER black bar below:[/b]

[spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/3eab07a6ae16459948f58cb725287cdf4d2ae289.png[/img][/spoiler]
[/*][/list]

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
[list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Solved [b]softlock [/b]before/after getting the Taser: if you have [b]disabled the Platforms button[/b], platforms will be [b]forced active [/b]after shooting the [b]very first switch[/b], to [b]ensure you can get back.[/b] If you[b] disable the platforms[/b] after getting the Taser and try to return to Taser Room and fall, [b]relocation will now appropriately relocate you to the correct side[/b] to avoid softlock.[/*][/list]

[h2]BUG | FIXES[/h2]
[list][*][b]Zero-Gravity:[/b] Fixed the major bug that would cause "throwing the player" around while in Zero-Gravity and going out of cutscene state (even with cutscenes disabled this bug would happen)[/*][*][b]Moving Lasers: [/b]Could sometimes stop movement after character death and save reloads[/*][*][b]3D Texts: [/b]Some [b]Russian characters [/b]were [b]not displayed correctly[/b] [i](squares)[/i]. Should be [b]fixed[/b]. Please [b]report if you find others[/b] ;)[/*][*][b]Breakable Windows: [/b]Falling from breakable window glass shards (example, walking on it and dropping down) could cause jetpack request to not happen until next time you touched regular ground[/*][*][b]Hover: [/b]Was recharging during cutscenes[/*][*][b]Collectibles: [/b]Various collectable objects could still have collisions (with other objects) after being picked up. Lens flares (small lights) were not displayed correctly (they should be back)[/*][*][b]Cutscenes: [/b]Some cutscenes could have lens flares wrongly placed (stars)[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Could see the Power Core after 3600 code sticking out of the wall if you then decided to go outside[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] "Find a way to unlock the Taser Room" objective could be triggered and displayed as active when going through the vent before entering the room (too early).[/*][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] The Bridge to get out of the first room had a ground placed above it - this was a bug.[/*][*][b]Chapter 2: [/b]Interior of the Big Room could have a missing part[/*][*][b]Chapter 2: [/b]First shooting camera cutscene could go wrong and prevent camera's surrounding walls to retract, if you were in first run (not NG+), and cutscenes disabled.[/*][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Last room's Cube could be picked up through the breakable window at some angles[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Horizontal fast smashers could kill the player at incorrect moments of their moment:

Intended, to avoid issues with the door they control, and keep that door closed.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] After the first double-pressure plate area (with 2 timer boxes), the Cubes and structures behind would be destroyed while the moving platform was moving to the next area. Now, has been changed to be destroyed when entering the Vertical Room, to be less noticeable.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Power Core Slot for optional upgrade before The Cube initialization button, and others, could sometimes not be present.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] The Cube area could be missing the Encryption Key readers and formatters. If you still have them missing, please share a video of how you played the previous rooms, as it may be linked to what actions you perform before reaching The Cube:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/c22545d8feecbf75515ae44b2b048f3b2f19dae0.png[/img]

[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Invisible ground just before the "Timing is Important" room, after getting out of the vent[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] After the Bridge from the Vertical Room, you could shoot the button and result in a buggy entrance towards the next area. This button is now manual only.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Going through the disabled lasers after the music hacking part, would destroy the camera and other objects, even if you went back down. This has now been changed to be done later in the level to make it less noticeable.[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] "initializeRoom" button cutscene had a few objects wrongly present beforehand[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Fixed various blinking objects inside Initialization Room, and some floating structures of the level that were visible too early[/*][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Sun Room Power Core Slot and others could sometimes be missing[/*][*][b]Chapter 4: [/b]A Train wall collider was bugged and you could clip through it[/*][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] The Hyper-Speed Suppressor area could sometimes have a missing destructible wall on the ceiling[/*][*]Fixed [b]camera glitches during cutscene[/b] transition for a non-skippable cutscene with Disable Cutscenes enabled[/*][*][b]Keyboard / Mouse Objects:[/b] Keyboard / Mouse objects of Terminals would be[b] thrown very fast if shot with Taser in Zero-G[/b]. Will now react appropriately.[/*][*][b]Localization:[/b] Various [b]typos and wrong localizations[/b] were fixed [i](thanks for reporting them)[/i][/*][*][b]Subtitles:[/b] [i]"Nope"[/i] subtitle [b]wouldn't disappear[/b][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/5540e1f6cdbbaf8804710295483e7221d6551de7.jpg[/img]

[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll continue working on the various remaining bugs, and re-update the game [b]within 3 weeks[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.57 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

A new [b]update 0.57[/b] of [b][i]Fractal Space Pre-Alpha[/i][/b] is [b]ready to be tested[/b], and [b]live[/b] on [i][b]Windows[/b], [b]Mac [/b]and [b]Linux![/b][/i]

Please [b]restart [/b][i][b]Steam[/b] [/i]to be sure you get the [b]latest update as soon as possible.[/b]

As mentioned below, this [b]update is significant in terms of code changes and optimizations[/b] - I'm [b]expecting new bugs[/b] to appear with [b]lasers[/b], [b]in-game screens[/b], and [b]character movement[/b].

[quote][b]RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER:[/b] If you were playing before this update, [b]please restart current Chapter[/b] from the [b]beginning[/b] to [b]avoid bugs[/b][/quote]
[b]Thank you [/b]for testing and [b]reporting bugs![/b]

[h2][b]TIMELAPSE |[/b] Adding Pipes[/h2]
In case you [b]might have missed the video[/b], we added [b]new pipes in all levels[/b]  in the last few updates. This updates adds [b]a few more around the end of Chapter 3[/b]. Here's a [b]timelapse [/b]of the addition of only a few of them:
[previewyoutube=K8_2cIC18bM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]CHAPTER 1 |[/b] Dialogues[/h2]
From v0.57, [b]most dialogues are no longer silent for Chapter 1![/b]

As you might be [b]used to the old dialogues[/b] from the mobile version, you [b]might not like the new ones at first[/b], and [b]it will take some time for you to adjust [/b]to the change; but [b]they are better for new players [/b]who do not know the mobile version.

[quote][b]NOTE:[/b] They are[b] not all final in terms of quality and acting[/b], and some will be [b]improved over the next updates[/b]. Chapter 1 dialogues will [b]soon be added to the Localization sheet.[/b][/quote]

[h2][b]CONTROLS |[/b] Rework[/h2]
There has been a [b]major rework of the controls / gravity / fall movement engine.[/b]
This is a [b]significant change in code[/b], which came along with a pretty significant amount of headaches :)

You [b]won't[/b] [b]see [/b]the difference much at [b]first glance[/b] - but this major rework was [b]necessary in order to fix a few complicated bugs[/b], that were annoying whenever they would happen, [b]especially during speedruns.[/b]

The [b]end result[/b] is [b]smoother fall / landing on grounds[/b], especially while [b]running and on slopes[/b], etc.

Here's an [b]explanation of the fixes[/b] and [b]desired behavior[/b] with the [b]new changes:[/b]
[list][*][b]Undesired Fast Fall: [/b]When [b][i]"dropping from a ledge"[/i] without jump[/b], the player would [b][i]"fall very fast"[/i] for around 0.2s[/b], which created a [b]visible downwards [i]"jitter"[/i][/b]. This could sometimes [b]prevent a jump [/b]from being performed as requested.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Slopes Fast Fall: [/b]The [b]same as the above[/b], but was [b]worse when running on slopes[/b] [i](especially downwards slopes)[/i]. This could also happen when[b] falling off the edge of a vertical moving platform[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Hard sticking to Ground:[/b] When [b]running off a ground towards another ground slightly below[/b], the character would [b][i]"hard stick"[/i][/b], meaning [b]instantly teleport to the next ground's vertical position[/b], creating a [b][i]"vertical jitter"[/i][/b] of the character [b]instead of smoothly falling on the next ground[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Tolerant Jump: [/b]In order to[b] avoid frustration[/b], there is a [b]jump tolerance of around 0.1s[/b] that allows the character to [b]jump[/b], even if he is [b]no longer on the current ground[/b] for [b]less than this duration[/b]. This [b]avoids jumps being ignored[/b] if the player [b]just got off the platform[/b] [i](necessary, especially while running fast)[/i]. However, before the rework, these jumps would [b]create a visible [i]"downwards jitter" [/i][/b]of the character too. Should now be [b]smooth[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Sprinting on Slopes:[/b] This was [b]still an issue and the character would sometimes "[i]unstick[/i]"[/b] from [b]slopes [/b]when [b]running downwards on them[/b]. Should happen [b]far less often[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Various other non-smooth movements[/b] were happening in other situations, especially on [b]smashers / moving platforms[/b]. This has been improved.[/*]
[/list]
[quote][b]NOTE: [/b]The rework[b] does affect how gravity / ground collision / jetpack / hover / dodge[/b] is applied to the character - this means that even though the [b]bugs above have been fixed[/b] in most cases, these changes [b]may have introduced new bugs[/b], especially if you test [b]complicated combinations[/b] of hover / dodge / jetpack / jump / moving platforms.
[/quote]

[h2]NEW | From v0.57[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Screens with Texts:[/b] Screens which display texts in-game were OK, but they were becoming an issue. [b]Every single one of them[/b] has been [b]replaced in all levels[/b] with a [b]new display system[/b] that allows:
- [b]Smoother texts[/b] [i](no blurriness)[/i], even with [b]large characters[/b] [i](like the Big Room screen)[/i]
- [b]Significantly more optimized[/b] when there are many [i](the PC version has more than 200 screens per level)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/f7204bbed09443a8d52a8ad063afa5c390b386b9.jpg[/img]

The new system for these screens [b]doesn't have yet the "typewriter effect"[/b]. It will be added in a [b]future update[/b] [i](needs to be re-done)[/i].

[*][b]Active Lock:[/b] For some [b]locked vents where the player must act to unlock them[/b][i] (removing a power core, Room Control, etc.)[/i], now have a [b]visible "active lock"[/b] to make it [b]more clear[/b] that this vent is [b]currently locked[/b], and that [b]power to this lock must be cut-off[/b] to [b]unlock it:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/3f91f5e64161d9811d13e359b24ea28e9d2f3c1a.jpg[/img]

[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] All[b] collectable recordings [/b]are [b]now placed [/b]for [b]this level:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/61e04b4c4bb8e042c80bb242e85b3f4bcb40ce91.jpg[/img]

[/*][/list][list][*][b]Relocation:[/b] Added [b][i]Black & White [/i][/b]effect when starting a [b]relocation[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Cables:[/b] Added [b]many new cables[/b] for some [b]Power Core Slots / buttons in Chapter 2[/b] and [b]Chapter 3[/b], to make some areas [b]more clear:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/8dd6dc33b77ffdad66ba0a9166ffa23d952ceb05.jpg[/img]

[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3: [/b]Added[b] more pipes [/b]at the [b]end of the chapter[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Texts: [/b]Both [b]in-game 3D texts[/b] and [b]User Interface now support all languages characters display[/b]. All [b][i]Ukrainian / Russian[/i][/b] characters should [b]now be displayed correctly:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/ce6398b78ceb4c2359f0d9cb084567ab8ea5fead.jpg[/img]

[/*][/list][list][*][b]Options: [/b]New [b]Accessibility[i] tab[/i][/b]: You can now [b]disable / enable the white point crosshair [/b]when [b]not aiming the Taser[/b], and [b]change [i]Subtitles Size[/i][/b]. In addition, you can now [b]change the [i]Display Safe Area[/i][/b] if you have a screen aspect ratio that may have UI elements [i]"oustide the screen"[/i]. This can mostly happen when [b]connected to a TV[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/a46b9649a0af8ecced2ec71dc682ef1dd108743b.jpg[/img]

More accessibility options will be added in [b]future updates[/b], like color blind options, and more. In the future, you'll be able to select [b]different crosshair styles and colors[/b].[/*][/list]
[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Lasers / Mines Optimization:[/b] The [b]code [/b]that [b]handles lasers and mines[/b] has been [b]significantly optimized[/b]. It will [b]run better on low-end CPUs[/b] when [b]many lasers are active[/b]. These changes [b]might have introduced new bugs with Lasers[/b] - keep an eye out ;)[/*][/list][list][*][b]User Interface Optimization:[/b] The [b]code [/b]that handles the [b]user interface in general [/b]has been significantly [b]optimized[/b] as well. It will run [b]better on low-end CPUs[/b]. In addition, [b]all in-game UI elements positions[/b] are now [b]depending on the new Display Safe Area.[/b] These changes [b]might have introduced new bugs with user interface elements[/b] - keep an eye out for new [b]UI-related bugs[/b] too ;)[/*][/list][list][*][b]Various Optimization: [/b]Many other systems were optimized, and [b]many more to come in future updates.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Lens Flares:[/b] [b]Disabling / Enabling "Bloom"[/b] will now [b]also enable / disable associated Lens Flares of lights[/b] (small stars on them). This will [b]improve performance on low-end PCs[/b] when disabled.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1[/b] [b]Quote:[/b] Has been [b]removed and replaced[/b] by a [b]different one[/b]. It is now on an [b]Information Tablet[/b], not on a wall screen. Please check localization sheet to[b] re-translate it[/b]. Thank you![/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1: [/b]First [b]Crushers Room[/b]: In case you [b]leave your cube in an inaccessible place [/b]without it, [b]you can now regenerate the cube with a button[/b] next to the [b]platform to avoid softlocks:[/b][list][*]This button[b] doesn't work until cube has been picked up at least once[/b] after initial spawn / manual respawns.[/*][*][b]Note: [/b]This new [b]Reinitialize Cube button cannot be activated while the cube is on the objective Pressure Plate [i](intended)[/i],[/b] to [b]avoid mistakenly respawning [/b]the cube when you have solved the room.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] The pathway to get to the[b] optional area[/b] to get[b] "Impressive" recording[/b] has [b]changed visually[/b]. Since the [b]Cube can be re-generated using the new button[/b], the [b]slopes to help get there without a cube[/b] after completing this area [b]has been removed.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] First [b][i]Power Core Slot[/i][/b] will make the [b][i]Entrance door [/i]button activable[/b]; but [b]opening the [i]Entrance[/i][/b] door will [b]properly make the button inactive again[/b] to [b]avoid softlocks.[/b][/*][/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Smasher Death during Cutscenes: [/b]Was no longer resulting in [b]"red invincible state"[/b] since 0.56 (good), but was then [b]breaking collisions with the Smasher[/b] (bad). Should now be [b]fixed[/b].[/*][/list][list][*][b]Language: [/b]When [b]changing languages[/b], tutorials, objectives and other texts that were [b]not updated to the new language[/b] until [b]next time they are shown[/b] - will now be[b] updated correctly.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]ALT+B In-Game Bug Reporting:[/b] Should now be [b]displayed properly on all screen aspect ratios and resolutions[/b], including [b]very low resolutions.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Zero-G Boost:[/b] Was [b]wrongly displaying "[i]Pending…[/i]"[/b] for the [b][i]Sprint [/i][/b]when [b]performing [i]Zero-G Boost[/i][/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed [b]more misaligned walls [/b]in the [b]last camera rooms.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2: [/b]The [b]door [/b]at the [b]end of the first shooting cameras corridor [/b]could be [b]missing[/b], allowing you to [b]enter the room [/b]with the first electrified water, [b]without it being properly initialised.[/b] This is a bit of a [b]mystery bug[/b], as it [b]doesn't happen here in normal play.[/b] I made some [b]changes to try and avoid it[/b], but cannot guarantee it's fully fixed. [b]To be tested ;)[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Fast [b]horizontal [i]Smashers [/i][/b]should [b]no longer push you through the wall [/b]upon death.[/*][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] I was [b]not able to reproduce the bug[/b] in which the [b]initializeRoom.cpp button failed to initialize the room[/b]. If you do manage to [b]find a way to reproduce this[/b], please [b]report it again with more details[/b] of how this bug can happen [i](maybe something specific to do before?)[/i][/*][/list][list][*][b]Interaction: [/b]Fixed a case in which the [b][i]"Interaction" [/i][/b]sign [b]would be stuck in a loop [/b]of being [b]hidden and shown very rapidly[/b].[/*][/list]
[b]Thank you for testing! [/b]We'll continue [b]working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and[b] re-update the game within 2/3 weeks[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.56 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi all! PC update [i]0.56[/i] is available on Windows, Mac and Linux! [b]Restart [i]Steam[/i][/b] to be sure you get the [b]latest update[/b] as soon as possible.

This [b]update is mostly about bugfixes[/b] after the [b]0.54 - 0.55[/b] updates. You can view the previous [b]full 0.54 update changelog[/b] on our post here: [url=https://haze-games.com/update-0-54]https://haze-games.com/update-0-54[/url]

There [b]has been changes to Chapter 1[/b] - Please [b]read the changelog before testing,[/b] or else you [b]might think these changes are not intended[/b] ;)

[quote]
[b]RESTART CURRENT CHAPTER:[/b] If you were playing before this update, please [b]restart current Chapter[/b] from the beginning to avoid bugs 

[b]RESET SAVE:[/b] If you want the [b]recordings counter fixed properly[/b], you'll need to [b]reset your save[/b] with the [b]!Reset Save![/b] button. As a precaution, it's good to [b]reset your save[/b] if you are going to test the full game ;)
[/quote]
[b]Thank you[/b] for testing and reporting bugs!

[h2]NOTES & KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[quote]
[b]Reset Save:[/b] [i]"Bonus rooms count doesn't reset by !reset save!"[/i] -> Was [b]not able to reproduce;[/b] every time I reset save [i](either from Main Menu or Pause)[/i], everything is [b]reset correctly[/b], including [b]Bonus Room count[/b] and states. Maybe there is a [b]specific step to do[/b] in order for this bug to occur? However, [b]I made a change to Reset Save[/b] that [b]may help this[/b], so it [b][i]might[/i] be solved[/b].

[b]Jetpack & Cutscenes:[/b] [i]"Sometimes, when cutscene start, and you starting to use jetpack, after cutscene, jetpack would start and hold Space until end of oil"[/i] -> [b]Not able to reproduce:[/b] jetpack is [b]always interrupted when a cutscene starts[/b] [i](intended)[/i] and request to [b]use Jetpack is always ignored[/b] during cutscenes, until cutscenes end. At end of cutscene, jetpack [b]reacts normally.[/b] If you find a way to reproduce this, [b]please report again[/b] - it doesn't look systematic.

[b]Text:[/b] Russian characters are supported by the [b]main User Interface of the game[/b] - the [b]Taser screen and hidden messages aren't displaying correctly[/b] with all languages yet - it's a known issue, I'll be working on this soon. It's different because text display in 3D uses a different system than UI texts - dynamic font switching support needs to be added for 3D texts [i](missing feature, will work on it for future update)[/i].

[b]ALT+B Reporting:[/b] Not displayed correctly on [b]super-low resolutions[/b] [i](like 640x480)[/i]. Will be fixed in a [b]future update[/b].
[/quote]

[h2]NEW IN 0.56[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Ukrainian:[/b] Added [i]Ukrainian[/i] [i](thanks for the translation!)[/i]. However, [b]some characters might not yet be displayed correctly[/b], please [b]wait for the next update[/b] if there are issues with this language.

[*][b]Vents:[/b] Outside [b]texture of ventilation shafts[/b] has changed to [b]look cleaner[/b], and [b]more consistent[/b] with the rest of the level. You might not like it at first, as you were [b]used to the previous texture[/b] - but it [b]looks better for new players.[/b] They will be [b]improved later[/b] to [b]look more different than grounds.[/b]

[*][b]Cables:[/b] New [b]cables visuals[/b] have been added in [b]Chapter 3[/b], first [b]Encryption Key area[/b] on roof of vertical room. They will be [b]gradually added to various [i]Power Cores Slots[/i][/b] [i](not necessarily all of them)[/i].

[*][b]Local Pixelation[/b] effect has been added to [b]"censor" the player position[/b] on [b]camera feed screens[/b]. There will be [b]something for Cutscenes[/b] too [b]in the future[/b]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Roof next to [b]first smasher button[/b] has been [b]visually improved[/b]. [b]Walls[/b] of this smasher room have been [b]reworked to be better aligned[/b], [b]avoiding ghost collisions[/b] on small borders.

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Room with "Taser Room" door using [b]2 pressure plates[/b] has [b]changed[/b]. In addition, all elements are [b]directly present the first time[/b] you enter it, but [b]can't be used yet[/b] [i](before, elements for your return were not present at all the first time)[/i].
[list][*]When [b]coming back with the Taser[/b] on [b]New Game+[/b], you can [b]skip activating the platform[/b] by [b]directly activating the Laser Field button[/b] [i](inside the room, or button behind Laser Field, coming from breakable window)[/i].[/*][*]Made the [b]dual pressure plates safer:[/b] You [b]can't get out onto the Bridge with the cubes[/b] anymore in [i]New Game[/i]. If you do so using [b]HS + Dodge in NG+[/b], they [b]will be respawned as you cross[/b] the bridge to [b]ensure they remain on the pressure plates and keep the door open.[/b] [b]Dropping it[/b] on the [b]bridge[/b] will also result in [b]respawning[/b].[/*][*]You also [b]cannot softlock yourself in this room[/b] by using [b]HS to drop the cube on the bridge and go back in[/b][/*][/list]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] The [b]roof of the room mentioned above[/b] [i](where you find Orange color pack)[/i] has [b]changed too[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] First [b]Power Core Area:[/b] Has changed to [b]add a little bit more to explore[/b], and different way get the [b]Color Pack[/b]  ;) It is intended to be [b]playable on both NG and NG+[/b]. Easier in [b]NG+[/b] as you can use [b]Hover / Dodge[/b] to get it directly [i](intended)[/i]

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Player [b]stuck between moving platforms[/b] and [b]walls[/b] in the [b]first room[/b], will [b]teleport him above[/b] or [b]below[/b] the platform, instead of [b]pushing him out and killing him[/b]. Please report other occurrences of pushing you out of bounds, as this is complicated issue that needs to be [b]solved per-platform[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Until now, [i]Chapter 4[/i] had [b]no recordings to find in the level[/b]. You [b]can now find 3 of them[/b] [i](there will be more)[/i] - even though they are [b]silent and temporary [i]"Work In Progress"[/i] [/b].

[*][b]Camera Screens:[/b] Camera Feed Screens now display [b][i]"Error, rebooting"[/i][/b] when [b]stunned[/b], and [b][i]"Camera Destroyed"[/i][/b] if camera is [b]destroyed[/b] instead of [i]"Offline"[/i] for both cases.

[*][b]Destructible Walls:[/b] Made [b]walls easier to break[/b] in general.[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Walls are [b]meant to feel stronger than windows[/b] and [b]harder to break completely[/b]. [b]Multiple shots are required[/b], and [b]pieces remain and require you to shoot more[/b]. This is the [b]intended feel and won't change for the normal game[/b].However, I know this can be [b]annoying in speedruns[/b]. From now on, [b]Taser Power Level 3[/b] will [b]break walls much more efficiently[/b] than [b]Level 2[/b] [i](was intended, not yet implemented)[/i]. If you want to [b]speedrun faster with breakable walls[/b], please do so with [b]Taser Power Level 3[/b] ;)
