[*][b]Destructible Walls:[/b] [i]Dodge[/i] will [b]still not break non-broken walls[/b] [i](intended)[/i]. However, [b]walking through a broken wall will detach the remaining parts slowly[/b], and [b]Dodging through[/b] it will [b]break them to ensure you get through[/b]. This should help for speedruns :) Still [b]recommended to make decent hole[/b] before going through ;)

[*][b]Destructible Walls:[/b] Now have [b]sounds[/b]
[/list]
[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] First lasers [b]"Don't be Afraid":[/b] [b]ATTENTION, SPEEDRUNNERS:[/b] I want the player to [b]not be able to go through them at all on first run[/b], but still allow [b]speedrunners to skip them[/b], so it has changed:
[list][*]There are [b]more lasers[/b] now, and it's [b]intended[/b] that you [b]can't walk through them[/b] on [i]New Game[/i] [i](you won't survive)[/i][/*][*]On [b]New Game+[/b], you can decide to go [b]through while speedrunning[/b] and lose [b]some health[/b] by moving through them [b]crouched[/b] [i](crouch + dodge works too)[/i] to [b]minimize the count of lasers that hit your body[/b].[/*][*]You will need to have[b]Health Level 2[/b] minimum to [b]survive it[/b]. [/*][*]The [b]3 blinking lasers[/b] just after this will [b]now be activated[/b] even if you [b]skipped the first lasers[/b] - you'll need to be [b]more careful[/b] ;)[/*][/list]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Prevented [b]softlock in first elevator[/b] bonus area: vent will now close correctly upon going through the [b]breakable window.[/b]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Prevented [b]softlock in Taser Room:[/b] cubes [b]respawn if thrown to the other side of pipes[/b] until you [b]reach other side of pipes[/b], way to [b]return to [i]Taser[/i] if you didn't pick it up[/b] in the fall and then [b]went over pipes[/b]. Softlocks here should [b]now be impossible[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] [b]Taser Room[/b] changed [b]Cubes initial positions[/b] to force player to [b]drop a cube for protection.[/b]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] [b]First Power Core Area:[/b] Button to [b]open Entrance Door to 3600 code vent[/b] will now be [b]present at start[/b], but will [b]only be online after inserting Power Core into [i]Main Power[/i].[/b]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Right after the lift to reach the [b]first Power Core Area[/b], it was [b]possible to be relocated next to the Main Power Core Slot[/b] instead of [b]start of the area[/b]. It will now [b]properly relocate you next to the lift[/b], then [b]next to the Power Core Slot[/b] when you [b]have reach it first at least once.[/b]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] 3600 code hint screen now [b]shows "Unavailable"[/b] by default [b]instead of nothing[/b] until [i]Information[/i] button is activated, to [b]avoid feeling like it's a bug that nothing is displayed yet[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] [b]Relocation[/b] in the [b]First Power Core area[/b] will now [b]only relocate you to Bonus Room[/b] if you [b]at least touched the ground of the bonus area[/b] (orange) once - then [b]relocation position[/b] will return back to [i]"in front of power core slot"[/i] if you successfully [b]get out of the bonus room[/b]. You could sometimes [b]die before relocation happens[/b] - [b]now fixed[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] This [b]orange bonus area[/b] mentioned above now allows you to go [b]closer to edges[/b], and [b]avoided some softlocks here in NG[/b]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] [i]"Disobeyed orders"[/i] dialog has [b]moved to be a bit earlier[/b] [i](inside vent)[/i] than before. Can be skipped in NG+ if you go through window (intended)

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] You can now [b]stand on the [i]"Big Room"[/i] screen[/b] - not very useful, but looks like [b]something would expect[/b].

[*][b]Damage Blur:[/b] [b]Smoother[/b] blur effect on / off when [b]damaged[/b] 

[*][b]Depth of Field:[/b] Smoother [b]aiming depth of field change[/b] when [b]aiming close / far objects[/b] [i](now gradual)[/i]

[*][b]Chapter 1 Dialogs:[/b] Improved [b]quality of most of the new dialogs.[/b] Some are [b]still not good and will be re-done later on[/b]. Priority is just reaching a state where there is no silent dialogs in CH1 - then a [b]second pass[/b] on dialog recording will be done.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Invincible Red State:[/b] Dying [b]during a cutscene should not be possible;[/b] if it happened, you would [b]enter an invincibility state[/b], with the [b]red "death effect"[/b]. This [b]has been solved[/b], and you [b]should never get killed during cutscenes[/b] [i](yes, even if you are squashed during a cutscene - this is an [b]intended choice[/b] to [b]avoid the frustration[/b] of being killed during a cutscene rather than being realistic)[/i].

[*][b]Dialogs:[/b] Some [b]silent dialogs[/b] were actually playing [i]"Cmon, let's go on an adventure"[/i] instead of silence. You were [b]not crazy[/b], hehe :)Fixed many - You [b]might find more[/b] - let me know if you do!

[*][b]Cubes:[/b] A player reported sometimes [b]not being able to pick up a cube[/b]. After a lot of investigation, [b]found and fixed a case that provoked this;[/b] it was having a cube [b]forced respawned via "Unauthorized Object"[/b] while the [b]cube was in hands [i]and[/i] invalid position[/b] [i](red, cannot be placed here)[/i]. Should [b]no longer happen.[/b]

[*][b]Game Completion:[/b] After [b]completing the game[/b] and [b]directly exiting[/b], the game would start a [b]normal New Game upon re-launch[/b], [b]instead of New Game+[/b], thus [b]resetting your recordings to 0[/b] and probably upgrades too. Should now start a [b]New Game+ as intended[/b].

[*][b]Recordings:[/b] Number of [b]recordings collected[/b] could not be displayed correctly [i](showing 0)[/i], especially [b]after re-launching[/b] the game or [b]New Game+[/b]. If you are [b]still having this bug[/b], please [b]!RESET SAVE! in the menu[/b].

[*][b]Customization:[/b] [b]Resetting the save[/b] will [b]correctly select default colors[/b] to [b]avoid selecting colors that aren't unlocked anymore[/b]

[*][b]Reporting:[/b] Reporting a [b]bug in the main menu without any level loaded[/b] will now [b]behave normally again[/b]

[*][b]Tables:[/b] You could [b]crouch underneath tables[/b] - not intended

[*][b]Rumble:[/b] Fixed some rumble sequence to still trigger when Rumble is disabled [i](rumble only with XInput devices like Xbox controller + Windows)[/i]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Could stand on the [b]retracted Bridge[/b] that [b]closes in front of you[/b], on return from picking the Taser.

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Skip breakable wall with pipes was [b]hard to break[/b] than others.

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed being able to stand on [b]invisible ground[/b] next to moving platform in front of [b]Smashers[/b] button

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Button in [b]first Power Core[/b] area, [i](next to the blue light)[/i] to [b]shoot with Taser[/b] could [b]not be activated manually[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed sometimes being [b]"stopped in the air"[/b] when falling down the [b]vertical corridor[/b], just [b]after recharging Taser for the first time[/b]

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Ceiling [b]pipes for Recording[/b] in [b]Smasher Room[/b] could sometimes be [b]disabled[/b] and would be enabled only later on.

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed [b]floating pipes[/b] when reaching the [b]first Power Core area[/b]. This [b]won't happen in a normal run[/b]. If you use [i]Ghost Mode[/i], many bugs like this will happen but ignore them - shouldn't in "normal play".

[*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Fixed [b]softlock in when doing optional room[/b] for the recording [i]("Impressive" bridge)[/i]. If you dropped the cube a on some [b]remaining objects in the room[/b], you couldn't retrieve it. Room should now be [b]empty as intended, preventing this from happening[/b] [i](cube will respawn)[/i].

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Bridge Minigame:  Wasn't able to reproduce reported bug about [b]Bridge minigame being ended with a wrong solution[/b] - changed it to be [b]safer[/b] - [b]let me know[/b] if you [b]find a way to have it end on an incorrect solution[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Weird bug with [b]Cubes jumping off the vertical moving platform without being touched by the moving saws[/b], next to the the lift to the first shooting camera room: made some changes that [b]should help[/b], but [b]couldn't reproduce the issue here[/b], so [b]not 100% sure[/b] it's fixed - to be [b]tested[/b]!

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Fixed a [b]critical error[/b] that was [b]happening[/b] for a [b]specific language[/b] [i](Czech)[/i] when loading this chapter.

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] New roof of vertical room: You could [b]squeeze through some pipes[/b] [i](not intended)[/i] instead of using the Power Core to open [b]Maintenance Access[/b] of the new area, to [b]get the Recording[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] The [b]Recording[/b] in the new area above, would [b]sometimes not be present[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] [b]Standing up[/b] in the [b]glass vents[/b] of Chapter 3 with [b]Zero-G disabled[/b] would [b]result in a bug[/b].

[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] [b]Crypto-Locator[/b] button would [b]fail to work as intended[/b] if player [b]picked up the [i]Encryption Key[/i] beforehand[/b]. It was a [b]bug that the key was already present[/b], as it [b]should spawn randomly[/b] when [b]Cypto-Locator is activated[/b].

[*][b]Crosshair:[/b] Could sometimes see [b]Crosshair[/b], [b]Dodge Cooldown gauge[/b], or [b]Dodge visual effect[/b] while in [b]Pause / Taser Customization[/b].

[*][b]Music:[/b] Fixed a case where [b]detected music would continue playing[/b] even [b]after[/b] being cleared [i](maybe still more cases present)[/i]

[*][b]Other:[/b] Various [b]other reported minor bugs[/b] have been fixed
[/list]

[b]Thank you for testing![/b] We'll [b]continue working on the various remaining bugs[/b], and [b]re-update the game by the end of next week[/b] ;)

notes.title: Update 0.55
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/5e7e5e4ab9006fae0d5c3367d23fdff753b2a72d.png[/img]

The [b]first patch of version 0.54 [/b]is now [b]live[/b], as [b]0.55! [/b]Restart [b][i]Steam [/i][/b]to ensure you [b]receive it as as soon as possible![/b]

This update [b]focuses on bugfixes [/b]from the [b]first wave of reports[/b] [url=https://haze-games.com/update-0-54][b]from the 0.54 update[/b][/url]. We'll [b]continue fixing more [/b]as they are [b]reported during the week.[/b]

[b]Thank you[/b] for testing and reporting bugs!

[h2]| [b]NEW IN 0.55[/b] |[/h2]
[list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Added [b]hint dialogs[/b] for [b]Encryption Keys[/b], improved [b]info tablet text[/b]. Encryption Key on roof now [b]easier to find[/b]. [b]Information tablets[/b] will [b]look different[/b] than [b]Encryption Keys[/b] in the future.
[*][b]Resolution:[/b] First launch of the game will now be in [b]full resolution of screen[/b]. [b]Windowed mode[/b] will now work correctly for [b]subsequent launches[/b], and will [b]not return to full screen after ALT+Tab[/b].
[*][b]Sprint:[/b] It's intentional to [b]see the Sprint icon[/b] even when [b]not able to sprint[/b], to ensure you are [b]aware[/b] if sprint is [b]Toggled ON or OFF[/b] (especially useful if using [b]TOGGLE[/b] sprint type in options).[*]New [b]Sprint request icon[/b] now visually different when [b]sprint request is pending[/b] (not sprinting right now / cannot sprint now) or [b]currently sprinting[/b] to make it more clear. This way, you clearly know [b]if you are going to sprint ASAP[/b] or not.[/list]

[quote=Haze Games][b]Known Issue: Bug Reporting:[/b] Reporting a bug in the [b]Main Menu[/b] with no level loaded, will [b]result in an error[/b]; please [b]only report bugs while a level is loaded in 0.55[/b] - this will be [b]fixed in next update[/b] ;) [/quote]

[h2]| [b]CHANGES[/b] |[/h2][list][*][b]Pre-Alpha Warning Popup:[/b] The popup [b]explaining that most dialogs are not recorded yet[/b], and it's [b]not a bug that they are silent[/b], was [b]not being displayed[/b] on first launch. Should now be [b]displayed again[/b].[/list][list][*][b]Sound Effects:[/b] I was [b]not able to reproduce the bug[/b] with [b]sound effects that stop working[/b] (music only) after character death. I tried many times with the same save as The Promidius, unsuccessfully. If you manage to find a [b]way to reproduce[/b] this, please [b]let me know the steps in a bug report[/b]. It may be linked to character death exactly [b]while volume is being reduced[/b] for a dialog to be played, or something tricky like this ;) I made some changes to [b]try and avoid this[/b], but not sure if this is properly fixed yet. [/list][h2]| [b]BUG FIXES[/b] | [/h2][list][*][b]Mines:[/b] Potential [b]critical error[/b] in some cases of Exploding a Mine [b]should be fixed[/b][/list][list][*][b]Discord:[/b] Username was [b]no longer being added [/b]automatically to the [b]in-game bug reports[/b]. Should now be [b]functional again[/b][/list][list][*][b]Collisions:[/b] There can be times when the [b]player would ignore some collisions randomly[/b], like [b]fall through a floor[/b]. This is very hard to solve everywhere - Theoretically, fixed [b]a few that were reported[/b] in [b]Chapter 1[/b] by Ilya. If you encounter any others, [b]please report them[/b] so I can investigate. Thanks![/list][list][*][b]Safe Landing:[/b] Potential [b]critical error[/b] in some cases of Safe Landing detection [b]should be fixed[/b][/list][list][*][b]Cubes:[/b] Picking up a [b]cube that is below another cube[/b], could result in the [b]stacked cube[/b] to [b]remain stuck in the air[/b].[/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Platforms [b]disappeared on first try[/b] when opening the [b]Bridge:[/b] They will now act as intended, and [b]appear after activating the Bridge[/b] switch ;)[/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Collision [b]bug pushing the player[/b] in room with [b]first Cube[/b].[/list][list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Third laser in [b]first Cube[/b] room [b]couldn't harm you[/b] if moving towards the "vent access bloc"[/list][list][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] Various [b]visual bugs[/b] reported in [b]0.54[/b][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] New area [b]had a bug[/b] provoking a [b]missing button[/b] for [b]Platform 1[/b][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Some [b]disappearing objects[/b] when exploring the [b]new Cube area[/b] on some angles[/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] [b]Power Cores[/b] could be "sticking out" of [b]Processing Center[/b] and the room [b]just before[/b][/list][list][*][b]Chapter 4:[/b] Visual bugs with [b]blinking walls[/b] on solar station roof[/list][list][*][b]Lights:[/b] Lens flares ("stars") from lights are [b]no longer "outside the light"[/b], but at the [b]edge limit[/b]. They are [b]intentionally not fully "inside"[/b].[/list][list][*][b]Bug Report Error:[/b] If you are having a [b]"invalid uri" game error when trying to upload a bug[/b], it may simply be that your [b]Firewall is blocking the game[/b] from uploading files externally. Please check your firewall settings to allow the game, or disable it while reporting bugs ;) Otherwise, it can also be that [b]another user is uploading at the same time[/b], the server has [b]limits of concurrent users[/b] - simply try [b]reporting your bug again[/b] a few seconds later.[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.54 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/d363d2a67516745cb73b0f80be79ce7ad40b017e.jpg[/img]

After [b]a lot of work[/b], the [b]major Update 0.54[/b] of [i][b]Fractal Space[/b][/i] is now [b]live and ready to be tested![/b]

As [b]Steam announcements[/b] do [b]not properly support Spoilers for images[/b], we have decided to keep the changelog on our [b][url=https://haze-games.com/update-0-54]on our official website[/url][/b] for a few days - until most of you [b]have had enough time to play the update.[/b]

Please [b]click the link above[/b] to read more about the [b]content of the new update without getting spoilers [/b]- we recommend [b]reading the spoiler parts once you have tested the new update :)[/b]

notes.title: Development Update #19
notes.content:
We have [b]updated the game today to version 0.53 on [i]Steam[/i]! [/b]This update [b]brings hundreds of bugfixes[/b] reported by players since [b]0.52 [/b]last week!

[b]Restart [i]Steam [/i][/b]to ensure the[b] download is detected[/b], then [b]check top-right of the main menu[/b] that you are [b]on the latest version.[/b]

We [b]only [/b]going to detail here[b] a few of the important[/b] [b]bugfixes [/b]and [b]changes [/b]from this update.

More [i]Steam [/i]keys are going to [b]be sent now[/b] for a few new players.
[quote=Haze Games][b]Please remember: silent dialogues are normal as they are changing - not bugs [/b]
If you are in [b]Chapter 3[/b]: [b]Restart CHAPTER [/b]required![/quote]
[h1][b]KNOWN |[/b] ISSUES[/h1]
Here are listed the [b]known bugs[/b]. You[b] can avoid them[/b], but please [b]don't report these bugs again[/b], unless you have[b] found new information or a 100% reproducible situation[/b] to help solve them:
[list][*][b]Aim Stabilizer:[/b] Auto-aim when[b] high angle vertically[/b] [i](object right on top or right above you) [/i]will result in[b] fast camera rotation instead of auto-aiming.[/b] Will be solved in a next update[/*][*][b]Camera Rotation: [/b]Maybe a consequence of another bug, that can cause[b] "camera jumps"[/b] when looking around you. Please report if you[b] find any way to reproduce the occurrence of this bug[/b]. Possibly only with a [b]gamepad[/b].[/*][*][b]Chapter transition[/b] might result in[b] playing 2 soundtracks. [/b]Restarting the chapter should fix it, or exit the game and resume. Will be fixed in future update. [/*][/list]

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]

Below are listed the [b]changes [/b]- not bug fixes of this update. Bugfixes are listed [b]further down.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/8d818e96edd8dc9446d4302d18ffce734e9c4769.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]UPGRADE |[/b] SAFE LANDING[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/4c48fb13d5b9ffe06246efa16cae12a961d49b95.jpg[/img]

The [b]behavior [/b]has [b]changed [/b]for this [b]upgrade:[/b]
[list][*]Now only displayed when [b][i]GROUND [/i][/b]is detected, [b]AFTER [/b]flying [b]at least once [/b]over [b]an UNSAFE area[/b] [i](this avoids it being displayed most of the time, when unnecssary, like small jumps).[/i][/*][*]Now shows[b][i] LIMIT[/i][/b] for r[b]elocation detection[/b], [b]2 to 10m[/b] before [b]reaching the lower limit[/b] [i](only a few meters to avoid always showing where limits are from far away, different per-relocation systems)[/i][/*][*][b]Always displayed[/b] when flying over a [b][i]HAZARD[/i] [/b][i](electrity, large laser fields)[/i][/*][*][b]Doesn't show [/b][i][b]VOID[/b] [/i][b]anymore [/b]to avoid showing it too often, and it's best to inform[b] when it's safe rather than when there is nothing to land on.[/b][/*][*][b]Distance [/b]always shown if [b]distance < 30m[/b] [i](except for limit detection, for which distance display varies)[/i][/*][/list]
There [b]may be new bugs[/b] with this[b] new behavior,[/b] like[b] false-positives on [i]GROUND [/i]detection.[/b] To be tested! Please note [b]it will still show [i]GROUND [/i][/b]when[b] normal lasers / saws[/b] are present. This is [b]intended[/b], as it's [b]up to you[/b] to avoid small traps ;) 

[h2][b]SEQUENCE |[/b] SWITCHES[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/65e260d13d31dd5a1842fb58443aadd4b96ff6a8.jpg[/img]

[b]Sequence switches [/b]were[b] reacting to [/b][i][b]Cubes[/b] [/i]in addition to the player. They have been [b]changed to only react to the [i]Player[/i].[/b] This is the [b]intended behavior[/b].

[h2][b]OTHER |[/b] CHANGES[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/668d33ad1f0e06ad8143a0d603e61fdadaa1ee18.jpg[/img]

[b]Chapter 2:[/b] Changed the [b]large button platform[/b] to [b]require player presence to start[/b]. No longer possible to [i]"stay behind"[/i] [i](safer relocation system)[/i].

[h1][b]BUG |[/b] FIXES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/e049d1f58dbe7853e8ac247bcf6bfa29dce3d2c2.jpg[/img]

[b]Chapter 3:[/b] You could [b]place cubes through the small breakable windows[/b], at the glass-window station area in zero-gravity. [b]This was not intended, and not possible before:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/2abd0cb50253450e3f5f946dffb278d51c67e8d2.jpg[/img]

List of [b]some [/b]of the [b]bugs that were solved [/b]in [b]0.53:[/b]
[list][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] First dialog sequence fixed[/*][*][b]Chapter 1:[/b] Picked up recordings were not played correctly[/*][*]Being crushed could sometimes cause [b]character to teleport through crusher[/b][/*][*]A bug allowed you to [b]interact with Terminals from further away[/b] than before, and without facing them[i] (not intended)[/i][/*][*][b]Skipping cutscene[/b]s could create a [b]game error,[/b] leading to [b]cutscene events not being executed properly[/b][/*][*][b]Jumping [/b]in an [b]accelerated lift with Speedrun Mode[/b] enabled could cause you to [b]fall through it[/b][/*][*][b]Chapter 2:[/b] New change in first Shooting Cameras would make them being active too early[/*][*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Large button and moving platform after double-cube door safer if you try to leave the platform or skip (relocations and others should trigger correctly). To be tested![/*][*][b]Chapter 3: [/b]Player pressure plates (sequence switches) were also reacting to cubes. Won't anymore (intended this way).[/*][*][b]Breakable Windows:[/b] Various bugs solved with them. Shouldn't result in[i] "flying parts"[/i] anymore as well.[/*][*][b]Many various bugs[/b] fixed in [b]Chapter 4[/b][/*][*][b]Safe Landing:[/b] Could previously show false-positives for[i] "VOID" [/i][/*][*][b]Color Packs Stats:[/b] CH1 would display "3/4" max, and CH3 too. Fixed, but requires a SAVE RESET if you want this counter to be correct. If you don't reset your save, you'll keep "3/4" as max for CH1, and will reach "5/4" for CH3 if you find them all.[/*][*][b]Bonus Rooms Objectives[/b] won't be activated anymore in[b] End Game mode[/b]. They might still appear as "Completed". Will be solved in the future.[/*][*][b]Many other bugs [/b]and [b]rendering issues [/b]reported in some Chapters were fixed[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/d2e608155b4bf9c062434c4cc2983a87e42fe159.jpg[/img]

[b]Thank you [/b]to [b]all players [/b]who [b]reported bugs from the game[/b], and [b]helped solving [/b]these!

notes.title: Development Update #18
notes.content:
[h1][b]HELLO | [/b]DEAR PLAYERS[/h1]
Hi there, [i]Fractal Space[/i] players! New [b]update 0.52[/b] is [b]finally live![/b] This update includes [b]many changes, improvements and bugfixes![/b]

[h1][b]MAJOR CHANGES |[/b] RESET SAVE[/h1]
This update contains[b] many bugfixes and changes[/b] to make the game more stable, and fix various gameplay bugs & additions, and [b]save system reworks.[/b]

[quote=Haze Games]IMPORTANT: These changes imply that [b]a full RESET SAVE is required for the game to function properly[/b]. We strongly recommend you press the [b][i]!Reset Save![/i][/b] button in the main menu [b]after the update![/b][/quote]

[h1][b]CHAPTER 1 |[/b] DIALOGUES[/h1]
Chapter 1 had many [b]old dialogues coming from the [i]Pocket Edition[/i][/b], and most of the new [b]PC-exclusive dialogues were simply not present.[/b]

We have [b]added the missing dialogues in Chapter 1 for PC;[/b] they are [b]silent [/b]– and this is not a bug.

As we are [b]reworking them all in the game[/b], please[b] ignore the fact that the audio is not yet recorded[/b], and[b] read subtitles[/b] meanwhile.

Please note that[b] new dialogues are not yet localized[/b], and they should not yet be translated as they are liable to still change. Some lines are the same as on mobile – good chance these will change as well in the future. They will only be added to the Localization Sheet [b]when they are considered to be final.[/b]

In addition to Chapter 1 dialogues, there are also [b]many new dialogue events.[/b] Here are a few examples:
[list]
[*] Dialogues for[b] first Upgrade Terminal discovery[/b]
[*] Dialogues after[b] taking an upgrade[/b]
[*] Dialogues for [b]approaching already used Upgrade Terminals[/b] in [i][b]New Game+[/b][/i]
[*] Dialogues which only exist in [i]New Game+[/i], or changed for [i]New Game+[/i]
[*] Dialogues for [b]trying to get out of the level[/b] [i](relocation system)[/i]
[/list]

[h1][b]SPEEDRUN |[/b] DIALOGUES[/h1]
[i]Speedrun Mode[/i] now [b]disables many dialogues in Chapter 1[/b] [i](around 60% are disabled)[/i] to [b]prevent having too much talking during Speedrun sessions[/b]. If you want to test the new dialogues[i] (silent, only subtitles for now)[/i], please [b]play without Speedrun Mode first[/b]. This will be [b]applied to all Chapters[/b] in the future.

[h1][b]LEVEL | [/b]CHANGES[/h1]
Many [b]changes[/b] were made to[b] various areas in most leve[/b]ls – sometimes these are small changes and fixes, and a few larger ones:
[list]
[*][b] Chapter 1: [/b]Cutscene that shows the door closing in front of you in 1..2.. SLICE room has been removed, to allow skip using HyperSpeed without the need to disable cutscenes.
[*] [b]Presure Plates:[/b] Reworked in Chapter 1 before Taser Room in order to solve many bugs with their logic. They now enter lockdown for the second time you enter that room, after picking up Taser, preventing many possible bugs, and making them inactive (intentional).
[*][b] Chapter 2: [/b]A room now has higher ceilings to avoid the feel of being “too constrained”.
[*] [b]Chapter 3: [/b]First breakable wall with Upgrade Terminal has changed into Bonus Room 6; now also contains a recording and has been rebuilt differently.
[*] [b]Chapter 3: [/b]The corridor with the breakable wall above now has higher ceiling
[*] [b]Chapter 3:[/b] The area in which you must destroy the Generator to disable the laser field, before the Sequence Room, has changed a bit
[*] [b]Chapter 3: [/b]The Bonus Room 7 next to the Sequence Room area has been built and should be functional
[/list]

[h1][b]END GAME |[/b] NEW GAME+[/h1]
The [i]End Game[/i] was one of the main game systems that was not yet functional – and[b] it is now! [/b]There might be bugs with this, but the [b]main logic is implemented.[/b]

The [i]End Game[/i] system is activated when the [b]player has found all [i]Upgrade Terminals[/i][/b] in the game, and none are available to use:
[list]
[*] Makes [b]all terminals available[/b] for a [b]second upgrade[/b]
[*] These terminals will now provide you with [b]missing upgrades[/b]
[*] When the player[b] acquires all upgrades in the game[/b], all terminals become [b]unavailable[/b]
[/list]
Selecting [i][b]New Game[/b][/i] also [b]resets all picked up Recordings and Color Packs[/b] [i](intended)[/i]. Only [i][b]New Game+[/b][/i] keeps upgrades and collectables. Selecting[b] [i]New Game+[/i] should never reset anything.[/b]
 
[h1]NEW UPGRADE[/h1]
A [b]new Upgrade[/b] has been[b] added to the game![/b]

[h2]SCANNER[/h2]
This upgrade [b]helps finding Recordings, Upgrades Terminals and Color Packs[/b]. It has [b]2 levels of upgrade:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Level 1: [/b]Be notified when an [b]Upgrade Terminal [/b]is nearby
[*][b] Level 2:[/b] Be notified when [b]Recordings or Color Packs[/b] are nearby
[/list]

[h1][b]NEW |[/b] CHAPTERS PAGE[/h1]
The[b] [i]Chapters [/i]page[/b] has been [b]reworked to be more suitable to PC[/b] and gamepads. Each Chapter now has a[b] specific image and loading image.[/b]

It now also [b]displays new stats for each Chapter:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/0f0c26bbe149ecd138d75d3752ca934c847fabde.png[/img]

[h1][b]NEW | [/b]STATISTICS[/h1]
This update[b] introduces new statistics available in the Pause Menu[/b]. Later on, we’ll rework the interface display to be easier to read, but for now it’s important to [b]check it regularly to see if it displays accurate information[/b] at all times:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/773f142c71591e4bf2f18ecc2b807db14591743b.png[/img]

Both stats of your current Upgrades (left) and the current Chapter are displayed (right)

[quote=Haze Games][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] It’s intended that[b] Chapter Stats (right side)[/b] are [b]NOT DISPLAYED on the first run[/b] of the game. [b]Upgrade stats[/b] are displayed [b]after acquiring your first Upgrade[/b].[/quote]

[h1][b]UPGRADES |[/b] CHANGES[/h1]
Changes and fixes were made to various upgrades in the game, detailed below.

[h2][b]HOVER |[/b] FIXES[/h2]
[b]Level 3 [/b]Upgrade of [i]Hover [/i]had a bug, and [b]felt like walking freely in the air[/b] because of perfect air control. Changed to [b]feel like hovering[/b], while still having [b]more air control than previous levels.[/b]

[h2][b]JETPACK |[/b] HYPER-SPEED[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/70b1e17e57c37255b6799b9ac9f8a9a99e4d990d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Jetpack light[/b] and gauge color now [b]yellow[/b] to make it easier to distinguish between health / hover / hyper-speed and another element to be revealed in [i]Chapter 5[/i]
[*] Health Backpack and Hyper-Speed [b]display improvements,[/b] now above health gauge
[*] Health gauge now [b]becomes blue while Hyper-Speed is active[/b], and becomes red when not enough health to activate Hyper-Speed. The gauge and buttons now [b]look like it has been “Toggled On”:[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/96af22731045b6dd116b03e7bfc8daad823a9c7d.png[/img]


[h2][b]AIM | [/b]STABILIZER[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/957c3c1756edb16c06e2b9ed1e72013968811d93.png[/img]

Many improvements were made to the [i]Aim Stabilizer[/i] upgrade mechanic:
[list]
[*] Now shows [b][i]“Stabilizing…”[/i][/b] gauge when auto-aim is[b] starting and waiting for you to stop moving the camera[/b]. Any camera movement will [b]cancel stabilization[/b]. it will [b]resume if you stop moving the camera again[/b]. This will allow you to still play normally with [i]Aim Stabilizer[/i], and only use it by not moving the camera and [b]prefer to wait for [i]Aim Stabilizer[/i] to perform.[/b]
[*] Longer delay before auto-aim kicks in.
[*] Will [b]no longer instantly auto-lock while in air / hovering / using Jetpack,[/b] in order to [b]avoid unintentional instant auto-lock[/b]. Instant auto lock now [b]only works if you aim close to the target[/b] while [b]on the ground.[/b]
[*] Instant auto-lock when starting to aim close to a target to now [b]exclusive to [i]Aim Stabilizer Level 2[/i].[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]CROUCH | [/b]SPRINT[/h1]
Many bugfixes and improvements were made to [b]Sprint and Crouch mechanics [/b]for this update:
[list]
[*] Requesting to [b]Crouch shortly after touching the ground[/b] wouldn’t be taken into account properly. It will [b]now work and crouch as expected.[/b]
[*] Holding the [b][i]Sprint [/i]key would not always work[/b] if the character could [b]not sprint at that moment [/b][i](cannot stand up or other scenarios)[/i]. Any Sprint request [b]should now always be performed as soon as possible.[/b]
[*] [b]Crouch:[/b] [i]TOGGLE [/i]mode is now the [b]default [/b]mode.
[*] [b]Crouch:[/b] Various bugs fixed cause by [b]alternating between crouch and sprint[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]CHAPTER 5 | [/b]PROGRESS[/h1]
If you have played [b]Chapter 4 [/b]on PC, the word[i] “Progress” [/i]might ring a bell 😉

[b]Chapter 5[/b] is [b]a lot of work[/b], just like [i]Chapter 4 [/i]on PC was. We’re gradually getting there, though. We’re getting more rooms functional. There’s a few [b]new features that were added for this Chapter[/b], and creating rooms, puzzles and traps that use them [b]takes time[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/411bdb1f2dd369a4ffc5ee097a613f6671cd0ad4.jpg[/img]

We’re hoping to have a [b]first playable of [i]Chapter 5[/i][/b] in [b][i]Experimental Builds[/i][/b] in [b]April[/b]. [b]Thank you[/b] for your patience!

[h1][b]FUTURE | [/b]PC TASER[/h1]
We have [b]started to rework the[i] Taser-Gun[/i] exclusive for the PC version[/b]. It will have the following [b]major improvements over the current [i](mobile)[/i] version:[/b]
[list]
[*] The [b]Taser model [/b]have [b]better visuals[/b]
[*] All Taser–related[b] Upgrades will have a visual impact[/b] on the Taser in-game: [i]Batteries will be added, scope attachment, etc.[/i]
[*] [b]Ammo[/b] will be [b]displayed more clearly as a number[/b] instead of gauge
[*] [i][b]Taser Customization[/b][/i] will [b]affect more parts of the Taser[/b]
[*] [b]Reloading system:[/b] Batteries will be [b]ejected and replaced[/b] with a [b]reloading animation[/b]
[*] New [b]animations[/b]
[*] Taser [i]Power Level 2[/i] and 3 will be replaced by a [b][i]“Charged Shot Level 1 and 2″ [/i][/b]mechanic. A [b][i]Charged Shot[/i][/b] will [b]consume more ammo[/b], but will [b]break walls (Level 1) and destroy cameras (Level 2)[/b] . This will allow you to [b]still choose to only stun a camera[/b], even [b]after reaching max Taser Power level[/b], by not charging the shot thus saving ammo. This change will also make [b][i]Taser Capacity [/i][/b]and [i][b]Taser Backpack[/b][/i] upgrades [b]more meaningful.[/b]
[/list]
The new [b]Taser system[/b] requires [b]a lot of work as well[/b], in parallel of Chapter 5. The first playable version is[b] planned to be tested at the same time as Chapter 5 PC[/b]. If it’s ready before CH5, it will be set live before 😉

[h1][b]BUG FIXES | [/b]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
Here’s a [b]list of the many other various bugfixes[/b] of this update – [b]many more have been fixed[/b], only listing the [b]major ones here:[/b]
[list]
[*] Crashes & Optimization: GPU memory load has been improved for all Chapters. Crashes on old graphics card should occur less often when loading next chapters. Chapter 4 might still have issues, thoughm as there is still work to do for this one. Let us know how it goes!
[*] Subtitles: Could sometimes display slowly or with wrong timings with Hyper-Speed active – should now work fine in all cases
[*] Jump: Low framerate would make it impossible to jump quite often, usually after interaction. Should now be at least reduced, or fixed – let me know if it still happens
[*] Fast Moving Platforms / Smashers / Lifts: Reworked to ensure smooth movement while standing on them, and avoid going through them at low framerate. Please don’t jump while in accelerated lifts for now, still not perfect 😉
[*] Water: Would only be rendered if Depth of Field was Enabled, or Reflections was set to Dynamic. Should now always be displayed, as intended.
[*] Triggers / Events: A bug could provoke some triggers / events to be activated twice, when they should only work once. This could create many level bugs, like unexpected relocations.
[*] Save System: After loading a save, some triggers or objects could be enabled when they shouldn’t be – would create unexpected random level bugs
[*] Aim Stabilizer: Could continue trying to aim after stopped aiming Taser.
[*] Jetpack: Starting using jetpack when a vertical moving platform just started to move upwards would provide massive boost to jetpack.
[*] Jetpack: QuickSave / Quickload will keep Jetpack Fuel at time of save (avoid exploits). For Auto-Saves / Last Checkpoint, fuel will now be fully recharged
[*] Exit Crash: Fixed crash that could occur upon game exit
[*] Shadows / Reflections: Many reflections / shadows fixes that were reported
[/list]

[b]Thank you[/b] for reading, and see you next time!
[i]Charles from [b]Haze Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Development Update #17
notes.content:
[h1]Dynamic Reflections[/h1]
The latest updates of the [b]PC version[/b] now support a [b]new [i]Dynamic [/i]level of [i]Reflections[/i][/b][i] [/i]in the [i]Graphics [/i]options:
[previewyoutube=JyqThxyS1YA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Static[/b] reflections are precomputed and [b]greatly optimized[/b], so it [b]should be fine keep [i]Reflections[/i] to [i]Medium[/i] or [i]Low[/i][/b] even [b]with an integrated graphics card[/b]. The [b]main drawback [/b]is that [b]as the environment changes[/b] [i](a door opens, a screen changes color, etc.)[/i], these new changes [b]are not seen in the reflections[/b]. It is a [b]performance [i]VS [/i]realism compromise[/b].

The new [b][i]Dynamic[/i][/b] reflections level uses [b][i]Screen Space Reflections[/i][/b] and [b]solves the issue [/b]stated above. However, it is [b]resource demanding[/b], and should be used [b]only if you already have a good framerate[/b]. It usually [b]lowers the FPS significantly on integrated graphics cards[/b].

If you are on [b]integrated graphics instead and not a dedicated GPU[/b], you should [b]keep [i]Reflections[/i] to [i]Medium[/i] or [i]Low[/i] level[/b]. 

[h1]New Electrified Water[/h1]
[previewyoutube=IiKRe5DlKoo;full][/previewyoutube]
The [b]Electrified Grounds[/b] were [b]only made of an electricity visual effect[/b]. We have[b] improved them[/b]:
[list][*][b]Optimized [/b]the [b]electricty effect [/b]to have a [b]lower impact on framerate[/b] - will be [b]even more optimized later[/b] on[/*][*][b]Water [/b]has been [b]added below them[/b], with the [b]associated sound effects[/b][/*][/list]

[h1]New Vent Doors[/h1]
[previewyoutube=WAH0rzaQJSI;full][/previewyoutube]
Vent doors were [b]using a small regular door visual[/b]. This was [b]temporary[/b]. They now [b]all have been replaced with the new visual![/b] They have been improved to:
[list][*][b]Look better [/b]from [b]both sides[/b][/*][*][b]New animation [/b]that [b]avoids sticking out [/b]through walls and windows[/*][/list]

[h1]Aiming Depth of Field[/h1]
[previewyoutube=NWl-iX7W6sQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The [b][i]Depth of Field[/i][/b] effect can [b]simulate the blur[/b] that can be observed by a [b]real-world camera[/b], when it is [b]focusing on close or distant objects[/b]. If this effect is enabled, it will be [b]used in the following cases:[/b]
[list][*][b]Aiming Taser:[/b] The [b]aimed at point[/b] becomes the [b]focus[/b]. When aiming at [b]close objects[/b], [b]distant objects are blurred[/b], and[b] vice-versa[/b][/*][*][b]Taking Damage:[/b] The [b]screen becomes blurry[/b] for a [b]few seconds[/b][/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/de438431de3398535001043d7cb8c70e759fa83d.jpg[/img]

This effect is [b]demanding;[/b] if you have an [b]integrated graphics card[/b] and a [b]low framerate[/b], it's [b]best to keep it disabled[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/377ca3c0300b3f631d191688eb783ab585b50b31.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/e6c94b341e9c52af04da56be1dc3e3830c816e35.jpg[/img]

[h1]Reworked Taser Aiming[/h1]
The [b]aiming laser [/b]for the [b][i]Taser [/i]-Gun [/b]has been [b]reworked significantly [/b]to fix the following issues:
[list][*]The laser was [b]not always pointing at the exact position [/b]the shot would be performed[/*][*]The laser [b]point [/b]was sometimes [b]positioned wrongly[/b] to the [b]left or right [/b]of the [b]laser line's end[/b][/*][*]With a [b]high [i]Field of View [/i]setting[/b], the laser would [b]not be aligned with shooting final point [/b][i](with default FOV, it was working correctly most of the time)[/i][/*][*]The laser line [b]could be seen through some solid objects [/b]in some cases, making it [b]hard to perform precise shots[/b][i][b] [/b](ex: through pipes)[/i][/*][*][b]Aim Assist [/b]on [b]mobile [/b]and [b][i]PC [/i][/b]would use the [b]center point of the screen[/b], resulting in sometimes [b]locking slightly next to the target[/b] [i](because the laser end point cannot always be at a perfect center of the screen depending on the distance and angle with aimed object)[/i]. It is [b]now using the laser's end point[/b] [b]instead[/b]. This was [b]much more complex[/b] [b]to accomplish than it seems![/b] Pfew![/*][/list]
You can see [b]the issue described above[/b], in the [b]following image[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/5a8334617f4f887c59f1f29b19a6175a64d5ad5f.png[/img]

With the newly [b]reworked [i]Taser [/i]aiming system[/b]:
[list][*]Aiming [b]laser always points exactly [/b]where the [b]shot will be performed[/b], [b]regardless [/b]of the conditions or [b]current FOV value[/b][/*][*]Laser [b]point [/b]now has [b]dynamic lighting[/b]: makes the [b][i]Laser [/i][/b]color from [i]Taser Customization[/i] more visible, and allows [b]easier aim in dark areas without having to turn on the flashlight[/b][/*][*][b]Aim assist [/b]will [b]always perfectly lock[/b] at the desired target, [b]regardless of distance and angle[/b] with the target[/*][/list]

Here's an image of the [b]updated version of aiming[/b], with these [b]issues fixed:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/3d762ddd105bb7c28317eb70f61f7e227f6ad04e.png[/img]

[h1]Softlocks and Hyper-Speed[/h1]
In the game, for quite a while, it was possible to [b]get on the wrong side of some doors as they were closing[/b]; this would result in being [b][i]softlocked[/i][/b], requiring to [b]reload from last checkpoint[/b].

[h1]New Door Type: Hyper-Door[/h1]
[previewyoutube=GZyj2YzLk4w;full][/previewyoutube]
Since we have introduced [i][b]Hyper-Speed[/b][/i][b] in Chapter 3[/b], there were [b]3 major design problems to solve:[/b]
[list][*]The player [b]should not be able to skip all doors[/b] of the game by slowing down time using Hyper-Speed: only [b]some that are intended[/b][/*][*]The player [b]should not be able to use [i]Hyper-Speed [/i]to go backwards while a door is closing[/b]. By doing so, he can [b]get stuck behind a locked door[/b], resulting in a [b][i]softlock[/i][/b] :([/*][*]If a door [b]can be slowed down with Hyper-Speed[/b], it needs to be [b]clear to the player[/b], using a [b]different visual for doors[/b] that are [i][b]Hyper-Speed[/b][/i][b] proof[/b]. This way, the player [b]can plan his action accordingly[/b], and [b]doesn't have to[/b] [b]try skipping every single door[/b] with [i]Hyper-Speed[/i] only to see [b]if it will be slowed down by the ability or not[/b][/*][/list]

In order to solve the issues above, we have [b]introduced a new door type:[/b] the [b][i]Hyper-Door[/i][/b]:
[list][*]It always [b]closes or opens at a constant speed[/b], even if [i][b]Hyper-Speed[/b][/i] is [b]activated[/b].[/*][/list]
With this [b]new door type [/b]and [b]other changes to the door closing system[/b], it is [b]now impossible to go backwards behind a closing door [/b]and remaining stuck. This means [b]many softlocks were solved.[/b]

If you find any [b]softlocks [/b]while playing, [b]let us know![/b]

[h1]New Upgrades[/h1]
We have [b]added 3 new upgrades [/b]to the game; the [b]upgrades distribution has also been changed [/b]to reflect the new upgrades and a few [b]new improvements [/b]were made:
[list][*][b]All playable Chapters [/b]have the [b]correct amount of Upgrade Terminals [/b]per level, using temporary [i]Work in Progress [b]Bonus Rooms[/b][/i][/*][*]All [b]work in progress Bonus Rooms[/b] have the [b]intended Upgrade Terminal [/b]even if the rooms are not built yet. [/*][*]Associated [b]Bonus Room screen will now reflect the state [i]Incomplete [/i]or [i]Completed[/i][/b][i] [/i]if the upgrade in that room has [b]already been consumed[/b][/*][*][b]All Upgrade Terminals[/b] already consumed will [b]now display the selected upgrade[/b] on this [i]Terminal[/i]. [/*][/list]
[h1]Upgrade 1: Scope[/h1]
Allows to [b]zoom while aiming[/b] with the [i]Taser[/i]. Simply use the [b][i]scrollwheel [/i][/b]or [b][i]Directional Pad Up/Down [/i][/b]while [b]aiming [/b]to start using the [i]Scope[/i]. The [b][i]Aim Stabilizer [/i][/b]is [b]disabled while using [i]Scope [/i][/b]to allow precision shots.

It has [b]2 levels[/b] of upgrade: 
[list][*][b]Level 1: Moderate [/b]maximum zoom [/*][*][b]Level 2: High [/b]maximum zoom [/*][/list]
[h1]Upgrade 2: Aim Stabilizer[/h1]
[i]Taser [/i][b]aim assistance module[/b], which [b]automatically locks aiming[/b] to the closest aimed at target. It has 2 levels: 
[list][*][b]Level 1:[/b] Only works [b]while standing still[/b]. Any [b]horizontal character movement requested by the player[/b] will prevent the [i]Aim Stabilizer [/i]from locking to targets[/*][*][b]Level 2:[/b] Works in [b]all conditions[/b] and [b]faster [/b]lock on targets[/*][/list]As this upgrade [b]makes the game much easier[/b], it is [b]only available from Chapter 2[/b]. 

This system is[b] hard to make comfortable in all situations[/b]. At the end of this post, we have some [b]additional details[/b] on [b]how it works [/b];)

You can [b]see these 2 upgrades [/b]in action in the [b]following video:[/b]
[previewyoutube=-jO7PNcPzM0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Upgrade 3: Safe Landing[/h1]
This upgrade [b]informs the player if it's safe to land below him[/b]. It has [b]2 Levels of upgrade: [/b]
[list][*][b]Level 1:[/b] Displays a [b]notification [/b]when a [b]hazard is detected below the player [/b][/*][*][b]Level 2:[/b] In addition, shows a [b]view camera[/b] of what is [b]directly below the player in realtime[/b]. This feature has [b]not yet been implemented.[/b][/*][/list]
You can see this [b][i]Hazard [/i]notification [/b]at the [b]bottom of the screen:[/b]
[previewyoutube=6j4dB1LIBCQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Elevators[/h1]
We have [b]reworked and improved elevators in all Chapters[/b] of the game:
[list][*]Ensure [b]they open faster[/b] and [b]earlier [/b]in case you are [b]speedrunning[/b][/*][*]Ensure they [b]move much faster [/b]in [b][i]Speedrun Mode[/i][/b][/*][*][b]Avoid [/b]elevator [b]doors to "stick out"[/b] that could block you[/*][*][b]Avoid [/b]activating an elevator switch [b]if you are not inside:[/b] prevents having the [b]lift leave without you[/b][/*][/list]
[h1]Chapter 1: New Elevator Skip[/h1]
[previewyoutube=z03hqM4Egt4;full][/previewyoutube]
We have [b]added a new Skip path in [i]Chapter 1![/i][/b] It is located in [b]the very first lift[/b], and is only accessible [b]after activating the elevator[/b], using [b][i]Dodge [/i][/b]in [b][i]New Game+[/i][/b].

The [b]first time you try it[/b], you might [b]not be faster than the lift[/b] - however with a bit of training,[b] high [/b][i][b]Speed [/b][/i][b]upgrade level[/b] and [i][b]Sprint[/b][/i] ability, you will be able to [b]get up much faster than the lift[/b] ;)

In addition, this new skip path [b]contains a[i] Bonus Room[/i][/b] [i](currently empty)[/i], in which[b] you can acquire an additional upgrade[/b].

[h1]Chapter 4: New Bonus Room[/h1]
A [b]new Bonus Room[/b] has been [b]added to [i]Chapter 4[/i][/b], just before the [b][i]Enhanced Camera[/i][/b]. It allows you to [b]acquire an additional upgrade[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/2bbec83a30089a5022a8fc261cba1808201a5440.jpg[/img]

This is [b]one of the rare [i]Bonus Rooms[/i][/b] that will be [b]accessible on the first run [/b]and not only in [i]New Game+[/i], as it [b]doesn't require a specific ability[/b], and is [b]only protected by a [i]Breakable Window[/i].[/b]

[h1]Chapter 5[/h1]
We have been [b]working a lot on the PC version of Chapter 5 [/b]in parallel. Progress is [b]slow, but steady[/b]. It's a [b]complex [/b][i][b]Chapter[/b][/i], introducing [b]quite a few new elements[/b], similarly to [i]Chapter 4 [/i]on PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/da9cd643ea5300b80207cc0ee3fb3d92f7eb9fbf.png[/img]

We [b]can't give you too many details[/b] as we [b]don't want to spoil your first experience[/b] with this new [i]Chapter [/i]when it's available to play. Here's what we can say:
[list][*]It will be [b]quite surprising[/b][/*][*]It will have [b]a few new elements[/b] that you [b]haven't seen in the previous [/b][i][b]Chapters[/b][/i][/*][*]It will start with[b] new PC exclusive content[/b], and end with a[i] "similar logic" [/i]than [i][b]Chapter 4[/b][/i] on mobile, but [b]reworked and improved[/b][/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/455874c0e65aeac3788b32af2b73663f8da84ba9.png[/img]

[h1]Level Editor[/h1]
In parallel, we have [b]also worked on the Level Editor[/b], but we are still [b]currently focusing on Chapter 5 and mobile updates[/b], so it's still [b]not ready to be tested[/b]. Here's a bit of news on the status.

We have started to [b]create a basic user interface [/b][i](currently, all icons are the same)[/i][b] to add objects[/b], and edit [b]selected objects[/b], in addition to a [b]customizatble [/b][i][b]Quick Access[/b][/i][b] hotbar:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11869706/79d85b5c575c2c6240edfca5bd561be208fbf1e7.png[/img]

[h1]Functional[/h1]
[list][*][b]Placing/deleting [/b]objects[/*][*]Changing [b]"floor"[/b]: construct on ground floor, or at [b]higher / lower [/b]levels to build [b]vertically[/b][/*][*]Placing [b]walls, grounds, windows[/b][/*][*]Placing [b]doors, buttons, cubes, pressure plates[/b][/*][*]Placing [b]Lasers, Mines[/b][/*][*][b]Customizable damage[/b] for [b]lasers [/b]and [b]mines[/b], and [b]option to make blinking lasers[/b][/*][*][b]Saving/loading [/b]a work in progress level[/*][*][b]Hooking events [/b]to ensure buttons/pressure plates can [b]interact with the environment[/b][/*][*][b]Testing [/b]a level instantly: not perfect yet, a few bugs, but mostly functional[/*][/list]
[h1]Not Functional - Required[/h1]
Here's a list of what [b]we need to work on [/b]before a [b]first version can actually be tested [/b]or [b]shown:[/b]
[list][*][b]Checkpoints [/b]must also save while "really playing" a level[/*][*]Placing [b]checkpoints[/b], [b]saws[/b], [b]invisible triggers[/b][/*][*]Placing [b]invisible killzones[/b][/*][*]Placing collectibles: [b]Taser Ammo[/b] packs, [b]Healthpacks[/b][/*][*]Placing [b]Jetpack[/b], [b]Taser [/b]collectibles[/*][*]Customizing player spawn point, player stats [i](health etc) [/i]and if player starts with [b]Taser / Jetpack [/b]and which [b]upgrades[/b][/*][*]Improving the [b]user interface[/b] [i](many functions are only on hotkeys currently)[/i][/*][*]Interface to [b]load different levels[/b] [i](only 1 level supported right now)[/i][/*][/list]
When we will have [b]the features above ready[/b], we will either [b]upload a video or livestream a demo [/b]of these basic functions before it can be tested by players ;)

[h1]Bugs & Crashes[/h1]
We have [b]fixed hundreds of bugs [/b]in the last few updates; one major victory was made on [b]mysterious crashes some users were experiencing[/b] every time the game was [b]trying to reload the latest checkpoint[/b].

[h1]Fixed Crashes[/h1]
The [b]crashes [/b]upon [b]last checkpoint reload [/b]were linked to some [b][i]Graphics Cards[/i][/b] [b]not supporting some specific instructions.[/b]

After [b]a lot of work and testing of special development builds[/b] from these users[i] (thanks again for helping out!)[/i], they are [b]finally fixed [/b]and these users can [b]enjoy the game again without crashes![/b]

[h1]Important Bugfixes[/h1]
[list][*][b]Jump: [/b]If the character was [b]standing on an edge[/b][i] (half on the ground, half in the air)[/i], he would sometimes [b]refuse to jump[/b][/*][*][b]Reflections: [/b]There was a bug that could cause [i]LOW [/i]or [i]MEDIUM [/i]level of [b]static reflections to not be displayed[/b][/*][*][b]Cameras:[/b] [b]Destroying [/b]a camera while the room was in [b]lockdown [/b]could result in a [b]softlock[/b]. Other bugs were fixed with [i]Cameras[/i].[/*][*][b]Interface: [/b]Many interface elements [b]adjusted to reduce pixelization[/b], including [i][b]Dodge [/b][/i][b]Cooldown[/b] widget, [b]center crosshair[/b] and objective [b]markers [/b][/*][*][b][url=https://bit.ly/2DRceY4]Performance Guide[/url]:[/b] Has been updated to [b]explain and describe[/b] the new [b][i]Dynamic Reflections[/i][/b] and [b][i]Depth of Field[/i][/b] effect.[/*][*][b]Steam Leaderboards:[/b] Were [b]not updating properly[/b] in [i]Chapters [/i]page[/*][/list]
[h1]Aim Stabilizer Details[/h1]
Here are[b] a few additional details[/b] about the [b][i]Aim Stabilizer[/i] system:[/b]
[list][*][b]Disabled [/b]while using[b] [i]Scope[/i][/b][/*][*]Works with [b]both mouse[/b] and [b]gamepad [/b]aiming[/*][*][b]Does not snap[/b] to breakable [b]windows [/b]or breakable [b]walls[/b], as they are large targets - [b]all other targets [/b]can be locked[/*][/list]
[list][*]If you start aiming with a target [b]next to the center of the screen[/b], it will [b]immediatly lock it[/b][/*][*]If you [b]move your aim next[/b] to a target while [b]already aiming[/b] the [i]Taser[/i], it will [b]start locking after a short delay[/b] [i](this delay is to [b]avoid snapping to the wrong object[/b] while moving the camera to find your desired target[/i])[/*][/list][list][*]While [b]locked to an object[/b], [b]shooting [/b]or [b]moving[/b] the camera [i](a certain camera movement threshold is required)[/i] will [b]cancel the lock[/b]. If a lock is [b]cancelled [/b]in this case, it [b]will not try to lock again[/b] until you [b]aim somwhere else[/b] and then [b]aim again at this object[/b] or [b]release aim button[/b] [i](this is to [b]avoid repeatedly lock [/b]an object you have just explicitly stopped aiming at) [/i][/*][/list][list][*]While [b]aiming is locked to an object[/b], any [b]visibility obstruction will cancel the lock[/b]. [i]Example: wall or moving platform coming in between[/i][/*][*]However, in this case, it [b]will auto-lock again[/b] to this target [b]immediatly when it is visible again[/b][/*][/list]
That's it! [b]Thank you all for reading[/b] and see you [b]next time[/b]![b] Happy gaming,[/b]
[i]Charles from [b][url=https://haze-games.com]Haze Games[/url][/b][/i]

notes.title: Development Update #16
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/60d1748085048c36df40ca238a9df714fc0ff911.png[/img]

Hi there,[b] dear [/b][i][b]Fractal Space [/b][/i][b]players![/b]

We’ve had [b]quite a lot of new things added to the game[/b] recently, and many long-lasting issues were addressed in the latest updates.

We’ll discuss here the [b]new and changed elements[/b] in [i]Fractal Space[/i].

You can also check [url=https://haze-games.com/pc-development-update-16]this post on our official website here[/url].

[h1]Taser Customization[/h1]
We’re very happy to announce a [b]new feature[/b] that was requested a lot over time by the community on both [i]PC [/i]and the [i]Pocket Edition[/i] of [i]Fractal Space:[/i] The ability to [b]customize your [/b][i][b]Taser[/b][/i]!
https://youtu.be/QsX_JiNxozg
In the video above, you’ll see that you can [b]separately select a color[/b] for:
[list][*][b]Structure:[/b] Color of the Taser’s [b]body structure[/b]; becomes [b]brighter when aiming at an interactive element[/b][/*][*][b]Laser:[/b] Color of the [b]laser[/b] when [b]not aiming[/b] at an interactive element[/*][*][b]Laser Active:[/b] Color of the[b] laser[/b] when[b] aiming at [/b]an interactive element[/*][*][b]Screen: [/b]Color of the Taser’s[b] screen[/b] [b]when aiming[/b] at an interactive element[/*][*][b]Impact:[/b] Changes the color of the[b] shooting impact lightning[/b] effect, [b]particles[/b] and explosion[b] lighting[/b] [i](not visible in the video)[/i][/*][/list]
When you [b]start the game[/b], you have access to a[b] 2 default unlocked color swatches:[/b]
[list][*][b]Cyan:[/b] Default Taser [i]Structure[/i] / [i]Laser[/i] / [i]Screen[/i] color[/*][*][b]Green:[/b] Default [i]Laser Active[/i] color[/*][/list]
There will be [b]approximately 20 color[/b] [b]swatches[/b] in total. In order to [b]unlock new color[/b] [b]swatches[/b], you’ll have to find them by[b] exploring all levels[/b] and picking up the [b][i]Color Packs[/i][/b] in the game:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/74815293f687ffb2ce7263903e68598acebadbc5.png[/img]

If you try to[b] activate a locked color[/b], a [b]hint will show you[/b] in [b]which Chapter[/b] it can be found:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/58af3916c8752c985b59eda4139a8894bbf53bde.jpg[/img]

Some [b][i]Color Packs[/i][/b] can be found in the[b] first run[/b]; rare [i][b]Color Packs[/b][/i] can [b]only be accessed in [i]New Game+[/i][/b] using [i]Taser Power Level 2[/i], [i]Dodge[/i] and [i]Hyper-Speed[/i].

[h1]New Objectives System[/h1]
The game was missing a core element: [b]objectives[/b] and [b]objective markers[/b]. We have now added this to the game, and [b]completely reworked the objectives system[/b]. You can see a[b] demonstration[/b] of this [b]new Objectives System[/b]in this video:
https://youtu.be/tcTrL-R96NU
As you can see [b]in the video above:[/b]
[list][*][b]Multiple objectives[/b] can be active [b]simultaneously[/b][/*][*]An [b]objective[/b] can be[b] completed[/b] or[b] cancelled[/b][/*][*][b]Objectives[/b] can have an[b] associated Marker[/b], showing an[b] action[/b] [b]name[/b] and [b]distance[/b][/*][/list]
We are [b]keeping objectives as general[/b] goals like [i]“Open the Door”[/i] or [i]“Find an Exit”[/i], and we [b]rarely provide step-by-step[/b] help in order to [b]avoid making the game too easy[/b].

However, it’s now [b]much harder to forget what you are supposed to do[/b], by simply pressing [b][i]Tab[/i][/b] or [b][i]Dpad Down [/i][/b]to [b]see your current objectives and their markers anytime[/b].

[b][i]Chapters 1, 2 and 3[/i][/b] have new, [b]reworked objectives throughout the level[/b]; we will [b]soon be adding them to[/b][b][i]Chapter 4 [/i][/b]too on the [i][b]Experimental [/b][/i]branch.

[h1]Controls Remapping[/h1]
[b]Controls Remapping[/b] has been improved, [b]bugs have been fixed[/b], which makes it [b]more stable[/b] and [b]all cases should work fine:[/b]
https://youtu.be/AZFgbkXt0_I
[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
Many changes were done to the[b] core gameplay[/b] of the game; some that are [b]hard to notice[/b] if you don’t know about them, but they [b]should prove to make the game more comfortable[/b] especially for newcomers.

[h1]New Area[/h1]
We have added a [b]new hidden area[/b] in [b][i]Chapter 1[/i][/b] in which you can find a[b] Bonus Recording[/b] [i](coming later)[/i] and a [b]Color Pack[/b]:
https://youtu.be/uS2FfoLrePo
And below is a [b][i]Time Lapse[/i] [/b]of [b]how this area was created[/b] if you’re curious :)
https://youtu.be/ohMcypxl06Q
[h1]Multiple Paths[/h1]
The game now supports [b]multiple paths[/b] to [b]reach the very first [i]Taser Ammunition Pack[/i][/b] in [b][i]Chaper 1[/i][/b] on [b][i]New Game+[/i] demonstrated in the video below using the [i]Dodge[/i] ability:[/b]
https://youtu.be/Z45gvUuRpqo
[h1]New Skip[/h1]
We have added a [b]new skip path[/b] in [b][i]Chapter 1[/i][/b] for [b][i]New Game+[/i][/b] only, [b]next to the very first crushers[/b] you encounter in the game:
https://youtu.be/JAT3AJylcnQ
[h1]Improved Area[/h1]
In [b][i]Chapter 1[/i][/b] on [b][i]New Game+[/i][/b], you can [b]walk on the vent next to the very first [i]Power Core[/i][/b]; this area [b]looked visually buggy[/b]; it has been[b] reworked [/b]to look more like an[b] intended secondary path:[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/fdb863a0eed68c66adf5a6d176237de8f27bd370.jpg[/img]

[h1]Interaction[/h1][list][*]All interactions [b]no longer require to aim[/b] precisely to objects[/*][*][b][i]Power Cores[/i][/b] can now be[b] inserted even while[/b] they are currently [b]moving to their [/b][i][b]“insertion preview position”[/b][/i][/*][/list][h1]Jump[/h1]
In some cases, the character[b] wouldn’t respond to jump requests;[/b] now this shouldn’t happen anymore and the player [b]should always jump when requested[/b], even while moving fast – [i]considering there is a valid ground below[/i].

[h1]Slopes[/h1]
There were [b]many issues[/b] when the[b] player was moving fast on slopes[/b]. Now, moving fast[b] up or down a slope[/b] will still ensure[b] the character remains “sticked” to the ground [/b]all the way instead of “slowly [i]flying down”[/i] the slope sometimes [i](that was preventing you from jumping while going fast down slopes)[/i].

[h1]Jetpack[/h1][list][*][b][i]Jetpack [/i][/b]activation requests [b]wouldn’t work every time[/b], especially if you requested to activate the[i][b] Jetpack[/b][/i]just[b] as you were touching the ground[/b]. It should now[b] always turn on when requested[/b], or [b]jump[/b] if there is [b]no more fuel[/b].[/*][/list]

[h1]Mine Beams[/h1]
We have [b]reworked the mine beams visual effect [/b]to be [b]more distinguishable from normal lasers[/b], and to look nicer:
https://youtu.be/gbTSm4CXR5k
[h1]In-Game Bug Reporting[/h1]
We have[b] reworked the in-game bug reporting system[/b]. It is now:
[list][*][b]Faster [/b]to upload[/*][*][b]More[/b] [b]stable[/b]: Sometimes, there could be errors after posting bugs[/*][*]Uploads[b] screenshots, log files[/b] and [b]save games[/b] directly to [b][i]Haze Games[/i][/b][/*][*]Reported [b]bugs in-game [/b]are [b]now linked [/b]to the [b][i]Discord Server[/i][/b][/*][/list]
https://youtu.be/WFpqZqjnv9I
It is now the[b] recommended way to report bugs[/b]: Please press [b][i]ALT+B directly in-game[/i][/b].

A[b] great addition[/b] thanks to these changes and[b][i] The Promidius’ [/i][/b]hard work on the [b][i]Discord Server[/i][/b] code, bugs are now fully linked to the server, and it will [b]automatically post a new bug report[/b] on the[b] #active-bugs channel![/b]

[h1]New Sounds[/h1][list][*][b]Heartbeat:[/b] There are [b]2 new heartbeat looping[/b] sounds: slow[i] (low health)[/i], fast [i](low health while Hyper-Speed is active)[/i][/*][*][b]Jetpack: [/b]New sounds for [b]firing the jetpack[/b], the [b]jetpack loop[/b] and [b]jetpack stop[/b][/*][*]User Interface Sounds: New sounds for user interface confirm, cancel, show taser screen, etc[/*][*][b]Dodge: [/b]New[i] “fast wind” [/i]sound when performing a [i]Dodge[/i][/*][/list][h1]Next Steps[/h1]
From now on, we have the [b]following main next steps [/b]that we are going to be actively working on.

[h1]Finishing Chapter 4[/h1]
[b]Chapter 4 on PC [/b]is currently [b]only available in [i]EXP [/i]builds[/b]. We will now [b]make some final additions:[/b]
[list][*]Implement all remaining [b]temporary silent dialogues[/b][/*][*][b]Integrate all the [i]Objectives [/i][/b]using the [b]new [i]Objectives System [/i][/b]to help [b]guide the player[/b][/*][*]Minor level changes to result in [b]more clear puzzles [/b]/ somes easier challenges based on [b]feedback of experimental testers[/b][/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/4186ced523142204dbc8fdecc9942e6efe4fce89.jpg[/img]

After these [b]3 steps[/b] are completed and testing is done, [b][i]Chapter 4 [/i]will be available in the [i]default [/i][/b]branch!

[h1]Building Chapter 5[/h1]
We have[b] just started the work on Chapter 5 for PC[/b]; It will be a[b] long journey of work[/b], [b]estimated to 2 months.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/c3551729d40c831f6a1fb15f47bb264e7a6e80a6.jpg[/img]

[b]Chapter 5[/b] will be a [b]reworked version of Chapter 4 on mobile[/b], with many [b]new rooms and new PC-Exclusive content[/b]. The existing mobile content will be [b]completely re-designed [/b]to [b]look and play better [/b]with the [b]PC gameplay mechanics[/b].

When it will be ready to be tested, it will [b]first only be playable[/b] on [b][i]EXP builds.[/i][/b]

[h1]Creating the Level Editor[/h1]
We have started working on [b]first tests for a [i]Level Editor [/i]for [i]Fractal Space [/i]a while back[/b]. However, it’s in a very early state, and [b]cannot be tested currently[/b].

We will now be [b]spending some time every week working on the [i]Level Editor[/i][/b] in parallel, and we will now [b]share screenshots and progress [/b]of how the [b][i]Level Editor [/i][/b]is coming up on social media, [b]hopefully once a week![/b]

[h1]Updating the Pocket Edition[/h1]
https://youtu.be/1s2iQAbm29g
With our [b]focus on progress for the PC[/b] version recently, we haven’t updated the mobile version for a while. We’ll now be [b]working on the mobile version in parallel[/b], in order to:
[list][*][b]Fix many bugs[/b] that were reported[/*][*]Add [i][b]Taser Customization [/b][/i]to [b]all mobile versions of the game[/b], with [b]exclusive colors for players who [i]Donate [/i][/b]or [b]purchase the [/b][i][b]HD Edition [/b][/i]on [i][b]Android[/b][/i] and [b][i]iOS[/i][/b].[/*][*]Add [b][i]Speedrun Mode [/i][/b]support on [b]mobile versions[/b][/*][/list]
We’ll [b]keep you updated as progress is made[/b] on the mobile version update; there will first be a [b][i]Beta-Testing [/i]phase on both [/b][i][b]Android [/b][/i][b]and [/b][i][b]iOS[/b][/i][b].[/b]

That's it for this month! Thank you for your support and for reading us!

notes.title: Development Update #15
notes.content:
[h1]Experimental Chapter 4![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/0ea6accd03a2f944b22efd88d11b86aae46cc960.jpg[/img]

We hope you're all doing great since last time! We had [b]quite a lot of updates of the PC version[/b] since the last article - I'll try to summarise them all up here!

It took a [b]great amount of time [/b]to get this [b]new, exclusive Chapter 4[/b] ready for you to [b]play and test[/b] to help [b]improve and find bugs, but it's finally available in an early, experimental version! [/b]This new Chapter features [b]quite a lot of new gameplay mechanics - [/b]we sincerely hope you'll enjoy them!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/fe9e5fa3ae172ef3b1d702188578e4d1e6a8c160.png[/img]

It's currently [b]missing objectives [/b]and [b]voice-over dialog;[/b] even if they are [b]silent[/b], [b]subtitles are displayed [/b]to help you [b]understand what to do [/b]as you play.

There was a [b]very first release[/b] of [i]Chapter 4[/i] a few weeks ago, but it had [b]various bugs[/b] and was [b]missing some rooms[/b], that have since then [b]been added [/b]in the[b] latest update [i]v0.4.2c_EXP[/i][/b]. In addition, the [b]first version wasn't optimized[/b]; the latest [b]should now run better on low-end computers[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/954bb1633de9385ddae3e8c5200bbeb8ea9f0953.png[/img]

Even if the [b]ending of [i]Chapter 4 [/i][/b]is [b]still missing [/b]the latest version, [b]most of Chapter 4's playable content [/b]is now here. [i]Chapter 4 [/i]will then be available on the [b]main [i]Default [/i]branch [/b]for all players [b]only once the final ending of the Chapter [/b]is implemented. This is estimated to be for the [b]end of May 2019[/b].

I would like to [b]thank all the early testers that have already tested the new Chapter through our official [i]Discord Server[/i]![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/685d841c4338bbba2b413cacc04da25b34ca1eed.jpg[/img]

I'm [b]not going to provide more details[/b] of this new Chapter to [b]avoid spoilers[/b] :) If you're interested in [b]trying out the current [i]Experimental [/i]version[/b] of [b]Chapter 4[/b], head to the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=1571094198][i]Official Steam Guide [/i]for accessing [i]Experimental Builds[/i][/url][/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/82abb54674c431713e895714ff82516457e3e927.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Upgrades[/h1]
[b]New Upgrade available,[/b] with [i][b]3 upgrade levels[/b][/i][b]![/b] You can find it in all [i]Chapters[/i].  This new upgrade is called [i][b]Hover: [/b][/i]It allows you to [b]hover in-air for a short duration[/b] while you [b]aim your taser[/b], making it [b]easier to shoot while[/b] [b]airborne[/b]. This upgrade is meant to be [b]functional before picking up the [/b][i][b]Jetpack[/b][/i], which is why it's a separate system than the [i]Jetpack[/i]. However, it does [b]prevent the [i]Jetpack [/i]from recharging [/b]while in use [i](intended).[/i]

Check out [url=https://youtu.be/7A21cvhwX0g]a video of the new Upgrade here![/url]

[b][i]Health Backpack [/i][/b]and [b][i]Taser Backpack  [/i][/b]upgrades are now considered [b][i]Abilities[/i][/b] until [b]first unlock [/b]to [i][b]Level 1[/b][/i]. Then, can be upgraded to[b][i] Level 2[/i][/b] and finally, [b][i]Level 3[/i][/b]. Until now, there were [b]only 2 upgrade [/b]levels possible for these upgrades - we have now [b]brought it up to 3[/b] in order to [b]carry up to 3[/b] [b]of each item [/b]types [i](Healthpack or Taser Battery).[/i]

[h1]New Graphics Options[/h1]
The game now has a new [b][i]Display Type[/i][/b] option in the [b][i]Graphics [/i][/b]tab: Select either [b][i]Fullscreen[/i][/b], [b][i]Borderless [/i][/b]or [b][i]Windowed [/i][/b]mode.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/fd9a18123702f213dc80b0688c331c4fd1e5cba8.gif[/img]

We have added a new [b][i]Depth of Field[/i] [/b]option in [b][i]Graphics [/i][/b]tab: Enable or Disable the [b]hit blur visual effects[/b][i] (high performance impact on low-end integrated graphics cards)[/i]

[h1]New Sounds![/h1]
We have [b]started to rework the sounds of the game! [/b][i]Philip[/i], a good friend of mine and sound designer, is [b]working on his free time [/b]to [b]replace gradually the sound effects of the game[/b], and he will help with some new music sound tracks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/56bc58fe4545e2dd07c2be2ebe67a118f61cc785.png[/img]

We already have quite a few new sounds implemented: [b]taser shooting sounds, heal, healthpack / taser battery pickup, taser reload, ui notifications[/b], and a few more.

More will come over time as he has time to work on them!

[h1]More Optimizations[/h1]
In the previous major updates of the game, we had[b] already made big optimization improvements[/b], making the game more playable on low-end computers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/11a88c4c83777ee90273256e177d7ae2b8884ed8.png[/img]

With this latest update, [b]many of the rooms[/b] that were still a bit more demanding have now been adjusted, re-structured and optimized to be [b]easier to render on integrated graphics cards. [/b]

[h1]Bug Fixes and Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Use [i][b]Dodge[/b][/i][b] [/b]ability into it a [i][b]Fragile Window[/b][/i][b] [/b]to [b]blast through [/b]it without consuming [i]Taser[/i] ammo! [/*][*]Many [i][b]Dodge[/b][/i] ability improvements: [b]Smoother + Verticality [/b]in dodge movement now more accurate in [i]Zero-Gravity. [/i]Dodging temporarily interrupts [i]Jetpack[/i], but [i]Jetpack [/i]resumes correctly if [i]Jump [/i]button still pressed. You can now [i][b]dodge while crouched[/b][/i], but will be [i][b]forced to stand up if dodging up vertically[/b][/i][b] [/b][/*][*][b]Linux [/b]builds should now [b]launch properly[/b] in [b]both Default and Experimental branches.[/b][/*][*]Many [b]level design[/b] and [b]visual bugs [/b]were fixed[/*][*][b]Fixed: [/b]Various [i][b]Taser [/b][/i][b]aiming laser bugs:[/b] [b]misalignment when aiming laser switches from "far away empty space"[/b] to touching an object, and[b] sometimes going through objects[/b] should now all be fixed. Makes it easier and more precise to aim far away objects.
[/*][*][b]Changed: [/b]If cutscenes are disable OR speedrun mode,[b] first intro of the game is automatically skipped[/b]
[/*][*][b]Changed: [/b]Disabling Cutscenes, OR enabling SpeedRun Mode will always automatically skip the respawn animation
[/*][*][b]NEW [i](EXP only)[/i]: New additional rooms at the end of Chapter 4! [/b]The[b] ending is still missing[/b], but the transitional rooms towards the ending of Chapter 4 are now here. It's not very long, and they will be improved a bit since this is a first version, but please tell me if you find any problems or bugs already :)
[/*][*][b]Changed[i] (EXP only)[/i]:[/b] [b]Optimized more rooms in Chapter 4:[/b] A lot of areas should now run fine on integrated graphics cards. Still some rooms are required to be optimized (50% done)
[/*][*][b]Changed:[/b] [b]Optimized Destructible Walls:[/b] Some Areas in CH3 were heavy on performance due to presence of 2 or more destructible walls; should now be much better. It is a [b]known issue that the "interior" sides of wall parts have a texture visual bug[/b] - ignore it - it will be fixed later.
[/*][*][b]Changed: Optimized Destructible Windows:[/b] Destructible Windows should be much less heavy on performance than before. Still some optimization to do on them once they are broken, that will come later.
[/*][*][b]Fixed: [/b]Dodging into a[b] breakable window during [/b][i][b]Zero-G[/b][/i][b] will also break [/b]it [i](used to work only in non-Zero-G)[/i][/*][*]Many [b]gameplay bugs[/b] reported by the [i]Discord Community [/i]were fixed. Check the [b]#solved-bugs[/b] channel of our [b][i][url=http://bit.ly/fsdiscord]Official Discord Server[/url][/i][/b] to know more.[/*][*][b]Changed: [/b]Smoother [b]Jetpack[/b]: Short jetpack impulsions while falling used to create a "jump" - no longer the case. Acceleration is faster after long fall [i](used to take up to 4 seconds to start going up again)[/i]
[/*][/list]

[h1]Chapter 4: Ending[/h1]
Now that [b]most of Chapter 4's content is functional[/b], we have the [b]ending of the Chapter to create[/b]. This will be done in a future update, as it's going to require a lot of additional work. We will now be focusing on that.

[h1]Chapter 5[/h1]
Once we have [b]implemented the ending of Chapter 4[/b], the chapter will be [b]out of Experimental build for all players to test[/b], and we'll start working on [b][i]Chapter 5[/i][/b], which will be a[b] longer, improved version of the mobile version's [/b][i][b]Chapter 4[/b][/i].

[h1]Mobile Updates[/h1]
Currently, the [b]mobile version's updates are on hold[/b] as we focus on the PC version. However, we're planning to [b]fix a few additional bugs[/b], and [b]improve performance and quality[/b] even more [b]within the next 1 or 2 months.[/b]

[h1]Level Editor[/h1]
[b]We are aware you all would love a [i]Level Editor[/i][/b]. We still haven't announced anything yet, as [b]we are still researching the possibility of adding a [i]Level Editor[/i] in the PC version[/b] of [i]Fractal Space[/i].

Yes, we are [b]experimenting[/b], in parallel of creating the ending of the game. However, we will only start focusing on a [i]Level Editor[/i] [b]once we are closer to releasing the final version[/b] of the PC version.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/c54eaebe403397c0db0de348e370e8b9d05abf9e.png[/img]

Once experiments are concluded and [b]if they are successful[/b], we'll officially announce a [i]Level Editor [/i]and start a beta-testing phase for the feature. However, at this stage, [b]we still cannot confirm[/b] [b]there will be one[/b], and [b]when [/b]it will be released.

One thing is sure: [b]if [/b]there will be a [i]Level Editor[/i], it will be completed and [b]available to the public only after the story mode is completed[/b], as we are [b]too small a team [/b]to work on the [b]game itself and a fully-fledged [/b][i][b]Level Editor[/b][/i].

[b]Thank you[/b] all for [b]playing[/b], for your endless [b]support [/b]and for [b]reading[/b]! Talk to you soon,

notes.title: Development Update #14
notes.content:
It's been a while since the last Development Update! We've been updating the game through [b][i]Steam[/i][/b] and [b]posted news on our[/b] [i][b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/BZgmMB6]Discord Server[/url][/b][/i], but not here.

We have been [i](and still in the process of) [/i][b]moving from [i]France[/i] to [i]Canada[/i][/b][b],[/b] so it has been [b]very busy around here[/b], and we didn't have much time recently, but here is a [b]summary of the improvements that have been made the past two months![/b]

[h1]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS + OPTIMIZATIONS[/h1]
The builds of the last two months were primarily[b] focusing on many visual improvements and performance optimization;[/b] the game now [b]runs much better than before[/b], [b]while looking better as well! [/b]These changes [b]were in [i]Experimental Builds[/i][/b] for a while, they are now in the [b][i]default[/i][/b], stable branch for all players.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=1502176940][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/c8d7da8ada439db7fffb2d4f1ca6fb5b3af57fd2.jpg[/img][/url]

We've reworked [b]most of the visual effects [/b]and [b]post-process [/b]effects; [b][i]Ambient Occlusion[/i], [i]Motion Blur, Antialiasing [/i][/b]and [b][i]Bloom[/i][/b] are [b]more realistic[/b], and a lot of work was done on [b]lighting [/b]to [b]increase realism [i]and[/i] performance, while making all scenes brighter[/b].

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=1502176940][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/88448aba597e184a1faa924a8634c930b6512e2a.jpg[/img][/url]

Finally, we've added a [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=1502176940]Performance Guide here[/url] to help tweak / customize the Graphics options[/b] available in the game's [i]Options[/i] page:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=1502176940][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/9269a57dfe3714030702199fc9287f7077dcea6e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]NEW: IN-GAME BUG REPORTING[/h1]
Good news for testers! If you [b]encounter a bug or want to make a suggestion[/b], you [b]can now do it directly in-game:[/b]
[list]
[*]Press [i][b]ALT + B[/b][/i] shortcut anytime, enter information in the form and click [i][b]Submit[/b][/i]
[*]Or click the [i][b]Bug / Suggestion[/b][/i] button in the Main or Pause Menu
[/list]
This is very helpful for us, as it will [i][b]upload the log files, save game files, and screenshot[/b][/i] directly with the report! [i]Discord[/i] integration will be added later:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/ac4922283c41ec7dd8052e374728032b54a59496.png[/img]

[h1]NEW: SPEEDRUN MODE[/h1]
This has been [b]requested for a while by our community;[/b] a way to [b]help Speedrunners [/b]and [b]compare scores;[/b] it's [b]now possible from the latest update! [/b]You can [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1584744653]check out the Speedrun Mode guide here[/url] [/b]to know more about this mode:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1584744653][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/f18719132d03291ac1c4cf19589454db0a7b701b.jpg[/img][/url]

When this [b]mode is enabled[/b], you can press [b]Tab[/b] (or [i][b]Dpad Down[/b][/i]) anytime to see your current stats:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1584744653][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/792d92695746f9a1f51f012eeb797c691d9f9b8d.jpg[/img][/url]
[list]
 	[*]Current time for this level[/*]
 	[*]Current time for entire game[/*]
 	[*]Current best time for this level (if any)[/*]
 	[*]Current best time for entire game (if any)[/*]
 	[*]Current rank for this level (if any)[/*]
 	[*]Current rank for entire game (if any)[/*]
[/list]
In addition, [b][i]Discord Rich Presence [/i][/b]will now [b]display total time elapsed[/b] for [b]current level[/b], and [b]show if in speedrun mode[/b] for current level.

Everything isn't perfect yet; but [b]the system basics are here[/b] and we'll add a few missing features soon! Currently, [b]you cannot view the[/b] [i][b]Leaderboards [/b](coming soon)[/i], but you [b]can see your best times and rank by selecting [i]Chapters[/i][/b] in the [i][b]Main Menu:[/b][/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1584744653][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/b32b201cf71335e0bc6a56664c96ce7cc7ec05e2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]NEW: DISABLE CUTSCENES[/h1]
