For [b]testers who know the game well[/b] and want to speedrun it, you can [b]now completely disable cutscenes[/b] using the [i][b]"Cutscenes"[/b][/i] button in the [i][b]Options[/b] [/i]menu:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1584744653][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/a6422d79abd4ae3424c43448500f248022e19be2.png[/img][/url]

Please note that in any case, [b]even with cutscenes enabled[/b], the [b]timer stops counting seconds during cutscenes[/b], so this option is really just here to [b]smooth out the speedrun experience[/b], and [b]avoid spamming the [i]"skip cutscene"[/i][/b] button as you speedrun the game, but [b]won't affect your speedrun score[/b].
 
[h1]NEW: DEBUG MODE[/h1]
We have now [b]a brand new version of the Debug Mode[/b], which is[b] more stable[/b] and [b]much easier to use[/b]. If you want to [b]test out Debug features[/b], get your[b] upgrades back after a Reset Save[/b], or test the [b]new [i]God Mode[/i][/b] to reach a specific point, [b]I invite you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=1571068580]check our new [i]Debug Mode[/i] guide here:[/url][/b]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails?id=1571068580][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/74deed2c12fce3969b1ad4a9142072ad87365a31.jpg[/img][/url]

You'll be able to [b]see all the available commands[/b] in the guide ;)

[h1]VARIOUS BUGFIXES[/h1]
[list]
 	[*][b]Fixed:[/b] In [b][i]Chapter 1[/i][/b], the door opened by the pressure plate next to [i]"Go Left, Go Right"[/i] labels [b]could be force closed[/b] in some cases[/*]
 	[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Using [b][i]God Mode[/i] and reloading[/b] the level could [b]create a bug in which collisions were broken[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Changed:[/b] Timer for speedruns [b]stops when the game is not focused[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Changed:[/b] If you enable [i][b]Debug Mode[/b] [/i]in a level, your [b]end score for the level and entire game will be randomly set to a much higher value[/b]. if you do so and want to speedrun the level, you must [b]restart the current Chapter from the beginning[/b].[/*]
 	[*][b]Fixed:[/b] In some cases, a [b]cube on a pressure plate[/b] could [b]incorrectly activate linked objects[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Change:[/b] When [b]cutscenes are disabled[/b], [b]respawn camera animation is now ignored[/b] after last checkpoint reload[/*]
[/list]

[h1]POCKET EDITION UPDATES[/h1]
We've also been [b]fixing various bugs on the [i]Android[/i] version of the game[/b]; [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hazegames.fractalspace]Fractal Space FREE[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hazegames.fractalspacetv]Fractal Space HD[/url]. Also, we have finally been able to publish an [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/fractal-space/id988799702?l=fr&ls=1&mt=8]update for the iOS version[/url], in [b]Beta channel[/b] using [i][b]Testflight[/b][/i]! You can [url=https://testflight.apple.com/join/iApGVOzZ]subscribe here the test the current [i][b]iOS Beta v2.0.4[/b][/i][/url]!

We'll fix a few more bugs that some testers have already found in the mobile beta version, then this update will [b]be live for all players on[/b] [i][b]iOS[/b][/i] and [i][b]Android [/b][/i][b]before end of December![/b]

Thank you everyone for playing, reading and supporting us! Talk to you next time!

notes.title: Development Update #13
notes.content:
[h1]AlienFX: Enhanced Immersion[/h1]
We are happy to announce a [b]partnership with [i]Alienware![/i][/b] [i]Fractal Space[/i] supports [b][i]AlienFX[/i][/b] [b]LED[/b] lighting technology on [i]Alienware[/i] computers! Below is a [b]demo video[/b] to show examples of [b]how the lighting reacts in realtime[/b] to [b]in-game events:[/b]
https://youtu.be/PlZFt6yLQF0
And [b]a few photos[/b] of the [b]LED lighting[/b] while running the game:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/ae05a425d03eb11253cfe523cd73f409e19c10cf.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/3921c82c0c724da539d406b8a534c5ed4db62beb.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/382c16bde424b34cc1c5fc84e1dcbdd3eae8ce92.jpg[/img]

[h1]Stable New Save System[/h1]
A [b]huge task[/b] for us the last [b]4 weeks[/b] has been to focus primarily on the [i]PC[/i] version's [b]new [i]Save System[/i] for [i]Fractal Space[/i][/b]. You can read more about [b]how it works[/b] and [b]why it was necessary[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/435410/announcements/detail/1672401810598294922][b]in our previous news here[/b][/url].

The great news is that the new system is [b]now functional with Chapter 1, 2 and 3![/b] We had testers [b]finding many bugs[/b] concerning this feature using [i]Experimental Builds[/i] on [i]Steam[/i]'s [i]Experimental Branch[/i]. Thank you again, [b][i]Adam[/i][/b], [b][i]Promidius[/i] [/b]and [b][i]Fractal Space Fan[/i][/b] for your help!

Thanks to [b]extensive testing[/b] and [b]many updates[/b], we now have a [b]new save system[/b] which saves the [b]entire level state[/b]; if you play the game again, you will notice that there are [b]many additional checkpoints[/b], especially in [b][i]Chapter 3[/i][/b]!

As of today's update on Steam, from v0.3.0, everybody testing the Pre-Alpha is now using the new Save System.

[b][u]IMPORTANT:[/u][/b] Previous builds save files [b]are not compatible with the new update[/b]; you will lose all current progress. After the update, you must [b]press [i]TAB [/i]on game launch[/b] to show the [b]main menu[/b], and select to [b]perform a [i]!RESET SAVE![/i][/b] using the button. If you tested latest [i]Experimental Builds[/i], your save should remain compatible.

[h1]Pocket Edition Status[/h1]
Currently, [i][b]Fractal Space: Pocket Edition[/b][/i] is [b]not available to download on the [i]Google Play Store[/i];[/b] This is [b]TEMPORARY[/b]; we need fix a couple of important issues with the game before we can upload an update again.

Lately, we have been [b]focusing on the [i]PC[/i][/b] version of the game. We will work on the [b]mobile [i]Pocket Edition[/i] [/b]to provide an update for the [b]end of [i]June[/i][/b], and it will [b]then be back online[/b] where it has always been ;)

This means we hope to finally deliver the[b] update v1.7[/b] of the [i][b]Pocket Edition[/b] [/i]around the [b]end of [i]June[/i] / beginning of [i]July[/i][/b], in which we'll have [b]many bug fixes[/b], better controls and [b]controls customization[/b], along with a couple of [b]reworked visual 2D and 3D assets[/b] to [b]look more like the [i]PC[/i] version[/b].

[h1]Chapter 4[/h1]
[b]Initial work[/b] has started on the[b][i] PC[/i][/b] version's [i][b]Chapter 4[/b], [/i]in parallel of the [b]new Save System[/b]! There's still a lot of work, but we will have more time to work on it now that the [b]new Save System is stable[/b] :)

We've created about [b]25-30% of the content[/b] [b]for Chapter 4[/b]. Below are [b]a couple of screenshots[/b] of the [b]work in progress[/b]; we won't show you too much, it's best to [b]keep a bit of the surprise[/b] :)

We currently have [b]2 rooms in very early playable[/b] stage, and we are [b]prototyping the new gameplay elements[/b] that will be introduced during this [b]fourth Chapter:[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/0e2b055e1f79ff2a9477f8a4e9d7b3d78fd86279.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/aa399c508d4949c5b9fb80133582182f8f1a57c2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/285d5423591b34ccf3013e2f2e0e746996ebcaf4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Update v0.3.0 on Steam[/h1]
[b]v0.3.0[/b] is available on [i][b]default[/b][/i] Branch! If you are on [b]Experimental Branch[/b], you can switch back to [b]default[/b].

[list]

[list]

 	[*]Scenes look now brighter than previous builds. This is to reduce the amount of time spent with Flashlight ON. I'll be happy to have your feedback, as maybe the general increased brightness now looks too pale, and some lights might now be too bright. I didn't have time yet to rework all areas; feel free to post screenshots of too bright/dark areas in [i]#visual-bugs[/i] ![/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Debug Mode Change[/u][/b]
[list]

[i]Charles from Haze Games[/i]

notes.title: Development Update #12
notes.content:
[h1]New Save & Load System[/h1]
There has been no new updates on [i]Steam[/i] the [b]past 2 weeks.[/b] That's because we have [b]started a new task [/b]that's still [b][i]Work In Progress[/i]:[/b] [b]reworking the entire game saving / loading system[/b]. It is a huge task, and it will still be the [b]current priority for the next three weeks[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/7c1d98e0cc3c3dbcface7cb9b89d667d0c87b254.png[/img]
 
[h1]Why?[/h1]
Since the latest [i]Steam[/i] update, the game has [b]reached a point in which [i]Chapter 1, 2 and 3[/i] are now stable;[/b] only a few bugs are present, and they are not game-breaking. This means that we could start working on [i]Chapter 4[/i]... ? Yes, but we have [b]one big issue we've been pushing back[/b] and that is... the [i][b]current save system[/b][/i].

The current save system is [b]very limited[/b] and [b]requires a lot of additional level design work[/b] to function properly. It also [b]does not allow to save specific elements[/b] that are required by the game's new features, like [i]destroying cameras[/i].

You may have noticed already that in some areas, [b]there aren't many checkpoints.[/b] This is caused by the current save system; it would [b]require a big amount of time to setup checkpoints in some specific parts of the level[/b].

For example, in [i]Chapter 3[/i], you must [b]remove 2 [i]Power Cores[/i][/b] in order to access the button to enable [i]The Cube. [/i]You can potentially either remove [i]Power Core A [i][b]or[/b][/i][/i] [i]Power Core B[/i] first. Currently, [b]the game cannot save in between both actions and "remember" which one was removed first[/b]. This kind of limitation makes some [b]gameplay situations impossible to create[/b], but also becomes [b]frustrating[/b] as when you die in these areas, you are [b]forced to re-play the entire room[/b], which can be long and repetitive.

Because of this[b] inefficient save system[/b], it's [b]very dangerous[/b] [i](from a game design perspective)[/i] to [b]create hard and skill-based rooms[/b], because there's a [b]good chance the player will be frustrated of starting the entire room again[/b] if this challenge requires 2-3 attempts.

Last but not least, some of the [b]future features[/b] of the game, and especially [b]one big and exciting one[/b] [i](that we will talk about in a future development update, when there is more progress)[/i], [b]will require this new save system[/b] in order to work correctly.

[h1]What?[/h1]
As a summary, the [b]new save system will allow:[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Easier checkpoint system[/b] to setup [b]for us[/b], while building levels[/*]
 	[*]We'll be able to [b]place checkpoints[/b] to [b]save [/b]at [b]anytime[/b], [b]anywhere[/b] in the game [i](without additional work)[/i]
[list]
 	[*]This means we can make [b]challenging areas less frustrating[/b][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]The game [b]won't have to reload the scene[/b] after each death / checkpoint reload
[list]
 	[*]Close to [b]instant reload after first loading![/b][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Previously placed checkpoints will be [b]easily moved or removed[/b][/*]
 	[*]A large amount of [b]level design bugs [/b]due to reloading at checkpoint [b]will be fixed[/b][/*]
[/list]
[h1]When?[/h1]
We are currently [b]in the middle of the implementation for this new save system[/b]. After a lot of [b]work[/b], late [b]nights[/b], and extensive [b]testing[/b], it's [b]starting to work correctly [/b][i](yay!)[/i], and we can [b]save most objects of [i]Chapter 1[/i][/b]. This is a good start, and theoretically the implementation will be easier for [i]Chapter 2 and 3[/i], as most of the work has been done during [i]Chapter 1[/i] implementation.

I hope to [b]deliver an experimental build[/b] ([i]with Chapter 1 only[/i]) to players who are [b]interested in helping out finding bugs with this new save system[/b]. It will be [b]available through [i]Steam[/i] using a special code[/b] ([i]easy to setup[/i]).

When the first [b]players have tested[/b] [i](and broken!)[/i] the [b]new system[/b] applied to [i]Chapter 1[/i], we will see how stable it is. I'll then fix all the bugs found. When we reach a point where Chapter 1 is stable with this new save system, I can switch to [i]Chapter 2 and 3[/i]'s new save system implementation. We'll do an [b]experimental build for each Chapter[/b] ;)

When [b]all 3 Chapters are stable[/b] with this new system, the [i]Pre-Alpha[/i] "[i]public[/i]" channel [b]will be updated to use it[/b]. I hope that this save system will be stable and finished for the entire game, around [b]mid-May[/b], so [b]about 3 weeks from now[/b].

[h1]Experimental Build[/h1]
I'll soon make [b]an [i]Experimental Build[/i] [/b]available for [b]testers through [i]Steam[/i] [/b]who which to help us find bugs with the new save system. If you're interested in opting in for the [i]Experimental Build[/i], simply notify me in the [url=https://discord.gg/NceYxww][i]#general[/i] [i]Discord [/i]Channel.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/89f453103c364055a07af05236279eab88ad43a4.png[/img]

[b]Please read and follow the steps written[/b] in the very last section [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=905452572][i]"New Save System"[/i] of this guide[/url] to access the build and start testing ;)

In this [i]Experimental Build[/i], you'll be able to [b][i]Quick Save (F5)[/i][/b] and [b][i]Quick Load (F9)[/i][/b] at [b]anytime[/b] (only for testing the new system). This way, you can [b]check if everything is restored to correct states[/b] after reloading the save game.

However, the game will now be [b]using the new save system for all checkpoints;[/b] upon death, the [b]last checkpoint saved is reloaded[/b] [i](normal behavior)[/i].

When, the build is available, I will [b]add a section in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=905452572][i]Steam[/i] [i]Guide[/i][/url] to explain the steps for correct testing[/b] of the [i]Experimental Build[/i] ;)

[h1]New Languages[/h1]
We've updated the localization files and font systems to support the following new languages:
[list]
 	[*]Polish[/*]
 	[*]Hungarian[/*]
 	[*]Italian[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Steam Integration[/h1]
The game now supports [i][b]Steam Achievements[/b][/i]! They are [b]not yet all implemented[/b], thus won't all be unlocked - but there are[b] quite a few already that you should unlock as you play![/b] We also [b]started the work[/b] on [i][b]Steam Leaderboards[/b][/i]; for now [b]scores are being gathered[/b], but there is [b]no way to view them currently[/b]. We'll add this in a [b]future update[/b] ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/4257f662b7dc2364a2efaa280294fe3d07dff3e0.jpg[/img]

That's it for today! I hope that in the next [i]Development Update[/i], we will have [b]finished the new save system[/b] :)

[h1]Hello![/h1]
Hi there, dear [b]Fractal Players[/b]! We have a small new [b]update v0.2.1![/b]

[h1]Steam Controller Support[/h1]
From any variant of version [b]v0.2.1[/b], the [b][b]Steam Controller[/b] [/b]should now [b]work nicely with [b]Fractal Space[/b][/b]. A specific profile has been created with the following specs:
[list]
 	[*][b]Improved aiming:[/b] Mouse movement using the [b]right trackpad movement[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Gyroscopic Controls:[/b] Pull [b]Left Trigger[/b] [b]fully[/b] to enable [b]Gyro[/b] for more [b]precise aiming [/b][/*]
 	[*][b]UI Navigation:[/b] [b]Mouse cursor[/b] with [b]right trackpad movement[/b] + [b]mouse click[/b] with right [b]trackpad button[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Left Rear Button:[/b] Crouch[/*]
 	[*][b]Right Rear Button:[/b] Jump[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/8c0e8364b358d163def9e73f38980379c76e7854.png[/img]

[h1]Controls Remapping Fixes[/h1]
Various bugs were fixed with the [b]controls remapping window and associated tutorials[/b]. It should now work better and be more stable :)

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
We have a [b]couple of issues[/b] that will be fixed for the [b]next update:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]If you can [b]only move the camera[/b], and other inputs are not working correctly, please [b]restart the game[/b]. Make sure the[b][b] Steam Controller[/b][/b] is [b]connected before launching the game[/b].[/*]
 	[*]If you have a [b][b]<RI.Hid>[/b] errors[/b], at start or later, simply enter the pause menu and click "[b]Close[/b]" next to the console. Ignore them, they are [b]harmless[/b] and will be fixed in next update[/*]
 	[*]You might have errors [b][b]FormatException: Index (zero based)[/b] [/b]on display of some tutorials when using the [b]Steam Controller[/b]. You can [b]ignore those too.[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Please do not use the right trackpad (mouse)[/b] in the game's [b]controls remapping window [/b]for now - you might have some issues [b](navigate with left stick or Dpad)[/b][/*]
[/list]

That's all for this small update! Thanks for reading us. Have a great holiday, and Happy Gaming!

[b]Charles from Haze Games[/b]

notes.title: Development Update #10
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/da75d05ddfc7b46897da7b05c23e397e26465aee.jpg[/img]

[h1]Update v0.2.0b on Steam![/h1]
Hello! We are now doing the[b] first update - [u]V0.2.0b[/u] - since the release[/b] of [b]a playable version of Chapter 3[/b] on PC! Here are the various updates, bug fixes and news about the game.

[h1]Walls & Texture Alignments[/h1]

It has been very long, but [b]most of the wall and textures alignements[/b] that were present in [b]both Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 should be fixed[/b]! [b]Chapter 3 has not been reworked yet.[/b]

[b]3D assets have been reworked[/b] to ensure a better alignment, and all objects have been [b]checked / moved / resized to avoid the misalignments that were visible[/b]. There [b]might still be some present [/b]here and there; if you do [b]find some in Chapter 1 or 2[/b], please do [b]take screenshots[/b] and notify me! Thanks!

[h1]Skip Cutscenes[/h1]
You can now [b]skip cutscenes by pressing the [u]TAB[/u][/b] key (or [u][b]Y[/b][/u] on Controller)! That will be very useful to [b]test the game quicker[/b] and for [b]multiple runs:[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/3047678b241e06cd985d4dfc67368136ea6a2eb4.jpg[/img]

Even though this new addition has been tested, I recommend that as a tester, you [b]try it thouroughly;[/b] as skipping a cutscene [b]means that all the events during those cutscenes need to be executed instantly[/b] (open a door, turn off a laser, etc); and there is a chance that in some cases, with specific cutscenes, it [b]breaks some puzzles or creates undesired scenarios[/b].

Especially, for example, for a cutscenes that normally requires the player to [b]wait until some parts of the level are being loaded[/b], configured or initialized [u](ex: Chapter 3 "Initialize Room" button)[/u].

For these [b]very few specific cases of complex cutscenes[/b] in the game (maybe [b]3 out of 200[/b]), they need to be set as [b]exceptionally not skippable[/b]. [b]If you encounter some sort of strange glitch or bug after skipping a cutscene[/b], please [b]write a bug report on the Discord channel[/b] or the [b]Steam Discussion[/b] :) Thank you!

[h1]Faster Zero-G Boost[/h1]
[b]Zero-G[/b] movement itself has not changed; only the [b]boost speed is faster to cover larger distances[/b]. We'll be glad to hear if it feels too fast now :)

[h1]Concentration --> Hyper-Speed[/h1]
[b]Concentration[/b] has been [b]renamed to [u]Hyper-Speed[/u][/b]. I'll be happy to hear as well [b]how this feels and if this ability name makes more sense[/b] to you as a player.

[h1]Hyper-Speed: Show Threshold + Controls[/h1]
[u][b]Hyper-Speed[/b] [/u]now shows an [b]orange threshold of auto-deactivation[/b] on the health bar; it's easier to know when it will be [b]forced to be disabled. [/b]The associated key icon [u][b]V[/b] [/u]or [u][b]Y[/b][/u] on Gamepad is now [b]displayed next to the health bar as well[/b], and remains displayed [b]until deactivated:[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/b9a9ccdbf5e830ac6466fe1ca6e8c001b011ff59.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Most of the [b]first bugs found in Chapter 3[/b] have [u][b]theoretically[/b] [/u]been fixed, including:
[list]
 	[*][b]Bloc Switch[/b] that was [b]not behaving properly[/b] to open the Vent in the "[u]rotating laser and electrified ground[/u]" ([u]Maintenance Room[/u]) should now be [b]working as intended[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]A few flying lights[/b] and [b]flying objects / grounds[/b] have been fixed ;)[/*]
 	[*]A bug made some [b]players get killed[/b] by [b]lasers that were disabled[/b] in Chapter 3. Should now be fixed.[/*]
 	[*]A few [b]walls were not casting shadows [/b]properly. Fixed[/*]
 	[*][u][b]HEALTH_ADDED_TO_IVENTORY[/b] [/u]notification should now display appropriate text[/*]
 	[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] "[u]On your knees[/u]" part should now [b]require the player to crouch to see the switch[/b][/*]
 	[*]Very rapidly [b]crouching and releasing key[/b] could sometimes result it [b]standing up inside the ceiling[/b]. Fixed ;)[/*]
 	[*][b]Various Power Cores[/b] could be [b]seen through some walls[/b] of the level. Fixed[/*]
 	[*]You could [b]re-enter the room with the Kojima Quote[/b] on the wall, later on the in game - Undesired. Fixed.[/*]
 	[*][b]Disabled buttons[/b] were [b]still making sounds[/b] when out of interaction range[/*]
[/list]
I hope you guys will[b] like these changes and bug fixes![/b] Now I'll continue working on [b]wall alignments of Chapter 3[/b], so that the game can be [b]updated some time next week with all 3 Chapters in a more final state[/b] :)

Thanks again for your help and support, and Happy Gaming!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/b9a9ccdbf5e830ac6466fe1ca6e8c001b011ff59.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Most of the [b]first bugs found in Chapter 3[/b] have [u][b]theoretically[/b] [/u]been fixed, including:
[list]
 	[*][b]Bloc Switch[/b] that was [b]not behaving properly[/b] to open the Vent in the "[u]rotating laser and electrified ground[/u]" ([u]Maintenance Room[/u]) should now be [b]working as intended[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]A few flying lights[/b] and [b]flying objects / grounds[/b] have been fixed ;)[/*]
 	[*]A bug made some [b]players get killed[/b] by [b]lasers that were disabled[/b] in Chapter 3. Should now be fixed.[/*]
 	[*]A few [b]walls were not casting shadows [/b]properly. Fixed[/*]
 	[*][u][b]HEALTH_ADDED_TO_IVENTORY[/b] [/u]notification should now display appropriate text[/*]
 	[*][b]Chapter 3:[/b] "[u]On your knees[/u]" part should now [b]require the player to crouch to see the switch[/b][/*]
 	[*]Very rapidly [b]crouching and releasing key[/b] could sometimes result it [b]standing up inside the ceiling[/b]. Fixed ;)[/*]
 	[*][b]Various Power Cores[/b] could be [b]seen through some walls[/b] of the level. Fixed[/*]
 	[*]You could [b]re-enter the room with the Kojima Quote[/b] on the wall, later on the in game - Undesired. Fixed.[/*]
 	[*][b]Disabled buttons[/b] were [b]still making sounds[/b] when out of interaction range[/*]
[/list]
I hope you guys will[b] like these changes and bug fixes![/b] Now I'll continue working on [b]wall alignments of Chapter 3[/b], so that the game can be [b]updated some time next week with all 3 Chapters in a more final state[/b] :)

Thanks again for your help and support, and Happy Gaming!

Even though we [b]still have a lot of work ahead of us,[/b] we will gradually [b]make it a great experience![/b]

Feel free to [b][u]join our Official Discord Server[/u] with this link: https://discord.gg/NceYxww[/b] to keep posted on progress, chat with us and provide feedback for the new third Chapter!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
For this update, we have [b]fixed a lot of bug reported by our lovely community of players on [u]Steam[/u]:[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Controller Bugs:[/b] Controller button icons were not always displayed, it was not possible to shoot the Taser with some controller types[/*]
 	[*][b]Pickup System:[/b] Sometimes, objects were carried "inside the player" and provoke a "throw" of the object upon drop.[/*]
 	[*][b]Boxes Crushed:[/b] If a box / power core is crushed, it is now destroyed and respawned. This also introduced other bugs which are now fixed as well.[/*]
 	[*][b]Dialog Pause:[/b] Dialogs were not always paused correctly upon game pause[/*]
 	[*][b]Junctions Fixed:[/b] Many wall / ground junctions had visual issues and were not always placed correctly. A strange [b]vortex-like effect[/b] on doors was fixed.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
In the sections you will find a listing of [b]notable improvements[/b] that were made on the game in recent [u]Steam[/u] updates.

[h1]Flashlight[/h1]
The flashlight was really just illuminating [b]a small circle on the screen[/b]. In addition, it was [b]not lighting the objects surrounding the player[/b]:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/8084a805b183556e5f46da76e33e24395ef1e049.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/40cede982883e99ebfa0fe6624a7f9f2a4e3fe3f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Squashed Textures[/h1]
We had a few object's textures that were "squashed" and didn't look good. We have fixed a couple of them. You can see an example in the screen below:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/63ce99bc978fcf35ea81e8c236617e17e8e32d87.jpg[/img]

 
[h1]Upgrades Distribution[/h1]
Upgrades available to the player in [b]Chapter 1, 2 and 3 have been reworked;[/b] you will now have [b]different available upgrades per PC[/b], and [b]more variety[/b] in the choice. There is also an [b]additional upgrade PC in Chapter 1[/b], in the same room in which you see the [b]very first Cameras:[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/046b1f735da17c0e80a1ec3f50761fb3c66814e4.jpg[/img]

Thank you for reading, and for your support! See you next month for more news, or directly on our [b]Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/NceYxww[/b]

Cheers, [b]Happy New Year and Happy Gaming![/b]

notes.title: Development Update #8
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]
Hi again everyone! Here is some news about [b]latest improvements[/b] of [b]Fractal Space PC version[/b] [b]0.1.5c[/b] for [u]November 2017[/u]!

[h1]Linux and Supported Resolutions[/h1]
The game was [b]crashing on [u]Linux[/u] hardware[/b]. This has [b]now been fixed[/b], and the game also supports [b]all resolution types[/b]. You can now play the game with[b] any resolution [/b]on[b] [u]Windows[/u], [u]Mac[/u] and [u]Linux[/u]![/b]

[h1]Game Auto-Start & Auto-Resume[/h1]
In addition to [b]improving the general main menu[/b] [b]visuals[/b], if you [b]launch the game for the first time,[/b] the game [b]starts automatically a new game[/b]. If you launch it [b]with a game to resume[/b], the game [b]is resumed on launch[/b]. This [b]avoids to go through the main menu every time you wish to play[/b]. You can still come back to the main menu or access options in-game ;)

You can also [b]prevent the game from auto-launching[/b] and display the main menu instead by [b]pressing the left [u]CTRL[/u][/b] [u](or Command)[/u] [b]key[/b] as soon as the [b]auto-save warning is displayed[/b].

[h1]Steam Guide Update: Errors[/h1]
We have [b]added in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=905452572]Steam Guide here[/url][/b], the section regarding errors "[b][u]A Wild Error Appears![/u][/b]" and what to do when they happen, as [b]from now on[/b] code errors will be [b]displayed in red at the bottom left of the screen.
[/b]

We also [b]added a few tips regarding performance[/b] [u]Options[/u] in the guide.

[h1]Improved Lighting[/h1]
[b]Lighting is much more optimized:[/b] [b]performance[/b] should be better in [b]both Chapters[/b]. Some areas might [b]seem now darker[/b]; please do point them out if you think they are way too dark. We also did this [b]intentionally [/b]to [b]encourage the usage of the [u]Flashlight[/u][/b].

[b]Lighting is more realistic:[/b] There are now [b]less areas[/b] where lights are "[u]very bright on close surfaces[/u]", creating a [b]blinding-bright zone[/b] on the closest walls of realtime lights. This makes the general feel less colorful, but [b]more realistic[/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/573b83d9245c4527ac97e59b64a551c27fe162b2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/546ae2fa75b8ffe03ce7ee7ac7f3215dc39ab3f2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/8bb467f038dc735e0641b3e351f053a7d81b8c90.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/6a094b5b7dcde7cb08a077a8a779a413ca919442.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Destructible Windows[/h1]
[b]Destructible [u]Walls[/u]:[/b] They are now replaced by [b]Destructible [u]Windows[/u][/b]. [u]Windows[/u] can be [b]destroyed with the basic [u]Taser[/u][/b], whereas [b]Destructible [u]Walls[/u] require the [u]Taser Firepower Level 2[/u] Upgrade[/b] to be destroyed.

Destructible [u]Walls[/u] found in [b]Chapter 1 and 2 are Bonus Rooms[/b] - you will need to [b]play them again once you have acquired the Taser Upgrade in Chapter 3[/b], as Upgrades are Persistent, and [b]remain even if playing an earlier Chapter![/b]

Bonus rooms are [b]not yet designed;[/b] if you do break the wall, you will [b]currently find nothing behind ;)[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/aa8a04973f1376e09b42650159607d24127d76ce.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/09b57fd3bd8ee003b0d889873a201518591c0f64.jpg[/img]


[h1]Visual Improvements[/h1]
A [b]lot of small improvements[/b] and tweaks have been made on most [b]3D models and textures to look better;[/b] the light some objects emit is now more realistic compared to the previous very bright binary "[u]emissive or not[/u]" aspect they had.

[b]Screens are now improved[/b] and there are [b]more of them for better prediction of the switches usage[/b]. The [b]User interface has also been improved[/b] for most pages of the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/9883cef9ab2f56031f75dcbc01372733e269a31d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/6bd449b7754f3c3d9a11b7af9a017275b57e1499.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/e43c08d4363bfe04d3cae588eede0890675ff84e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/48a0e71cf51780fa8a3e9b06928c32384cf6392a.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Upgrades: Healthpack & Taser Ammo Backpacks[/h1]
At [b]first[/b], when you pick up a [b][u]Healthpack[/u] [/b]or [b][u]Taser Ammo[/u][/b] pack, it is [b]used automatically on-the-spot[/b] to [b]heal[/b] [b]you[/b] or [b]recharge your [u]Taser[/u] [u]Energy[/u][/b]. If you acquire the [u][b]Taser Backpack[/b][/u] or [u][b]Health Backpack[/b][/u] upgrades from [u][b]Upgrade Terminals[/b][/u], you will then be able to [b]store 1 to 2 of each of those packs[/b].

This will allow you to always keep a [b][u]Taser Ammo[/u] [/b]pack or [u][b]Healthpack[/b] [/u][b]for later use[/b] in a hard situation ;)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11869706/852c8df2a6fa4e0201607a0bb6287527b7766302.jpg[/img]

 
[h1]Chapter 3 ?[/h1]
We have made [b]a lot of progress on Chapter 3[/b], and it's [b]soon ready![/b] We expect to release it [b]before [u]Christmas[/u][/b], as a first playable version!

Talk to you soon, on the next development update :)

notes.title: Development Update #7
notes.content:
[h1]Pocket Edition: Update 1.7 (Work In Progress)[/h1]
We [b]have switched to the mobile version the last few weeks [/b]in order to [b]complete some of the features[/b] we've been working on for a while. Details on the [b][i]Pocket Edition[/i]'s additions [/b]([i]still Work In Progress[/i]) [b][url=http://haze-games.com/fractal-space-update-1-4-is-rolling-out]can be found on the dedicated page here[/url].[/b]

All these new additions [b]have taken a lot of time[/b], which is why we [b]didn't upload any [i]PC[/i] [i]Pre-Alpha[/i] version update on [i]Steam[/i][/b]. We hope to soon complete and release the [b][i]Pocket Edition[/i] Update 1.7[/b] and [b]switch back to working on the [i]PC[/i] version![/b]

 
[h1]Chapter 3: Work In Progress[/h1]
In parallel of [b]improving and adding new features[/b] to the[b][i] Pocket Edition[/i] on [i]Android[/i] &[i] iOS[/i][/b], we've been working on the [b][i]PC[/i] version's third chapter[/b].

Since [i]Chapter 3[/i] is [b]introducing a few new features[/b], it takes [b]a long time to build[/b]. Here's an example of a room (pretty dark one for now) that[b] builds itself in real time:[/b]

notes.title: Development Update #6
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Pre-Alpha v0.1.1d[/h1]
The latest [b]Steam Update of Fractal Space Pre-Alpha preview build[/b] has been updated. A few of the changes have been listed in the sections below.

[h1]New Visual Effects[/h1]
The Taser Gun now has [b]more realistic and more immersive visual effect[/b] when shooting:

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Taser_VFX.gif][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Taser_VFX.gif[/img][/url]

We also have [b]new electrified grounds[/b], which allows us to [b]create large traps without having to create a large number of lasers:[/b]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Electric_VFX.gif][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Electric_VFX.gif[/img][/url]

Lasers now have[b] particle effects! [/b]Later will come an [b]option to disable[/b] for performance purposes:

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-02-1.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-02-1.png[/img][/url]

We have[b] a few additional rooms in Chapter 2[/b], and some [b]modifications in the rooms that were already present[/b]. Example screenshots here:

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Newpart1.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Newpart1.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Newpart2.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Newpart2.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Newpart3.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Newpart3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]You can now[b] jump even when crouched:[/b] you will [b]first stand up automatically[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Hold [i]Space[/i] key or[i] A[/i] button[/b] to use [b]Jetpack[/b]:[b] no need[/b] to press the button [b]twice[/b][/*]
 	[*]Fixed behavior if [b]jump vertical trajectory is obstructed by an object[/b][/*]
 	[*]Overall [b]better movement reactivity of player character[/b][/*]
 	[*]Many [b]floating lights[/b], objects and other visual issues are fixed[/*]
 	[*]Fixed [b]some doors which were not opening[/b] / closing or [b]disappearing[/b] as player progresses[/*]
 	[*]Reworked [b]Doors[/b]: [b]Texture fixes[/b] and frame looks better + red & blue lines to show if locked or opened[/*]
 	[*]Reworked [b]Cubes to look better[/b][/*]
 	[*]Ground [b]Bloc Switches:[/b] Now look nicer as well[/*]
 	[*]Reworked[b] lighting to have more lights in Chapter 1[/b] - some areas are darker intentionally - flashlight tutorial placed earlier in the game[/*]
 	[*]Taser could sometimes shoot in "void" - also be fixed[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Reboot Develop 2017[/h1]
We were at[i] Reboot Develop 2017 Conference[/i] at the end of April. It was in [i]Dubrovnik[/i], the real-world [i]King's Landing[/i] from the famous [i]Game of Thrones[/i] TV Show!

It was a great experience; we had some players try out the game, had some positive and interesting feedback on some of the work in progress game mechanics. We also managed to see a few of the conferences there with great speakers like [i]Renaud Charpentier[/i], [i]Matthew Steinke[/i] and [i]Chris Taylor[/i]. We also met other interesting people from the games industry.

We have [b]gathered a lot of feedback,[/b] and also[b] a few new bugs that were discovered on the spot![/b]

I would like to [b]thank [i]Peter[/i] and [i]Kjus[/i] for helping so much with the bug reporting and testing[/b] prior to the event; this helped getting a build ready for people to test more relevant aspects of the game.

We have been working on the [b]build v0.1.1d for [i]Steam[/i].[/b] It will be live within the next hours. It will include [b]a lot of main bug fixes reported[/b] on [i]Steam[/i] and during the [i]Reboot Develop[/i] event.

[h1]Back to Pocket Edition[/h1]
Now that this [i]Steam[/i] updated build is released, we need to [b]slow down the work on the PC version[/b] and return t[b]o improving the [i]Pocket Edition[/i] of the game on [i]iOS[/i] and [i]Android[/i][/b].

We want to [b]add new languages[/b], [b]fix a few issues[/b] that some players reported, but mostly [b]improve the User Interface and some usability issues,[/b] like the[b] jump button being too far away[/b] for some large screens like the[i] iPad Pro[/i] and large-screen [i]Android[/i] tablets.

The next major mobile update of [i]Fractal Space: Pocket Edition[/i] will allow us then to[b] focus on marketing the mobile version[/b], and[b] return to work 100% [/b]on the [b]PC version[/b].

notes.title: Development Update #5
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]
We are happy to write to you again :) We hope you're alright. We're back here to write about the [b]current progress and state of the game[/b] :)

[h1]Pre-Alpha Testing[/h1]
[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Menu.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Menu.jpg[/img][/url]

As mentioned in the previous development update, [b]we have a PC Pre-Alpha build ready[/b] for [b]anybody to play and test[/b], if you are willing to [b]play an early version[/b] in order to [b]provide useful feedback and opinion on the game and find out bugs[/b]!

Current pre-alpha testers are currently finding a lot of nice [b]glitches, bugs and other issues[/b], but also provide interesting ideas for current and next chapters of the game. If you're interested in helping us improve the game, you can [b]simply request a [i]Steam[/i] key for the PC Pre-Alpha build[/b] of the game by sending an email to contact@haze-games.com

The Pre-Alpha [i]Steam[/i] build is updated about [b]1-3 times / week[/b] to fix all bugs which are encountered by players and test new experimental features.

[b]Special thanks[/b] go to [b]Peter and Kjus[/b]! They have both [b]found many bugs and created videos for them![/b] Peters also helps with [b]Hungarian localization![/b] Thanks very much to [b]both of you![/b]

We are focusing on [b]fixing all bugs and polishing the first 2 chapters[/b] of the game, mostly because we want a good playable build for... [b][i]Reboot Develop[/i][/b]!

[h1]Event: Reboot Develop[/h1]
[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Fractal-Space-Level3_PC-SceneCamera-2017-03-26-10-41-45-3840x2160x1.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Fractal-Space-Level3_PC-SceneCamera-2017-03-26-10-41-45-3840x2160x1.png[/img][/url]

We are happy to announce that [i]Haze Games [/i]is going be [b]present at the[/b] [b]indie games[/b] event [b][i]Reboot Develop[/i][/b] in [b][i]Dubrovnik, Croatia[/i][/b]!

We are thus working actively on a [b]fully working build of the first 2 Chapters of the game on PC[/b], for the people on-site to play! We are getting some [b]very useful feedback, bug reports and comments from Pre-Alpha players[/b] that have requested a[i] Steam[/i] Key. Thanks to them, we hope to achieve [b]a bug-free and fully playable demo build[/b] :)

This also means we have to work on [b]Posters, Flyers and Business cards[/b] for the game; a different, time-consuming type of work, but also very important.

We hope to have a few players at our booth - if you live in the area, please feel free to come and see us, [b]we would be very happy to meet you![/b]

[img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-2.png[/img]

[h1]Tutorials & Controls[/h1]
We have[b] reworked all tutorials[/b] to be [b]fully compatible with display of keyboard/mouse icons and Xbox One / Xbox 360 controllers[/b]! Now, we're sure everything can be understood easily, and [b]those controllers are now fully supported:[/b]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-5-1.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-5-1.png[/img][/url]

[i]Note: Later on, we'll [b]add support for the [/b][b]Steam Controller[/b] and various others.[/i]

Using a gamepad, the [b]Jump/Jetpack buttons[/b] are now [b]either[/b]  [img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_A.png[/img]  [b][i]OR  [/i][/b] [url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_RB.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_RB.png[/img][/url].   The player can use [b]either of these 2 buttons[/b] at anytime to [b]Jump/Activate Jetpack[/b].

In most [i]circumstances, [b]u[/b][/i][b]sing  [img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_A.png[/img] to jump is fine[/b]. However, [b]using  [img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_A.png[/img] button to use the Jetpack[/b] forces you to[b] remove your right thumb from the right joystick[/b]... This is bad, since you [b]cannot look around or change direction[/b] [b]without interrupting jetpack thrust[/b].

Instead, you can now use  [url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_RB.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_RB.png[/img][/url]  for [b]Jump/Jetpack[/b], and [b]keep both your thumbs[/b] on the gamepad's [b]joysticks while using the jetpack[/b]. This makes it [b]much easier to control![/b]

[h1]Upgrade System[/h1]
We have been working on an interesting feature for [i]Fractal Space [/i]on [i]PC[/i]: The [i][b]Upgrade System[/b][/i] from [b][i]Upgrade Terminals[/i][/b]. These [b][i]Upgrade Terminals[/i][/b] allow the player to, for example, [b]improve[/b] [i]Taser[/i] capacity, movement speed, Jetpack duration, maximum [i]Health, [/i]or [b]unlock new abilities:[/b]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Upgrade.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Upgrade.jpg[/img][/url]

You can[b] only select one type of upgrade[/b] out of [b]2 to 4 choices[/b] every time you encounter an [i]Upgrade Terminal. [/i]They are [b]not always easy to find[/b] (or reach). Upgrades being [b]persistent from a playthrough to another[/b] we hope it[b] improves replay value[/b] for a [i][b]New Game+[/b][/i]. As soon as an [b]upgrade has been selected[/b], the[i][b] Upgrade Terminal[/b] [/i]is [b]not longer available[/b], you'll need to [b]search for the other ones[/b] throughout the station if you want to [b]upgrade more![/b]

[h1]Sprint[/h1]
We will be adding the [i]Sprint[/i] Ability to [b]unlock from [i]Upgrade Terminals[/i][/b] very soon to the Pre-Alpha for current alpha players to test. This allows you to [b]run much faster[/b]. We've been making sure it works nicely, both [b]with and without controller.[/b]

[h1]Focus[/h1]
The [b][i]Focus [/i][i]Abilitiy[/i][/b] is not yet ready for testing and will be [b]introduced in Chapter 3[/b], [b]when it is ready[/b] for pre-alpha testers to play with. However, further work has been done on this feature to [b]make sure it works well while in [i]Zero-Gravity[/i][/b], and a few [b]new rooms exploiting it[/b] have been created.

[h1]Chapter 3[/h1]
We are also working in parallel on the [b]third chapter of the game[/b], which will mainly exploit [i]Zero-Gravity[/i] and introduce the [i]Focus [/i]Abiltiy described above!

Here are a few [b]screenshots of some of the new rooms[/b] of Chapter 2, and [b]Chapter 3 Work In Progress![/b]

notes.title: Development Update #5
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]
We are happy to write to you again :) We hope you're alright. We're back here to write about the [b]current progress and state of the game[/b] :)

[h1]Pre-Alpha Testing[/h1]
[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Menu.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Menu.jpg[/img][/url]

As mentioned in the previous development update, [b]we have a PC Pre-Alpha build ready[/b] for [b]anybody to play and test[/b], if you are willing to [b]play an early version[/b] in order to [b]provide useful feedback and opinion on the game and find out bugs[/b]!

Current pre-alpha testers are currently finding a lot of nice [b]glitches, bugs and other issues[/b], but also provide interesting ideas for current and next chapters of the game. If you're interested in helping us improve the game, you can [b]simply request a [i]Steam[/i] key for the PC Pre-Alpha build[/b] of the game by sending an email to contact@haze-games.com

The Pre-Alpha [i]Steam[/i] build is updated about [b]1-3 times / week[/b] to fix all bugs which are encountered by players and test new experimental features.

[b]Special thanks[/b] go to [b]Peter and Kjus[/b]! They have both [b]found many bugs and created videos for them![/b] Peters also helps with [b]Hungarian localization![/b] Thanks very much to [b]both of you![/b]

We are focusing on [b]fixing all bugs and polishing the first 2 chapters[/b] of the game, mostly because we want a good playable build for... [b][i]Reboot Develop[/i][/b]!

[h1]Event: Reboot Develop[/h1]
[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Fractal-Space-Level3_PC-SceneCamera-2017-03-26-10-41-45-3840x2160x1.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Fractal-Space-Level3_PC-SceneCamera-2017-03-26-10-41-45-3840x2160x1.png[/img][/url]

We are happy to announce that [i]Haze Games [/i]is going be [b]present at the[/b] [b]indie games[/b] event [b][i]Reboot Develop[/i][/b] in [b][i]Dubrovnik, Croatia[/i][/b]!

We are thus working actively on a [b]fully working build of the first 2 Chapters of the game on PC[/b], for the people on-site to play! We are getting some [b]very useful feedback, bug reports and comments from Pre-Alpha players[/b] that have requested a[i] Steam[/i] Key. Thanks to them, we hope to achieve [b]a bug-free and fully playable demo build[/b] :)

This also means we have to work on [b]Posters, Flyers and Business cards[/b] for the game; a different, time-consuming type of work, but also very important.

We hope to have a few players at our booth - if you live in the area, please feel free to come and see us, [b]we would be very happy to meet you![/b]

[img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-2.png[/img]

[h1]Tutorials & Controls[/h1]
We have[b] reworked all tutorials[/b] to be [b]fully compatible with display of keyboard/mouse icons and Xbox One / Xbox 360 controllers[/b]! Now, we're sure everything can be understood easily, and [b]those controllers are now fully supported:[/b]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-5-1.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-5-1.png[/img][/url]

[i]Note: Later on, we'll [b]add support for the [/b][b]Steam Controller[/b] and various others.[/i]

Using a gamepad, the [b]Jump/Jetpack buttons[/b] are now [b]either[/b]  [img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_A.png[/img]  [b][i]OR  [/i][/b] [url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_RB.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_RB.png[/img][/url].   The player can use [b]either of these 2 buttons[/b] at anytime to [b]Jump/Activate Jetpack[/b].

In most [i]circumstances, [b]u[/b][/i][b]sing  [img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_A.png[/img] to jump is fine[/b]. However, [b]using  [img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_A.png[/img] button to use the Jetpack[/b] forces you to[b] remove your right thumb from the right joystick[/b]... This is bad, since you [b]cannot look around or change direction[/b] [b]without interrupting jetpack thrust[/b].

Instead, you can now use  [url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_RB.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/XboxOne_RB.png[/img][/url]  for [b]Jump/Jetpack[/b], and [b]keep both your thumbs[/b] on the gamepad's [b]joysticks while using the jetpack[/b]. This makes it [b]much easier to control![/b]

[h1]Upgrade System[/h1]
We have been working on an interesting feature for [i]Fractal Space [/i]on [i]PC[/i]: The [i][b]Upgrade System[/b][/i] from [b][i]Upgrade Terminals[/i][/b]. These [b][i]Upgrade Terminals[/i][/b] allow the player to, for example, [b]improve[/b] [i]Taser[/i] capacity, movement speed, Jetpack duration, maximum [i]Health, [/i]or [b]unlock new abilities:[/b]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Upgrade.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Upgrade.jpg[/img][/url]

You can[b] only select one type of upgrade[/b] out of [b]2 to 4 choices[/b] every time you encounter an [i]Upgrade Terminal. [/i]They are [b]not always easy to find[/b] (or reach). Upgrades being [b]persistent from a playthrough to another[/b] we hope it[b] improves replay value[/b] for a [i][b]New Game+[/b][/i]. As soon as an [b]upgrade has been selected[/b], the[i][b] Upgrade Terminal[/b] [/i]is [b]not longer available[/b], you'll need to [b]search for the other ones[/b] throughout the station if you want to [b]upgrade more![/b]

[h1]Sprint[/h1]
We will be adding the [i]Sprint[/i] Ability to [b]unlock from [i]Upgrade Terminals[/i][/b] very soon to the Pre-Alpha for current alpha players to test. This allows you to [b]run much faster[/b]. We've been making sure it works nicely, both [b]with and without controller.[/b]

[h1]Focus[/h1]
The [b][i]Focus [/i][i]Abilitiy[/i][/b] is not yet ready for testing and will be [b]introduced in Chapter 3[/b], [b]when it is ready[/b] for pre-alpha testers to play with. However, further work has been done on this feature to [b]make sure it works well while in [i]Zero-Gravity[/i][/b], and a few [b]new rooms exploiting it[/b] have been created.

[h1]Chapter 3[/h1]
We are also working in parallel on the [b]third chapter of the game[/b], which will mainly exploit [i]Zero-Gravity[/i] and introduce the [i]Focus [/i]Abiltiy described above!

Here are a few [b]screenshots of some of the new rooms[/b] of Chapter 2, and [b]Chapter 3 Work In Progress![/b]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-3.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-3.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-4.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-4.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-1.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09-1.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/2017-04-09.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Room.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Room.png[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoyed reading us today, and we'll be back next month for more news! Have a great day, and[b] happy gaming![/b]

[i]Charles and Amélie, from Haze Games[/i]

notes.title: Development Update #4
notes.content:
[img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-33.png[/img]
[h1]Hello![/h1]
We have been working on the [u]PC[/u] version of [u]Fractal Space[/u] this month, and we are happy to announce that we have a first [b]Pre-Alpha PC Press build available[/b]!

We have worked a lot on the [b]visual effects[/b] and [b]sound effects[/b] to make the game more immersive. We will make them better in the polish stage, but it's already sounding much better than it was last month :)

We also have [b]updated the [url=https://youtu.be/P5ACN0crRr8]video of the Steam Store page[/url][/b] with new footage and gameplay of the PC version!

[h1]PC Pre-Alpha Available[/h1]
We have [b]completed the re-work[/b] of the game on [u]PC[/u] for the [b]first two Chapters of the game[/b]! Meaning that we are [b]now sending [u]Steam[/u] keys to everyone who requested[/b] one! You can request one by [b]sending an email[/b] to [b]contact@haze-games.com[/b].

This[b] Pre-Alpha [u]Steam[/u] build[/b] lets you try the [b]new features[/b] and [b]reworked graphics[/b] exclusive to [u]PC[/u],[u] Mac[/u] and [u]Linux[/u] platforms!

[u]Important notes:[/u]
[list]
[*]This pre-alpha build only includes the first 2 chapters of the game
[*]Voice-over are temporary, and will be recorded with actors for release
[*]Some rooms are currently silent - dialogs still require writing and recording
[*]You may see blinking/disappearing 3D objects at a distance - this will be fixed later
[/list]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Screen1.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Screen1.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Zero-Gravity[/h1]
Another nice [u]PC[/u]-exclusive feature we are working on is [b]Zero-Gravity rooms[/b] with their associated puzzles!

This requires a lot of [b]re-work of the controls and physics[/b] handling for movement, jump, jetpack and objects. Handling [b]player collisions[/b] has been painful. It's still an unstable system, that's at its early stage - we need to build more rooms exploiting this feature, and fix issues & bugs as we go along.

However, it's starting to work pretty well, and [b]we hope you'll enjoy [/b]it on the [u]PC Pre-Alpha [/u]build!

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-33.png]
[/url] [url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/ZeroG_1.png][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/ZeroG_1.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Destructible Walls[/h1]
That's [b]also new[/b] for the Desktop version of Fractal Space: We are using [b]Destructible Walls[/b] to place some of the [b]hidden recordings[/b], and some rooms require you to [b]break its structure[/b] in order to [b]solve their associated puzzles:[/b]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/DestructibleWAlls.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/DestructibleWAlls.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Level3.jpg][img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Level3.jpg[/img][/url]

Beware, you may also [b]find yourself lead into a trap, [/b]hidden behind [b]what seemed to be[/b] a [b]secret reward [/b]behind the wall ;)

[h1]Visual & Sound Enhancements[/h1]
For the PC version, we have reworked most 3D assets to [b]look better[/b], be [b]more visible[/b], and show [b]more instant feedback[/b] to the player:

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Projector1.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Projector1.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/2016-09-24-26.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/2016-09-24-26.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Next Step: Chapter 3[/h1]
Thanks for reading! We are now [b]working actively on Chapter 3[/b], and all the [b]new rooms[/b] and [b]new features[/b] this room involves. We have [b]something new[/b] about [u][b]Time Manipulation[/b][/u]... But we will talk more about it when [b]we have something to show[/b] :)

We will release a new [u]Development Update[/u] when [u]Chapter 3[/u] is completed, within 1 or 2 months! Thank you all, see you next time, and [u]Happy Gaming![/u]

[u]Charles[/u] from [u]Haze Games[/u]

[img]http://aze.bernardoff.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/LEvel3_4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development Update #3
notes.content:
[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-37.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-37.png[/img][/url]

We have been very busy the last few weeks, [b]focusing on the Steam version[/b] of the game. This is why there[b] hasn't been any update[/b] [b]of the [/b]Pocket Edition on iOS and Android - yet.

The Pre-Alpha PC Press Build is [b]soon to be ready[/b] for Press and Youtubers to enjoy! It was supposed to be ready within the next few days, but we have[b] taken the decision to delay it a bit more[/b].

For the next development update, during October, the Pre-Alpha PC Press Build[b] will be ready[/b].

[img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-3.png[/img]

[h1]Movement & Controls Rework[/h1]
Instead of releasing the Pre-Alpha PC Press Build in the next few days, we took a hard decision:

[b]Player movement and controls[/b] on PC were working OK. But they [b]weren't perfect[/b]. And that was the issue. After a lot of hard work and time spent fixing issues, tweaking and trying to make them perfect with the current system, we finally decided that [b]it would be best[/b] for our players to actually[b] completely rework[/b] the movement, jump, gravity, jetpack and moving platforms system.

What does this mean?

Well, as we were adding features and perfecting the player experience, the current system proved to have flaws. Flaws that[b] couldn't be fixed[/b]. There would still be situations where we'd be unhappy with the result. That comes from the fact that this game was first started a long time ago, and [b]was not ready[/b] to support the new features we have added since.

This means that the [b]entire controls and movement system[/b] has been [b]restarted from scratch[/b]. It's a long process, and a lot of work, yes, but [b]it had do be done[/b] at some point.

The reason behind this decision is that it was [b]too hard to achieve a smooth[/b], [b]reactive[/b] and completely [b]bug-free[/b] experience with [b]all 3 input systems[/b]: touch controls, keyboard & mouse combo and gamepad. We want YouTubers and Beta-Testers to have the [b]best experience possible[/b] for the early PC build.

After this huge rework, the result will be:
[list]
 	[*]Global [b]movement feel and experience[/b] will be the same [b]regardless[/b] of input system: touch, gamepad or keyboard & mouse[/*]
 	[*][b]Acceleration[/b] and [b]deceleration[/b] of the character will [b]feel much more natural[/b] on all platforms[/*]
 	[*][b]Jump[/b] will be smoother[/*]
 	[*]Additional [b]PC-exclusive features[/b] will feel[b] more polished[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Bugs[/b] regarding moving platforms [b]will be fixed[/b][/*]
 	[*]Moving platforms will now [b]give velocity[/b] to the player and [b]objects[/b] placed on them[/*]
 	[*]Objects will now have[b] momentum[/b] and will be [b]thrown with player's current velocity[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Falling[/b] from a platform or ground will result in a[b] smoother fall trajectory[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Jetpack[/b] will feel[b] more smooth[/b] and gravity applied while using the jetpack will[b] feel more realistic[/b][/*]
 	[*]We will have [b]the same experience with all 3 input[/b] models[/*]
[/list]
This development update is mostly about telling you what we are working on; it's something that cannot be seen or explained easily, but [b]will be felt[/b] as you play the game.

However, below are some [b]new screenshots[/b] of improvements and levels for the PC version, and a few new features announcement!

[h1]Zero-Gravity[/h1]
Another nice PC-exclusive feature we are working on is [b]Zero-Gravity rooms[/b] with their associated puzzles!

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-38.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-38.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-39.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-39-e1474738178313.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/ZeroG_1.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/ZeroG_1.png[/img][/url]

This requires a lot of [b]re-work of the controls and physics[/b] handling for movement, jump, jetpack and objects. Handling [b]player collisions[/b] has been painful. This is also one of the reasons why we chose to rework the movement system; it makes it [b]easier to support[/b] this features.

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-41.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-41.png[/img][/url]

It's starting to work pretty well, and [b]we hope you'll enjoy [/b]it on the PC Pre-Alpha Press Build!


[h1]Visual & Sound Enhancements[/h1]
We have reworked most 3D assets to [b]look better[/b], be [b]more visible[/b], and show [b]more instant feedback[/b] to the player. For example, cubes, switches, cameras, ammo packs and health packs are [b]more visible in dark areas[/b], and their [b]current state[/b] is more understandable using[b] more visible color changes[/b]:

notes.title: Development Update #3
notes.content:
[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-37.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-37.png[/img][/url]

We have been very busy the last few weeks, [b]focusing on the Steam version[/b] of the game. This is why there[b] hasn't been any update[/b] [b]of the [/b]Pocket Edition on iOS and Android - yet.

The Pre-Alpha PC Press Build is [b]soon to be ready[/b] for Press and Youtubers to enjoy! It was supposed to be ready within the next few days, but we have[b] taken the decision to delay it a bit more[/b].

For the next development update, during October, the Pre-Alpha PC Press Build[b] will be ready[/b].

[img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-3.png[/img]

[h1]Movement & Controls Rework[/h1]
Instead of releasing the Pre-Alpha PC Press Build in the next few days, we took a hard decision:

[b]Player movement and controls[/b] on PC were working OK. But they [b]weren't perfect[/b]. And that was the issue. After a lot of hard work and time spent fixing issues, tweaking and trying to make them perfect with the current system, we finally decided that [b]it would be best[/b] for our players to actually[b] completely rework[/b] the movement, jump, gravity, jetpack and moving platforms system.

What does this mean?

Well, as we were adding features and perfecting the player experience, the current system proved to have flaws. Flaws that[b] couldn't be fixed[/b]. There would still be situations where we'd be unhappy with the result. That comes from the fact that this game was first started a long time ago, and [b]was not ready[/b] to support the new features we have added since.

This means that the [b]entire controls and movement system[/b] has been [b]restarted from scratch[/b]. It's a long process, and a lot of work, yes, but [b]it had do be done[/b] at some point.

The reason behind this decision is that it was [b]too hard to achieve a smooth[/b], [b]reactive[/b] and completely [b]bug-free[/b] experience with [b]all 3 input systems[/b]: touch controls, keyboard & mouse combo and gamepad. We want YouTubers and Beta-Testers to have the [b]best experience possible[/b] for the early PC build.

After this huge rework, the result will be:
[list]
 	[*]Global [b]movement feel and experience[/b] will be the same [b]regardless[/b] of input system: touch, gamepad or keyboard & mouse[/*]
 	[*][b]Acceleration[/b] and [b]deceleration[/b] of the character will [b]feel much more natural[/b] on all platforms[/*]
 	[*][b]Jump[/b] will be smoother[/*]
 	[*]Additional [b]PC-exclusive features[/b] will feel[b] more polished[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Bugs[/b] regarding moving platforms [b]will be fixed[/b][/*]
 	[*]Moving platforms will now [b]give velocity[/b] to the player and [b]objects[/b] placed on them[/*]
 	[*]Objects will now have[b] momentum[/b] and will be [b]thrown with player's current velocity[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Falling[/b] from a platform or ground will result in a[b] smoother fall trajectory[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Jetpack[/b] will feel[b] more smooth[/b] and gravity applied while using the jetpack will[b] feel more realistic[/b][/*]
 	[*]We will have [b]the same experience with all 3 input[/b] models[/*]
[/list]
This development update is mostly about telling you what we are working on; it's something that cannot be seen or explained easily, but [b]will be felt[/b] as you play the game.

However, below are some [b]new screenshots[/b] of improvements and levels for the PC version, and a few new features announcement!

[h1]Zero-Gravity[/h1]
Another nice PC-exclusive feature we are working on is [b]Zero-Gravity rooms[/b] with their associated puzzles!

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-38.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-38.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-39.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-39-e1474738178313.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/ZeroG_1.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/ZeroG_1.png[/img][/url]

This requires a lot of [b]re-work of the controls and physics[/b] handling for movement, jump, jetpack and objects. Handling [b]player collisions[/b] has been painful. This is also one of the reasons why we chose to rework the movement system; it makes it [b]easier to support[/b] this features.

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-41.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-41.png[/img][/url]

It's starting to work pretty well, and [b]we hope you'll enjoy [/b]it on the PC Pre-Alpha Press Build!


[h1]Visual & Sound Enhancements[/h1]
We have reworked most 3D assets to [b]look better[/b], be [b]more visible[/b], and show [b]more instant feedback[/b] to the player. For example, cubes, switches, cameras, ammo packs and health packs are [b]more visible in dark areas[/b], and their [b]current state[/b] is more understandable using[b] more visible color changes[/b]:

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-33.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2016-09-24-33.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Development Update #2
notes.content:
[img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-1.png[/img]

Hello, dear Fractal Space players, fans and readers!

We are writing this post to [b]update you on the progress made on the PC version[/b] these past few weeks. We have been [b]very busy[/b] with:
[list]
 	[*][b]Working[/b] for other studios, on different games :)[/*]
 	[*][b]Moving[/b] from London to Kosice, Slovakia (pfew!)[/*]
 	[*][b]Finishing the first chapter[/b][b] [/b]of the PC version[/*]
 	[*]Adding [b]new rooms[/b] to the [b]second chapter [/b]of the PC version and [b]reworking lighting[/b][/*]
 	[*]Adding [b]cool new PC-exclusive features[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Answering[/b] to many Google Play comments from our players[/*]
 	[*][b]Adding[/b] [b]localization[/b] options (German, Russian & Spanish) to the Android & iOS (Pocket Edition) of the game[/*]
 	[*][b]Fixing[/b] a few [b]bugs[/b] reported by our Android players (thank you very much!)[/*]
[/list]


[h1]PC Release?[/h1]

Some of you have asked [b]why the game isn't released on PC yet[/b]. Others even wondered if we're still working on it.

The [b]initial plan[/b] was to release in [b]May 2016[/b].

However, the recent [b]gameplay and level additions[/b] that will drastically [b]improve the game experience[/b] have taken more time than expected.

[b]Why is that?[/b]

The main reason is that [b]I am the only one working on the game development[/b], while Amélie writes the[b] story and dialogs[/b].

Building a game takes time. Building a [b]good game [/b]takes [b]even more time[/b]. That's what we are trying to do.

If we were working full time on the game, it would already have been released. However, we are both [b]working full time in the games industry[/b] for other companies. We have recently been completing other projects, and we are now[b] moving from the United Kingdom to Slovakia [/b]to work on a new project!

[img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-19-1.png[/img]

Fractal Space is our [b]side project[/b]. It is very important for us - I work on [b]game building most evenings[/b] and over [b]weekends[/b]. Amélie thinks about the story as often as I think about new rooms, situations and features: [b]every day[/b].

In parallel of of building the new Steam version, I have also worked on [b]bug fixes for the Pocket Edition[/b]. We will release an update for mobile platforms within a month or 2 to fix all known issues, and[b] add German & Spanish[/b] localization.

Simple version: we are[b] never going to stop working [/b]on the game until it's properly released, but we are [b]creating out of passion[/b] - meaning that we do not have as much time as we would like to. The current goal is to [b]release before the end of 2016[/b]. It is currently hard for us to be more precise than this.

[img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-16.png[/img]

I would like to [b]thank all Android players that have generously donated[/b]. Some of you [b]have donated $7[/b], which is [b]awesome[/b]; and it [b]gives us hope[/b] that it's possible to release a game for [b]free[/b] and still get a a little reward for it! Thanks again ;)

Now, let's talk about the PC development update!

If you have not yet read the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791441391114/announcements/detail/812148329599609382][b]first PC Development Update we published in August[/b][/url], we recommend you have a quick look before scrolling down!


[h1]Press kit[/h1]

We are very pleased; we have received a [b]large number of CD Keys requests for press[/b] and Let's Play videos for YouTubers.

We can now say that [b]we will very soon be ready to send a preview build[/b] including the [b]first two chapters[/b] of the game! We will release a [b]new development update[/b] on this blog for the occasion, so keep your eyes open on our [url=https://twitter.com/HazeGamesStudio]Twitter[/url], [url=https://goo.gl/iUajY9]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://goo.gl/o2ZXWJ]Google+[/url] account ;)


[h1]Chapter 2 Lighting[/h1]

[img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-7.png[/img]

As we did for the first chapter, we have [b]reworked the lighting[/b] of the [b]second chapter[/b] of the game. That's a big part, so we're happy to have completed this :)

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-9.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-9.png[/img][/url]
[h1][url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-15.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-15.png[/img][/url][/h1]
 

[h1]Chapter 2 Additional Rooms[/h1]

[img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-20.png[/img]

We have added a few new rooms and challenges these past few weeks. They focus mainly on [b]using the Jetpack[/b] and [b]avoiding trap-enabling cameras[/b].

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-22.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-22.png[/img][/url]

Cameras can usually be disabled for a few seconds using your taser-gun. However, some of them might be [b]equipped with a force field[/b], making your beloved taser-gun useless against them!
[h1][url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-25.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-25.png[/img][/url][/h1]
[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-23.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-23.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-27.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-27.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Room Control[/h1]

We are adding the Room Control feature, which allows the player to [b]control certain security modules[/b] of the room!

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-26.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-26.png[/img][/url]

A [b]map of the current room [/b]is displayed. You can use it to[b] enable or disable security modules[/b] to help get past challenges that are apparently impossible.

If you feel like it - or you're afraid of the dark - you can also[b] switch on the lights[/b] ;)

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-24.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-24.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Laser-Equipped Cameras[/h1]

In the previous development news, we talked about [b]cameras[/b]. These cameras will set deadly traps once if they detect you.

Beware! You will now also encounter [b]laser-equipped cameras[/b], and these [b]will try to kill you[/b] on sight!

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-14.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-14.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/LaserCameraShoot.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/LaserCameraShoot.png[/img][/url]

If you move [b]quickly and swiftly[/b], you might successfully[b] avoid the camera's laser projectiles[/b] and [b]get to cover[/b] behind a crate. Or not...

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-21.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-21.png[/img][/url]

That's if for the development update! We hope you liked this post and screenshots, we'll keep you posted about Chapter 3 within the next two months. You can [b]expect a new development update when we release the press test builds[/b] around the end of July or beginning of August, hopefully ;)

Cheers, and Happy Gaming!

Charles & Amélie from Haze Games.
