We are adding the Room Control feature, which allows the player to [b]control certain security modules[/b] of the room!

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-26.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-26.png[/img][/url]

A [b]map of the current room [/b]is displayed. You can use it to[b] enable or disable security modules[/b] to help get past challenges that are apparently impossible.

If you feel like it - or you're afraid of the dark - you can also[b] switch on the lights[/b] ;)

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-24.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-11-24.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Laser-Equipped Cameras[/h1]

In the previous development news, we talked about [b]cameras[/b]. These cameras will set deadly traps once if they detect you.

Beware! You will now also encounter [b]laser-equipped cameras[/b], and these [b]will try to kill you[/b] on sight!

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-14.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-14.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/LaserCameraShoot.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/LaserCameraShoot.png[/img][/url]

If you move [b]quickly and swiftly[/b], you might successfully[b] avoid the camera's laser projectiles[/b] and [b]get to cover[/b] behind a crate. Or not...

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-21.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/2016-07-12-21.png[/img][/url]

That's if for the development update! We hope you liked this post and screenshots, we'll keep you posted about Chapter 3 within the next two months. You can [b]expect a new development update when we release the press test builds[/b] around the end of July or beginning of August, hopefully ;)

Cheers, and Happy Gaming!

Charles & Amélie from Haze Games.

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
[img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-2.png[/img]

[h1]Hello dear followers![/h1]
Since we have released the [url=http://haze-games.com/fractal_space]Pocket Edition[/url] of the game around a month ago on [i]Android[/i] & [i]iOS[/i], we have delivered [b]a few game updates[/b] that you can check out [url=http://haze-games.com/fractal-space-update-1-4-is-rolling-out]here[/url].

By the way, we just had a [b][url=http://www.pocketmeta.com/review-fractal-space-first-person-sci-fi-exploration-finest-39898/]great review from PocketMeta[/url][/b] :)

These past few weeks, we have mainly been working on the [b]PC version[/b] of the game.

We [b]do not want to deliver a simple[i] PC[/i] port[/b] of the[i] Pocket Edition[/i] on [i]Steam[/i] - we want to create the best experience possible, considering our small team of 2 with only 1 developer. [b]This[/b] is the reason why it takes so long.

Some of you might think:

[i]"Fractal Space on PC will just be a simple mobile port. It's basically the same game with keyboard and mouse!"[/i]

[b]We would like to prove you wrong[/b].

First of all, the [b]graphics are much better[/b] than the mobile version. The [b]levels will be more surprising[/b], even for a huge fan of the[i] Pocket Edition[/i], who may have completed it more than once.

What we mean by "surprising" is that levels are [b]longer[/b], more [b]challenging[/b], and make use of [b]exclusive new features[/b] that we could not implement on mobile devices.

The goal of this post is to show you a bit of the new stuff!


[h1]A Lifting is Always Good[/h1]
Here are a few new screenshots of some simple elements that simply [b]look nicer[/b] than the mobile version. Please note that [b]all images in this post are [i]Work in Progress[/i][/b]. Final quality might change and look better after polish phases:

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-8.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-8.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-54.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-54.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-7.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-7.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-21.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-21.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Duck![/h1]
The space station will now be[b] crawling with ventilation shafts[/b] ([i]oh, I see what you did here[/i]).

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-17.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-17.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-23.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-23.png[/img][/url]

You will need to[b] crouch through them[/b] to discover where they lead you. Let's hope they don't lead you straight into a whole new trap!

Of course, you'll also need to [b]crouch under nasty lasers[/b] and other mean things... ;)


[h1]It's dark in here, isn't it?[/h1]
We have been working a lot with lighting in the [i]PC[/i] version of[i] Fractal Space[/i]. You now have a[b] flashlight attached to your[i] Taser Gun[/i][/b], allowing you to see - even in the darkest corners of the space station:

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-30.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-30.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-43.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-43.png[/img][/url]

This flashlight will come in handy in many situations; lighting in the station might be[b] unstable[/b], and sometimes [b]you might need to cut the power[/b] in order to get past some [b]deadly traps[/b].

Beware! Your [b]flashlight intensity depends on the charge of your [/b][i][b]Taser Gun[/b],[/i] so don't go around shooting anything that moves, or you'll discover how dark the station can be ;)


[h1]Power-Up, Baby![/h1]
One of the new elements of the [i]PC[/i] version is the [i][b]Power Cores[/b][/i]. These little guys are portable batteries, allowing your to [b]power-up systems by inserting them inside[i] Power Stations[/i][/b].

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-44.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-44.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-56.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-56.png[/img][/url]

They will thankfully [b]turn on lights[/b] in the room, allowing you to walk around without your flashlight. They will also activate [b]lifts and moving platforms[/b], helping you reach the exit. However, they might [b]activate those lasers, [/b]who seemed to be useless until then!

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-49.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-49.png[/img][/url] [url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-52.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-52.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Big Brother Comes In[/h1]
We wanted to add [b]a little bit of life[/b] within the walls of the space station. We have added [b]static and moving cameras[/b]. Indeed, life couldn't be added without a bit of a [b]new challenge[/b] too :)

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-60.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2016-04-25-60.png[/img][/url]

Upon [b]detection of an intruder[/b] (hm... [i]yes, that might just be... [b]you[/b][/i]), these cameras will [b]enable set the room in lockdown[/b], preventing you from getting out. Since locking you up in isn't enough, they will - on some occasions - [b]enable traps[/b] to make your survival harder.

You will sometimes need to [b]shoot cameras with your [i]Taser Gun[/i][/b] [b]to stun them[/b] while you slip through.

When you do that, please be careful; after a strange stun coming out from nowhere, these cameras[b] enter a warning state[/b], in which they will [b]thoroughly search the room for intruders[/b]. You'd better be far away when it comes back to "consciousness" again!

Some cameras have [b]force fields[/b], [b]shielding them from any kind of attack[/b]. In this case, your best shot is to[b] stay hidden until things calm down[/b].

[url=http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Camera2.png][img]http://haze-games.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Camera2.png[/img][/url]

Oh, important note: all of these cameras [b]aren't[/b] [b]just about containing you[/b]. Some are[b] equipped with a laser-gun[/b] ([i]uh-oh...[/i]). You'd better be[b] extra careful[/b] while slipping through their line of sight!

At the time I am writing this post, we are quite close to[b] completing the first level of the PC version[/b]. We still have to [b]re-work all the next levels[/b] of the game, create[b] new rooms[/b], and [b]add new cool[/b] [b]PC-exclusive features like the above[/b] for you guys.

We'll keep you posted within the next few weeks about more things we'll be adding to the game! We hope you enjoyed having a little news :)

Cheers & Happy Gaming!
